tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā sbya muḥ/(sbya 085305nga000ji 'ang 5055'acu 7 bci kho migaX 507 khor
miX/༷ ཿ

phag mo gru pa'i gdan rabs kyi skabs/ de ltar bu slob byon pa'i rim pa che ba rnams ni phyi nas 'chad cing /rags pa cig brjod nas gdan sari tshul lugs ni/ 'jag spyil na bzhags pa'i sku 'dra rin po che 'di ni/ gshegs rjes kho nar bu slob rnams kyis sman dang rin po che dang dar zab la sogs bsres pa'i 'jim pa la gdung thal mang du btab ste bzhengs/ byin rlabs kyang shin tu che/ gsung yang lan mang du byon/ byi bas sku'i gdan gyi zur nas sa cung zad byas pa la/ dkon gnyer la gsung byon nas byi bas gnod pa byas pa'i rjes rnams bkag sa de rnams la ru ma byas te bzhengs pa'i sku 'dra'ang mang du yod pa la/ byi sa ma zhes grags/ bzo byed pa'i tshe sku'i cha shas nas lhag pa rnams dras pa'i sa la ru ma byas te bzhengs pa'i sku rnams la ni dras sa ma zhes grags/ chos khri la bzhugs pa'i sku 'dra 'di yang mar pa lha snying bya bas mang 'gar sgang du bzhengs/ rags pa grub pa na ga nas 'ongs cha med pa'i jo mo ma cig byung nas/ nga'i bla ma de 'di kho na 'dra/da bcas bcos ma byed zer bas ngo mtshar du gzung ste/ chos khri'i stengs su spyan drangs nas bzhags su gsol ba yin no/ /de nas 'gro mgon gshegs rjes su bla ma zhang gis dge 'dun gyi gral gong du bzhugs bsngo ba 671

ca ma mdzad kyang / lcags pho stag gi lo mjug nas me pho spre'u'i bar lo bdun du gdan sa ba med/ me mo bya nas sa mo phag gi bar lo ngo gsum du 'bri khung chos rjes gdan sa mdzad pa la longs spyod kyang chung zhing mkhan po ba la sogs pa'i grwa pa rnams kyang dad pa chung zhing re checho bar byung bas/'gro mgon la gsol ba btab pa na/ 'gro mgon byon nas za 'og gi 'bol rnying pa zhig 'dug pa 'di khong rang tsho la gtong la/ khyod rang dbu ru byang phyogs su song gsung ba'i lung bstan byung bas nam phyed na dpon g.yog lngas bros byon pas/ gnas po rdo ba'i sar tsha ba la phebs/ des zhabs tog byas shing phyam tshe gsar pa cig kyang phul/ gsang phu nas lam brgyud nas 'bri khung du sa mo phag la phebs so/ /de ltar sa mo phag gi smad nas me mo yos kyi bar yang gdan sa pa med/ 'on kyang stag lung chos rjes dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bdun bzhes shing / 'bri khung chos rjes lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa sa pho rta'i lo la gtsug lag khang chen mo bzhengs te/de yang mang 'gar sgang du bzhengs na rdo rje gdan tshun chad 'du ba cig thong byas nas 'bri khung pas gsung pa la/ stag lung bas nga'i bla ma'i zhu rjen par 'jog pa mi 'ong gsung nas/ gtsug lag khang gi nang du 'jag spyil yod pa cig byed dgos byung bas/ rnam pa gnyis pos brag rkon chen mo mdzad cing gtsug lag khang legs par bzhengs/ der rten dang gsung rab kyang mang du byung / phyi nas ngams shod kyi btsad po gnyi ma 672

'cham pas/ bud med rnams gangan sa bshigaste ngeng rang rnams kyi bal kur du ra gan gyi dum bu tho re ba gcig byed zer ba'i tshe/ 'bri khung chos rjes phyag rdzas shin tu mang bar bsnams nas bsam yas kyi zhig gsos la'ang mang du bzhag btsad po gnyis la'ang nor mang du byin nas bsdums kyang ma 'du mas/ 'on kyang mdzad pa des lo bco brgyad kyi bar du 'khrug pa ma byung / yang gyis 'bri khung chos rjes phyags phyir dge 'dun mang po khrid nas/ gdan sa'i cigasung rab rnams sgam por spyan drangs pas/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyi blo dang yang ma mthun/ gro sa'i rnal 'byor byang sang gis/khos bla ma'i gdan sa bshig zer ba'i skur pa yang btab/ stag lung chos rjes kyang / nga'i bla ma'i gdan sar chos rnams bzhugs su mi 'jug par gsung nas yi chad mang po mdzad/ rkyen des thugs 'khrugs pas stag lung chos rje gshegs pa yin zer ba byung yang / 'bri khung chos rje nyid ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dgongs pas/ 'jig rten pa dang mi mthun pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba yin zhes gsung / spyir 'bri khung pa dang stag lung pa gnyis kyis bar skabs der gdan sa'i thugs khur cher bzhes kyang gdan sa'i nyams pa gso ma nus/ de nas 'bri khung chos rjes drug cu rtsa drug bzhes/ pa sa pho 'brug gi lo la rje spyan snga dgung lo sum cu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa zhig gdan sar phebs te/ de yang nyin cig khri mthon po la stan bzang po bshams/ de'i thog tu rje spyan snga bzhugs su 673

bcug chos rje nyid thang rkyang mdzad nos phyag legs par mdzad/ nyom khas phan chad khyed nga'i bu yin/ slob ma yin/ de ring nas khyed nga'i bla ma yin/ pha yin zhes gsungs te/ phag mo grur brdzangs/ de la rje spyan snga ni gnas drug gi sa char mkhan po bo d+dhi sa ta'i mkhan bu khams pa go cha dang / slob dpon pad+ma'i dngos slob a mi byang chub 'dre bkol gnyis kyi gdung rabs grub thob dang sde dpon brgyud mar byung ba'i rlangs lha gzigs kyi rigs te/ yab yon chen rgyal ba skyabs dang / yum 'bro ldog gza' gyu gu lcam gnyis kyi sras su shing mo lug la bltams/'di phag mo gru pa gshegs nas lo drug pa yin/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la spyi gnas g.yo gu zhes bya bar mkhan po rdzong mgo ba dang / slob dpon ston pa zhes pa thang po che ba gnyis la rab tu byung mtshan grags pa 'byung gnas su gsol/ rab tu byung nas lo ngo gsum du bla ma ye phug pa'i spyan sngar thun 'jog dang lhan cig skyes sbyor la sogs pa'i khrid 'ga' zhus/dgung lo bco lnga pa la yab la bla ma ye phug pa'i phyir tar du 'gro byas pas rta bzang po cig bskur byung bas de chibs nas dkar shod du bros byon/dpon bla mas bsun rta dang g.yog cig kyang btang byung / 'phral gyi ci dgos kyang bskur nas rag shi'i 'bul skyel dang bsdongs nas 'bri khung du byon/ yab spun mkhan po ye shes bla mas bsu ba dang dgyes pa mdzad/ khong gis sprogs mdzad nas mjal du byon pas chos rje chos khri dmar po la 674

bzhugs pa dang thog mar mjal bas/ chos rje zhal 'dzum mdzad nas dbu'i thog tu phyag bzhag nas bu tsha 'di kun mig rtsa dang grung / bsags pa yang che/ zha'u'i gyon lugs dang bcas pas/ khyod kyang sgom chen cig tu brdzu bar 'ong gsung / der phyag dbu la bzhag pa tsam gyis chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po bya ba de thugs la lhang gis 'khrungs/ chibs de tshogs su phyag tu phul bas mnyes pa dpag tu med pa mdzad/ de rjes lo ngo gsum du dpon byang 'od dang gnyis kyis chos rjes gnang ba'i spyil po cig tu lhan cig tu thugs dam mdzad/ bcu bdun pa la chos rje dgas por gshegs pa'i phyags phyir byon/ chos rje zangs lung du bzhugs pa'i tshe sgam po ba'i sku 'bag la gsol ba btab pas/ smin mtshams nas 'od byung bas dwags lung pa khengs pa'i ngo mtshar yang gzigs/ sku khams cung zhig mnyel ba la chos rje'i gsung nas/ bod phyug gcig la 'di sku gces/ 'di da lan ma grongs na gyis dwags po bka' brgyud kyi rten sa cig 'ong gsung nas rim gro'ang mdzad/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ da khyed la sku tshe la sogs pa la bar chad gang yang med/ rnal 'byor pa mgo rgyal ba bya ba yin gsung / de nas chos rje phag mo grur phebs pa'i tshe nye gnas kyang mdzad/ chos rje 'on du lha 'bri sgangs ba mjal du byon pa'i tshe/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs pa gyis gsung bas/ kho pos lo bco brgyad las ma lon zhus pas/ 'dul ba nga 675

mkhas pa yin/ de la bsnyen par rdzogs pa rung gsung nas/ zhang sum thog pas mkhan po dang / lha 'bri sgangs pas las slob dang / mkhan po rin po ches gsang ste mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas 'bri khung du chos rje'i gzims g.yog mdzad pas spyan snga bar grags/ chos rje chos gsung ba'i tshe g.yas su bzhugs nas chos rnams gsan/ gzims g.yog tshar ba dang srod la de thams cad tshang bar bshar/ nam gung la mnyam par 'jog chos rje tshogs su 'bul ba bzhes pa dang / chos gsungs nas gzims khang du phebs nas thugs dam mdzad pa'i bar la gsol ja sun re gsol nas/ mkhan po rin po che dang jo bo ngam shod pa la sogs pa gsung ma 'khyor ba rnams kyi skyar grogs mdzad/ lo bco brgyad nas sum bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du 'bral med du phyags phyi mdzad/ phag mo gru nas chos rjes sgam por chos spyan drangs pa la stag lung ba dang ngams shod pa rnams gdan sa la 'di 'dra ba mdzad zer nas nyer ba la/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ ngas gdan sa brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur du bzang du btang cig gsung nas rje spyan snga btang / dam bus tshogs pa 'di tsam bskyangs pa'i phud rje phag mo gru pa la 'bul ba yin gsung / de la rje spyan snga 'dis logs shig tu dben par sgrub pa ma mdzad kyang / chos rje la sangs rgyasakyi 'du shes dang skad cig ma gcig kyang ma bral/ de lta na yang sangs rgyasayin pas mi dgos mi gsung bar gsol ba dang na bza' dang zhabs bsku 676

ba sogs phran tshegs thams cad la dus ma yol bar mdzad/ rgyu mtshan des thams cad las mngon par 'phags par gyur pa yin/ chos rjes ngams shod kyi bcad po dang khu sgom sogs che dgu rnams la ja dang dar gyi gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad nas/ slob dpon 'di gangs ti ser bzhud dgongs pa dam bus gdan sa der brdzangs pa yin/ khong la lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na 'gran zla med pa cig 'ong bas/ khyed ngams shod pa rnams kyis kyang zhabs spyi bor long gsung / rje spyan sngag gdan sar phebs 'phral de la/ chos rjes la ril rgyas btab pa cig skyel btang byung ba bshig nas gzigs pas/ nang bde chen ting 'dzin mi brtan par/ /lus ngag yid gsum rnam par g.yengs/ /gzhan rgyud byin gyis mi rlob pas/ /sgom gsal chab la mi dbo zhu/ /zhes bya ba 'dug pas/ de bzhin du gdan sar bzhugs pa'i tshe chos rje'i phyag len dang mthun par thub pa'i dbang pos bsngags pa'i 'dul ba'i bcas pa las mi nyams pa dang /chos gsung ba'i tshe ma gtogs sku mtshams kho na la bzhugs/ phyi rol gyi kha mchu la sogs pa'i bya ba mi mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams kyang thugs dam la bskul/ mdzad pa bla na med pa des ngams shod pa rnams kyang chos rje'i gsung kho na ltar gdan sa brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur la song / nged rang rnams la 'di 'dra ba'i bla ma yod zer nas mig 'phangs mtho bar byed/bsam yas kyi lha btsun zhi ba 'od kyi bu cig na nas bru sha rig 'dzin pa 67tsho

lam nas bos na rtsis bya pas/ bu 'de'i lo jo bo la gnod sku srog la 'bab zer bas/ thabs med dam byas pas/ jo bo'i yum sto la btang na des sab zer nas jo bo'i ma lto la btang bas shi/ bus lo drug lon ba'i tshe ci phan byas pas da lo cis kyang mi phan 'grongs zer/ thabs gtan med dam byas pas ngams shod klungs na bzang ba'i dge bshes shig la sto thengs na thub zer/ su bzang byas pas rje spyan sdo bzang bar kha 'cham nas spyan drangs te bsgyur bar byas pas bru sha na re/ de rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pa yin par 'dug pas mi 'gyur ram zer bas ma nyan par/cis kyang gdan drangs nas bsgyur zer nas gdan 'dren btang bas/ thams cad kyis rje spyan snga la mi gshegs par zhus pas/ a'u rtsi rkang bzhi thams cad seng se gcig gis zil gyis gnon pa dang 'dra/ dam bu seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas gzhan thams cad sgril gyis gnon pa yin gsung nas thegs/ bru shas dang po zam pa'i khar grod pa chus thug la ri mo sna tshogs bris nas rlung gis bskyod pa byas/ zam pa'i khar spyang gi'i gzugs la gzugs brnyan bskyon/ khang pa'i gong la la yang sto rigs mang po byas/ bzhugs khri 'og na yang khyi ro sko ba la ba dang / thod pa so gtsogs pa'i nang du sto bcug pa bzhag de nas rje spyan snga byon pas/bru sha na re/ sngon la rta nag zhon pa cig byung na sto mi 'gyur zer/ slob dpon ti se ba rta nag cig zhon nas sngon la yer te byung bas/ sto mi 'gyur 678

ba 'dug zer/ slob dpon bram zes rag dung cig khur yod pa bus gsung nas bus pas/ tsag rgyangs can cig byung bas/ da des chog gsung de nas chibs rna mas zam pa la ma byon par rab la byon pas/ spyang gi'i gso ba lagazugs brnyan bskyon pa de kho rang la kha gtad nas 'gyel/rje'i zhal nas/ nye gnas kun la dang por khri de gul ba cig gyis/ de nas lhung bzed de zhog des thub gsung / zhabs g.yon pa khri la bzhag pas khri de tsal zer nas rnams te song / zhal shar blta byas 'dug pas rje spyan sngas lhor bstan nas bzhugs pa dang / bru sha shed med sto yog khong la mi 'gyur ram byas pas ma nyan/ da nga yang yul du e sleb/ de nas 'chi/ jo bo rang yang thabs yod na gyis dang gzhan 'chi zer ba/ bru sha zhag bdun na shi/ jo bo zla ba gsum na mis bsad/rje spyan snga 'khor dang bcas pa la nyes pa ci yang ma byung ngo / /de'i lo rgyus 'bri khung du byung bas/ khyed kyis lhung bzed kyi tshab tu sdud pa cig bzhag na de bas 'jam pa cig 'ong ba yin te/ zhes 'bri khung chos rjes gsung / bsam yas btsad po'i sto 'og tu ma tshud pa'i dbang gis/rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhes grags/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas kyang /thub chen bdud las rgyal ba'i spyan snga ba/ /zhes bstod par mdzad/mdor na rje thams cad mkhyen pa des spyir tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa'i stong du gong ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas tshil bu btab pa'i thug pa yang mi 679

bzhes/ sngar dgon pa yun ring du rnyings pas dge 'dun gyi nang na hral le 'dug pa rnams kyang tshul dang mthun pa dang sgom pa kho na la sbyar/byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis thel ba nyid kha mchu mi mdzad par ma zad/ gnyal phyin yar klungs la sogs kyi 'khrug pa thams cad zhi/ mu ge med cing thams cad kyis spyan snga rin po che la skyabs 'gro ku di ri byed pa'i ngang nas/ gdan sar lo nyi shu rtsa drug bzhugs/ de nas 'bri khung du dbon rin po che zhi bar gshes/sa pa'i ma legs skyel du byon nas gdung 'bul mdzad nas zhag 'ga' song ba dang / gcung rin po che dang / 'bri khung gling pa dang / 'gar chos sdings pa dang / sgom pa rnams kyis gros byas nas/ 'bri khung du bzhugs pa'i zhu ba phul bas/zhag bcu gsum du zhal gyis ma bzhes/ tha ma la stag lung pa dang bka' gad /sa pa sogs dang rgya 'dre mi byed pa'i rtsigs gzung nas/ gdan sa rin po cher lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ der bzhugs pa'i lo bdun pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo la hor dmag gis 'dam du sleb pa'i 'ur byung bas/'bri khung thel gyi dge 'dun rnams kyang 'bros par rtsom pa'i tshe/ mi 'jiṭa pa'i gsung gis dbugs phyung nas bzhugs/ de yang thog mar hor gyi dmag dpon mi li byi byung ba/ sku mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa skyes nas pha dang bu'i 'du shes byung nas phyis 'bul ba skyel bar khas blangs te/ mi phyugs gang la yang gnod pa med par phyir log de nas zhag nyi shu rtsa 680

brgyad na dor rtas dmag dpon byas nas sleb byung bas/ khos sgom spro shāka rin gyi lag pa nas gzung nas khrid pas nam mkha' nas rdo'i char bab/kho na re/ 'di ci yin zer bas/ khyed kyis dam bu'i sgom pa gzung bas dam bu ma dgyes/ dam bu ma dgyes pas gnam ma dgyes te rdo char byung ba yin gsungs pas / 'dis ci byed pa yin zer/ dam bu so nam ni mi byed/ gzhan gyis 'bul ba byung ba rnams 'di'i lag tu gtad nas dge 'dun skyong ba yin gsungs pas/ gdug pa can de yang zhi ba chen por gyur te/ dmag rnams tshong pa 'grim pa bas kyang 'jam zhing khu co med par log/ de phyin chad stabs nyes re tsam ma gtogs mi bsad pa dang lha khang bsregs pa sogs cher ma byung / de ltar na thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang du mdzad pas 'bri khung gi sde yang cher 'phel/ khri tsho bco brgyad du grags pa yang dus der byung / de'i tshe gcung rin po che la zhin 'then pa 'ga' zhig gis cung zad mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pas/da ni 'gro ba yin gsung nas ma zad kyi thad cig tu sgar mdzad/ de gcung gis mtshams khul nas gzigs pas don dgongs te/ mtshams la rtar 'don mdzad nas spyan snga rin po che la bzhugs par zhus pas ma gnang ba la/ gcung gis/ da 'o na khyed rgya gar yul na sku khams bzang 'dug zer na yang / de bar du nga gdan sa la sdom ri byas nas dbu bsnyung phul bas/ 'o na da gzu ba dgus phul kyang mi 'gro gsung nas 'bri khung nyid 681

du bzhugs/ bod khams spyi la bka' drin gyis khyab par mdzad/ rin po che las bsgrabs pa'i sgo mangs gnyis kyang bzhengs/ rgya gar dang bod kyi lha gdong ༵ la sogs pa'i dam pa thams cad kyang chos kyis tshim par mdzad de/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig nga shing mo yos kyi zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco brgyad la gshegs/ gdung bzhu bas ring bzel dpag tu med pa'ang byon/ bu slob rnams kyis kyang dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir sgo mangs khyad par can cig kyang bzhengs/ gyin chad kyang shin tu bkra shis par gyur to/ /bu slob kyang rgyal ba rin po che/ bcu gnyis pa/ gcung rin po che/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ rin po che grags bsod/ rin po che gter rgyab pa/ spyan snga sgo mang pa/ snye mdo thams/ cad mkhyen pa la sogs pa mang du byon no/ /rin po che grags bsod pa ni/ dpon shes rab rgyal gyi sras su gyur pa rgyal ba'i gcen po yin te/ mngon mkhyen dang sprul bsgyur nus pa sogs mnga'/dpon po shar gling bar grags/ phyis rdo chu'i rgyud kyis skad du zla dgon btab nas phrin las kyang rgyun chags su byung bas tsa rir ri thebs kyang nga lta bar du gtong ba'i srol ma chad do/ /sgo mangs pa ni/ sgo mangs bzhengs pa'i zhal brda mdzad pas sgo mangs par grags/ ti ser theb pa la byon dus lam du 'tsho ba med pa la gzhi bdag gis 'bri'i ro skyur ba mngon shes kyis mkhyen pa sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' zhing /682

sgos lung du bzhugs nas 'gro don rgya che bar byung ngo / /rgyal ba rin po che ni/ yon chen sangs rgyas skyabs dang yum ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis kyi sras su chu mo phag gi lo la sku bltams/ dgung lo bco lnga la mkhan po ston pa dang slob dpon lan ba la rab tu byung mdzad de/ mtshan grags pa brtson 'grus su btags/ dgung lo bcu drug la dbus su phebs/ rje spyan sngas byin rlabs mdzad pas rtogs pa 'khrungs shing / dgung lo bcu dgu la 'bri khung du byon/ mkhan po ston pa dang / las slob shar gling pa/ gsang ston yung ba pa rnams la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de nas sgrub pa mdzad pas sprul bsgyur nus pa byung / dgung lo sum cu rtsa gsum pa shing mo lug gi lo la gdan sa'i go sar phebs/ rje spyan snga 'bri khung du thegs pa'i phyi lo de yin/ lo sum cu rtsa gsum bzhugs/ lan cig thog babs pa sku chos kyis gtums pas gnod pa med pas thog thugs par grags/ yon tan gyi snyan pa gsan pas rgyal po hu las stod nas 'bul mo che lan gsum byas gzhan yang siṅgā gling / ti ra hu ti/ ya tshe'i rgyal po rnams kyis kyang 'bul ba mang du byas/ de nas drug cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa me mo yos kyi tshes bco brgyad la dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs/gdung bzhu bas me tog gi char dang 'od chen po gnyis byung bas nyi ma gsum shar zer ba byung / gdung gis kyang gsung lan gnyis byon/ gdung sbyangs pa'i tshe byang chub chen po'i mchod rten zur bzhir ring bsrel gyis 683

brgyan pa slo/ sogs pa dpag tu med pa shin tu mang ba byon/ bu slob kyang grub thob smon lam 'bar zhes pa khrug 'o mar 'bab pa'i ngo mtshar can sogs mang du byon/ rgyal ba rin po che la gcung bcu gnyis pa/ gter rgyab rin po che la rdor rin pa 'khrungs pa las/ bcu gnyis pa ni/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i sku skyer yang grags te/ sa pho stag gi lo la 'khrungs/slob dpon nam 'gag pa las rab tu byung / mtshan rin chen rdo rjer gsol/ lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la dbus su byon nas rje spyan snga dang mjal/nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la mkhan po zhang se gseb bar pa dang / slob dpon yar khang pa dang / gsang ston stod lungs pa rnams las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/de'i rjes su rje la bka' brgyud kyi chos rnams rdzogs par gsan/ lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du sngas la dbu mi 'jog pa'i dam bca' mdzad nas thugs da / mdzad pas du ma ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'khrungs/ rje gshegs khar byin rlabs mdzad pas rtogs pa mthar son/ de rjes rgyal ba'i drung du zab khrid lhag ma rnams gsan/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa me mo yos la gdan sar phebs/ lo bcu bzhi bzhugs/ rab gnas dang rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes/ mngon par mkhyen pa thogs pa med pa dang / bu hrangs lo chung gi dgra nag la gsol ba btab pas snyo rgyud kyi 'khrug pa zhi/ sman lung ba/ rdor thog pa/ dpon thung ri ba rdo rje dpal rnams kyis rin po che pa lha ru ka dang rta mgrin dang byams par mthong ba 'a/ sogs pa'i yon 684kyi

tan dpag tu meng pa mnga'/ gdan sar phebs pa nyid nas rgyal ba rin po che'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi sgo mangs 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di bzhengs te/ gdan sa'i sgo mangs rnams kyi thog ma yin/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyin gshegs/ lo 'di la 'gro mgon 'phags pa yang gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pas me tog gi char dang / gdung la bde mchog dang / rta mgrin dang / sgrol ma dang / spyan ras gzigs rnams byon zhing ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon no/ /de la bu slob mang bar byung ba'i nang nas/ mkhan chen kun gsal ba rin chen rgyal po zer ba/ rje btsun mi la la byung ba'i thugs dam gyi nyams rnams byung na'ang / ri khrod du sdod yun thungs pas rus pa khyor ba ya gyal gang byung zer ba de dang /slob dpon ston nag la sogs mang du byon no/ /rin po che grags pa ye shes pa ni/ dpon mgon po rgyal gyi sras po khro bo 'ban la/ bu rin chen shes rab/ rin po che ba/ gnyis mchod pa/ dpon rin chen skyabs dang bzhi 'khrungs pa la/ rin po che grags ye ba lcags pho byi ba la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu la rje spyan snga dang mjal/ zlar dgon du yig klogabaslabs/ de rjes rgyal ba'i bkas phag mo grur byon nas rab tu byung /chos khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan/ de nas sa skyar 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i spyan sngar byon/ thogs pa re la mdo sngad pa tshar re tsam mkhye na pa 685

byung nas shes rab che bar grags/ slar bcu gnyis pa la zab chos bsi na nas sgrub pa mdzad/ zhe gnyis pa lcags mo sbrul la gdan sar phebs nas lo brgyad bzhugs/ zhe dgu pa sa pho byi ba la gshegs/ grags ye ba gdan sar byon pa'i lcags sbrul 'di la hor dmag bod du shor nas bya rog rdzong hor dmag gis bcom/ dpon chen kun dga' bzang po hor gyis bsad/ de'i rting lo'i chu rta la grub chen u rgyan pas bstan rtsis bsam yas su mdzad/ grub chen pas gdan sa thel du phebs pa yang rin po che grags ye ba'i dus yin/ khong gdan sar byon nas lo gsum pa lus lo la yin/ lo de la gar ma pa shi gshegs/ sha grags seng ba 'khrungs/de'i phyi lo shing sprel rang byung rdo rje 'khrungs/ rin po che gnyis mchod pa ni/ lcags pho khyi la 'khrungs/ lo drug pa la rje spyan snga gshegs/ bcu gnyis pa la tshogs khrid gsan/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan grags pa rin chen du btags/ bzhi bcu pa sa mo glang la gdan sar byon/ lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du bzhugs/ ti shrī grags 'od dang rgyal bu gnyis kyis stag mgo gnang bas bla dpon sbrags/ gdan sar byon pa'i lo gnyis pa lcags pho stag la sa skya pas 'bri khung bcom/ sku 'bum shar nub kyi gser thog khyad par can 'di rngams kyang khong gi ring la ya tshe rgyal pos phul nas byung ste spyan snga gser thog par grags/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig rnga lcags pho rtse'i lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu gsum la gshegs/ dung 686

mtsho ras pas 'di gdan sar bzhugs ring la gtugs pa yin/ snas bzhi rnying ma ba ni/ dpon rin chen skyabs dang zhang lcam ma'i sras su chu mo sbrul gyi lo la 'khrungs/ sum la rmi ltas bzang po mang po byung / sku na gzhon nu'i dus su mkhan po tshul dar dang / slob dpon zhang btsun bu hrangs pa las rab tu byung ba'i mtshan grags pa rgyal mtshan du gsol/mkhan po tshul dar 'di kun dgar ra ba'i zhal ngo yin/ dpon po gzhon nu bzang po la dpon po zer ba yang khong gi dbon po yin pas ming du chags/ gnyis mchod pa la chos khrid rnams zhus/ bla ma lha khang bas chos sgo phye/ bla ma brag pa rin chen la chos skyong rnaca/sa gsan/ de dus khyed la chos skyong 'go bar 'dug gsung nas lung bstan/ bla ma ti se ba dar ma rgyal po sogs la bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa'i zhib cha rnams gsan/ de nas lcags khyi bco brgyad pa la gdan sar byon/ lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi bar tshogs pa bskyangs/ pra ti ba dang ti se ba'i ri ba rnams la mngon mkhyen gsungs/ gshegs khar mkha' 'gro mas bsu ba dang seng ge'i khri la gshegs pa mthong ba'ang byung / dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs/ gdung sbyangs bas ring bsrel mang du byon/ khyad par can gyi slob ma bcu gnyis rin po che dang / snga tshar gyi slob ma bla ma mkhar thog pa zer ba lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa mdzang pas mngon mkhyen mnga' ba dang / bla ma sne'u ba dang /687

rdor 'dzin sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes pa spros bral rtogs pa dang / bla ma mgon gzhon pa zhes pa ye shes mgon po'i zhal gzigs pa sogs skya/nga du byon/ phyi tshar la mtshungs med rin gzhon pa zhes pa sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa la sogs pa mang du byon no/ /bcu gnyis gsar ma ba ni/ khri smon ma 'bum skyid la dpon rin chen skyabs kyi sras ta'i si tu/ bcu gnyis gsar ma ba/ drung bsod nams bzang po ba rnams 'khrungs pa las/ grags shes pa lcags pho khyi la 'khrungs/ shing skam la me tog shar ba la sogs ltas khyad par can byung / lo brgyad la thel du phebs/ dgu la mkhan chen g.yung drung bsod nams dang slob dpon dbang bsod gnyis las rab tu byung nas/ mtshan grags pa shes rab tu btags/tshes bzhi pa la chos khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu'i thog tu mkhan chen seng rgyal ba la bsnyen par rdzogs/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/bu ston rin po che/ rgyal sras thogs med pa sogs la chos mang du gsamyo /yar klungs stod kyi sna mo rdzong du chos skyong gi bsnyen pa dung phyur tsam mdzad/mngon par mkhyen pa mnga' bar yang grags/ sems bskyed gsungs pas me tog gi char lan mang du bab/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa lcags byi la gdan sar byon/ lo bcu gcig bzhugs nas drug cu rtsa gcig pa lcags pho khyi'i zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum la gshegs/ tshes bzhi gsar ma ba ni/ drung rin rdor ba dang zin bkra shis skyid kyi sras rgyal sras grags 688

tshonadi la chos rje nyer gnyis pa 'khrungs/ gshegs rjes su'ang me tog gi char bab/ ring bsrel kyang mang bar byon/ rje btsun tshong kha pa chen pos kyang zhabs drung du gtugs nas chos drug la sogs pa zab chos rnams gsan/thugs shin tu mas pas rtogs brjod lhun po'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad do/ /chos rje bsod grags pa ni/ dpon rin rdor ba dang ngo brag pa dpon mo rin mtsho'i sras su sa mo phag la 'khrungs/ lo dgu pa la bcu gnyis pa la dge bsnyen mdzad/ chos khrid rnams gsan/ de'i rjes su sne'u gdong du chos rje bla ma dam pas mkhan po dang / mkhan chen gzhon dbang pas slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu pa la rtses thang du byon nas lo lnga gdan sa mdzad/ lha sar dge bshes mang du 'tshoṭa pa'i sar chas 'khor mdzad/ de nas lo chen byang rtse dang mkhan chen gzhon dbang pa/ slob dpon tshul rgyal rnams las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sne'u gdong rtse'i go sar lo lnga bzhugs/ me pho stag gi lo dgung lo nyer brgyad pa la thel gyi gdan sar byon nas lo nyi shu bzhugs/ mtsho dkar ba la phyag chen gyi khrid sogs mang du gsan pas thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la chos skyong gi rjes gnang gsan dus/ chos skyong chung ba 'di slob dpon bsod grags la 'khor ba cig thong ba 'dug gsung ba bzhin du chos skyong gis phrin las bsgrub pas/ khyung pos gdan sa pa'i phrin las pa la rgyab pa la khyung po rnams la cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa byung /690

gangs rdib kyis yul khams brlag pa sogs mang du byung / log par sgrub pa gzhan mang po'ang phung / thub pa chu khol ma la gsol pa btab pas stod lungs phur chu khol/ byang du stog tshang stengs su sgar mdzad pas mi phyugs gang la'ang gnod pa med/ snang sgom zhes pa nang ba'i chos la thugs dam du byed kyang / 'phral bon po'i tshul 'dzin cing mngon shes yod par grags pa zhig gis spyan snga nas la gnyan thang lhas bsu ba byed pa dang / chos skyong mang po byon par mthong bas dad de rab tu byung /glang lung pas rdo rje 'chang dngos su mthong ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma mnga' tho/ /gdan sar lo nyi shu bzhugs shing gdan sa gtad nas kyang lo bzhi bzhugs te/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa sa pho byi ba'i lo la gshegs/zhag zhe dgu'i bang du me tog gi char dpag tu med pa bab bo/ /spyan snga dpal ldan bzang po ba ni/ yab bdag po shāka rin pa dang / yum zi na rin chen 'dzom pa la sras drug yod pa'i bzhi pa/ chu mo phag la 'khrungs/dgung lo gsum pa la spyan snga grags pa byang pa la dge bsnyen mdzad/ mtshan dpal ldan bzang por btags/ dgu pa la brtag gnyis kyi slob gnyer mdzad/ bcu pa la spyan snga kun spangs pa la chos khrid rnams gsan/mkhan chen grags rdor ba dang slob dpon zhi ba dpal gnyis la rab tu byung / mtshan grags pa blo gros su btags/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab kyis chos sgo phye/ bcu bzhi pa la rtses thang du brtag gnyis gsungs/691

nyer gcigapa la mtshams bcad dpon po mdzad/ nyer gnyis la mkhan chen sang blo ba dang / mkhan chen rgyal bzang pas las slob/ gsang ston mkhan chen dka' bcu pas mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer gsum pa shing mo bya la spyan snga'i go sar phebs/ bla chen rin gzhon pa la bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams rdzogs par gsan/ tshogs lo gnyis bskyangs nas nyer lnga pa me mo phag gi lo zla ba bcu pa'i nyer dgu la gshegs/ spyan snga bsod nams bzang po ba ni/ lcags pho spre'u la 'khrungs/ spyan snga grags byang pa la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus/ spyan snga bsod grags pa la chos khrid mang du zhus/ mkhan chen grags rdor ba dang slob dpon tshul rgyal ba las rab tu byung / chos sgo ba tshul khrims bzang pos brda bzhi'i dbang bskur/ brtag gnyis la gsan sbyong mdzad nas rtses thang du gsungs/rje rin po che blo bzang grags pa dang mkhan chen bsod bzangs bas thog drangs rnams la dbang rgyud man ngag mang du gsan/ nyer dgu pa sa pho byi ba la gdan sar byon/ bla chen rin gzhon pa la bka' brgyud kyi chos khrid rnams zhus/ sa mo lug gi lo la rje blo bzang grags pa/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang pa/ gsang ston pa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad de bkra shis do khar bsnyen par rdzogs/ gdan sar lo dgu bzhugs nas so bdun pa shing pho spre'u'i lo ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer brgyad la gshegs/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ yab 692 1

bdag pho shākya rin chen pa dang / yum zi na rin chen 'dzom pa gnyis la sras drug 'khrungs pa'i lnga tshigs pa me pho stag gi lo la sku 'khrungs/ spyan mi 'dzums par mnal mdzad pa zhig byung bas/ mkhan chen dka' bcu pa'i gsung nas/ bla ma 'phags pa yang chung ngu'i dus su spyan ma btsum par mnal mdzad pa zhig byung bas/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis 'di la 'od gsal gyi bag chags stug po yod par 'dug ces gsungs pa bzhin du/ drung pa 'di la yang 'od gsal gyi bag chags 'thug po yod par 'dug ces gsung / sku chung ngu nas thugs gsal zhing gzhan sdug bsngal ba gzigs pa na spyan chab ngang gis 'byung / dgung lo drug pa la mkhan chen sang blo ba la gshed dmar gyi dbang gsan/ bdun pa nas brtag gnyis la gsan sbyong mdzad/ de'i dgun mkhan chen grags rdor ba dang / slob dpon zhi ba dpal dang / dus sgo ba chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab pas mdzad der rab tu byung / lo gsum gyi bar du rgyud kyi gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i skabs shig tu/ chos rje legs pa ba la byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/brtag gnyis 'phags mtshan bsdus don dang bcas pa'i lung yang gsan/ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang yang gsan/ chos rje byang rgyal ba la tshe dbang / chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab la phag mo brda bzhi'i dbang /spyan snga bsod grags pa la chos drug gi mgyogs khrid dang / ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang / sku rags ma'i rgya gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa la 6933

so sa pa dang / dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum la sogs pa gsan/mkhan chen bka' bcu pa la kye dor lha dgu'i dbang dang rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sogs mang du gsan/ mkhan chen bsod bzangs pa la tshe sgrubadang rta ma na la sogs pa mang du gsan/ chos rje byang rgyal pa la dusa'akhong ye shes le'u'i bshad pa dang / paṇa chen gyi snyan brgyud bdun la sogs pa mang du gsan/ zha lu rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan pa la yo ga'i dbang so che la sogs pa'i dbang mang du gsan/ gtso por thugs sbyong dang bde mchog gi bsnyen pa sbrel bas/ dgung lo dgu pa'i tshe bsnyen pa 'bum tsho gsum song / bcu gcig pa la rtses thang du bshad gsar mdzad de brtag gnyis gsungs/ der rting slob dpon sher don pa la brten nas tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi zugs sbyong mdzad nas mkhas par mkhyen te/ rtse chen pa grags yon la sog pa'i mkhas pa du ma sku mdun du bos nas rigs lung sbyangs/ chos rje nyid kyi bgro gleng tshar nas khong rnams kyi bar la chos skyong gi bsnyen pa mdzad pas sa ya dgu song / bco lnga bzhes pa'i tshe rtses thang nas rigs par smra ba'i sdi sgod 'dzin pa nyi brgya tsam phugs phyir khrid nas/ lha sar skyi shod kyi sde sdod 'dzin pa chen po rnams spyan drangs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de'i tshe skyid shod lung pa na mkhas shing sku no bgres pa rgyal ba'i mas po bde 'byung ba'i gsung gis/sde stod kyi rgya bdag chin 'jam dbyangs pa de che/ ston pa ni 'di pa bzang 694

gsung nas bsngags pa mdzad/ de'i tshe jo shāka rnam gnyi la go zung la sogs pa'i bye brag kyang mang du phul/ de'i tshe gong ma chen po la gzhan gyis snyan phra byas pas/ slob dpon sher don ba kong por mkha' spyod pa'i drung du thegs dgos byung / de nas gong mas slob dpon du snye thang pa rin chen rgyal po bskos nas gsas khang du chos bar la bzhugs pha la/ phra ma zhu ba po la gtor ma cig mdzad pas gtor ltas kyang legs par byung gsung / de nas slob dpon gzims chung du bzhugs su bcug gzims g.yog pa dpon sangs rgyas kyis zhabs 'bring byas nas mtshan mo bros te byon pas/ char chen po bab nas 'o brgyal ba byung / de nas mtshan de nyid la shan ljang 'phrang gi mar zur du phab nas/ snga dro na bza' rnams bskams/ de nas zhabs thang la byon pa na/ zhabs kyis cung zad ma pher ba'i tshe ba shi rdor rin rta cig zhon nas byung bas/ khyod kyi rtag gad 'dren dgos byas pas gdan drangs te/ ya dgon nang sor spyan snga kun spangs pa'i drung du phebs/ spyan snga'i drung nas zhal brda gces gcesamang du gnang / gzims chung nas na bza' thams cad kyang brjes/de nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad dgongs te mngon dgar bzhugs sa mdzad nas/ bla chen rin gzhon pa spyan drangs/ khrid rnams legs par gsan/ sku rags mi 'grol pa dang sku lus srong ba'i phyir dbu skra la thag pa btags nas/ de gdung ma la btags te bzhugs nas rtse gcig tu 695

bsgo /sa pas/ skad pa mar song song du bsgrubs pas ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang dag pa 'khrungs/ gong ma chen pos bka' bkyon pas sku mched gzhan gnyis kyis gnyer ba la bka' lung mdzad de gsol chas rnams gsangs nas bskyal/ de nas lo gsum song ba dang chos rje byang rgyal bas gong ma chen po la zhal brda zhus nas thugs khrel sangs ba mdzad de/ yon mchod gnyis rgyal bzangs na bzhugs pa'i drung du byon/ gong ma chen po'i dgongs pa la 'di cung zhig dma' dbab dgos dgongs nas/ chen po yon rin pa bgro gleng zhur bcug pas/ chos rje nyid legs par rgyal bas khyed chen po ba dbus phyogs na ston pa bzang ste/ bgro gleng 'am de nga'i slob dpon de bzang bar 'dug gsungs pas/ der gong ma chen po yang sngar gyi gtam thams cad mi bden par 'dug dgongs nas thugs khrel thams cad sangs/ de nas slob dpon sher don pa dang dpon slob lhan du bzhugs pas chog pa byung / de rjes g.yang gyil du phebs/ bla chen pa la gdams ngag gi 'phro rnams tshogs chos su gsan pa'i tshe/ nyin cig phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'khrungs/ sngar ma bslabs pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyang gzigs pa tsam gyis mkhyen pa byung / 'di ni bka' brgyud pa dag gi lugs la yon tan khyad par can skye ba'i snga rol tu gegs 'byung zhing / gegs de las grol ma thag tu yon tan skyes pa mang du byung snang bas/ 'dir yang de dang 'dra bar 696

go'o/ /de nas gdan sa dang rtses thang la sogs par yang lo shas bzhugs/mkhan po sangs rgyas blo gros pa/ las slob dgra bcom pa rgyal mtshan bzang po/ gsang ston mkhan chen bka' bcu pa bsod nams seng gis mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhan yang slob dpon sher don pa/ sto rin po che grags pa yon tan/ chos rje kun spangs pa/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ chos rje blo bzang grags pa/ mkhan chen rgyal dbang blo gros pa/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab la sogs pa rnams las chos mang du gsan/ de dag gi skabs shed du snar thang mkhan chen grub pa shes rab pa la sogs pa'i snar thang pa'i che bgres rnams gros mdzad nas snar thang du spyan drangs te/ snar thang sde ma lag dang bcas pa phyag tu phul/de nas phyir phebs lo gcig gi bar du thugs rlung gi bsnyun drag po cig byung yang gzhan gyis mi mngon par mdzad/ dgon gsar du byon pa'i nyin cig bsnyun de las grol bas/ a la la snang ba'i bde sha la/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i mgur gsungs/ de nas ni rtogs pa la 'phel 'grib med/ mnal yang 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ mnal 'thug por song 'dug bsam pa'i tshe'ang bzlas brjod mdzad pa'i phreng ba'i grangs mi 'chol/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las nam du yang mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa las/ spyan snga nyer brgyad pa zhi bar gshegs pa'i gshegs rdzongs kyi gral dbu la stag lung chos rje bkra shis dpal rtsegs nyi ma'i dbang po bsrung 697

ba'i go cha spyan drangs nas/ gshegs rdzongs grub 'phral la/ stag lung chos rjes ka bzhi stengs su bzhugs stan mthon po yang dag pa bshams/chos rje rin po che'i phyag nas gzung ste/ stan de la bzhugs su gsol/de bka' brgyud rin po che spyi dang gdan sa 'di'i bdag po khyed las 'os pa su yang med gsung nas/ de nyid du shis brjod kyi me tog gtor/gus pa'i phyag mang du mdzad/ de ltar grub pa'i dbang po des mnga' gsol bas/ phra sbom tham / cad kyi thugs la bka' bgros yod med dang 'thad mi 'thad kyi rtsis gdab med de/ me mo bya nas shing pho stag gi bar gdan sa chen po dang / chu rje ba'i dbang gis rtses thang gnyis su spel mar bzhugs/ phan tshun gnyis kur bzang ngan dang mi che chung gi rtsis gdab med par zhu 'dod yod pa thams cad la phyag rgya chen po'i khrid gcang /gdan sa'i mkhan slob dad ri dge bza' ba dang bcas pa sus kyang bka' las mi 'da'/ phyogs thams cad du sangs rgyas 'am zhig de na bzhugs yod par 'dug ces/ gtso bor ri sul na sgrub pa la bzhugs pa rnams kyi yid phrogs/ 'khyog po'i blo can rnams kyi gnya' bar ni gser gyi gnya' shing bas kyang lci/ mnga' ris nas phrin las pa phyir 'ongs pa la lha tse bas sna drangs pa'i jag pa mang pos bcom pa la'ang bden pa'i bka' brjod pa tsam gyis shi chad dang dmar shal la sogs pa'i yams chen po byung ste bka' bsrungs kyis chad pa phab/ de bzhin du pu hrangs su dkar 698

gdum pa bya ba'i bon po rang re'i sgom chen pa rnams la gnod pa chen po dze+ebyed pa zhig byung ba la yang dge 'dun gyi tshogs su bden pa brjod pas de rnams mi tshang dang bcas pa yul don/ gdan sa dang nye bar 'ga' zhigagis gus pa ma yin pa bstan pa'i mi tshang rnams je phra je phrar song ste rjes med du gyur/ spa ba'i seng ge rong ston chen po la sogs pa'i sde sdod 'dzin pa mkhas dgu rnams drung du lhags te/ de rnams la 'brel ba'igatam gnang ba na yang dag par bag 'khums par gyur/ rgya ma rin po che gzhon 'od pas ni bde mchog dngos kyi 'du shes kyis zhabs la gus pas bsten par mdzad/ bu chen rtogs ldan zab khrid kyis 'gro ba 'dren nus ba'ang ding sang gi bar du'ang mang du bzhugs/ dgung lo zhe drugapa la rgyu rin po che las grub pa'i sgo mangs legs par bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod snang bas lha rnams gzhan las byon legs pa grub/ de lta na yang snyigs ma las kyang snyigs ma'i dus 'byung bar gzigs nas shing pho stag gi wo zla ba dang po'i mar ngo'i nyer gcig la chos kyi dbyings su sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ de la sku 'khor rnams kyis mdzes btsal bas nyer gnyis par grags/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bzhes pa yin/ de nas mi'i dbang po grags pa 'byung gnas kyis/ dus mi bde yang sku 'dad stobs chen po yang ngag pa bsgrubs/ gdan sa'i mchod khang du'ang dngul gyi mchod rten che ba bkra shis sgo mangs kyi rnam pa can cig bzhengs/ de rjes mi'i 699

dbang po grags pa 'byung gnas pa thugs rab shin tu che zhing / gsang sngags kyi mkhyen pa shin tu rgyas par gyur kyang gdan sa'i bzhugs khri rin po che shin tu gnyan par dbongs mas/ gdan sar ma bzhugs kyang gnas chen du 'gro ba'i ri ba rnams la mgyogs khrid gsungs pas/ zhi bar gsheṭa nas zhal slob dus mchod 'dzin pa ni mang du byung mod/ gdan sa ni chu mo bya'i bar lo nyi shur stongs/ de rjes bdag po chen po kun dga' legs pa dang ches sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa bka' bgros mdzad nas shing pho khyi'i lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la chos kyi rje rin po che dpal ngag gi dbang po dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa zhig rin po che'i gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhu /sa su gsol/ de nas sa pho stag gi lo la sto byang gi dus gzings la brten nas sne gdong nas gdan sar rang byon mdzad nas bdag tu gzung / de nas lo bcu drug pa chu mo sbrul la lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzhi bdag rnams kyis spyan drangs te gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /'gro mgon rin po che 'khrungs nas deng sang gi me pho spre'u yan la lo sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa bdun song ngo / /phag mo gru pa'i gdan ra bas kyi skabs so/ / / /71 4

'bri khung chos rje dngos spob dang bcas pa'i skabs/gdung brgyud rin po che bdag cag rnams kyis mthong thos su gyur pa mtha' gcig du dben par spyod cing spong ba la dgyes pa ni sku mched rin po che rnam pa gnyis yin te/ sto rin po che grags pa yon tan ni/ me mo phag la 'khrungs/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa las gdams pa mnos nas sgrab pa kho na la gnas shing / khams stod kyi sto ba rnams kyi bla mar gyur pazlo sto rin po che zhes grags/ drug cu rtsa brgyad pa la gshegs/shar rin po che ni/ shing pho rta la 'khrungs nas sde sgod la sbyangs pa chen po yang mdzad/ mdo smad shar ba dag gi bla mar gyur pas shar rin po che zhes grags/ rgyal bu dang btsun mo rnams kyi bla mar yang gyur/ rwa sgring dang gsang phu la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams kyi yang zhabs tog rgya cher bsgrabs/ bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa me mo lug la gshegs/ ding sang chos kyi rā nyer gnyis rin po che'i gsung rjes su zlos shing khrid kyi rim pas slob ma skyong bar mdzad pa'i mchog ni mkhan chen rin chen bzang po ba dang /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bang rim pa rnam pa gnyis so/ /de la dpal phag mo gru pas gang gi lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bco ba mdzad de/ khyod la sgom chen bzang po cig 'ong / khyod la sgom chen tsam la bzang ba cig 'ong zhes 701

gsung dbyangs chen pos lung bstan pa chos rje 'bri khung pa ni/ yul ldan stod gtsong du zhes bya bar/ yab 'brug rgyal skyu ra'i gdung / rnying ma'i grub thob zam ma chad pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la rnal 'byor du mdzad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba dang / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma btsun ma gis bya ba'i sras su chu mo phag la bltams/ gzhon dus nas yab chos phal cher mkhyen/ der nyam nga ba'i mu gi byung bas stor byon nas phyug po dag la klog dom blangs te/ de'i yon gyis rang dang gnas po gso ba'ang cha/dzad/ de nas dgang lo dag lon pa'i tshe gzhan gyi slob dpon da yang gyar/rin rin ri rinaci rigs par sgrub pa dang gzhan la chos ston pa spel zhing gnas pa'i tshe/dpal phag mo gru pa'i snyan pa gsan pas dpe med pa'i dad pa 'khrungs te/zla ba shar ba na zla ba ya gis nga'i bla ma de mthong ba re dga' snyam pa'ang byang / de nas cha rkyen cung zad dang bcas te dpal phag mo grur rtol ja dang rta rnams phul bas ja ni bzhes/ rta ni kho bo dud 'gro'i 'bul ba mi len gsung nas ma bzhes/ ja de skol nas dbu che brgyad cu tsam tshogs byung / ja de bzhes pas 'gro ba'i mgon po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mdangs dang ldan par gyur pas thugs cung zad gzengs mtho bar gyur pa yang mkhyen te/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ dge bsnyen khyod dang rang la re che bar 'dug ste/ ngas bskal pa mang por khyed rnams kyi don du dka' ba spyad pa yin gsung / tshogs de na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun no cog la phyag mdzad pa 702

la sogs pas dge bsnyen dad pa can du yang grags/ gdams pa gsan pas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa'i ye shes chen po ni 'khrungs/ 'gro mgon gyi zhabs drung du phebs nas zla ba sum cu rtsa gnyis na 'gro ba'i mgon po gshegs/ de nas e chung phug par thugs dam la bzhugasapas glo bur du bsnyun mdze drag po zhig byung / dgongs pa la rdza ga ba tu zhugs te gdung mis mi mthong bar bya snyam nas 'byon par chas/ yi dam sbyan ra gzigs kyi sku zhig yod pa la phyi phyag bgyis/ sku shed chung bas kha rgyab tu chung zhig gnas pa na/ dang por rang gi sdug bsngal bsams/ de nas mas can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsams pas glags med pa'i snying rje chen po chu bo ltar rgyun mi 'chad pa 'khrungs te/ mtshan mo'i mthar mal thams cad kyang spyan chab kyis khengs/ klu gdon de yang 'khor dang bcas pa sku lus las 'thon nas song ba gzigs/ de nyid du nad thams cad rnam par dag kyang gzhan dag la zhag gsum dro dang bzhi'i nang bar na/ mi kho po'i las ngan rang sar dag/ ces bya ba gsungs/ der rgyu 'bras kyi chos thams cad kyang mngon sum du gyur/ dpal he ru gas kyang zhal bstan/sangs rgyas nyid dang mtshungs pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ de nas 'ur langs te gzhan ston mo byed pa'i gral dbur gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ thod pa bsam grub kyi sras mo nam mkha' rgyan gyes sku mdun du gcer rgyugs byas pas/ nga rten dge bsnyen du song bas 'dis brnyas pa yin/ da ci nas kyang rab tu 'byung 703

dgongs pa byung / skabs der thuṭa rje chen pos mdze po mang po yang gsos/dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga la zhang sum thog pas mkhan po/ las slob slob dpon tsi lung ba/ gsang ste ba gnyal pa 'dul 'dzin rnams kyis mdzad de tshig rdzogs kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ gnyal pa 'dul 'dzin la gyung kha lung du 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba gsan pas shin tu mkhas par gyur/ bla ma'i gdan sa yang lo ngo gsum du nye ba cig mdzad/ sum cu rtsa bdun pa sa mo phag la 'bri khung du phebs/ lo de nyid la btsun gsar brgya tham pa byung /bar skabs shig tu gangs ti ser 'byon par chas pas gnyan thang lhas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po byas pa dpon slob nyi shu rtsa bzhi las gcig ma gtogs pa thams cad kyis mthong / sku shin tu che ba'i kun dga' bo zhig kyang gzigs shing gsung gi snang ba yang byung / slar yang 'bri khung nyid du log ste dge slong gi dge 'dun bgrang bar dka' ba 'dus/ zab mo'i gdams pas de kho na nyid rtogs par mdzad pa'i slob ma mang po u rgyan dang dza lan t+ta ra tshun chod dang ri bo rtse lnga yan chod kyi lung sul dang ri khrod thams cad du khyab par mdzad/ nyin gcig 'dus pa'i tshad kyang gtos kyi bur ston la tshogs pa lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus/ de yang bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas kyis drang ba dang nges pa'i don gnyis su gsungs pa'i drang ba'i don thams cad ston pa thugs bskyed bzang bas rdzun du ming mi 'dogs kyang tshang ma'i gnod pa 704

can du bzhed pa la/ chos rje rin po che ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin phyin chad yi ge gcig la yang tshang mas gnod mi srid/ 'o skol gyi ston pa gcig pu'i lugs ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lugs yin pas sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs pa gcig par bzhed/ lung gi chos la yang pha rol tu phyin pa dang sngags kyi phyogs las lus pa med pa'i don bka' stsol bas/gsung phyogs ris su ni ma chad/ thugs ni byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa'i rang bzhin las skad cig kyang mi g.yo/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge 'dun yin zhing / de yang tshul khrims rin po che la rag las par gzigs na rang nyid 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra mo las mi 'gal/ dmar dang chang gi dri tsam yang mi sgom/ slob ma thams cad kyang tshul khrims phun sum tshogasapa dang ldan pas dben pa'i gnas su 'dug pa dag kyang bag yangs su mi 'gyur/ snyan pas ni dzasbu'i gling mtha' dag khyab/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa can de ni/ dang por dus gsum mkhyen pa 'bri khung du byon te/ khyed ni slob dpon chen po klu sgrub yin no zhes zhus/ gyis dgung lo drug cu'i stengs su phebs pa'i tshe/ sid+dha gling gi dgra bcom pas kha che paṇa chen gyi gcung po la me tog bzhi pa cig sgam bur rgyas btab nas so sor ma 'phrod kyi bar du mi rnying bar byin gyis brlabs te/ gcig 'bri zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs na slob dpon klu sgrub byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal du skye ba blangs nas yod pa de la phul/ gcig rat+na kyā snyi zhes bya 705

ba'i gtsug lag khang na byang chub sems dpa' skal ldan shing rta yod pas de la phul/ gcig di bhā ṣi zhig yod pa de la phul/ gcig des lha chen po zhig bzhengs pa 'dug pas de'i thags kur zhog ces dgra bcom pas kyang klu sgrub tu ngos gzung / kha che paṇa chen glas mo cher bzhugs pa na/ 'bri khung pa'i khams btsun zhig gis paṇa chen la chos gos blangs pas/ nye gnas kyis sku la bsnams pa 'di kha las med ces ma byin pas/ khos sku la bsnams pa de nyid la 'jus/ der nye gnas kyis kho la phul brdeg byas pas/ kho kha brdabs te sna khrug byung / paṇa chen thugs dam gyi tshe rje btsun ma gegs med par 'byon pa la/ de nyin nas zhag bdun du ma byon/ cis nyes ma dgongs pas spyi bshags mdzad cing gsol ba btab pas/ zhag bdun na byon yang sku'i rgyab bstan byang bas/ 'phags ma bdag gis ci zhig nongs zhus pas/ khyed dpon slob kyis slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob ma la sdig bsags gsung / de yang mi dran zhus pas/ kha sang gi sna khrug byung ba'i ban+de de yin med gsung / da sdig pa de ji ltar byas na 'byang zhus pas/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la rang gi lo grangs dang mnyam pa'i chos gos byin/ des 'byang gsung / gyis paṇa chen dbus su phebs nas srin po rir bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'tshur phu ba dang / 'bri khung ba dang / rgya ma ba rnams kyi gdan 'dren byung bas/ pazlo ta bai sh+lau ti tsan+d+ras/ phyag rgya ba 'di rdzun che ba yin zer/'o skol bka' gdams pa'i kār 'byon pa 'thad zhus pas/ paṇa chen thugs hur phyung ste/ bhu ti bhu ti de skad 706

ma zer/ sangs rgyas la 'khrul pa mi mnga'/ 'bri khung ba slob dpon klu sgrub yin/ khyod kyis las chen po bsags/ da khong ni drung du song la bshags pa gyis/ chos zhus gsungs pas/ bai bhu tis kyang de kho na bzhin du mdzad/ denas rje btsun ma la paṇa chen gyis/ bra bhu ti'i nyes pa des dag gam zhus pas/gnas 'dir bde mchog gi lha khang zhig bzhengs na des 'dag par 'gyur gsung ba bzhin lha khang yang legs par bzhengs so/ /de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po de ni lo bdun cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa me mo glang gi lo la gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ lo 'di la rgyal brten de yang gshegs/ snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa 'khrungs pa yin/ gshegs par nye ba na drung na 'dug pas/ da chos rje rin po gang du gshegs shes zhus pa na/ nga gang du yang mi 'gro/khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi khams rgyud la sdod pa yin gsung / sngar tsa ri g.yu mtshor byon pas sgo mangs mchod rten khyad par can gzigs pa'i bkod pa ji lta ba bzhin du dang por shing las bsgrabs pa zhig bzhengs / de rjes rin po che las bsgrubs pa zhig mdzad/ zhi per gshegs nas slob ma gtso bo rnams kyis kyang sgo mangs chen po zhig bsgrubs/ slob ma yang grub pa brnyes pa bgrang bar mi nus kyang phyis 'gro ba'i don chen po skyong ba na/ rje spyan snga rin po che/ dbon rin po che/ gcung rin po che/ gnyos 'gar chos gsum/ dpon sher 'byung / bsod stoms gling pa/ ti shrī ras pa/ shrī ri phug pa/ ba lu gong pa/ sbo sbo bkra shis nga ge/ nyi 707

gcig pa shing pho spre'u'i lo la gshegs/ shing spre 'di 'bri khung chos rje gshegs nas lo brgyad pa yin no/ /'gar dam pa chos sdings pa ni/khams su lcags byi la 'khrungs nas/ yab mes kyi chos rdo rje 'jigs byed la rnal 'byor du mdzad/ chung ngu'i dus nas 'bri khung du byon/ thal nyal ba yang lo 'ga' mdzad/ de nas gzims khang nang du nang mir tshud/ dang por tsa rir byon gsang sngaṭa kyi spyod pa legs par bskyangs / phyis dwaṭa por 'gar phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad 'dus nas/ dang por sku lus la zang thal du song ba'i mtshon cha mang po rgyab/ nam langs su nye ba na thams cad thang chad de skyabs su song nas srog gi snying po phul/las stod dang skyi rong sogs su byon/ gdul bya chen po byung ba la bar chad 'ong bar gzigs nas/ de bsal ba'i phyir chos rjes 'bri khung du bka' mang po bkyon pas sleb byung bas 'du ba rnams chad/ slar 'bri khung du 'ongs/ rlung shod dar da chos sdings btab/ der dge 'dun shin tu mang bar 'dus pas 'bri khung gi 'gran zlar 'gro ba 'dug dgongs nas/dgon pa dor nas yar stod la lam mdzad de dwags po nas rim gyis spo bor byon/ der phur dgon rin chen gling gi rtsig rmang bting / de nas zhag drug cu rtsa gsum lon pa na zhi bar gshegs kyang / byin rlabs kyis rtsa ba'i gdan sar song / de khong rang gi dpon po u rgyan pa la sogs pa rnams kyis gzung / 'gar dam pa ni 'phags pa'i slob ma slob dpon ār+yā 709

de ba yin par bzhed do/ /dpal chen chos yes ni/ chos rje la gdams pa rnams gsan zhing gzims g.yog yun ring du mdzad/ gnyos 'gar gnyis dang lhan cig tu tsa rir byon/ de'i tshe gnyos 'gar gnyisaspyadang mthun pa'i gsang sngags kyi kun du spyod pa ma mdzad pas/ chos rjes da dung tsa rir song la gsang sngags kyi kun spyod gyis shig par bka' stsal ba bzhin byas pas yon tan khyad par can mang po brnyes/ 'di rngog seng ge kha ba'i yang slob ma yin/ rin po che bzhi 'gros shes bya ba'i bstan bcos la sogs pa 'ga' re'ang mdzad/ 'di la 'bri khung na nag tshang ba zhes grags/ding sang gi bar du yang tsa rir ri thebs gtong ba ma chad par yod/ bal bu gong ba ni/ dgon pa'i ming gis btags pa yin/ ngor rje ras pa yang zer/ khong mtshan nyid la mkhas pas chos rje'i drung du mtho 'tsham du byon pas zhal mthong bas dad de gdams pa zhus pas yon tan gyi khyad par chen po brnyes/ kha che paṇa chen la'ang chos mang du gsan/ bstan pa'i snying po bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po'ang brtsams/ dbon sher 'byung ni/ gdung kyur/ de'i nang tshan 'o phro ma/ de la lha dgra lha snang gnyis las lha dgra/ de la dpal chen dang rgod gnyis las dpal chen no/ /yab ston pa sangs rgyas dpal zhes bya ba rje mar pa'i skye ba de dang / yum sngags mtshan nyid kyi chos mang du shes pa chos ldan zhes bya ba zhig ste/ de gnyis la sras drug dang sras mo gcig ste bdun 'khrungs pa'i che ba dbon 710

gsos/ bla ma'i zhabs tog dang mkhyen pa gnyis ka la mtha' med pas thams cad kyis slob dpon pa zhes zer/ bka' nan gyis gdan sa gyis gsung ba la sgrub pa 'ba' zhig byed par zhus pas phyis de ka tsugs rjes su yang gnang / 'jig rten mgon po'i bkra shis sgo mangs kyi nang rdzongs dang rten 'brel thams cad kyang lhur blangs/ gshegs rjes sku gdung gi gnyer mdzad de cung zad kyang ma god par rin po che'i za ma tog kha sbyar du bzhugs su gsol nas bre'i nang na bzhugs/ sku 'bum chen mo rtsig pa'i dang ngos dang nang bzhugs 'bri khung thel ba yun ring du bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel rnams kyang mdzad/ dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams legs par grub nas sa pho stag gi lo la gnam mtshor byon/ mchog dgon du bzhugs/ sa mo yos bu'i lo la ti ser thegs/ mnga' bdag a di ga la phyag rgya chen po'i khrid gnang ro gcig gi rtogs pa la bkod/ mnga' bdag ya tse ba dpung bskyed nas byung ba'ang shin tu mos par gyur nas dbang dang sems bskyed gnang / de la soṭa pa'i gzhan don gyi mdzad pa mtha' med pa ༷dzad/ pazlo ta mang po dang mjal ba'ang de rnams shin tu mos par gyur/ de'i tshe nang nad dang 'khrug la sogs pa'i slongs mang po byung ba la brten nas rgyu 'bras rten 'brel thams cad mngon du gyur/ sa bcu pa bar don gyis zhal gyis bzhes/ stod phyogs su lo bdun bzhugs nas so dgu pa shing mo bya'i lo la 'bri khung du byon/ bya de'i lo mjug la sto brag la thegs/ lam du bsam 712

yas su chos rje sa skya pa dang mjal/ khong rang gis zhabs rjen dang phyag tu spos reng bsnams nas dge 'dun dang bcas pas bsu ba mdzad/ khong rang la bzhugs stan ci yod brtsegs nas bzhugs su bcug chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ re shig bzhugs gsung yang snyo brag la thegs te khyi'i lo la lho brag nas 'bri khung du 'bul ba tshan cher brdzangs/ de'i dbyar sma da slob dpon sgom sang pas gro bo lung phul/ khyi lo'i dgun mkhar chung phebs nas khyad chos brgya dang dgu bcu pa ste dgongs gcig yi gir bkod/de nyid du gyis brgya lnga bcur bsdu ba mdzad/ gzhan yang phyogs der gang zag so so'i don du bstan bcos meng du mdzad do/ /spyir shing mo bya'i lo mjug de sto brag tu byon/ shing pho rta'i lo mgo la 'bri khung du thegs te dgun brgyad mkhar chur bzhugs/ dbyar brgyad kyi dang po gro bo lung du bzhugs/ de rjes kyi drug ya rgyal du bzhugs/ phyi ma de yar 'brog la phebs/ tshogs ma bskyangs bar ri khrod kho na mdzad kyang gcong byug ge ba lnga brgya re 'dus/ sto brag nas lam yar klungs la btod de phag mo gru la byon/ spyan snga rin po ches zhabs thang la phyag 'tshal sgang du byon/ ser phreng gi sna yang khong rang gis mdzad nas bsu ba gnang / spyan snga'i drung du phyag rten phul nas chos 'brel zhus pas brgyud pa rin po che la brgyud pa'i chos dang / brgyud pa rin po che'i grub pa'i mtha' gnyis gsungs/ de nas 'bri khung thel la byon/ bsu ba byung dogs nas gsangs nas byon te 713

dpon dang mjal nas 'bul mo che mdzad/ der yang sku mched gsum po 'dzom/ lo de la sgam por gdan 'dren byung nas thegs/ lo de'i nang du dpon rin po che gshegs/ slad de lo rang 'bri khung thel du byon nas dgongs gcig la tshoms bdun du byas nas gsungs/ sgom pas gdan sa'i rten 'brel sgrigs kyang ma mdzad par gdan sa rje spyan snga la bskos/slar yang sgam por byon/ jo bo ya tse ba'i gdan 'dren slar yang byung kyang ma thegs/ rin po che dam pa 'gar 'bru mdar byon nas chos phar gsan tshur gsan mdzad/ sku tshe'i smad kyi gdul bya dgos su phal cher bskyangs nas lnga bcu rtsa lnga bzhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo la gshegs/ sku tshe phyi ma la chos rje 'jig rten mgon po dang sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'gyur bar zhal gyis bzhes/ mkhan po 'dul 'dzin gyi rjes la sgam po'i gdan sar yang bzhugs so/ /dpal shrī ri phug pa ni/ 'jig rten mgon po la gdams pa gsan pas grub pa brnyes nas mdo smad du byon pas phrin las dpag tu med pa byung nas yul skyong lha khang bzhengs so/ /sbo sbo bkra shis ni/ 'khrungs yul zangs ri lu gung sgang pa yin/ de yang bu chen rnams rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa'i tshe/ chos rje'i thugs gar yi ge ar sprul pa sogs yon tan du ma mnga' 'o/ /yang chos rje'i slob ma gtsang zhig ces bya ba'i grub thob cig gis gnyal gyi dad rkyal btab/ khong chang la mnyes pas chang gi dus mchod ding sang gi bar du ma chad par yod/ de'i 714

rjesasu zhang dang rkyal ba mtshan gzi brjid rin chen byon/ 'di gtos rgyal ba lha nang ba'i yang slob ma yin/ kha che paṇa chen dang chag dgra bcom las bsnyen par rdzogs/ de rjes gnyi ba gnyal zhig yin te/ mtshan 0la ba ri khrod seng ge/ 'di chu mig pa'i slob ma yin pa la phyis bla mar song nas chu mig pa phyag rgya chen po la bkod/ dwags po sgom tshul gyis btab pa'i 'brag tu sgrub pa mdzad/ de nas dgon pa gnyis la dang 'brug ces lhan cig tu sdeb/ de rjes gsal rje ba/ 'dis g.yur spe ba rnams srog gcod spong du bcug pas da lta'i bar du lo re bzhin chos skyong gi drung du mna' skyel ba'i srol rgyun ma chad par yod/ de rjes mkhas grub rin chen rgyal mtshan/ de rjes nas da lta yan du bla ma drug song yang gong ma gsum gyi mtshan ma rnyed/ de nas chos rgyal rin chen/ rin chen blo gros/ da lta rin chen dpal bzang rnams so/ /gtsang zhig gi sku skye za ra ba chen po yin te/ de'i bzhugs gnas tshan gsum gyi dga' ldan yin/ rten ni dge slong du bzhugs/ g.yur spe ba rnams gtsang zhig gi sku 'dra la chang gi mchod pa byas pas dga' ldan gyi za ra dge slong bzi yong zer ba yang yod do/ /'bri khung chos rje dngos slob dang bcas pa'i skabs so/ / / /'bri khung pa'i gdan rabs kyi skabs/de la gdan sa'i rabs ni/ mkhan rin po che rdo rje tshul khrims shing pho 715

bhe lcags yos la gshegs/ chos kyi rgyal po shing mo phag lo pa/ bcu bdun pa la rdo rje rgyal po 'das/ rje rin po che blo bzang grag / pa 'di'i slob ma yin/ 'di'i rjes la drung bshes gnyen pa/ dbang ba/ chos ri drung chen no/ chos kyi rgyal pos nyi shu rtsa gsum bzhes pa'i tshe rje rin po che 'khrungs/ 'jig rten mgon po 'khrungs nas rdo rje rgyal po gshegs pa yan la lo nyis brgya dang dgu song / da lta'i me pho spre'u yan la lo sum brgya dang sum cu rtsa bzhi song ngo / /'bri khung pa'i gdan rabs kyi skabs so/ / / /stab/ lung pa slob ma dang bcas pa'i skabs/dpal stag lung thang pa'i rim pa ni/ stag lung thang pa chen po bkra shis dpal ni/ g.yang shong bong ra stengs su yab ba na blon 'bar po dang / yum brab shi gza' dge sum khro mo'i sras su chu pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs/ de'i phyi lo 'bri khung chos rje 'khrungs pa yin/ gdung rus dbrag zi 'bring po'i nang tshan klu dge yin/ yum snga mo nas grongs nas spu mo cig yab kyis blangs pas de ma byams nas/ yang sru mo phyogs shig blangs pas des byams par byas/ de nas cher skyes pa dang chos la lan 'ga' bros kyang yab kyis bkag bco brgyad bcas pa'i tshe thang skya lha khang du bla gang pa'i sar bros nas/ mkhan po ga ston bla gang ba shes rab 717

rdo rje dang/slob dpon tshar ston sgo mangs pa las rab tu byung / de tshar ba dang yab kyis ra mda' la sleb/ yab na re/ khyed la khrims gral bya ba yod zer/ klu dge 'bar po'i bu yin zer nas gral zhabs su ma bzhag cig zer bas/ mkhan pos mdun gral cig gi gral mgor bzhag/ de nas dge bshes brag dgon pa la 'grel chung / spyod 'jug bslab btus/ lam sgron/ do ha rnams gsan/ de'i dus su rgya gar du 'byon bzhed yod pa la ldan ma bla ma ser 'bal bya bas rgya gar du 'gro zer bas/ de dang sdod chad byas pas kho ma byung bar sbom por ba bla ma a skyabs dang 'grogs nas 'byon rtsis/ khong da nang nas song nas rjes ma zin/ deng khang dmar du sleb dus ra mda' sleb nas phyir log dgos byung / de nas yang bla ma ha shang rgya gar du 'gro zer bas khong dang 'grogs par chad pas kyang khong sngon la song 'dug rin po che bas rta gcig la sgro ba gnyis bkal nas mtshan la byon pas kha ba bab pas grang ba dang skom par byung / brab shi sum pa'i gru mur du sleb pa dang ra mda' byas sleb nas yang log dgos par byung / thang skya lha thel du ston btsas ma'i mi mang po brel tshub byed pa gzigs pas snying rje chen po 'khrungs/de la brten nas snang ba 'di thams cad ngo bo nyid med par mkhyen/ nub cig mnal lam du lam tsher mas gang ba'i gzur sa med pa cig tu bud med nag rma chen mo cig dang phrad/ des mgul la 'khyud pas rin po ches 718

lha'i nga rgyal gyis 'og tu bcug pas/ da thong khyod lha bcu gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin zer/ yang thang skya na rdon mo shi log bya ba cig yod pa na re/ khyod 'di 'dra ba cig 'ong / 'khor yang 'di tsam zhig 'ong zer ba gyis 'gro mgon gyi gsung dang yang mthun par byung / de nas skabs shed du thang skya nas steng khang du byon tsa na mo ma cig la phag mo gru pa'i sku cha btab/ mthu bo che cig 'dug gser gyi thang ma brdal ba bsdu zer/ khyod rang ri klung ser ba thang skya cha le ba cig la 'gro bar 'dug sto cig gis de ma byas na mgo chag pa'am rbab phog zer ba 'ong zer/ de nas rting ser du dbyar cig bzhugs te/ de nas snyel der bzhugs tsa na bla ma mig la phag mo gru pa'i sku 'bag cig bskur byung ba la/khyod rang yang mchod pa la e 'ong zer bas mar me'i rgyu gzung nas mchod pa la byon pas/ 'di'i rtsar cig ma byon na snyam pa'i zhe bcad 'khrungs/de nas dbus su 'byon khar mnal lam du skas rings shig la 'dzegs nas byon pas/ thog khar ma thon tsa na mi dkar po chen po cig byung nas phyag nas gzung nas/ des ma then na mi thon zer ba rmis/ phyis 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ de kho bo yin gsung / de nas 'byi ngos su bros nas rting ser du byon/ de nas slob dpon sangs rgyas skyabs can du steng byang du byon nas zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ de rnas mdor sto stengs su byon nas skyel mi cig dang rta sprubakhrig nas chu la brgal bas/ rab 'byams nas chus 719

de'u khyer byas tsa na/ rtag spo to cig la rkang pa thebs nas thon/ /de nas byang lam la 'thon nas stong bzher bcu ston bya yul du mar me 'dzugs su 'gro ba dang 'grogs nas byon pas com thang du sleb/ de tsa na com pa dang phod mdo ba btsas ma'i dus su 'dug nyan pa'i sman pa gcig na re/ nged kyi yul ba pha spun kha cig tshwa khyer nas phag mo gru'i sgo khar 'grim pa yin zer bas khong dang 'grogs nas klungs shod la lam btod de nyan du byon nas/ tshong pa dang 'grogs nas 'on la phebs/de nas zla bo med par ljang 'phrang la byon te tsha rong du phebs/ de nas bon po gza' mi gnyis dang bsdongs nas bzhud pas rtsibs lam zad pa nas dgon pa'i sa dkar lhag ge mthong / de nas sgo rtsar byon nas nang du 'byon rtsis byas pas 'brog chung bas sgo bkag sing ston gyis sna len byas te dro rting la spyan sngar mjal/ gser dum cig gis phyag rten byas/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas thang ma chad dam gsung / chus de'u khyer byas pa la rta'i rkang pa spo to cig la tshugs pas thon zhus pas/ da dus kho bo der yod pa yin/ lar kho bo rdo rje gdan na 'dug kyang khyod 'ong dgos pa yin/ skye ba 'di kho na'i bla ma ma yin/ nyams rtogs bskyed pa'i bla ma yin gsung /de nas phyis gtor ma'i dus su da phyi sar pa sgo kha na sleb nas nang du ma 'ongs ba'i bar der sar pa'i lus las sar pa 'dra ba cig chad nas kho bo la thim gsung / de nas phyi zhig na khyod la grwa pa 'di tsam zhig 'ong /720

de'i nang nas khyod rang tsam 'di 'ong gsung / de'i dus su 'u/nga pa 'di na nga rang las drag pa e yod dgongs pa byung / nye gnas sbas sgom la sbas sgom sar pa 'di bya yul ba 'dra ba mang gsung / de nas zla ba gsum na nga ni klad pa lug kyang gsol ba btab pas chog snyam pa'i dgongs pa byung / gser zho gang gis ma la byas nas phul ba zhu byas dngos grub lta bu cig byed pa yin/ gdams ngag kyang mi zhu byas pas/ lan cig bzhud nas gser bzhes/ ma la phyir gnang nas de dad pas khams gso nus pa bya ba yin/ ma la phul la gsol ba thob dang da dung 'char rgyu mang po yod pa yin gsung / de nas lan cig na chos byung tshad zung dang kho bo la brgyud pa 'ded mi dgos pa yin/ khyod la dgos pa'i dus shig 'ong /bod na zhu byas dngos grub las zhen pa chung ba med de lu yi pa cig yod pa yin/ rgya gar na bai rlu pa zhen pa chung ste brgyad stong pa cig yod pa yin gsung / yang bla ma bsten pa gdams ngag yin/ rang gis nyams su myong ba man ngag yin gsung bas/ de phyin chad tshig bzhi pa yan chad gsung thams cad la yi ger ma bris pa med gsung / nyin cig gdams ngag gcig gsungs pa brjed dogs nas rtsig ngos la bris nas phyir byon/de nas nang du byon nas de gzigs pas de phyin chad brjed dogs pa ma byung phag mo grur byon nas lo gsum tsam lon pa'i dus su khyod da lta song yang mkhan slob kyis chos zhu ba 'ong ba yin gsung / kho bo'i chos kyi 721

bdag po khyod kyis byed pa yin yang gsung / dge slong cig gyis gsung ba la bdag sgrub pa byed pa yin pas/ dge slong mi byed par zhu zhus pas/dpal rgu lo yang dge slong yin te/ gnam mtsho la lo bdun bsgoms 'dug ding sang mi chen po'i phyag len byed dgos pa yin gsung /skabs shed du gzims mal na bzhugs pa la sngar med pa'i chos tshan cig thugs la 'khrungs/ der 'gro mgon phyag mkhar bsnams nas byon te/phyag mkhar thugs por gtad nas 'di kho bo min pas mi shes gsung /nub cig yab kyis te'u chu cig byin pa rmis pas bza' mi zad pa'i gtor la longs spyod pa yin gsung / yang yab kyis lde mig ya gcig byin pa rmis te phyin chad ched du bya mi dgos pa byung / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bcas ma'i dus phag mo grur phebs/ lo drug phag mo grur bzhugs/dpal phag mo gru pa gshegs nas zla ba gcig phag mo grur bzhugs nas dbon phyag dang yon bdag rmog sgom la sogs dang 'grogs nas mal gro la byon te 'chad kha ba la chos gsan/ de nas klung shod na yang bka'agangams pa 'ga' zhig dang 'grogs nas byon pas khong rnams na re/ zhwa de spos zer ba la/ der nga'i zhwas dbur stod 'dir skyel ma thub pa cig byed dgos dgongs pa byung / de nas phod mdo khang chen du byon pas dge bshes khang chen pa phyir byon pa dang sgo 'gag tu mjal bas khong dad nas khong gi bla mchod du thang mgo dgon par dgun cig bzhugs/ de'i dpyid nas 722

kle ra bzhugs/ de dus khams nas rta bzang po cig dang bsun ma byung bas phag mo grur byon nas/ gdung rten bzhengs pa'i zhal brda dang lha bzo'i bsnyen bkur la dbyar cig bzhugs nas rta la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mdzad/ se gler bzhugs pa'i phyi lo slob dpon sgom pa yang byon nas brag skas kha na yar byon pas/ nang na phag mo gru pa'i gsung lhang lhang 'dug par thos nas nang du byon te/ khyed kyi gsung phag mo gru pa'i gsung rang du thos/ sngar phag mo gru pa'i gsung gis/ kho bo gar 'gro bar khyod 'khrid pa yin gsung ba yod pa de yin par 'dug snyam pa byung gsung /de nas zhang sho mar pa bgres po cig la mkhan po zhus/ las kyi slob dpon mar pa rtsom thang ba/ gsang ste ba zhang ston sgo mig pas mdzad de sho ma rang bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas yang se gler bzhugs pa'i tshe khams nas bsu rtas sleb/ kho gtsang du song shul du phag mo grur 'bul ba skyel du byon nas myur bar log byon pas khang chen pas rig nas mi tshang bsdus nas khams su mi bzhud pa'i zhu ba 'bul du bcug pas bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas grwa pa mang du 'tshogs nas ma shong bar dgon pa 'pho bzhed pa'i tshe/ be gler nam mkha' la sgra cig grag nas/ khyod da ste lo bdun na dar spras rong gsum dbang du 'du zer ba cig byung / de nas dgon sa brag po che phyin chad du gzigs pas ma rnyed par log byon pas tar mdar sleb tsa na/ 'gong lug na re/ pha ri stag lung zer ba 'di 723

dge bshes spo to ba'i bzhugs sa yin/ phu na brag phug legs po cig kyang yod zer bas/ stag lung du byon nas byin rlabs brag khung du de nub bzhugs/ de nas stag lung gi mdzo ra'i gong der yang dgon btab nas bzhugs/ de dus dpon slob bco brgyad yod/ de la spyir stag lung 'di 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po ches dgung lo drug cu bzhes pa sa mo glang gi lo la sku lus kyi bkod pa bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i tshe/ sku lus kyi bkod pa gcig gis stag lung gis thams cad zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs te/ stag lung gi sa thams cad sngags 'dam dang chu thams cad sngags chur mdzad nas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi phrin las rgyas pa'i sa cig nyi ma byang phyogs pha gir 'dug rab khyod khams su 'gro thang ba yin pas khyod khams su thengs gcig song / de'i rjes su sngon gyi las kyis bskos pa'i gnas shig dang 'phrad cing / gnas der phrin las thams cad rgyas pa yin/ de yang sa shin tu rtsub cing mi las gyur pa'i 'dre cig gis sna drangs pa'i lha 'dre gdug can dpag tu med pa gnas pas sus kyang mi zin pa yin pa la/ kho bos thams cad zhabs kyis bcags/ lha 'dre thams cad btul/ byams pa'i las dang ldan par byas nas gnas de khyed kyis zin pa yin gsung nas/ kha ba can ljongs byang gi phyogs/ zhes pa la sogs pas lung bstan pa yin no/ /yang na nam mkha' la sgra byung ste/ da dung stag lung mi non pas bde mi 724

bde byung na 'phos zer/ der dbang phyug grags kyis mod mdor gyin ngas spras pa'i spang pos mgo bcag pa la brten nas/ da se ba lung du lo bdun sdod pa yin gsung nas byon/ der grwa pa mang du 'a gas/ lha rje bong chung ba dang phod mdo bas mkhar las chen po byed rtsis byas nas ming nyi ma brgyad bting ba la/ 'o skol 'dir mi sdod/ grwa pa mang dus 'dir mi shong / stag lung du bong bu la nas khal nyil le ba cig byed pa yin gsung pas mkhar las gzhol/ de nas dar spras rong gsum dang phod mdo bas stag lung du gdan drangs te/ dgung lo sum cu so dgu pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo la bla brang nag por phyags pheb nas bzhugs/ de dus bya rog gis shing dang bong dum ci rnyed khyer nas da lta'i yang dgon yod sar bskyal bas/ der bla brang 'phos/ de nas lo 'ga' song ba dang khams nas bla ma zla 'od pa la sogs pas bsu ba la byon nas gtser bas/dpon slob lnga drug gis glang ling la kha bar du byon nas la phar skog gi chu las gsol/ dbang seng ja ska mo skol/ khyag rum khar bu ram bsgor gsung nas gsol/ kho bos ku yung sgangs su phyin pa yin gsung / de nub zhal shar du gzigs nas gzims pa la/ shar phyogs sprin gyis 'khrigs/ nub phyogs kyi nam mkha' dngas sing nge ba byung bas/ de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ thang skya nyams dmas 'gro ba'i rtags yin gsung /phyir nang nyi ma shar phyogs kyi sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa yin gsung 725

nas mi 'bral ba dran pa gsum gyi chos gsungs/ de nas sog nas ko khyim du bzhugs/ de nas bsu mi la phod mdo bas zhu ba byas nas khams su thegs ma dgos par tshur spyan 'brongs/ de'i phyi lo'i dbyar bkrab ting na bzhugs/ de'i tshe she pa dar re bsad nas dar yul ba dang rong pa ma 'cham pa'i bar du spyan drangs/ dar re'i mgo phul/ sha btson mang du yod pa btang nas dar rong gnyis dbang du 'dus/ de nas spras pas spyan drangs te spras pa dbang du 'dus/ 'phral gyi rnam thar mdzad lugs zla ba gcig gi tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar gyi mdzad lugs ni tho rangs snga mo nas bzhengs nas sku khrus mdzad/ de nas phyag de nas ma la/ de nas gsol 'debs/ nam langs nas nye gnas kyis spyan snga'i mchod pa brje/ gsung bcad 'byed par zhu/ sku khams e bde zhus nas bzhes pa 'dren pa zhu/ de'i ring la grwa pa 'gro 'dug byed pa dang don yod pa kun nye gnas kyis zhu/ gzhan su dang yang mi mjal/bzhes pa tshar nas dro ma ran bar du gsung gcod/ dro ran nas nye gnas kyis mchod pa brje/ gsung bcad 'byed par shu/ sku khams e bde zhu/ chab tsha skol ba zhu/ 'gron po mi chen 'bod dgos yod na zhus nas 'bod/ gro zin nas chos khri la 'byon/ mjal 'os rnams mjal/khrid mdzad/ de nas phyed ja skol ran pa dang / chab tsha skol ba zhu/rin po che pa gzims spyil du byon nas gsung gcod/ chab tsha gsol ran 726

pa dang gsung bcad 'byed/ chab tsha gsol ba zhu/ chab tsha 'dren 'os yod na 'bod/ phyis tshogs chen por song nas dro rting la gsung bcad mdzad nas chos khri la 'byon/ phyed ja mi gsol/ de nas gtor ma mdzad nas gsung gcod/ nye gnas kyis gtor ja skol ba zhu/ mgron po yod na 'bod/ mar me 'bul/ mchod pa brje/ de nas chab tsha 'dren/ sku khams bzang na chos dang bka' stsal mang du gsung / de nas gzims khar phyi nang ci bzhes zhu/ gsung gcod pa rnams zhag re bzhin gyi mdzad pa yin/ sku khams ma bde na gsung chos mi 'ong /bzang na yar ngo la 'ong / bcu drug nas gnam stong bar du sngar zhus med na su dang yang mi mjal/ spyir rab tu byung nas sha chang zhal du 'khyer ma myong / dud nag pa'i sbra dang khang par 'byon ma myong / sku rags bshig ma myong / phag mo grur bzhugs ring la yang g.yas g.yon gzhan du 'byon ma myong / phag mo gru pas chos tshig bzhi pa ci gsung yang rtsa na mi bzhugs pa med/ sha dang bud med gzims khang nang du 'grim ma myong /yang dgon dang nag tshang gnyis nas sha mgron la 'dren ma myong / gling gseb tu chang 'ong ma myong / bud med gling gseb tu zhag gsum las mi 'jog nag tshang du chab tsha skol ba/ gazlo brdung ba/ chab skad gtong ba/ dung gtong ba/ dung lung 'gyed pa/ grwa pa 'gro 'dug byed pa la sogs ci byed thams cad zhu dgos/ ngo mtshar can gyi mthong 727

snang ni spras pa'i dang ra ba jo bo bgres pos bstan pa'i bdag por mthong /shes rab dpal gyis thugs rje chen por mthong / gzhan yang bde mchog lhan skyes/ rje btsun mar mthong ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dang /sku'i bkod pa du ma dus gcig la mthong ba la sogs pa mang du byung /'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ in+d+ra bu gsum byung ba'i snga phyi gnyis kho bo yin/ bar pa khyod yin/ gsum ga ngo bo gcig pa yin gsung gsung / chos khri la bzhugs dus sgom bsam gyis phag mo gru pa'i sku rang du mthong ba dang / 'da' khar kho bo bde bar gshegs pa dang 'bral ma myong / thugs rgyud gcig pa yin gsung / gzims spyil du slob dpon dpon po dang nye gnas rnams la bde bar gshegs pa dang kho bo 'bral ma myong byas pas ma go bar 'dug bde bar gshegs pa kho bo rang yin gsung / de la spyir chu pho khyi la 'khrungs/ bco brgyad la rab tu byung /nyi shu rtsa bzhi la dbus su byon nas 'gro mgon lo drug bsten/ nyi shu rtsa dgu la phod mdor byon/ phod mdo/ se gle/ thang mgo rnams su lo gyingo bdun/ se ba lung du lo ngo gsum/ lcags byi la stag lung du phebs nas lo ngo sum cu tham pa'i bar du bzhugs/ grwa pa dpag tu med pa 'dus/ sku mda' khar grwa pa sum stong lhag tsam tshogs/ chos dang gser dngul gyi 'bul ba dpag tu med pa byung / phag mo grur lan gsum byon pa'i phyi ma la gser sku dngul sku la sogs rten dpag tu med pa/ po 728

ti sngo skya phyed dang drug brgya/ gser sbram dang g.yu rdog bzhi bcu/ ja sig drug cu/ dar zab stong tsho gsum/ mdzo rta brgya/ gser srang brgya lhag gi mar me/ ber khrub la sogs mang du phul/ spyir phag mo grur mar me nyis brgya brgyad cu rtsa gsum btsugs/ 'da' khar po ti sngon po bdun brgya/ skya bo dpag tu med pa/ gser sbram dang g.yu rdog lnga bcu/ dar zab phyed dang sum stong la sogs dpag med phul/sa mo sbrul gyi lo la phag mo gru'i chos rnams gdan drangs pa gsan pas rkyen byas te/ thugs mug skyes nas sku khams ma bde bar khrid dang mjal kha'ang dgun de lan 'ga' zung las ma byung / sku'i rim gro byed par zhus pas ma gnang / drug cu rtsa dgu bzhes pa rta lo'i dpyid dang dbyar kyang khrid dang mjal kha lan 'ga' zung las ma byung / mgo nya'i tshes bcu drug gi nub slob dpon dbon po la dpe mdzod kyi lde mig gtad nas/ khyod la de snga yang khong rnams rtsi bar 'dug pas khong gis bzhag sar sdod gsung / lde mig phyag gis bdag la gnang bar zhu/ sems can la phan thogs pa'i smon lam cig kyang zhu zhus pas mdzad/ bcu bdun la tshogs su zhal bstan/ chos dang zhal bde mang du gsungs/ bco brgyad la'ang tshogs su byon/ bcu dgu'i dgongs ja kha'i dus su gshegs/gdung sbyangs pas thugs lja gas spyan gsum byon/ sku dang ring bsrel kyang grangs med pa byon no/ /lo gsar gyi zla ba'i tshes gsum la ska yal rin ci ༄ 729

chen mgon gdan sar bzhugs su gsol/ de nas ring por ma lon par sangs rgyas sgom pa yang sku gshegs/ de la sangs rgyas sgom pa 'di 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i slob ma yin pa la/ dus phyis 'gro mgon gshegs nas stag lung thang pa chen po dang stabs gcig tu bzhugs pa de yin no/ /stag lung thang pa chen po'i dpon po dkar po zhes kyang bya/'gro mgon rin po che nyid stag lung thang pa'i phrin las skyong grogs la byon pa yin pas sku yal ba zhes kyang bya/ mtshan dngos rin chen mgon ni/yab yul ku lung gi sgang g.yang shed lung pa yin/ sgos bong ra stengs 'khrungs sa ni rab sgang na mkhar gsum yod pa'i dbus mal zhol du 'khrungs/ gdung ni stag lung thang pa chen po dang gcig yab ban blon mgo yags/ yum jo zi gza' bkra shis mtsho/ rin po che pa lhums na bzhugs dus yab kyis stag lung du mjal du 'ongs nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nyin cig stag lung thang pa chen po'i zhal nas/ mgo yags la 'dir shog gyis dang gsung / byung ba dang / khyod kyi shul du gzhan bu cig skyes yod par 'dug de nga la phul/ 'bul gyis 'bul gyis gsung bas 'bul lags zhus/ de nas lo gnyis gsum tsa na 'tshur phu ba gshegs nas 'tshur phu ba'i gdan sa gang gis byed zer ba la/ stag lung thang pa'i gsung nas/ 'tshur phu ba'i gdan sa gang gis byed kyang ngas ni gdan sa ba cig tshags byas yod gsung / stag lung thang pa chen pos lnga 730

bcu bzhes pa lcags mo phag gi lo la 'khrungs pa yin/ de nas lo gsu ma pa chu glang la dbus dang bla ma zhang dang glang lung pa rnams gshegs pa yin/lo bcu gcig lon pa'i tshe stag lung thang pas phrug chung gi cham tshe gcig gis sna drangs pa'i gnang sbyin mang du bskur nas byis pa de btsun pa gyis/ming 'di skad thogs gsung ba byung bas/ yum gyis btsun pa mi bzo zer bas/ yab kyis khong rang la dri zer/ ngas btsun pa byas nas stag lung du phyin nas dge bshes byas chos bslabs nas/ khyed pha ma la yang gdams ngag phrin du bskur btang cig gsung nas/ lo de la mkhar po spyi dpon pa dang / slob dpon 'gos lha khang lhag pa las thang skyar rab tu byung /mkhan slob gnyis dang nags lung pa la chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la dbus su byon/ yul mi rnams kyis skyel thung byas/ ma na re/ bu chos byed zer na nga dang ma phrad kyang mi sto chos gyis shig zer nas phyir song / stag lung nas bsu mi btang ba dang glang li la khar mjal nas lam 'di nas dbu ru lung la byon nas phebs pa'i nyin stag lung thang pa'i gsung nas/ dar dkar po cig la lam gyis/ 'phyar dar cig rgyab tu tshugs/ ri thel la 'phyar dar chung ba cig sngon la phyor/ dge 'dun rnams kyis ya thang la bsu ba gyis gsung / de nas dar yug cig la phyag rten byas nas spyan sngar mjal 'phral du khams 'dri zhe sa can mdzad/stag lung thang pa'i gsung nas skyes bu 'o ma brgyal lam gsung bas/ sku 731

drin gyis nyan par byung gsung nas dri smed mang du mdzad/ de nas skabs su shig tu rta brgyugs pas/ yab kyis rin po che ba la btsun chung chun zhus pas/ khyod rang kha rog sdod/ btsun chung gi tshod khyod kyis mi zin/ khos go chod nas 'ong cig gsung / de nas gling gseb kyi spyil po sgo shar lta cig tu 'dag 'byar mdzad/ khrid zhu ba'i skabs ma gtogs spyan sngar yang ma byon par sgrub pa lo bdun mdzad/ de'i dus su stag lung thang ba'i gsung nas gling gseb 'di na btsun chung cig gis sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed pa cig yod gsung / dgung lo bcu dgu la mkhan po gtsang pa/ las slob sangs rgyas sgom pa/ gsang ste ba slob dpon sangs rgyas rnams las bsnyen par rdzogs/ spyil po'i ka ba bteg nas gzhan gyi gos 'og tu 'dzud pa dang / sran ma bdun bdun tsam dus re la mtheb mdzub kyis phye bzhin gtong ba dang / ja sig la sgo dang rtse ba bzhin mdzad pa dang / skyil dkrung mdzad nas ngos chen po khang thog tu bsgyur ba la sogs mang du mdzad/ spyir stag lung thang pa chen po lo brgyad bsten/ nyi shu bzhig pa'i tshe stag lung thang pa chen po mnyel nas/ nyin cig sku yal ba la sku phyam cig dang zhwa theb cig g.yogs/dpal phag mo gru pa'i phyag mkhar de phyag tu gtad nas 'bol khar bzhugs su bcug bzhengs la sgor sgor gyis/ sham sham gyis/ de bzhin du mdzad pas 'ong bar 'dug nga bas bsod nams che ba cig 'ong 732

gsung / dpe mdzod kyi lde mig gtad nas/ 'di na gling gseb tu ma grags pa'i chos tshan cig kyang yod de/ kho bos chos la ser sna byas pa min/ rten 'brel gyi gnad cig dang phag mo gru pa'i gsung cig la brten pa yin/ khyod kyis bstan du btub pas su zhu la byin/ byang seng la'ang byang seng dang rin chen mgon gnyis stag lung skyong ba la khur mnyam pa yin co gsung / de nas stag lung thang pa dang sangs rgyas sgom pa gshegs ba'i bya ba rgya chen po rnams mdzad/ mkhan po bas da rin po che pas dpe cha la'ang gzigs rtog mdzad par zhu zer bas/ mkhan po ba/ 'o skol gyi brgyud pa 'di slob ma mdun du byung ba'i dus su rgyud tshod dang bstun nas chos gang thos ston shes pa cig min pa/ dpe la lta rtog byas pa'i dge bshes cis cang 'ong bayin nam gsung nas/ gdams pa zhu ba rnams la gang la gang 'dul du ston/ bzang ngan 'bring gsum la thugs rtsis mdzad/ gzhan gyis stag lung thang par mthong ba grangs med pa byung /sku'i bkod pa du mar mdzad pa yang lan mang du mdzad/ gzhan yang thub pa dang bde mchog sogs su mthong ba'ang mang du byung / mngon par mkhyen pa'ang rgya chen po mnga' ba'i lo rgyus kyang mang du yod/ gzhan zha ba dang 'on pa dang long ba dang nad tshabs chen gyis btab pa rnams rten 'brel sna re'i gsung sna res gsos pa'ang grangs med pa mdzad/ sku 'bum 'bum khang dang bcas pa'ang bzhengs/ 'bum khang gi sa'i brag brkos pas zhabs 733
