bsnyang / sa dpyad mkhan la bstan pas bla ma'i bla ri yin pa brkos pas la( zer/ dngul gyi gdung khang khru gang ba cig dang mtho gang ba cig bzhengs/ de rjes dngul gyi gdung khang chen mo/ nyi ma'i dkyil na gser srang bcu bdun la phag mo gru pa'i sku blugs pa bzhugs pa dang /dngul gdugs can gyi nyi ma'i dkyil na dngul bre gcig la bzhengs pa'i stag lung thang pa chen po'i sku bzhugs pa gnyis bzhengs/ de'i ltag la stag phung ba'i dngul sku chen mo bzhengs/ der mkhan slob la sogs gros la dbang ba rnams bsags nas/ rten rnams dang gsung rab rnams mangs nas mi shong bar 'dug pas mchod khang che ba cig bzhengs ba'i gros gyis la lan thong gsungs bas/ slob dpon khu na re/ mchod khang ci 'bras kyang chog sgom khrid skyong bar zhu/ gser 'bum brgya bas sgom chen cig dga' zer/ gzhan rnams na re/ mchod khang ya nga bzhengs par zhu/sgom khrid kyang skyong bar zhu zer bas/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa shing pho spre'u nas gtsug lag khang chen mo rtsig pa la zug nags shod du shing gcod du btang bas 'bri khung pas ba ga nas bod nas shing btsal rdo nas shing mang du drangs/ de'i skabs su phod mdo'i lde mig phyag tu byung bas/ de la brten nas 'bri khung pa'i dpon pos nags shod nas shing 'dren par zhus nas nags shod nas shing rnams drangs/ bran gas sa brtag pa gling gi phod 'dra ba cig byas na bzang zer nas gling gi mgor 734

bya / mchod khang ka ba brgyad cu la khyams stod ka tshar bzhi la so gnyis/ khyams smad ka tshar gsum la nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ 'gram gnyis na drug drug ste bcu gnyis/ glo 'bur gnyis na gnyis gnyis te bzhi/ sgo khang la bzhi/ sgo phubs la bzhi ste brgyad cu'o/ /shing brtsegs bcu gsum yod/ byi ba lo la khyams stod smad tshar/ mkhan slob bskos nas rab byung sgrub pa dang / chos sgo 'byed pa/ tan bshad sgom sgrub byed du 'jug rin po che pa rang ni stag lung thang pa chen po'i —rnam thar ji lta ba bzhin du mdzad/ gdams ngag la bza bslad/ gsol 'debs dang smon lam la bsgyur ba chig gcig la'ange mi mdzad/ rtag tu tsog bur bzhugs nas dbu sngas la 'jog ma myong / byang du 'byon dus 'khor rnams la'ang sha sdom/ mtshon cha'i 'a bul ba byu nga tshad sku ma du na rang du gcog rten 'bul rnams phyag ju bzhes/ gzhan mis sdud/ nag chags la khrid mi mdzad/ nag chags kyi dri smin mi mdzad/ don med pa'i zhal bkyal mi gsung / gdan sar phebs dus yon bdag gi khul rnams kyang rgud de las med kyang de rnams kyang dar rgyas su 'phel/ 'bul ba 'ong ba la'ang bsam gyis mi khyab/ dzi nang nas rgyags 'gyed dgos kyang shin tu mang bar yod/ 'i de rnams la repar khal spyad ma 'gyed/ gzhan — rnams la regan re stor/ tshan cigayal ci dgos sbreng / nang so namakha ba kha brgyad cu rtsa gnyi skyong/ gyi nas 'ong ba mthonge ne 'di tsa ma gar 155

zhong na bsam pa 'byung / nang nas 'gro ba mthong na lar gyid mi 'ong bsam pa 'ong / gtsug lag khang chen mo yang rten gsum gyis khengs/dang por gdan sar byon dus grwa pa rnams mi 'gyes pa'i bca' ba byas kyang ma nyan pa gyes/ spyil po rnams kyang zhig nas sog btab/ grwa pa bdun brgya tsam las med pa byung na'ang / de rting grwa pa mang du 'phel nas nyis stong brgyad brgya byung / de yang 'phel nas sum stong bdun brgya tshogs/spyil po yang mang du 'phel/ gshegs dus ni lnga stong tsam tshogs/dang po gdan sar phebs gdong du nas khal bdun las med/ gser srang lnga brgya tsam gyi bu lon yod pa la/ dus gyis nang thams cad gser dngul gos dar la sogs pas khengs/ phyi thams cad gnag rta stong stong tsam gyis gang ba byung / stag lung pa'i khyi la'ang ldog tsha zer ba'ang rin po che 'di'i ring nas byung ba yin/ bzhi bcu rtsa bdun bzhes pa me pho spre'u'i lo la 'ja' dang sgra dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba la sogs mang du byung /chibs 'brug khyung seng ge la'ang sngo byung / grwa pa g.yas g.yon du 'gro ba rnams la gar yang ma 'gro gsung nas/ la la la khyod kyis khrid tshar ba yin gsung ba la sogs pa mang du mdzad/ ) gnas rnams la'ang ja dang bu ram dang me shing la sogs pa'i tshogs chen po dgos pa yin gsung /de nas zhal brda mang du mdzad nas gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pa ring bsres gyi ci sdu bab/ thugs gas spyan phyag sor lha sku ring bgrel mang du 7 wo

du bzhengs/ dngul sku chen yo dang chung ba mab po bzhings gsung rab rgyun 'don dang lo re bzhin 'don pa'i srol mang du btsugs/ tsā tsa grangs med pa dang sku grangs med bzhengs/ dge 'dun sum stong drug ba rgyar 'dod pa rnams chos dang zang zing gis yang dag par bskyangs/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la gtso bor4 mdzad nas/ dge 'dun gyi gling rnams kyang nag khrims la sogs shin tu dam par mdzad/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags phab gang nas phyo blo pa'i dus su ma la gu ru phod mdor spyan 'dren du byon pas/ byu khyed kyi blaṣ+ṭha sangs rgyas tshor byon tshogs su 'byon na nga yang 'ong / mi 'byon na nged klung shod la 'gro ba min gsung bas/sangs rgyas mar byon tshogs su 'byon pa'i rgya ba byas pa / nga ma shi'i gar du yang dgon gyi 2them capa mi rgyag bsam yod pa mi te/ da bla ma'i gsung mi chogs gsung nas bla na tsho nga la byon nas bla ma 'dzigs pa dang phyag tsho sprod mdzad sangs rgyas yar byon khu dpon gnyis sum kyang mi mthong ba la ge ring mthong ba de khyed rnams la nga sgos ma yin sgyu sung sangs rgyas yar/byon palabarngod kyi na'on sproskobakra shis cha mas mgo byas/ stag lung ba'i sde ma lag dang bcas pa'i rgyal kha bdaba'iganyer khyed mkhyen pa'i zhu ba mdzad/ bdun cur zhes pa 7pho spre'u la gshegs/ gshegs khar ḍanye gnas rnams kyis bka'amanasal zhu —pas/ ci ra skyogakha rdu'akhodang bral ba'i snang545sar chos rje thob zas mas ba gis pas der gsolasuX ro tho 738

gsung / gdu nga sbyangs pas nam mkha' 'jas gang / me tog dang ring bsrel char ltar bab/ thugs ljags dang ring bgrel mang du byon no/ /maṅgal gu ru ni/ mes ban glang 'bar po la sras bzhi yod pa'i che shos stag lung thang pa/ yon bdag ma yags/ mgo rgyal/ bla ma zla 'od dang bzhi'o/ /mgo yags la sras sku yal bar ba/ yon bdag chos yags/ — ma kun/ chos tsho bas dang bzhi'o/ /mas yag la bras maṅgal gu ru/dzi nang skyabs — ba pa/ 'ong po dang bzhi'o/ /bla ma zla 'od pas phyis stag lung du byon nache'i sku yal ba'i skabs su stag lung du gshogs/ maṅgal gu ru chos yags dang )sgo zi4naza' gzungs sgom gyi sras su lcags mo yos la 'a khrungs/ lcags yos 'di sangs rgyas mar byon gyi nyi shu rtsa dgu pa yin/ cadagung lo bcu drug pa la mkhan po nga skya ba dang /slob dpon mkhas pa grags pa bzang /sgo/las rab tu byung / mkhan slob la 'dul ba dang lam sgron dang / jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i chos mang du gsan/ — ma mkha skyab chen po la kye'i rdo rje dang / dus 'khor dang / gsang 'dus sgron gsal dang / gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā sna/ phag mo/ dpyal gyi cachos drug dang / gur dang / sa ṭi/ lhag lung thang ba chen po'i ba chos/ phag mo brda bzhi/ nā ro pa'i bzhi chos rtsa 'grel bde mchog snyan brgyud/ dzo sems bskyed sum zhes/ rin chen them skal/ dbang gisalag len/ ba mo za ma'i rjes gnang /sgyu mi

lam lnga'i bshad pa dang man ngag gi rim pa mang po/ bshad brgyud mang po/ snyan brgyud mang po/ dbang byin rlabs kyi bka' mang du zhus/nyi shu rtsa lnga la dbus su byon pa'i dus su bla ma mkhas grub chen pos skyel thung mdzad de/ rdzogs su mgur yang gsungs te/ bla ma de ni mkhyen pa dang thugs dam shin tu ba nga ba cig yid par 'dug stag sang du thebs pa'i sbyi de nyin yang dgon du sa sa rgyas yar byon dang mjal/ khams nas slob gnyer la yong ba mang spru dang lhan du mjal b.lab 'di rnams su yin gsung / 'di rnams mdopa khams nas mi drag gi bu rkyang lags pa slob gnyer gyid du 'ongs pa lags zhus pas/ khyed rang rnams slob gnyer byed par 'dod na gsang phur song / dbon po rang gling ga ba tu bas sprang ma byed par/ dang mo nas nas sho lnga long la nang par nas mtshams la sdod/ slob gnyer khams su byas pa des chog rang re'i brgyud pa 'di sgrub brgyud yin pas sgrub pa gal che bas sgrub pa la gtso bor gyis la 'bad pa thon gsung / nang bar bla mi gling pa la mjal dar zhus pa / nang so nas ja zho do/ bu ram sgo gang / ta lhu gi ber thul gcig rnams gling pa la bskur nas/ —ber thul gyon sang nu bo 'bran du spong bar 'dug pas/ mas brgyad gzobs kyi gsung na bekra shi bla ma lojal/la d+ku lo de nyid la mkhan po nga dkar pa 'od gir 'byungaspyo gan / slob ngu2sgon mkhan dpon pha ri chen bkra shis la sogabasams 5740

mdzad nas zhi bar gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pas thugs ljags spyan gsum byon zhing / ring bsrel kyang mang du byon no/ /chos rje dpal bzang po ni/ lhang skyabs kyi sras bzhi la rin po che dpal bzang po/ yon bdag thugs rje skyabs/ yon bdag gsung drung 'bum/ gcung bya bra'aji ba rnams so/ /yum chos lcam gyi sras su me mo sbrul la 'khrungs/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos mang du gsan/ sa skya la sogs su bzhugs/ ma la gu ru'i drung du bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa thams cad tshang bar gsan/ rang lo zhe gcig pa me mo bya la gdan sar phebs/nga gsum pa sa mo bya la rat+na gu ru gdan sar bzhugs su gsol nas kun spangs mdzad/ nga bzhi pa lcags pho khye la zhi bar gshegs/ chos —rje rat+na gu ru ni/ g.yang shod bong ra stengs stsa sa pho byi ba la 'khrungag te/yum ni gzungs lcam zhes bya'o/ /mkhan chen bsod rnams ye shes pa dang slob dpon seng ba zangs pa las pab tu byung /dzi lo bcu drug pa la jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa dang ma la na chos mang du gsan/dgung lo bcu dgu la dbus su byon/ rin po che sangs rgyas dpal ba nga pa'i drung da kyi dor dang / bde mchog dang / gzhin rje dgra nagagadong drug la sogs pa'i bka' mang po dang / nā ro chos drug 'tshosogs pa'i chos bzhugs pa sums cad gsan/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo bya la rin po che sangs rgyas dpal bzang posu lha chen bzhengs pa'i rab gnas 743

dang lhan cig tu gdan sar bzhugs su gsol/ lo de la sa skyar byon nas 'jam dbyangs pa/ bdag nyid chen po/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' seng ge rnamos bsten nas chos mang du gsan/ de nas jo mo nang du kun spangs pa'i drung du mjal nas/ kun spangs pas mkhan po/bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis slob dpon/ kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtshos gsang ste mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ kun spangs ba'i drung du dus 'khor gyi dbang mo che/ sbyor drug la sogs gdams pa dpag rkye med pa gsan/ yon tan khyad par can 'khyungs/ kun spangs ba yang shin tu mnyes/ de nas khyi lo la phyir phebs/ lo de la rin po che sangs rgyas dpal bzangs po gshegs/ ga ra 'brem bzhings pa la sogs pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mas skemadzad di/ rang lo lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo yos la gshegs/ chos kyi rje ra/ ka ra ni/ yon bdag thugs rje skyabs dang yum gzungs lcam la sras gsum —'khrungs pa'i gcen chos rje rat+na gu ru/de 'og ra ka ra ste lcags spo byi ba'i lo la 'khrungs/ mkhan chen bsod rnams ye shes dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas bzing po las thang skya lha khang du rab tu byung / rin chen 'byung gnas su mtshan gsol// paṇa chen shākya shrī'i sdom brgyud 'dzin pa mkhan chen sher mdon pa dang slob dpon bsod nams dbang rgyun pa la sogs pa las lang na par rdzogs/ 'dis kyang sa skyar byon nas bla ma bdaganyid che po/ bla chen kun blo la sogs 744

pa dang / dpang lo tsā ba/ 'jam dbyangs don yod pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnams kyi drung du gsan pa mang du mdzad/ de nas jo mo nang du byon nas byang sems rgyal ye la sbyor drug gi khrid dang /sems 'grel skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par gsan pas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo phye/ de nas stag lung du byon nas rat+na gu ru'i drung du bka' brgyud kyi chos ma lus pa gsan/ gzhan yang lam 'bras la sog mang du gsan zhing ka drug tu bzhugs/ rang lo bzhi bcu pa sa mo yos la gdan sar byon/ de dang nye ba'i rjes su rat+na gu ru gshegs nas/ lha chen rgyab mtho nyi shu rtsa gcig pa dang / gser 'bum mtho nyi shu yod pa dang /bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa la sogs bya ba rgya chen po rnams mdzad/ rgyud sde dang sde sgod kyi bshad pa btsugs/ chos drug lams 'bras/ sbyor drug la sogs khrid rnams btab/ rang nyid kyang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar bzhin du mdzad cing / gzhan dag kyang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bca' khrims bzhin du mdzad de rang lo drug cu rtsa gnyis pa lcags mo glang la gshegs/ de yan gyi rin po che rnams khams nas phebs pa yin/kun spangs nam mkha' dpal bzang po nas bod nyadung 'khyungs pa yin no/ / chos rje nam mkha' dpal bzang po ni/ yon bdag ye shes rin chen dang / yum phyug mo dpal le'i sras su chu mo bya la 'phan yul gyi dar yul du sku 'khrungs/ calo lnga sdom nas gzhan sdug bsngal ba gzigs pa na — 745

spyan chab 'byung ba tsam gyi snying rje chen po 'khrungs/ sku gzhon pa'i dus su sprang po stogs pa'i snang ba rgyun du byung bas/ mas ming yang sprang por btags/ gzhan yang yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun dga' bo/ nam mkha' rin chi zhes kyang btags te sngon gyi las kyi dbang gis ming yang mang gsung / dgu'i lo bdun pa me mo skos la mkhan po bla ma nam legs pa/r+sha slob dpon dzon yod be+e las rab tu byung / mtshan nam mkha' rgyal metshan dpal bzang por ga la/ lo brgyad pa la mngon shes 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu pa la brtag gasnyes kyi ṭī ka mchan la sogs la byang bar mdzad/sbyor drug las 'byung ba'i rtags rnams ma bsgoms par mngon du rgyur/ 4ba gcig pa la stinge rje tshad medo pa/ skyo shas drag po/ zab mo'i ——gsunge rab la brten nas gnas lurges zab mo'i do/ rtogs pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa rnams bcos ma min pa 'khyungs/ sku daskye meshā hūṃ ma rgya gar dang gtsang la sogs par 'khrungs pa'ang dran/ma dus snyi/ ting nge 'dzin la bzhugasang pa na 'das ma 'ongaso rnams kyang mkhyen pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rdobang phyug la nub co gnyis su chos gsan pa'i snang ba rī byung gsung ste/ de la sogs pa dpag tu mede na'ang phal cher mi gsung /gnas 'dir lo bco brgyad sdod pa'i smod lam btab/ spyir tshe tshad lo sum cu so bzhi yin/ gdams ngag zab mo'i byin rlabs la nges pa med gsung / dgung lo bco bgyed la chos rje bla ma dang / lo chen byang rtse 746

lama'ibras gsungs/ /nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la mi ka ra gshegs nas sku 'dab/ lha chen dang rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs pa la sogs pa ma da de gdan sar byon/ lo bco lngar tshogs pa bskyangs/ sbyor drug gi khrid yigango sprod/ rtsis yig la sogs pa'i bstan bcos dpag tu med pa mdzad/zab mo'i gdams pas kyang gdul bya rnams legs par bskyangs/ dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgya cher mdzad bzhed na'ang cung ma grub/ gtso por sku mtshams kho na la bzhugs/ sog yan chad du lan drug bdun gyi bar du byon/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum gyi bar du gdan sar bzhugs/gling thams cad kyang dar/ dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang 'phel zhing dar rgyas che'o / /de na rin po che bkra shis dpal brtsegs pa gdan sar bzhugs su gsol nas/ se smrer lo bzhi'i bar du bzhug / brdzid pa'i rim pa bde mchog dang gshed dmar la mdzad/ —rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag dru pa la mdzad/ sngar lo so dgu bzhes pa'i skabs su da ste lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun brgyad kyi skor la zheg chen yod gsung ba ba na rang lo zhe bdun bzhes pa sa mo lug la gshegs/ de'i phyi lo spre'u lo la sku 'bum dang lha chen la sogs kyang bzhengs so/ /de ltar na da pa 'di ni sngon sku skye —ba snga ma mang por sbyangs pa'i skyes bu chen po/ gzhan pas khyad par du gyur pa ste/ /'phags pa'i yul du bdag cag sngon/ /'og par lta bas ma khrid kyang / /dus kyi 'khor lo dang mjal bas/ /phyi nas 7slo

ra gsol te/ de ni rin po che na mkha' dpal bzang po'i mnal lam du byon pa bzhin btags par 'dug de nas chos dbang gnyis pa'i drung du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ de rjes nā ro'i chos drug dang phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa gsan pas lam gyi drod rtags sa ma gyis mi khyab pa 'khyungs shing bka' brgyud kyi chos rin po che ba la bzhugs tshad gsan/ sbyor drug gi khrid zhus pas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma gyed/ gzhan yang sha ba ra'i sbyor drug chos rje bsod rnams rgyal mtshan pa'i sbyor drug gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid dang nag khrid skor/ dmar khrid/ dbu sems kyi sems bskyed/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/ gshed dmar shin du spros med/ sa 'bras/ gcod yul la sogs mang du gsan/ bco brgyad ngas pho 'brug gi lo la gdan sar byon nas chos kyi 'khong lo rgya chen po bshor/ nyi shu pa sa pho rta lo'i smin drug gi ba la lha sang phebs/ mtshal pa'i si tu dge slong ba dang snel pa dpon grags pas bsu ba rgya chen po mdzad/ lo chen byang rtse dbus su 'bas pa dang 'dzosta nas ra ka brag tu mjal/ de nas lo chen byang rtses mkhan po/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan pas slob dpon/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang pos gsang ste mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo chen la dus 'khor gyi dbang yongs su rdzog pa/ bde mchog dag po pa/tshe dpag med la sogs pa'i dbang dang / rgo grags pa la gsang 'dus 750

dmar khrid/ kyi rdor dang / bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang mang po/dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ dbang mdor bstan rtsa 'grel/ don dam bsnyen pa la sogs dang / sems 'grel gzhan rnams dang / dus zhabs ston brgyud dang / yu mo'i gsal sgron bzhi dang / ye shes spyan ba/nyi zla sgrub pa/ dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug man lungs pa'i sbyor drugagasang 'dus kyi sbyor drug dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma/ mdor bsdus dang po'i 'grel pa mi g.yo snang ba/ bu'i sbyor drug gdan bzhi'i 'grel pa/bka' gdams kyi lam rim lasogs nga dpag tu med pa gsan/ jo po'i drung du na bza' gser gsol dkar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad/ sa mo lug gi lo gorin bo che nam mkha' dpal bzang po gsheṭa zhes 'byung ste/ rin po che pa rang gi rnam thar na kun spangs zhe gsumadzo rta lo la mdzad nas rang 'okhozhe bdun pa la gshegs/ gdan bar lo bco lnga song zer ba 'dug bkra shis dpal rtsegs pa'i rnam /thar na gdan mir sbrul la bskos/ de rjes gyi lug la chos rje nam mkha' dpal bzang po gshegs zer ba 'dug pasaganyis po lo ni mi lagrig par snang ngo/ /rin po che ba'i gdung sbyangs pas me tog gi char/ lha sku/ ring bsres la sog pa dpag tu med pa byon/ gshegs 'dab kyi bya ba rgya chen po rnams mdzad/ dngul gyi gdu nga khab khyu gang pa / byulha chen/ gsung rab mang po rnams bzhengs/ de rjes mkhar rtse ba la dzong mis dmag drangs 351

pa'i bar mdzad/ de nas stagalung du phebs nas khrid kha grangs med pa btab ste chos kyi 'khor tho mchen po bskor/ mdzad spyod rnam thar thams cad bla ma gong ma'i rjes su 'jug/ snyan pa'i grags bas kyang phyogs thams cadabadu khyab par gyur to/ /gling ga ba tu sha mi 'grim pa'i khrims kyang rin bo che 'di mdzad/ skabs shed du rje btsun spyi lhas pa'i gdan sa ba 'phags pa'i sprul par grags pa de la 'bul ba dang / dge 'dun la mang ja bgyir bas mnal lam du rin po che blogazhu rigs lngas brgyan pa cig dbu la gsol ba mis/ bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur ba'i mtshan ltas du ma la brten na / sbyar bstan pa'i dar rgyas dang / khyad par kun spangs nam mkha' dpal bzang bo'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i snyir du dbus gtsang gi n+de dgo thams cad du mang skol gyi rnam bzhag rgya chen po ma da/ de'i snyi zhig na rgo bzhir sgu tshams shin tu dam pa la bzhugs te/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bar ba ga pa lhangs chen bo byung /de nas chos rje kun bkras ba rwa sgreng gi bar du phebs pa la mjal/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang sogs ba dang / lam 'bras dang gi gu'i skor mang du gsan pa'i rje su phag gru ba'i nang zings byung na /bar skabs su 'bul ba gnang sbyin zhal brda mang du mdzad/ de rjes dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan lha ra theb ba tshe mjal ba la phebs/ jo bo la mar khal sum brgya'i dkar / ga ra zang bzhi'i nam ga ra/752

bzhug dngul ji gsagaser yong dang na ba 'a mang po'i 'a latsho byung / ske 'grugadang rtses thab rnams su'ang phebs/ tshong 'dus su ngazha ltagacig bzhugs nas thelabakye phebs/ thel bas bsu ba rgya chen po mdzadas nasnasa' ga spyil du sku 'dra rin po che la mjal ba'i tshe smon lam mang du d+ku mthod cing 'dug sku 'khor rnams la byin rlabs phebs/ nyam 'i'atshib mang po byung / spyan snga bsod nams grags pa'i byang du 'bul sgo chen rupo dang mang skol la sogs mdzad cing / thel bas kyang zhabs stona'abul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ ltag lung mig mgor yang pheb / de nas phyir lam lha sa dang glang thang la sogs su blon/ khyad par du rgya cabaka'itu zabs nas chos gsungag pas chertag gi cham rdul non tsam du bab/'di'i skapas sungachos rje de bzhi na gshegs pol rgya'i gdan 'dren7)lha ste zhing gis tshebs/ rtog ldan zhogag rgya bo 'dod pa dang / sgo mo rin po che ba po dpal 4 mar 'dod pa rnam mkhyen nas 4byin parang /lha chen ba ngas byas 'dir brkos gsung nas brkos ༷ rdo lung byung ba — dab ma nga gi 4bulasa'i dzor sa mad por nye ba mkhyen pa sa sogs pa'i mngon pas mkhyen pas mkhyen pa'i gsung dang mdzad pa yang grangs las 3'ad / skabs shed du shin ju mnyel ba mirabyung )sa/ sku rim/du gsu — rab rmya rdul sprug klog 'don btsug dacakhri'adun phyed dang sum brgyas lo /gsum na tshar/ skabs der langa' ris ba'i 'bul bas sleb/ sngon 754

men zhang gi yul na mi re shi ba'i ro dang lhagadu gson po khyudrug bdun ji bsreg pa'i srol yod pa la gcung bya bral bas grub rtags mang du bstan nas las de'i 'phro shol du btsug pas lo sum cur bcad/ de rjes rje rin po che gong mas ri pa cig btang bal lo bcu gnyis su phul/ da yang mi cig gtong bar zhu zer byung bas/ bla ma 'jam 9dpal seng ge btang nas min zhang gi rgyal po tha gur la chis bshad/ rgyal po la sku 'dra/dbu zhwa la sogs pa'i gnang byin mang lapo dang / blon po bai ma la dang ther ma le gnyis la'ang gnang // nebaskur nas gsung bsgrags pas/ rgyal po de na re/ spyor mar gul gu ru/nas men zhang gi skyabs gnas stag lung pa yin zer nos/ me 'khor zer ba de phul/ sma na lung pa zar ba cig la'angakonazher mang du byin skes r+sha mkhor blus/ rgyal po nyungs ti tsho 5 rat+nas spyong phu 'ju/ de skos skadzab6chubaltatu rgyal dzamar la med sgo yong gesung na / tham rtsod la rngom gro gyi gtsang snang / — —dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dzi la'agre rim gro sku na po ba /la/ nang so nas kyang sku rim mang ru mdzad na'ing / ca sa g.yos chenamusatsunge na gtsug la khang gi sha ra sgo'i khang pa 7sgog gling da ba /zhe — ma tha ming du 'gyel zes zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam du skye 'bum ltag suñtsa skosemadzod nas bzhugs pas/ nye gnas rnams med spa'i shume du rna ba khyu sa spriji gi gis sku mdun du 'ongs/khong rnams phar 'ded la la snyi nas na ze 'a la ldeg byed pa byung /—zlasmosmo

tshul khrims kyi dri ngan phun sum tshogs pa sku mdun du ba ga pa'i sgyud pa rnams la'ang bro/ mtshun mo mar the la bltas dus grib ma'ang cher mi 'ong / sgo ma sge bar gyi nang du phar tal tshur tal du 'byon pa'ang mdzad/mi dpon chen po rnams dang rgya'i ta zhing la sogs pas kyang sku'i gzi mi bzod par zhum par gyur/ spyod ji rin po che bsod nams bzang po ba gshegs pa'i sku 'dab kyi gral dbu la phag mo grur phebs/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan pas rdo mda' nas bsu ba mdzad/ thel du phebs nyin nam mkha' la 'ja' rta babs kyi rnam par yod pa gsum/ phyed pa bzhi lnga tsam yod pa byung / de res zhag bzhi bzhugs pa'i gnyis song ba'i dro bzhes la yang dgon nang sor 'gon khar nyi ma tham cad dge ba yis rgyu skapa thams cad bzang ba yin/ nged la de ring brel ba chen po /ga yod gsung zhing byon/ dro bzhes grol nas thugs dam cung zhig gnang nas /de rjes gzims khang dben pa zhig tu ja zabs gyis/ khyed thel pa'i mkhan slob dgon pa gas rnying thams cad sog / lhad ja 'dren mtshon cig byed stong yin/ chos rje bsod nams rgyas mtshan pa la bzhugs ston mthon po bskams la/ de'i steng du nged kyi ston dmar 'di ring / nged rang gi lhags phyi ba tshos khong bzhugs gdan steng su gdan drongag la bzhugs su gsol gsung nas bzhugs pa drang 'bul ba chen po mdzad/ tsho sang sa rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi rnam 'uphrul mamo po phag mo gru pas gnas 'dir 75 6

skye 'gro mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad/ de rjes gyur rin po ches gdan sa bskyangs/ de nas spyan snga rin po ches gdan sar byon pa nas/ da lta'i bar du gdung brgyud dri ma med pas gdan sa bskyang / da rgyal tshab khyed kyis mdzod la gdul bya mtha' ya pa'i 'dren pa mdzod/ gong rme rnams las thugs rje dang phrin las mi chung ba 'ong ba yin ga zhung ba / spyan snga rin po che'i gsung nas kyang / bka' bzhin sgrub par zhu gsung /de nas sne gdong du phebs pa la nyang po'i shan khar shan dang skam gyi bar 'dom do tsam yod pa la/ la las chibs dang bcas nas bzhud pa ra mthong / las chen rin rgyal bas chibs bskal nas zhabs chu la ma0jig par brgyad pa mthong ba sogs mthong snang du ma byung / dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas shan kha nas bsus/ zhabs tog dang 'bul ba che khapo mdzad nas bya sa bar du skyel thung mdzad/ gyis phebs par zhu sgo / da mi sleb gsung nas sbyir phebs/ gong nas rgyal po daXng gis gu shrī'i las ka/ dngul gyi tham kha ga'o ming dang bcas pa'i gnang sbyin mang po gnang nas sleb/ de'i gyi zhig na sku grib la brten pa'i bsnyun blo deg cig byung nas sku rim dbag tu med pa mdzad/ chos rje byang chub rgya mtsho ba gdan sar bskos/ de gis re shig na dwang skyod che bar byung / ts+tshade'i dngas lugs zhus pas/ nges 'byung drag po cig la brten na lhung sems snying gar 'dus pa sna khyur tshud/ de rkyen byas nas mdu gyi nam 8557

mkha' pha rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon/ de'i 'og rim la yi dam mang po/ de dang nye bar sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang / de'i 'og tu dpa' bo dpa' mo cholas skyong dang bcas pa gsal bar byung / de tsho ri rjes ga rgya chen po'i ngang du gan pa byung gsung / stag lung — nga pa chen 4shārnyid myur byon pa min par lan grangs du mar zhal gyis bzhis/ mgur cham gyi mnyel ga cig la brten nas drug cu rtsa drug bzhes pa shing rdzo me thug la gshegs/ gshegabashakha gsol ba gang du 'debs zhus pas/gshed rdzongs kyi nyin 'jag /la stong gi nam mkha' sa 'ong bas gsol ba 'chab/ gzhan bla ma gong pha rnams kyang bzhud pas dga' ldan du gsol ba thob gsung / lha'i rol mo'i spa sgo tshogs grag pagagang / gzims khang chubazheng du 'od dkar po ka ba btsugs pa lta bu byung ba kun gyi mthun snang du gyur/— gdung sbyang pas dung g.yas 'khyil balha dang / thugs dang ring bsgrol mas du skyon/ 4 spur dud kyis gar khyab tu tog gi char 'dab ma bzhi pa'i the'u 'gru ring ba la la byas pa'i char bab ste/ tshogs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi ja por nang du bab nas kyang mang du byung ngo/ /chos rje byang chub rgya mtsho ni/ chu cangalug gi yo/ 'khrungs/ chu lug 'di chos rje bkra shi dbal brtsegs pa'i bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa yin/ —rin po che 'di ni/ daphal mkha' 4spyod pa'i gsung las/ sngon gyi 'phen pa'i lhag mas byang phyogs kyi rgyud bla ma'i t+panas spyod cing / de'i zin las 758

sgrub par byed do zhes sku yal ba'i slob ma bkra shes grags par rgyur pa'i tre rten 'brel la brten nas dpal mkha' spyod pa nyid yin pa'i nges pa du ma yod do zhes zer ro/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa shing pho 'brug la gad sar phebs lcags pho khyi'i bar du lo ngo bdun gdan sa mdzad/ de nas kun spangs mdzad de sa stod smad thams cad du byon nas gzhan don bskyangs/ gzims khang gzims sbyil du mdzad/ mthar kong po nas rim pas brgyud de mdo khams su byon nas gdul bya dpag tu med po bskyangs/ zhe drug bzhes po thorko'ibage li mdo khams su gshegs/chos rje bkra zhibashadapa'adi'od pa sa pho byibab la 'khyungs/ nyi shu rtsa gsum ba sakhapa'i lcagaso khyi 'khagadan sar 'khrig logs sum cu rtsa gcibatagi bar du gde sar bzhugs/ rang lo lnga btsu rtsa ga miganazhe tsho pa lcags 'brug la gshigs/ chos kyi rje perin po che ngag dbang grags pa dpa bzang por+sha ni/ sa pho khyi lko 'a khrungs/ skyes bu dam pa rdu makonabasnyen nas pha rol du gyido pa dang ༄da sde'i go sa pa mang du mdzad/ sgrub brgyud kyi gdams pa mang du gasna na/ khyad par gtsang phyog su byon nas thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyigasal po la gas pa'i skyes bu/dem ṭ+wāṃ mang rba bsten/ dpal mo chos dzipobatadang la phyi la sogs ba'i gnabaṇamang lhar nga'ispyogs/ snan pa'i grags pos phyogs thams rtsad du khyab/ dgung rgo bzhithabatsu rtsa bzhi3ba se pa lcags moskosgrolam gdage rdo phe ba /smyo khu nang gisamakhyi pa dang thugar dam 75nya

thams cad la 'gran pa'i zla ni med/ gtsug lag khang chen bo'i zhabs tog 'dzin tshugs thams cad kyang khyad par du 'phags pa mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi sde chen po yang dar rgyas su gyur/ dpal stag lung thang pa'i 'jig rten phyogs kyang chos rje rin po che 'di'i ring kho na dar rgyas che/ma gi nga gi rgyal khams yan chad du bya ba thams cad bzhugs stan mnan pa nyid kyis 'grub/ sde sned 'dzin pa thams cad kyang zhabs drung du lhags pa na mkhyen pa'i gting mi dpogs par rgya / 'bral gyi mdzad spyod rnam thar ni bzang / snyi nang tham cad nor longs spyod kyis ni gang / lha chen bzhengs pa dang sbyan gtong rgya chen po mdzad pa la sogs pha'i mdzad pa rnams ni bsam gyis /mi bab pa mdzad na / dpon rin po che dgung mo bcu gsum bzhes pa cig skadan sar bzhug su bcug chos rje rin po cu nyid kun spangs mdzad na zhabs brtan par bzhugs/ chos kyi rje rin po che bkra shis dpal ba ni lcags mo sbrul la bye mar 'khrung nas/chos rje rin po che las bka' brgyud kyi chos ma lus par gsan/ dgung —lo bcu gsum pa la gdan sar pheb so/ /de la sbyir bod gangs can gyi —rgyud 'dir/ lha sa'i rdo ring kyi yi ge sa/ 'phrul gyi lha bcan po 'od lde rgya rgyal yul byung 4dong tshun chad gdung ma 'gyur bar bod kyi rgyal /po chen po chen po mdzagaces pa ltar/ rje gnya' btsan po 'od lde nas sne ral pa chan yan chod du rgyal rabs bzhi bcu —rtsa gnyis su gdung ma 'gyur 760

bar bod 'bangs thams cad bskyangs pas/ gdung rabs rgyun ring zhing shin du bka' drin che/ chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis sbyin bdag mdzad mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mkhan po mdzad de/ sad mi mi bdun la sogs pa rab tu byung nas rab tu byung ba thams cad skyon med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan/ thams cad kyang mkhas pa'i yon tan gyis sde sdod gsum ga 'chad par dus pa byung mod kyi/ mi nar mas bstan pa ba bas pas rab hūṃ byung ba'i bston pa lo drug cu rtsa bdun tsam las ma ginas/ di nas bdun tsu lhagagi bar du dbus gtsang tshums pha tshunas ba rtsod kyis gang zhing dge 'dun gyi the med/ de nas bla chen po'i drin dang dbus gtsang mi drug gam bcu'i drin gyis dge 'dun gyi sde mang du 'phel na'ang sde phan tshun gyi rtsod pa dang dus gyis hor dmag gisi ju sgring du dge 'dun lnga bgyi tsam bkrongs pa dang / rgyaladur rta lnga thorgya tsam bsad pa sogs mtho dman mang du byung rte gyi bla ma 'phag ba'i sku drin gyis sa skya pas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi bdag mdzad/ 'on kyang gdung brgyud nang gi chags thang 'babarten nas/ ba na pa lo bdun cu rtsa lnga tsam las ma byung / lang rje dwags po'i slob ma yang slob la sogs pas so sor n+de chen po btsugs pa la/ gdan sa thel du'ang 'gro ba'i mgon po gshegs rjes nas yun ring du gdan sa ba med pas myag par byung / bogakyi yul 'dir gan sal cig ni 'du gyi sdethabatsugs pa 'bri khung the che 761

ba yin/ dus gyis sa skya pas dgon pa la me bcug gtsug lag khang dang rten thams cad bsregs te nyaganyes mang du byung / stag lung pa ni dang por rtog lung thang pas ngagon 4 btab pa nas ding sang gi bar tha rangs mang du byon pa la gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde phun sum tshoms pa/ ding sang bar du su'i yang gnod 'tshe med de/ hor dmag gi 'jigs pa chen po byung dus kyang dmag rnams phod mdo'i mdun la lazims pa la/ mu ga lung pa la gnod pa cung zang kyang /zhed dzedus sa ca'abri khung pa lha the ya sde gnyis spu'i dgang gis rtsa thang gi thang che po stse khengs ba la rtog5ming bu'i brgya/lhag cig gis shin tu gam par byas/— mdor na chosasde gas na ding sang bar du lo shin du mang bar song kya glingag ba tu bud1reng kyis mig (blta bar dka' ba'i chos khrims dang / nyams shen 7gyichogs khu rim zhig pu 'di ni 'gran zla dang bral ba yin nyu/ de tshos ske ri par —blon supa rnams grub pya sgrob pa sha sta ga byon pa'i byin gyi rlabs su rig par 3 ma bla de sgoms kyang rten 'brel sgrig bye 'a shin tu mkhas pa sde tshusha.u shin tu ring bar gnas pa yin no snyam dra bsams so/ /de yamachos sde 'di dang po lcags pho byi ba'i lo la btab pa tshonas brtsams te/ deng sang gi khu pho spre'u yan la lo nyis brgya dang das bcu rtsa bdun 'dam pā 'i rno / /sangs rgyas dbon ni/ gangs rgyas laca skyon gyi slobazhi bas jagu ༷ lcags tshu gas sa mdo skams su ཿga /tsho lha

'khrungs/ yab yum gyis chung ngu'i dus nas khrid byonate glang ling la'i nang khongs su phebs pa na/ zhabs la zom pa chung ngu cig gyon nas kha ba'i thog tu byon pa kha ba la sor mo'i rje ma 'dre par dod pa lang mdzad 'di rje sgasakhapo ba'i sku'i skye ba yin te/ cho 'phrul mang po bstan pa'i thog ma ni zhabs rjes der snang / phyis grong pa'i byis pa zla bo ril shing 'thur song ba dernams dang 'dra ba'i byis pa mang po sprul/ rtsed mo bayang mdzad tham su bumo gzhon zhu ma 'ga'irgyan cha 'phrog pha mdzad pa skyes khri mang po 'ded par brtsam pa na/ bar du mtsho chen po zhig sprul pas 'ong ma nus de la sogs ba byis pa'i dus kyi cho 'phrulagyi mdzad pa shin tu mdza dgung lo bcu ga thim lang bas rgyas thor skyon mi ra rabatu byung sangal rgyagayar byon la bka' brgyud kyi chos muphul4dang / 'gro ba'i ma na po phag mo gru pa nas brgyud pa'i ltagalu ya la snya brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs po rnams kyang legasapar ga rna/ gzhan sdi sdod dang rgyud sde la'adi mi mkhyen bya bar+sha da de/ mkhanapo 4 sag pa la sogs ba la dbu ma'i 'grel pa chen mo sgoms legs par gsungs pa dang / gzhan don du gnyir bapar gsang ba 'dus74'i 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba la sogs pa mang du gsungs/ mtshan di grags pa dpal zhes bya/ khungs rgyas mir byon ga shegs khar gdan sa gtad/ spyir longs rgyas yar byon de sa sku mtshams 'ba' zhig mdzad pa la/ lamags pa byon pas tshogs susbyor 36

nas 'phags pa dang mjal/ de'i dus su dbon po maṅga la gu ru 'phags pa la gtad gnyer bcol/ maṅga la gu ru la yang sangs rgyas yar byon nyid kyis gdan sa mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs/ gnyis po bla ma'i gdan sa la thugs mi mthun pa ltar gyur/ bla ma 'phags pa mang gur ba'i bdag gnyer mdzad pas/ sangs rgyas dbon gdan sa lo gcig mdzad na khams su brgyad dgos par byung ste/ stag lung chos rje'i ba la khang nang gi rna snang ma sbo la sogs pa yang ko thums mdzad de bsnams/ gzhan rten ngo mtshar can rnams dang / rje btsun mi la'i phyag mkhar dang / shal skyogagayod pa'ang bsna sa/ sa skya pa'i gser yig pas rgyag mkhar dang zhal /tanas gtong dgos rgyas pa la ma gtad pas gser yig ba blo gro bton nas/ nga la thod ba cig dang yog pa cig blang dang / nga de kha min bya mas zer ba la/ dpon gyi de byed da gzod gnyi ga la mid mi ches pa cig 'ong ba min gsung / phyags gyir yod pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang gtong ba 'thad zhus pas/ sangs rgyas yar byon gyi gsung gis/ 'di rnams dang ma shi ba'igabar du 'grogs gsung pa yod/ de sta yizhes kho bo 'chi ba min gsung nas bsnang bar gyur pa la/ gsol ba drag tu btab pas stogs/ de nas khams su byon nas me pho byi bzhimadza/ rab lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa la ri bo che btab/ding sang gi par du khams na che ba'i sde chen bo de byung bas/ sangs rgyas 764

g.yam bzang pa'i skabs/'gro mgon gyi bu chen ba ra'i skal ldan ye shes seng gi ni/ skye ba snga ma khams su mi phug ces bya bar skyes pa'i tshe ming col ba/ rus klad ru yin de'i tshe yum ni dmar gza' pad+ma zhes bya/ de'i dus su bal bod —mtshams nas byon pa'i rnal 'byor pa bde mchog mkhan po zhig yod pa des dbang bskur/ rnal 'byor pa de la jo mo cig dang g.yog po nag po ciba'iyode pa ming /(nga la gnang / yul de na/mi spun lnga yod me'i lnga tshigs kyis khong gi jo mo 'dzog khospri rang gsod mdu rgyung bas bred nas mdzod phugs su nyal bas/ shākamogashig po de na re/ — bad mi dgos ngas ru ga gepa sade pas chog zer/ kho'i lag pa'i mthil na ral gri'i mtshan ma'ang yod/ de nas rug se bsad/ nges par dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon de —bedi mchog dang / rjo mo de 'e gi ma dang / g.yog po nag po de dpal mgon po yin par gda'/ zhes zu ra bam̐ nyid/ kyis gsungs/ sbo ra bzhin tshe 'dir son 'gar du 'khrungs/ gzhon dus ra 'cha ba'i tshe ri kha nas phag mo gru pa'i dgon pa'i ri mthong ba tsam gyis sgom rang byung du shar/ sgom chen gnyis kyis sgom gyi gleng slongs byas chabs/ de sgom yin na ngas kyang sgom shes par 'dug snyam nas/ dgon par byon nas 'gro mgon 76 ri

dang mjal bas/ zhal nas/ 69da tshe snga ma sgom chen bzang po cig yin par 'dug pa la dam tshig gi sel cig yod par 'dug sgom che na bzang po yin pas ma'i lus la yod pa'i tshe yang ma'i lus sems bde ba dang /khyod rang la sgom rang byung du shar ba yin/ dam sel yod pa'i rtags su kha bub min pa nyal mi shes pa yin gsung nas/ ngo sprod cig btab pas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ ming yang skal ldan ye shes seng gir btags/ dus phyis gra rabs su zwa ra dgon pa btab/ gzims khang gi bla rdzam gyi rtsig ngos la khong rang gi skyes rabazla mang po yang bris/ gdan sa phag mo grur yang spyil mo che rtsig pa sogs gus zhen che bar mdzad/ / de'i slob ma g.yam bzang chos rje ni/ des rjes su gzung ba yin te/de yang yabasprang mo lcam dang / yum zhang lcam 'bum skyid bya ba mkha' 'gro ma yin pa zhig gi sras su sa mo glang gi lo la gtsang zhal gyi dmar mong 'khrungs/ gzhon pa'i dus bya zhing du skyal ba la dkon mchog mchod pa la mkhas pa cig byung / gnas po na re/ khyod rang btsun pa byas na la da par 'dug zer bas/ sgrin mkhan po chos ston bya ba gtsang ba cig la rangatu byung / mtshan chos smon lam du btags/ de nas 'chang dkar du slob dpon rnams la 'dul ba dang bka' gdams gsan/ de dus sgos rang 'khrungs su byung bas/ slob dpon na re/ btsun chung 'di la ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'dug gsung / de nas dge slong mdzad par dgongs 767

te rgya dur dgon par dgung lo bco brgyad pa la mkhan po klubs dkar dang / slob dpon gong gad pa gnyal dar ma gzi brjid/ gsang ste ba slob dpon me char la zhus te bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo lnga drug gi bar du mkhan po'i drung du bzhugs nas 'dul ba mkhas par bslabs pas bsnubs 'dul ba 'dzin par grags/ lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa lcags pho khyi'i lo la steng ba lo tsā ba gshegs pa'i 'dad dang / ltad mo byas lugs rnams der phyin pa rnams bos kyang gsal bar gzigs pa'ang byung / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga la nyi zla sgang du slob dpon gyi chos bzhi byung ba'i tshe zhar chos pa mdzad nas mdo rtsa ba thugs nas gsungs/ mkhan po la phal po che spong brgyad ma cig dang / khrub bzang ba cig gis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba phul bas mkhan po mnyes/ khyod la skye ba 'di la chos mang po bsdud pa cig 'ong gsung / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa la dge 'dun bya zhing pa'i gnyer bzang ba cig mdzad/ lo de la mkhan po klubs dkar gshegs pas mya ngan skyes pa'i skyo bsangs la bos ri ba dang 'grogs te grar phebs pa'i tshe/rmā ra na skal ldan ye shes seng ge bya ba sangs rgyas dngos cig bzhugs/sbrang mas gdugs phub/ phag mo gru pa'i bu chen yin zer ba gsan nas dad pa skyes nas zu rar byon pas/ zhal mjal ba tsam gyis bla ma'i thugal dang gnyis su med pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ de nas gtsang phyogs su yul ltad mdzad/ — zhig po bdud rtsi dang mjal nas nas 'gyed blangs/ slong 768

dpon bra sbang dang rgyang ro dar mgon gyi zhal mjal/ slar dbu rur byon pas bla ma zhang 'khrug pa mdzang zer bas cung ma dad par ma mjal yang phyis mos gus dpag tu med pa thob nas bla ma lta bur 'dzin/ 'phan yul brag dkar du brag dkar ba la sems bskyed zhus/ bya yul bsdubs sgom la skyabs 'gro zhus/ de nas tshur 'on la byon pas rje 'bri khung ba zhal mjal nas chos thun cig kyang gsan/ dgung lo sum cu pa la 'bum zhing du 'jig rten blos btang gi sgrub pa mdzad/ de'i phyi lo zu ra ba'i spyan sngar byon/ khyod kyis dbang bskur thob bam gsung pa la/ ma thob zhus pas/ slob dpon dbon po la bka' gnang nas dbon pos rnal 'byor ma'i dbang gnang / der ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dpag tu med pa 'khrungs pa la zwa ra bas lung bstan bzang po mang po mdzad/ de nas ra mo na rje btsun mi las ras chung ba la lung bstan pa'i mtha' lung dang / 'chu gu'i mgul la sogs par bzhugs/ de'i phyi lo thā ra ba'i drung du byon pas snying po phyag rgya chen po/ khyad par snyan brgyud kyi ngo sprod thabs lam nā ro'i chos drug la sogs pa gnang nas/ da kho bo rabs mi 'chad par 'dug gsung nas mnyes/ 'bum zhing du dgun se ba la me tog byung bas klus me tog phul pa'i snyan grags kyang byung / yab bsnyung pa la 'grongs khar zhig po bdud rtsi byung nas byin gyis brlabs/ mtha' lung du bzhugs pa'i tshe rgyu 'bras legs par mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi 769

khyab pa 'khrungs/ slob dpon gnyags sgom la lo ro ba'i chos jug dang tshe sgrub zhus/ gnyags sgom de sum pa'i nye gnas yin/ de nas 'o de gung rgyal la byon pas bzhugs snying 'dod pa ma byung nas log nas/ kha bu ya le la gcod thun gcig ma zhus/ ba ra bas phag mo grur khang pa rtsig pa'i mkhar las kyang mdzad/ khyod kyis snye nas shing drongs shig gsung thab /de ma grub pas thā ra ba'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis ma drang kyab nga'i shing 'dren pa'i stabs ma chag gsung / so drug pa shing byi la kha che paṇa chen bod du byon/ sha:sa yon bdag byed par khas snang nas/ so brgyad pa the pho stag la g.yam bzangs btab/ de'i snyi lo me mo yo la zwa nga ba gshegs/ de nas tshogs pa bskyangs skabs shig tu rang nyid srong btsan bam po yin pa dang / khru 'brug gi rtsigs lugs/ nor dang chos kyi gter sa lugs la sogs pa mang po yang gsungs/ nga nyid lnga brgya tha ma tshe/ /bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga na/ /sto phyogs g.yor pa'i rgyal kha mas su/ /glang chen ga ra gyi lo la 'khrungs/ /mtshan gi t+ta mi bra ṇi zhes/ /rgyal po 'di skad gsung zhes par/ /dam pa'i chos rnams 'a da par byed/ /ces gsungs pa de yang zhal du 'don/ chos kyi rgyal po 'di dgon pa btab rjes nas gnyal stod smad/ mtsho sna/ sto brag yar klung shar nub rnams su yon bdag so sos chos 'khor gyi gtso bor gdan drangs te chos gsung sa pa'i chos khri'ang sto brag tu bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ gnyal du bsha ba cu 770

rtsa bdun byung zhing gi rnams mcho da rten ri bas byin rlas d+kung/ gnas gzhan dang yar klungs shar rdu ba rnams su chos ga ra gyi gtso nu —mdzad pa dang / chos khri byung ba la bas 7byas la/ tshala'akhong lta byung ba'i 'bulab rnams kyi thog nas thā rar yang snga gyi mang du bskya la za ra ba sku gzi brdzid dang ldan pa zhal 'dzum pa tso gzigs pa'i snang ba yang mang du byung ngo/ /dus zhig gi tshe sa la du ser mdun la migs pa'i zhal brda' mdzad bas/ sbra dkar rnag da dang bzhi bas ba tu byung ba khri phyed dngaganyis/mkhan po khu pa da mdzad skasagatobab sum brgya/ g.yam bzangs pa'i ri pa brgyazhe nyi rtsartsa ga ga 'tshogasabyar sog chag ya / sga 'dra na nags r+shakrongs kha ma / yon 'gar mgonar gdong mas gro shul cha bdar+shatshun/ gang par ga ra chu kha yan bragagatam shul tshun/ yas ba bya sa'i bsgo'itshol rgya mdzad / gzhan don ston ring du mdzad nas gas drug cu rtsa chu pa lcags sbrul gyi mkhasagashegs/ 'di gdu rgya dpa tu da pa bskyangs pa'i nang nas/ slong sgol sgosagrag tho gnyal smad dbazlari ba ngas rgyas ga sgom/ gor gdogal sang rgya lha sgomarteg ra lte gresangs rgyas le sgom/ dgo da ga ra ba sangs rgyas rgya sgo rnams so/ /chos rje gshegs rjesak+ṣe nga rtanas 1 gdas rin chen jo za kyis chu tha rtog ṣ+ka ba gdan sa lo dgu mtshanaspyo gshegs/de'i rjes su rtog 77

ldan rgyal po dge mdzes 'od kyis chu mo yos nas lcags 'brug gi bar lo sum cu rtsa brgyad gdan sa mdzad/ gtsug lag khang chen mo btab/ de'i rjes su mkhar chu ba chos bsam 'od kyis lcags sbrul nas sa khyi'i bar lo bco brgyad gdan sa mdzad/ 'di grub chen u rgyan pa'i slob mar rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bstan/ de rjes sa mo phag nas thā ra ba bde legs 'od kyis chu khyi'i bar lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi gdan sa mdzad/ gnyal tshan gsum du thar pa gling gi gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes gdung brgyud pa bkra shis 'od kyis chu mo phag nas lcags pho stag gi bar lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad gdan sa mdzad/ 'di lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi yang slob ma yin/ 'dis gdan sa lha grags pa 'od pa la gtad nas khong rang kun spangs mdzad/lha grags 'od pa ni/ shing mo phag la 'khrungs nas bcu bdun pa lcags mo yos nas shing pho spre'u bar lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi gdan sa mdzad de/ rang lo bdun cu pa la gshegs/ 'di nas gdan sa lhas gzung ba yin/'dis chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gzims g.yog kyang mdzad/ bu ston rin po che la sogs mang du bston nas chos mang du gsan/ 'di la chos rje lha khang stengs pas gtugs nas chos mang du gsan no/ /de rjes lha bsod nams 'od zer pas shing mo bya nas me pho rta'i bar du lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis/de rjes spyan snga bsod nams 'od mdzes pas me lug nas chu spre'u bar lo nyi shu rtsa drug /de rjes bya lo la gdan sa med/ de rjes shing pho byi la 772

spyan snga rdor rgyal ba bskos nas chu sbrul gyi bar lo nyi shu bzhugs/ rda nas da lta'i me pho spre'u'i bar du lo gsum song/ spyir na g.yam bzang chos rjes me glang la 'khrungs nas me pho spre'u yan la lo sum brgya dang brgyad song ngo/ /gdan sa 'dir lha bsod nams 'od zer pa'i ring la bla ma sa skya pa rin chen dpal gyis bskul ma dang zhal bkod mdzad/ gtsang pa nam mkha' byang chub pas bshad nyan mdzad nas da lta'i bar du 'chad nyan gyi srol ma chad do/ /g.yam bzang pa'i skabs so/ /chos rje gtsang pa bu chen gdan rabs dang bcas pa'i skabs/dpal phag mo gru pa'i slob ma rje btsun gling ni/ myang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi bzhings kyi glang po sna na gling stod smad gnyis las gling smad pa/ yab rgyal po skyab be bya ba sngags kyi sgrub skor mang du mkhyen zhing sman dang rtsis kyi yon tan gyis 'tsho ba zhig yod pa de dang / yum gzug mo dar chung gi zas su sa pho spre'u la bltams/ mtshan pad+ma rdo rjer gsol/ gzhon dus su 'bri klog mkhas par mkhyen/ lo brgyad pa la lha rje ra sman la zhing gcig phul nas sman bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen/bcu gsum pa la yab gshegs/ bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe slob dpon gling 773

pas dge bsnyen mdzad/ slob dpon dpal dbyangs kyi sgron ma rnam drug la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du gsan/ rje dpon cig dang rabs chad la ma 'cham pos de pha phung par gyur te mthu che bar yang grags/ de nas dge bshes 'om thang pa la rab tu byung / jo stan gyi brtul zhugs mdzad/dbus pa zhang bya ba rwa dang dpyal gnyis ba'i slob ma yin pa zhig la jo mo'i skor rnams zhu / bsnubs kyi sreg pa lung du rwa lo tsā ba la dus 'kho ra dang / 'jigs zud dang / bde mchog dang / thog mo rnams gsarna/de nas bsod stoms mdzad cing byon pas sman mos brid nas tshul las nyams/ de yang smon sangs rgyas log par dad sel gyi bstan pa la dge slong byang chub sems dpa' gnyis kyis bud med kyi 'khor la chos bstan pa la/ gzhan dge slong drug cu'i sde zhig yod pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' de gnyirmes la 'khrig pa'i chos kyis skur ba btab/ des skye bo rnams kyang de gnyis la ma dad par gyur/ las drag po de'i rkyen gyis dge slong drug cu po dmyal bar lhung zhing yun ring po gnas/ de nas shākya thub pa 'ji ga rten du byon pa'i tshe dge slong drug cu pos mi lus thob nas ston pa'i spyan snga ra yang lha nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de rngams kyi las kyi tshul gsungs pas drug cu pos bshags pa mang du byas/ 'on kyang las kyi lhag mas drug cu po rnams yul ga na ngan par dbul po'i rigs su skye ba sogs su lung bstan/ rje btsun gling ni de rnams kyi nang nas byang chub 774

sems dpa' brtson 'grus 'od bya ba yin par dkon brtsegs phyis gzigs pas mngon par mkhyen par gyur/ de'i rnam smin gyi 7 lhag mas sku tshe 'dir yang sman mo dang 'a/brel ba yin/ /rab tu byung ba'i ba slab sra nyams pa / sman mo na re/ nga'i pha ma gnyis rmu phyu ga khong gnyis la zu med pas nor blangs pas ster bas/ khyung tshang ba la 'o skol gnyis kritalas 'ardal mi gnod pa'i ba/dmas pha yod par 'dug spras zhu/ khong gi de gsor chos yi zer bas nga 'i 4 ma'i lag las gsor khyer na 'gro mod byas nas khyung tshang ba'i thad du byon nas/ ras chung tha'i gdams pa rnamasagasan/ der yab yum gnyi la gas na bza' mags gos re gsol/ khyung tsha nga ba ra sa chung ba dngos dab mjal ba'i gsung mang po gnang ba la cung zad the tsho skyel pas/ dus gyis rtogs pa 4thon spar gyur nas kyang —blon ni chung bar byung gsung / der yab yum gnyis kyir ltaras/pa'i cha lugs byas/ khyung tshang bas kyab bas chung —ba'i gdan sar song cig ces gsubar pas/ nor rdzas kyang dum re khyir nas lo ror byon/ nyid kyi dgung 'o so lnga pa chu pho rta'i lo la lo ror sleb/ ras chung ba na nib lcag mo sgrol de la gshegs nas ma mja / de rjes ra chung pa'i slob —ma su pa la sku mtshams gcod pa'i nub mo mjal bas/ nged thag rings rnas chos zhur 'ongs pa yin pas thugs gdags por zhu byas pas/ gdams nga byed dgos bas slob dpon lo la dbang zhu la shog gsung / de na 775

lo'i spyan sngarabyon nas/ los gtsos pa'i grwa de na bzhugs pa rnams la ja skol dang rnam bzhag bzang ba zhig kyang mdzad/ dbang yang zhus/ de rjes sum pa la gdams pa rnams zhus/ chos zhu res kyis ja re yang zhus pas/ dus phyis jag ma phongs gsung / sum pas gdams ngag thams cad tshang bar gnang / tshig res don mang po khrol ba'i thugs skyes pas phan pa yang che/ gdams pa kha tshang bar gnang bas da lta 'jom bu'i gling na gdams pa nga rang las che ba med snyam pa yang byung / sum pa la gdams pa zhu bar bcugs pa'i mtshan mo cig mnal lam du mi dkar po cig byung ba na re/ da ste lo lnga cha khyod kyi don grub 'ong bar 'dug zer byung /gzhan yang bur sgom dang byar bo pa la sogs pa'i bu chen gzhan rnams la'ang gdams pa 'ga' re rgyas/ de nas dgung lo sum cu rtsa brgyad pa shing mo bya la dam pa sum pa'i gsung gis/ da khyed bzhud/ nged kyi gnyal 'di srin po stogs gri shi ba'i lung pa yin gsung / de nas lo de nyid la phag mo grur byon pas dgun tshes bco brgyad kyi nyi ma ldog gdong cig la 'gro ba'i mgon po chos khri la phebs pa dang mjal/ der dad pa tshad med pa skyes/ shing dang bya 'di rnams kyang sprul ba kho na yin la che snyam pa byung / 'gro ba'i mgon po de rnal 'byor ba gza' mir byas pa la ye mi dgyes pa la/ gling ras la shin tu dgyes par byung / der 'gro ba'i mgon pos khrid gnang / dam bca' can gyi mtshams byas nas bsgoms 776

pas zhag gsum na rtogs pa khyad par can dpe las 'das pa 'khrungs te/lo bdun dang zla ba bdun zhag bdun gyi rim pa la ma ltos par mtshams bral nas 'gro mgon gyi drung du byon/ rje yi zhal nas gnyug ma'i don/ /bsgoms shig gsung nas bsgoms lags pas/ /bsgom bya dang sgom gyed stor nas thal/ /sgom thun mtshams gzung rgyu yang mi gda' 'o/ /zhes bya ba k+ṣiṃ/ sogs pa'i mgur mdzad cing rtogs pa phul bas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po yang dag pang dgyes/ de ltar me pho khyi lo'i dbyar zla ba gsum phag mo grur bzhugs/ de nas 'on rmi sdings su jo mo dang bcas nas bzhugs/slar 'gro mgon gyi drung du byon pas zhal snga nas da jo mo 'di thong gsung /'di sngar yang mang du brdzangs pa lags te 'gror ma nyan zhus pas/ da lan 'gro bas rdzongs/ ngas rten 'brel cig kyang byed gsung nas/ sman mo byang thang gi yar lugs su bskyal/ ngas khyod kyi pha ma'i nor yang cher god pa med/ da yul du song la pha ma'i nor rnams la longs chod cig byas te btang / de nas phyir byon te skabs shig tu zangs ri nas bud med cig kyang phyag rgyar bsten pas/ de ma legs par dgongs nas da nga'i rjes lam 'brang cig byas kyang mos phyi bzhin du 'brangs pas khams su bros te byon/ lam sgam po ma byas pas slob dpon sgom pa dang yang mjal/myang bo nas nags shod la byon/ der 'bul ba byung ba rnams kyang / nga bka' brgyud kyi bla mi 'tshong gsung nas ma bzhes/ phyis zangs ri ba'i 777

phyag rgya mo des khams su rje btsun 'tshol du phyin pas lam du shi nas zla dgon dang nye ba'i ri gcig la nags bud meng kyi gzugs 'dra ba cig skyes/de'i bdag byed pa'i mi ma yin cig tu song ngo /wa ston gyis khyed nor gzhan mi bzhed kyang rta 'di chibs/ ja 'di skol byas nas phul bas phag mo grur rta de phul bas nga rta mi 'dod/ rgyal ba lo la phul gsung nas/ lo ror byon nas tshwa la rta dang sum pa la g.yu phul/ bla ma gzhan rnamasapar yang zhabs tog bag re mdzad de mog ser bzhugs/ de nas phag mo spur 'khor dus 'gro ba'i mgon po gshegs nas spur yang sbyangs zinagaradug mang skol cig la mi stong tsam 'du ga pa'i gral du/ grong sterter rtsa ma ga lta bu yi/ /dpal phag mo gru yi nags khrod na/ /zhes ba gosogs pa'i mgu ra bzhings/ de nas dbus gtsang gi sa cha mang por 'byon bsad mdzad/ 'phrang por btsad pos spyan drangs nas 'ga' re ba zhubs / bla ma zhang gis 'khrug pa'i grogs shus gsung ba byung nas/ pho rgang mkhar chu gle'u chung ba rnams kyi dmag kha bkag sku bsod bdo bas mig rdzas mang po byung ste/ khong gi lha chen gyi phyed tsam ldangs pa'i 'thung bskyal/ gsung rab 'bul mi byung ba phag mo grur bskyal/ phag mo grur byon pa'i lamarwa bsam yas su bud med sngon mo cig gis po ti cig khar bcug pa'i snang ba byung / de nas chos mthong tshad mkhyen/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gnang ba byung bas rgyud kyi rnam bshad 'ga' re byas pa la rang 778

bzor byas zer nas 'cha' ba'ang mang du byung / spyir rgyud kyi rnam bshad dang / sgron me rnam drug dang / sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa dang /rnal 'byor 'jug pa dang / bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sogs pa brtsams shing / bla ma sgrub pa'i phyag bzhes kyang rje btsun gling na sa rgyung ba yin/ phyogs thams cad du 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing sko ro ro byon/phyis sna phur dgon pa'i gzhi gzung nas gzhan don kyang mang du bskyangs shing / der zlob ma rnams khrid kyi rim pa dang tshogs chos kyis skyong zhing bzhug pa'i tshe/ dam tshig lnga pa ga stong zhing yod pa'i 'phro la dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i mi gnyis byung ba'i rkyen gyis tshems khrig de 'khrigs nas/ sa pho spre'u'i yo drug cu rtsa gcig pa'i dbyar zla ra ba'i nyer brgyad la gshegs/snga gong nas zhal chems kyi yi ge bkod de phyag dpe'i khrod nas byung ba/nga'i lus ngagakhayid gsum dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dbye ba med por sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum la bzhugs pas gus pas gsol ba btab na 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur bya ba'i don can du 'dug go/ /yi ge 'ga' zhig na rje btsun 'dis sbar phu ba la do ha gsan bya ba 'dug do ha'i ṭī ka mdzad pa yang sbar phu ba dang cung sgros mi mthun par snang / /de'i slob ma chos rje gtsang pa ye shes rdo rje ni/ 'khrungs pa'i yul ni ha'o gangs kyi mgul myang stod khu le'i char 'khrungs/ yab rgya zur bo tshab pe dang / yum mar gza' dar skyid 779

kyi sras bdun byung ba'i chung shos su lcags mo sbrul gyi lo la 'khrungs/ yab sras mang bas gces par mi 'dzirna pa la/ yum gyis bon po cig la gtad de mtshan g.yung drung dpal du btags/ dgung lo brgyad pa la yum gshegs/ bcu gnyis pa la gcen po skal ldan bya bas khrid nas gtsang rong du slob gnyer mkhas pa'i drung du klog bslabs/ bcu gsum pa la slob dpon rta thang ba'i sar lo gsum bzhugs nas mngon pa dang yo ga dang / zhi byed la sogs zhus/ bco lnga pa la slob dpon mkhar lung ba'i sar byon nas lo brgyad bsnyen nas rdzogs chen dang tshad ma la sogs pa gsan/ der bsnyung gzhi cig yod pa'ang mtshams bcad ma dgos par thon/ slob dpon 'khor re ba la rdzogs chen rigs rdzogs gsan/ slob dpon btsang tsha la sgyu 'phrul dang thugs rje chen po gter ma gsan/ so dar ma seng ge la spyod 'jug khu lung gi lha rje kun rgyal la mtshan brjod/'om thang gi slob dpon 'dul 'dzin la thugs rje chen po jo bo lugs gsan/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la yab kyis slob dpon mkhar lung pa spyan drangs te/ chos rje ston sar bton nas chos gsungs/ ri khrod la mnga' bar bzang du bzhugs/ de'i rjes su rje btsun gling ra lung na bzhugs pa la tshwa bre gang tsam gyi phyag rten mdzad nas gsung gling mang du zhus/ las 'brel de'i dus su sad pa 'dra gsung / de nas sna phur byon nas gdams ngag zhus pas zhag bdun nas ras thub pa byung / der 'brum pas yun 780

ring du bsnyung / de dwangs nas rta rgod ma byol song gi rgyal mo blangs nas bla ma la phul/ ja bur yang drangs/ der mchod khang rtsig pa la grwa pa phyogs su 'gro ba dang mtshams gcod pa la gser zho re'i chad pa 'bebs kyi 'dug pas gser zho gang phul nas yig mtshams bya bar zhus pas/khyed rang gle'u chung du song la gyis gsung / der bsams pas bla ma ma mnyes na gdams ngag gis ci btub nga 'dra ba 'ong ba byas nas bshums/bla ma'i spyan sngar bu ram sder gang khyer nas ngas nor 'dug byas nas bshags pa phul bas/ 'o chos go ba bya ba de tsug 'ong ba yin gsung nas mnyes/ de nas zla ba lngar las byas pas sgom ngo mtshar che ba yang skyes/mchod khang yang tshar/ nyi ma bzhi la shog ldeb re tshar ba'i yi ge bris/gdams ngag thams cad tshang bar zhus/ dar rdor bya ba cig dang bgro gleng byas pas khos ma thub pas shes rab can gyi grags pa byung / bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga la chos shig dris dang gsung / de mi mchi bla ma la thal 'gyur phog na mi rung zhus pas/ ngas gnang ba byin pa yin mod gsung /chos sku'i mtshan nyid cig bzhag par zhu zhus pas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba yin gsung pa la/ 'o na nam mkha' yang chos skur thal lo gsungs pas lan med cing mnyes par gyur/ yul du rgyags len du byon pas yab la phag mo'i byin rlabs shig kyang mdzad/ de nas sna phur byon nas dgun 'dag char mdzad nas bsgoms pas rlung phyi nang bsre nus pa'i 781

rgad po cig khyod su'i slob ma yin zer/ nga rje btsun gling gi slob ma can byas pas/ kho'u zer bas/ kho'i ngag de la thugs ma ches nas log nas sna phur byon pa na/ gleng gshegs zin 'dug der dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnams grub grub kyi bar du bzhugs/ de nas dbyar de yo ro ye mgon la sogs pa bzhi khrid nas ra lung du byon/ de rnams kyi khrid tshar bar mdza da/ sku bso da kyang de nas skyes/ rta rag chung cig snams sna phur ma ma jo mo la phul/ gdung brten rab gnas dang / gdarna sa'i 'dun ma tshar/ dpon slob bdun gyi mkhar chur byon nas lcags la can du 'dag 'byar mdzad bas bar chad kyi klong rdol te/ lha gre spu sa cad kyis dmag byed pa dang sku sa la mi bsnyung ba'i sa gcig spub rmed pa la sogs pa byung / der bar chad thams cad zil gyis nan nas/ rtogs pa nam mkha' la mdung bskor ba bzhin song / rten 'grel gyi mkhastan 'ga' zhig kyang gzigs/ der ye she sa mgon po zhal gar+sā70/ de dus la sbyor byas na gos brdabs pa tsam gyis mthu chen po 'od pa zhig 'ong ste/ 'khor dang longs spyod la gnod dogasapa ma dzad/ debalo gsum bzhugs nas rje btsun chal chung pas gter du sbas pa'i ro stos skor drug kyang de res thon/ de'i tshe dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa sa mo bya yin/ de nas mdo bo ras pam la du skyon nas chos drug gi /nyan zhus pas/ khyod bsgoms ba cig 'duzla(gsung / de nas bya skyungasadang chu 7 3

bo ri la sogs par yang dum re bzhugs/ 'bri khung du byon nas tshogs chos gsan/ snying rje skye ba'i thabs zhu zer ba'i yi gi phul bas/ sku mdun du bos te rab tu byung zhig gsung / snying rje la bogs ni ma thon/de nas myang po la brgyud nge sgam po dang tsa rir byon nas dbyar cig bzhugs/ de nas skyi shod du phebs nas klong rdol btab/ de 'bral du bla ma zhang gi drung du byon nas rtogs pa phul bas mnyes/ snying rje skye ba'i thabs zhus pas/ khyong la gdams pa bya gsung nas snying rje blo rdeg ma gnang / snying rje la bogs chen po thon/ ci kyang rab tu byung gsung bas dge tshul gyi mkhan po bzang ba la zhus/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po zhang rang gis mdzad nas/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa gsum la chig rdzogs mdzad/ de nas gtsang phyogs dang pho ma la sogs pa'i 'brog bod dang byang tsha kha tshun chad du khrid btab pa dang / gzhan gyi longs spyod don yod par mdzad pa dang / 'khrug bsdums mdzad pa dang bla ma'i gdan sar 'bul ba bskyal ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa mdzad/ 'brug tu dgon pa btab pas lo de nyid la spyil po stong tsam thebs/ de nas yang sa phyogs rnams su 'gro don la byon zhing da mi shes pa'i dngos po byung ba chos kyi phyogs kho nar bkye/ de ltar gang dang gang du byon pa thams cad du longs spyod zad mi shes kyang slob ma rnams la 'jig rten gyi zhen log tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa/ bla ma'i mos gus gsum gtso bor 'dzin du bcug 78 4

nas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa shar ba stong phrag lnga tsam/ spu rgyan dang jo la ra dang kha che dang bya rgod phung po'i ri bo dang / rgya'i ri bo rtse lnga dang tsa ri dang sha 'ug stag sgo dang ti se la sogs pa'i gnas dag tu tshe dang sgrub pa stoms pa gyis gsung ba'i bka' gnang nas/ 'khor 'gyed pa mdzad/ bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad du 'brug pa'i bu slob kyis ma khyab pa med bya ba byung ste/ 'a ga pa la gtogs pa'i sgom chen yin phyin chad sde ris dang slob ris kyi chags sdang dang 'khrug pa med cing shin tu dul ba sha stag 'byung ngo / /chos rje 'di ni dpal nā ro pa'i sprul par grags shing /phal cher de la nges pa yang 'jog go/ /de nas sku tshe 'di'i phrin las rdzogs nas dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa lcags mo lug gi dbyar zla tha chungs kyi mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i tho rangs la gshegs/ gdung bzhu ba'i nyin 'ja'i gur dang me tog gi char bab/ skal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig la spyan ras gzigs kyi sku nyi shu rtsa gcig byon nas phal che bar lung du gdung rten du bzhugs so/ /'dis gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs pa'i slob ma'i mchog ni/dang por che ba spa rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/ tha mar che ba 'o/ rgod gnyis/ zhes bya'o/ /de la sba ri ba ni/ dang por bla ma zhang gi gtor bsho sa pa yin la/ chos rje gtsang pa rab byung la byon dus chos rje gtsang pa yang mnyes/khong rang yang gus par byung ba yin/ spa ri ba la gtsang bas phan thogs 785

par mkhyen na / zhang gis kyang btang nas gdams pa zhus ba cu gas dam khyad par can 'khrungs/ spa ri byang chub gling gong btab/ rje mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag tu grags shing 'gro don rgya che bar mdzad/ de las gye sa ba'i dgon lag kyang chu bo ri la kha shar la sogs pa mang du byung / /de 'tshoslob ma'i mchog rje dgon gsar pa zhes pa ye shes mgon po'i zha'i ga gang skying grub rtags mang du yod pa cigangabyon/ /de'i dgon pa'ang spa ri'i nye logs na yod zer/rkyang mo kha ba ni/ dang po bde ba can pa'i dge bshes yin pa zhigachos rje gtsang pa 'brug tu bzhugs dus mjal nas/ gdams pa gsan pabakhagyigs dam 'khrungs/ bur du rkyang mo kha btab nas 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/ /rgya mags ba ni/ gra'i zar po phur rgya yags btab nas gzhan don mjong pas/ rgya yags bka' brgyud zer ba byung ngo / /'bras mo ba ni/ da na pa'i ming ste myang stod na yod/ tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /chos rje gtsang pa gshegs rjes su dpon ra dar ma seng gis gdan bangamadzad ba min te/ de ni rigs kyi dbon po chos kyi sras yin pas/rje ngargod tshang ba la sogasu pa'i bu chen sbyi tshar ba rnams kyi yang bla ma yin no / /de ni me mo bya la 'khyungs/ so lnga bzhes pa la chos rje gtsang pa 7 6

gshegs/ rang lo drug cu rtsa gcig pa la ga gas/ /de'i dpon po gzhon nu seng ge lcags pho spre'u la 'khrungs/ bde drod la dbang 'byor bas sku mdun na yod pa rnams kyang grang ba'i 'jigs pa med pa byung / so brgyad pa la dbon ras gshegs/ rang lo drug cu rtsa bdun pa me pho stag la gshegs/ /de'i dbon po nyi ma seng ge gzhon nu seng gis lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa lcags mo phag la 'khrungs/ bar 'brog rdo rjesdesprong gi gdan sayang mdzad/ rang lo so bdun pa me mo phag la gshegs/ /sbos skya ba seng ge rin chen gzhon nu seng ge'i lnga bcu rtsa dgu nga sa pho rta la 'khrungs/ lnga bcu rtsa drug pa chu mo glang la gshegs/ /bcu gsum pa seng ge rgyal po sa mo glang la 'khrungs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la spros skya ba gshegs/ rang lo so bdun pa shing mo glang la gshegs/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge spros skya ba gshegs pa'i phyi lo shing pho stag la 'khrungs/ rang lo so bsku pa me mo phag la gshegs/ /blo gros seng ge ni/ kun dga' seng ge'i sum cu rtsa gnyis pa shing mo bya la 'khrungs/ bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa lcags pho rta la gshegs/ /shes rab seng ge blo gro seng ge'i nyi shu rtsa bdun pa lcags mo ga la 'khyungs/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis ba chu pho 'u la 'das/ ye shes rin chen ni/ blo gros seng ge'i nyi shu pa shing pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ rang lo lnga 7 7

bcu pa chu mo la la gshegs/nam mkha' dpal bzang ye shes rin chen gyi so lnga pa sa pho stag la —'khrungs/ nyer brgyad pa la gshegs/chos rje kun dga' dpal 'byor ba ni/ sa pho spre'u la 'khrungs/'brug ra lung gi gdan sa bskyangs/ 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i bla ma mang du bsten/ dus phyis skam po'i gdan sa yang mdzad de/ zhe dgu bzhes pa me pho spre'u la gsheḍa/ 'di la sba gro/gtsang / dbus/ dwags po/ kong po/ gnyal/ lo ro/ lho mon la sogs pa rnams su gdul bya rgyas shing / chos kyi rje sgam po ba'i gdan sar bzhugs nas/ slar sgam po ba'i gdung brgyud la gdan sa gtad de 'gro ba'i don bskyangs so/ /chos rje gtsang pa bu chen gdan rabs dang bcas pa'i skabs so/ /zad 'byag gi skabs/thog ma dang bar du che ba bzhi po la 'gro ba'i don spyod dus pa kho nar nges mod kyi/ rnam par bar pa ni gsal bar ma mthong ngo / /tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis las/ chos rje lo ras pa ni/ gdung lo dang yin pas de las mtshan chags pa ste/ gzhung gi grags chen sa na/ yapa78

rnal 'byor dang yum me ga 'a skyid de zhes bya ba gnyis la sras med nas/jo bo thugs rje chen po'i drung du mchod pa phul zhing / bu 'byung bar gsol ba btab pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs las yum la ltas bzang po dang bcas te/ me mo lug gi lo la sku bltams/ chung ngu nas chos kyi bag chags ma gtogs byis pa gzhan gyi rtsed mo'i zla la'ang mi bzhugs/lo drug nas klog legs par mkhyen/ lo bcu drug pa la chos rje gtsang pa gzhung du byon pa la dad pa thob cing bsnyen bkur rgya cher byas/ bcu bdun pa la rje gong ma snye thang du dums la phebs pa'i tshe yab mum sras gsum gyis mjal/ bco brgyad pa la bros nas skyor mo lung du mkhan po sbal ti las rab tu byung / mtshan ni dbang phyug brtson 'grus so/ /de nas rje gong ma'i spyan sngar bzhugs yul nas bsnyegs ma byung bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ bar chad du mi 'gro bas da lan bzhud cig gsung / yul du byon pa na nye ba rnams kyis bag ma bsus nas/ lcags 'jug pa la sogs pa'i gros byas pa/ ma mas bya btang byung bas/ rje'i spyan sngar bros te byon/ gtum mo la sogs pa'i khrid 'phro rnams zhus pas/ de dus rang nas drod khyad par can skyes pas ras rkyang mdzad/ de'i ston de chos rje gong ma yul du sbyan drangs nas chos 'khor bskor/ nye 'brel rnams kyis chos rje gong ma la 'di 'babs pa'i bka' gnang dgos zhus pas/ gtam lan rang gis 'debs pa zhus nas/ nga 'chi ba'i tshe khyed nye bas shol mi 789

thebs/ srog la bab kyang 'babs pa'i skabs med bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ der tshogs pa thams cad la spyan chab byung / der yab la so/gas pa thas cad kyang re thag chad/ chos rje'i zhal nas kyang / tshe 'di phyi'i pho shan de ring phyed gsung nas mnyes/ yab sras kun gyis 'brus tu phyags phyir byon/ dbang yang zhus/ ston de bsnyen par rdzogs nas mdo rtsa ba la sogs pa gsan zhing bslabs/ brtag gnyis dang ma hā mā lha la sogs pa'i rgyud dang / do ha la sogs pa'i zab chos dab / bde mchogaltal sogs pa'i sgrub gzhung mang du gsan/ de nas yab bsnyung bas yul du byon/ ring por ma/lon par yab 'das nas/ chos rje 'khor dang bcas pa gzhung du spyan drangs/ khal nyis stong brgyad brgyas gtsos pa ga'abul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ dge 'dun rnams la'ang stod mo bzang lo dang dbu che dang las dpon kun la 'bul ba rnam bzhag dang phog ba nga po phul nas chos 'khor bskor/ yu'akhami rnams la'ang ston 'gyed ba nga po yang dag pa mdzad/ mtha' bzhi 'khor stong lhag tsam shor/ de min thams cad chos phyogs su thongs par mdzad/ bre gang gi'ang 'dzin chags ma gzung bar 'brug tu byon nas/ pha yul du mi 'gro ba/ ri mi 'babs/ tsog bu rgyun du mdzad pa/ khyim pa'i them spangs ras rkyang / gsung bcad/ gtor ma brgya rtsa ma chag pa ste dam bca' bdu /mdzad/ rje'i zhabasanas khyed la rmedam bca' 'di rnams dgos rgyu 790

med de/ thupa pa sa kyang lo drug tu dka' ba spyad pa / dam bca' 'di rnams lo drug gi bar du skyongs/ de nas ci bder mdzod gsung / de nas rgya gar gyi dur khrod la sogs par ro stoms la 'byon bzhed pa la/ rje'i gsung nas/ bla ma sku khams bzang ring la 'di ra sdod gsung nas spu zhugs/der pha spun gyis sum dang sring mo mnar ba'i gtam dang / mchegagrogaso kyis chags ldang byed pa dang / lus la shig nad tshabs che ba dang / thubakha rlung la sogs pha'i 'gas rkyen drag po byu nga yang / bla ma'i mos gus dang ma bral bar thams cad dge sbyor gyi grogs su gyur/ de nas btsang tu rje'i zhabs byang du byon zhing gdams ba mang du gsan / dbus su chos khri'i zur du khang chung brtsigs nas tshogs chos rnams kyang mtshams khakhusas nas gsan/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la rje gtsang pa ga shegs / de nas kha rag gi rtse mo jo mo gro sar bzhugs pas/ 'tsho ba ni med/ steng du gangs ru da chen po byung nas chu me shing yang blang du med par bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin du jo mo gangs dang / se mo do dang / slar yang jo mo gangs rnams su dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad cing nang sems kyi nad dang / phyi 'byung po'i bar chad la sogs pa dang / da /'a lhab kye gegs la sogs pa blo las 'das pa mang po byung ba rnams thugs da ma gyi grogs su song nas nang ye shes kyi stobs rgyas/ mngon par shes pa chen po dang yang ldan/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lhas lung bstan pa bzhin gnas 791

dang gnas rnams su dge 'dun mang du 'dus pa rnams la sgom btab nas ri la 'gyed pa lan mang du mdzad/ chu mig dkar mo dang / shing skam dang / lcags spyil dang / dbu ri la sogs pa'i dgon pa phran re mdzad nas gzhan don bskyangs/ khyad par dbu rir lo bdun bzhugs pas tshogs pa'ang stong lhag tsam 'dus/ phyogs de 'jigs pa can gyi sa yin pas de gzungs pas stod smad gzhan du yang 'jigs pa dang bral/ skye bo'i lam zan 'dzugs pa la sogs sbyin gtong yang rgya cher mdzad/ 'di nas brtsams nas gdan sa yar mar du 'bul ba btang ba'ang grangs las 'das/ phyis myang ro la lam btod nas jo mo lha ring yang bzhugs/ dpon slob thams cad la hor dmag gi gnod pa ma byung / de nas slar glang gi lo la dkar po chos lung btab/ tshogs pa mang dus khri tsho lhag pa 'tshogs/ thugs dam gser gyi po ti mang du bzhengs/ de nas sto brag mkhar chur byon/mkhar chu'i lha khang nang 'khrug gis zhig pa rnams yang dag par gsos shing gser gyi rgyal mtshan btsugs/ de nas mon bum thang du byon nas/ mon pa dud 'gro dang 'dra ba rnams kyang bsnyen gnas la sogs pa la btsud/thar pa gling gi dgon pa yang btab/ de nas seng ge rir phebs nas/der dge slong bslab pa cung zad stod pa rnams kyang phyir bcos byed du bcug nas rab byung stong dang lnga brgya tsam la bde mchog gi dbang mo che rgyas pa zhig kyang gnang / de nas dus mchod chen mo mdzad nas zla ba 793

phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du chos ma chag par gsungs/ lcags pho khyi'i lo dgung lo drug cu rtsa bzhi pa zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu gcig la gshegs/zla ba rting ma'i tshes gcig la sku gdung zhugs la phul bas thugs ljags dang ring bsrel la sogs pa mang du byon/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang grangs kyis mi chod/ de'i tshes bcu gcig la sto brag rgyud gyi dge 'dun bsdus nas ska 'angab mdzad/ de ltar na skyes bu dam pa 'di ni gtong ba phun sum zlogs pa dang zhen chags med pa dang / sgrub pa'i snying rus dang /mkhas pa'i mkhyen pa dang / brtse bas gzhan don mdzad pa thams cad zla bos dben par gyur pa zhig go/lo ras gshegs rjes su dbon po tsa ri bas gdan sa gzung zhing /spyi la 'gro don yang rgya cher mdzad/ grub thob mgon yes la sogs pa'i slob ma khyad par can yang mang du byon no/ lo ra kyi slob ma 'jam dbyangs mgon po ni/ yul myang stod/ bye brag kham grong / yab khyung po bsod nams dpal dang yum 'dre mo khye 'dren dpal gyi zas su sa pho 'brug la bltams/ slob dpon gtsang ston la gsor bcug khong phyag drug pa'i phrin las gtong ba'i dus su phyag drug pa yud tsam zhig gzigs/ mtshan bsod nams mgon por btags/ lha'i yul du skyes pa sogs skye ba mang po dran/ rmi lam rgyun du zin yang 'od gsal du 'gror ma 'dod/ lo bzhi lnga nas sgom rang skyes su byung na'ang ngo ma shes/ lo 793

drug bdun lon pa'i tshe slob dpon lce ston sangs rgyas dang / sne ston mgon po dang / g.yu thog jo rgyal la sogs pa me tog sdud pa'i chos gsung ba blo la zin nas byis pa zla bo la bshad/ gzhan yang gzhan bgro gleng byed pa la sog pa thams cad kyang zin/ jo gzungs la klog bslabs pas zla gcig dang zhag bcu bdun la mkhas par shes/ lo bcu lon pa'i tshe yulagrongs/ gnyen chad byas pa'i bud med la bor byin nas chos la bros nas g.yas rur phyin/ bla ma mar ston la rab tu byung nas ming shes rab 'byung gnas su btag sa/ khrid zhus pas sngar gyi sgom dang khyad par ma byung /'o yug sogs su mtshams dam po byas te bsgoms/ rin po che mar ston gyis mkhan po dang / dung lung pas slob dpon dab/ slob dpon gcung po ga bste mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ khro phu lo tsā ba la bya spang du sem nyid ngal ga dang rin chen 'bru dgu rnams zhus/ stan gcig lo bcu bzhi dang / sha mi za ba lo bcu bdun gyi bar byas/ de na dbu ri ba'i snyan pa ga san nas dbu rir skyon nas lo brgyad kyi bar bsten/shin tu thugs la 'dogs par byung nas 'brug pa'i chos skor dbang bka' thams cad tshang bar gsan/ 'o nyi shā la sa gdon gyi rtog pa chen po byung bas 'dag 'byar byas nas 'jam dpal gyi bsnyen pa bskyal bas nad kyi rto ga pa sol/ lha dang gling mo byas chog pa byung zhing she sa rab kyang che bar byung / lha ri mo dang myang stod dang chos lung rnams su 'dag 'byar mdzag7mi

nge thugs dam mdzad/ seng ge rir dbang mo cher mdzad pa'i tshe khong med par dbang bskur ba mi thong gsung nas/ zla ba gcig gi bar du spugapa gnang nas dbang yang thob/ mkhan po stod lungs pa/ mkhan po dung lungs pa/ mkhan po las stod pa rnams la 'dul ba nyan/ slob dpon sba ba glan ston la tshad ma/ kong nag chos kyi so seng dang 'jam gsar la tshad ma zhus/ bla ma lha sgang ba la dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyud nams gsan/ slob dpon zla grags la dbu ma dang sa sde dang spyod phyogs dang gsang 'dus 'phags skor thams cad dang ma rgyud kyi skor rnams gsan/bla ma dbus pa la spyod yul bka' brgyud dang nyams brgyud rnams gsan/'brug tu sangs rgyas dbon ras la 'brug skor rnams zhus/ yar 'brog gi slob dalon rog ston la sgra'i bstan bcos rnams zhus/ khyung tshang ba'i bu chen dkon mchog rin chen la ras chung snyan brgyud skor rnams zhus/ slob dpon ston gzhon la sbyor drug zhus/ dbang zhus pa'i me tog phal cher don yod grub pa la phog pas gsang ba'i mtshan don yod rdo rjer btags/blo la yang mtshan nyid kyi dbu ma rtsa she la sogs po ti mang po dang / sngags kyi dus 'khor la sogs mang du bzhugs/ ko brag pas hor bzlog pa'i rim gro bskul ba la dge bshes nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam mngags grang bas/long gis tshong 'dus yan cha/ke kyi rim gro bskul ba po byas pas/ mi rnams na re/ btsun chung 'di 'dra'i shes rab che ba 'jam dbyangs rang yin 795

su sa mo bya la sku bltams/ gling ras gshegs pa'i phyi lo yin/ gcen po gnyis snga bar grongs pas sri'u gso ba'i slob dpon zug ston bya ba la gtad/mtshan mgon po dpal du btags/ sku na phra ba nas sku mdzes pas kun gyi yid du 'ong / gsung snyan pas glu la mkhas/ thugs 'grogs bde bas gzhon pa'i dus bro pa'i ba shi mdzad/ ba shi don grub seng gir grab/sa/skabs der slob dpon wa zhwa la lam rim/ slob dpon stod la dbu ma/slob dpon yu pi ba la spyod 'jug slob dpon zhang la 'grel chung gsan te/ phal cher tshar res mkhyen pa byung / lha sa lan gsum skor du byon nas chos 'ong ba'i smon lam kho na btab/ yul na chang 'thung byed pa cig gi tshe gtsang nas glu mkhan bzhi byung nas de rnams kyis/ dgon par lung gi chos rje rgya ras la/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi bde legs yod/ nged rang grogs tshan zung cig de ru gshegs sam/ snying nas rang du chos la gshegs/bya ba'i glu gsan pas/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis de las che rgyu med pa'i mos gus shig skyes/ yab la zhus pas kyang gnang nas zong dum cig kyang thogs te/ chos rje'i slob ma zug sgom zer ba cig la lam gyi 'dren pa zhus nas ra lung du rtol/ tshogs chos gsung ba dang mjal de rang du rab tu byung mtshan mgon po rdo rjer btags/ mjal res kyis chos rje zhal 'dzum 'ong zhing thugs la btags/ der gtor dbang cig gnang nas khrid zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bskyangs/ ma bde ba 'ga' re byung ba'ang khad kyis 797

nas sgrub pa kho na mdzad/ mkhar chu nas gzung ste gnas de rnams su grub rtags 'ga' re yang bstan/ khyad par jo lan dha ra na rnal 'byor ma 'ga' zhig tshogs 'khor byed pa'i sgo la 'tshangs te byon pas/ tshogs dpon ma de na re/ rnal 'byor pa de thong gsung / der tshogs la yang longs spyad cing byin rlabs kyang che bar byung / rnal 'byor ma de ni phyis zhabs drung na yod pa'i 'gro ba bzang mo yin/ kho la gser 'ong du re nas lam du chom rkun gyis bsgugs na'ang bla ma spyi bor bsgoms pas ci yang nyes par ma gyur/ slar bod du phebs te dpal mo dpal thang gi dkyil du phebs tsa na gsol rgyu med pas/ sku lus kyi stobs zhan par gyur pa la/ der bon po cig byung ba la gshen rabs mi bo'i sprul pa khyed la bza' rgyu 'dra yod dam byas pas/ kho na re/ khyed chos pa 'di rnams 'di kho na yin/ dka' ba spyod ma ran par sbyod zer nas zan dum bu cig dang / rgyu ma'i sna 'ga' byin byung bas mur zhing byon/ phyis ding sang gi brgya 'bul bas bon po'i skyos ma de dga' gsung nas dgyes pa'i gtam yang gsung / de nas ra lung du byon nas dbon ras dar ma seng ge dang mjal/ dpon gyi zhal nas khyed rang lha khab tu sgrub pa la bzhugs dang / thugs dam 'phel po 'ong gsung bas pho ma lha khab tu byon nas spyil po cig tu lo gsum du bla ma sgrub pa mdzad/ skabs da du nga'i bla ma chos rje ras pa de sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin snyam pa byung 799

bas/ de ma thag tu sems sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa'i bla ma la sa bcu pa bar mthong ba khyod kho na byas nas rang la smad/ de phyin chad sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang 'bral ma myong / der lo gsum bzhugs ring la mtsho lad nas spyil bo chus gang nas sku smad chu nang du bzhugs pa las mi g.yo bar mdzad/ gsol ba ni chu 'thung ba kho na yin/ nyin cig mtsho 'gram du sha ba'i ro cig 'dug pa len du byon nas/ rkyang cig 'dug pa la bkal bas spyil po'i bar du des bskyal/ dus shig gi tshe nam mkha' la sbrul gyi char 'bab pa'i snang ba byung zhing / des rkyen byas nas bsnyun mdze byung ba'ang myur du dwangs/ de nas dbon ras kyi drung du byon bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ de nas tsa ri la byon nas lo gsum bzhugs/ g.yu mtsho skor ba la byon pas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyis gser skyogs gang gnang byung ba'ang mtsho mchod mdzad/ der tsa ri na bzhugs pa rnams kyi g.yog 'ba' zhig mdzad pas rdza khrod shar nub kyi bong bu ser po zer ba'ang byung / ma chen pa rnams kyi rtsam pa skyel 'dren gyis sgal pa rnag rtsa song song gi bar du mdzad/ thugs ni brod par byung gsung / der nub cig mnal lam du nang sto thams cad mthon nas khog pa stong bar song ba rmis/ da 'di phyir ldog gam mi ldog snyam pa la/ mi dkar po cig chu re/ da lan rang 'di mi ldog zer/ der thugs dam shin tu 'phel bas gyur nas/ slar yang byon nas chos rje dbon dang mjal/ dbon nā 800

zhi ge nas khyed thugs ngam 'phel bar byung 'dug pas/ da nga'i khrid gnyer ba gyis gsung / kho bo la stod du 'gro 'dod zhus pas ma gnang / grogs po kun na re yang 'gro rgyu mi 'ong zer ba la/ grub thob yin yin lta byas nas lkog ta ma la mang po phul/ gzod zhu ba phul bas/ da 'o na song /bstan pa med pa'i sa phyogs su bla ma'i bstan pa dar bar byas na de rang zhabs tog tu che gsung / der la stod du byon nas bya rog tshang du pha sgrub pa zhig po dang mjal bas/ kun du bzang po bya ba 'di rang yin snyam pa'i mos pa byung / gdams ngag kyang zhib tshags dang bcas te gnang /de nas khyung da ra du lo gsum bzhugs pas thugs dam shin tu 'phel/der shig nad drag po zhig byung nas 'grongs pa la phyogs yod tsa na/ nye gnas bsod stoms la song ba de yang bya rog tshang du na bas/ da ngas kho blos btang bas mi 'ong dgongs nas 'byon pa'i 'dun pa btang 'phral la shig nad de yang sos/ /bya rog tshang du byon nas nye gnas blangs te gsos pas dpon slob gnyis ka dwangs/ yang yang dkar du rje btsun mi la'i zhabs rjes yod sar dbyar cig bzhugs pas kyang thugs dam 'phel/ de 'os rgod tshang du skyes nas mtshams kyi dam bca' drag po mdzad/ mnal lam du bud med cig la ngas mtshams byas pa dang / gzhan don byas pa khebs gang che byas pas/ mtshams byas na gzhan don chen po'ang 'ong zer bas mtshams mdzad/ grogs po sgom grags kyis thabs lam bsgoms pas 801

mngon shes phyi thal nang thal du byung ba la/ steng 'og gi gdo thams cad rgod tshang du 'dus nas chos nyan pa mthong bas/ sngar gzhan don mi mdzad phar snyam pa'i blo yod pa der log de nas rgod tshang nas byon nas las stod kyi ri sul rnams su byon zhing gsang spyod mdzad/ nge yang chos rje 'dis gnas chen rnams su bde sdug sna tshogs byung ba rkyen dang bsres pa dang / shig nad lan bcu gsum du byung ba'ang byang chub kyi sems kyis shig gcig tsam yang ma ngor bar rkyen phyag rgya chen po dang bsres pas myur zhing myur bar sos pa dang / rten 'brel mdzad pas ci 'dod 'ong ba la sogs pa'i grub pa'i mtshan ma mnga' zhing / khyad par du rnam par rtog pa yang gnyis su 'thung srid kyi/ gsum phag chad du phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin du gyur nas 'thung mi srid pa dang / tshe 'di'i rnam par rtog pa spu tsam yang mi skye ba/ dge sbyor gyi gtso bo phyag rgya chen bro dang ma bral ba'i morakhagul kho na la mdzad pa/ mnal sad 'phral la mdang ma shi ba legs/ de ring grub pa ci thob bya snyam pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ chos gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i shes rab mnga' ste shrī rir bzhugs dus bud med dmar mo cig gis pu sti cig khar bcug byung bas/ de phyin chad bod du 'gyur ba'i chos la mi shes pa meng gsung pa yin no/ /de nas sku tshe'i smad la steng gro dang / spud dra dang byang gling / bde chen stengs/ bar 'brog rdo rje gling la sogs pha kyi lhanyu

kyi sras kyang yang dgon pa/ grub chen u rgyan pa/ byang gling pa/ chos rje ne rings pa/ phu ri ba/ mnyam med pa ri sbyil dkar ba/ rje ma bdun pa/ zhi byed mgon po/ sangs rgyas khrom ras/ dpal skyer shing ras pa/ shākya ras pa/ 'dar ras la sogs mang du byon no/sgrub tshugs rang dang mnyam pa ba ri spyil dkar bas 'gos yul 'bring mtshams su dgon pa btab/ 'od gsal khor yug tu mnga' gzhan don yang rgya che zhing ding sang gi bar du sku 'dra cig bzhugs pa la rdul mi 'chags so/dka' spyad rang dang mnyam pa phu ri ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan ni/ro stoms sgang 'dril zhu mkhan yin/ pha drug tu dgon pa btab/brgyud pa 'dzin pa sprul sku bde chen seng ge/ ma cig chos sgron/ de'i slob ma bka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer te/ 'di dang po la stod byang pa'i bka' bzhi 'dzin pa'i dge bshes chen po gcig gis chos bar la byon pas ma cig dang mjal nas gdams pa zhus pas thugs dam khyad par can 'khyungs pa cig yin/'di'i slob ma kha rag grags rgyal ba ni/ me pho rta la 'khrungs nas spyan snga grags byang ba'i gsol ja ba yang mdzad/ spyan snga kun spangs pa'idus su ja dpon mdzad pa'i skabs su chu bar du bros nas thugs dam mdzad/bka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer sogs dang mjal nas gdams pa mang 804
