du zhus/ ri thebs gnyis kyi bar du bzhugs nas phyir byon te dgon rin chen gling du lo skor cig tsam bzhugs/ de'i skabs su rtogs pa 'khrungs/dus phyis kha rag tu rgyun ring du bzhugs pas kha rag par grags/ de nas gdan sa thel du bzhugs nas gzhan don bskyangs/ brgyad cu gya drug ji lcags lug la gshegs/snying rje rang dang mnyam pa ma bdun pa mtshan gzhan mdo bo che spro zhes kyang bya'o/dag snang rang dang mnyam pa ne+e rings pa ni/ de'i yab mes rnams shrī ri'i shar zhol du byung ste/ skyi ston chos grags chu mig ring mor rgya 'a ma can gyi slob ma mdzad/ lo brgya dang bco lnga thub/ de'i sras slan tsha 'bar ni/ myang ror mgo bya tsha'i slob ma byas/ ldum ra'i lha khang bzhengs/ sku tshe mi ring bar 'das/ de'i sras lha rje phan pa ba regaston skya'i slob ma/ de la sras min tsha mched lnga'i lnga tshigs pa bya tshang gi sgrub pa zhig po/ sgros lnga'i che shos dbugs gtso bor sdings pa'i sras nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ 'dis paṇa chen dang chung dus su mjal/ de la sras bdun byung tha'i ne+e rings pa bdun tshigs yin/ mtshan bde legs rgyal mtshan/ shing mo bya la 'khrungs/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa me pho rta nas rgod tshang ba la gdams pa gsan zhing sgrub pa mdzad/ rgod tshang ba gshegs pa'i phyi lo sa mo lug la ni rings btab/ de nas kyi lo nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rang 805

glo lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa lcags mo sbrul la gshegs/ rme ci ba dang spyog ro skyon pa'i skye ba yin par bzhed/ rgod tshang ba bu chen dang bcas pa'i skabs so/stod 'drug gi skabs/rgyal ba rgod tshang ba'i slob ma rgyal ba yang dgon pa zhes grags pa de ni 'khrungs yul la stod sto'i dgon pa lha gdong du rnying ma ba'i grub thob zam ma chad pa'i brgyud pa/ lo drug cur bar ma chad du bsgoms pa'i grub thob dar ma zhes bya ba la/ gcung po jo bsam zhes pa sngags rgyud kyi yon tan chen po mnga' zhing nyin mtshan dge sbyor gyis 'da' ba zhig yod pa de dang / yum rnal 'byor ma chos mthong zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su chu mo bya'i lo la sku bltams/ gdung rus ni stong yin/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe na yum la nyi ma gnyis shar ba la sogs pa'i rmi ltas khyad par can mang po dang / ting nge 'dzin rang 'khrungs su skye ba byung / bltams nas ring po ma lon par gsung 'byon mkhyen te/ thog mar skyabs su mchi'o bya ba'i gsung byung / klog dang yi ge'ang bslab ma dgos/ gsung 'byon mkhyen pa nyid nas yum gyis thog drangs nye 'khor na yod pa rnams dze+ed ma pa'i chos 'ba' zhig la bskul ba'i gsung 'byon zhing / skyes / 806

ca thag nas 'gro ba'i bdag tu gyur to/ /sku bltams pa'i dus nas yab de mi bzhugs kyang snga gong yab kyi zhal nas/ 'di la sprul pa'i sku gcig 'byung bar 'dug pas/ ming gdung so ba 'bar du thogs/ khu bo gzhan du 'gro don la 'gri gsung nas bdun cu don lnga la gshegs/des na/ sgyu ma'i mi chung 'bar ba nga / zhes pa'i don de yin/ lo lnga bzhes nas gzhan la phan pa'i mgur mang po gsungs/ 'jig rten thams cad du sprul pa'i sku byon par grags/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba zhig sam bu la byon pa sus kyang ngo ma shes pa la/ rin po che ba bu chung des mkhyen nas bang du byon rte dgyes par mdzad pas thugs dam bogs che/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal nas/ la stod tsho bzhir 'khyams pas ngo shes mkhyen pa'i bu chung lo lnga pa cig byung / pha ngo shes pa'i bu gcig yod pas de mjal du 'gro yang yang gsung / phyis sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje byon nas rin po che dang mjal/ jo sras dbyangs shig long gsung ba la/ bla ma rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ sgyu ma'i mi chung 'bar byā nga / /snga ma'i las 'phro sang ba yin/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs shā yin/ /lta ba gza' gtad bral ba yin/ /sgom pa dmigs gtad bral ba yin/ /spyod pa spang blang bral ba yin/ /'bras bu re dogs bral ba yin/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas/ mnyes nas phyag tha'/ mo sbyar te rdzogs chen la ska rags btsongs pa cig 'dug807

kun bzangs kyi phru gu/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa skyabs su mchi'o/ /gsung nas spyan chab sil gyis mdzad/ de dus khong la mnga' bdag myang gi gter kha'i skor rnams dang zhi byed gsan/ lo drug bzhes pa'i tshe phul dmar ba'i thad du byon nas/ sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang dang rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud gdams ngag dang bcas pa dang / bka' gdams zhi byed/gcod yul/ lam 'bras snying po skor zhal gdams rgyab chos dang bcas pa'i chos dpag tu med pa gsan/ phul dmar ba'i drung du lo gsum bzhugs/ dgung lo dgu pa la lha gdong gi gdan sa mdzad/ bu chung gi dus nas mngon par shes pa mnga'/ sku tshe de la bsten pa'i bla ma ko brag pa/ rgod tshang ba/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rje spyan snga/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ bla ma drod chung pa la sogs pa rnams las thams cad kyi chos ma lus par lon par mdzad/ lo dgu nas tshogs pa bskyangs/ gzhan la khrid btab/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la mkhan po lha btsun sog kha ba/ las slob ko brag pa/ gsang ston drod chung / las gral ba brgyad cu'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan rgyal mtshan dpa' du gsol/ phyis shrī ri gnam sdings kyi dgon pa btab/ der gzhan gyi mig stos bstan pa'i phyir lo gcig gi bar rdo rje skyil dkrung gcig gis bzhugs/der ma zad bu le lasogs pa'i gnas rnams su yang khrid skyong zhing dben pa bsten/ /spyir sku snyan pa che bas phyogs mtha' dag nas 'dus pa'i slob ma 808

bra phrag brgal/ slob ma rnams kyis bskul bas ri chos skor gsum dang ma drug la sogs pa'i brtsams chos kyang mang du mdzad/ mthar zhe drug bzhes pa sa pho rta'i lo la bar 'brog tu byon/ der lcags dur du sku khams zhan pa'i tshul bstan/ de nas shrī rir spyan drangs te der tshes bcu dgu cig la gshegs/ de'i slob ma yang rtogs pa dang ldan zhing 'jig rten la ma chags pa'i sgrub pa po mang du byung mod kyi/ gtso bo ni spyan snga rin chen ldan zhes bya ba sku shin tu phra ba'i dus nas zhabs la gtugs te 'bral med du bzhugs nas bka'i bsdu ba po mdzad pa de dang / lo ras chos skyong dpal zhes bya ba rtsa rlung la dbang 'byor ba de gnyis ni gtso bo'o/de'i slob ma spyan snga rin chen ldan ni/ ding rir yab yum bsags pa can gyi sras su chu pho khyi'i lo/ yang dgon pa las bcu gcig gis snga ba de la 'khrungs/ lo lnga drug lon dus su gla 'khor gyi sku gdung ga ru la sogs dang mjal/ snying nas chos byed pa'i zhen log de dus rang nas skyes/ der ri pa 'ga' zhig gis lha gdong na sprul pa'i sku bzhugs pa'i sngags pa brjod pas shin tu dad/ phyis lha gdong pa lo lnga bzhes pa ding rir bzhugs pa dang mjal/ mos gus thun mong min pa 'khrungs/ ting nge 'dzin yang rtsol med du skyes/ chos 'brel zhus pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / zu ga rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa gsan/ pha jo ston pa la 'bri klog la sogs bslab zhing gsan pa mang du mdzad/ de nas lha gdong pa chos 809

rje ko brag pa'i drung du dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa cig byon pa dang mjal nas mos gus dpag med skyes/ nga'i phyi la phyin pas chog gsung ste/phyags phyi 'brangs nas zhi bar gshegs kyi bar lo sum cu rtsa lnga'i bar du zhabs drung zhag gcig kyang ma bral bar spyan sngar bzhugs pas spyan snga bar grags/ chos rje la bzhugs pa'i gsar rnying gi dbang gdams pa lung la sogs pa gang bzhugs thams cad gsan/ ko brag pa'i drung du'ang chos mang du zhus/ rgod tshang pa la'ang 'brug skor thams cad gsan/ sa paṇa la sa skya pa'i chos skor rnams zhus/ rje spyan snga la 'bri khung pa'i chos skor rnams gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma bzang dgu la gtugs nas gdams pa zab dgu nyan/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ gnas 'u gas kyi rtogs pa shar/ phyis ding rir bzhugs nas tshogs pa mtha' yas pa bskyangs pas/ zur phug pa dang grub thob nyi ma mdon la sogs pa'i rtogs ldan gyi slob ma mang du byon no/zur phug pa'i slob ma ni chos rje 'ba' ra ba zhes snyan par grags pa —de yin te/ 'di yang shabs kyi chab lung par dpon 'bum zhes pa'i mi chen po'i sras su yang dgon pa gshegs nas lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa lcags pho khyi la 'khrungs/ gzhon pa'i dus su chos rje bsod rnams rgyal mtshan pa'i gsol ja ba mdzad/ de'i modapo skyo shas drag po 'khrungs te sgro mon can pa la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams la khrid zhus pas ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrungs/ 810

phyis zur phug pa dang shug gseb ri pa la sogs pa la gdams pa zab dgu gsan/ brtson 'grus drag pos bsgoms pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur/'ba' ra'i dgon pa yang btab/ spa gror byon nas kyang phrin las mang du bskyangs/ slar yang shangs su phebs nas 'gro don yun ring du mdzad/de nas yang spa gror byon te dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa lcags mo lug gi 'o la gshegs so/yang zur phug pa'i slob ma ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan ni/ lcags mo phag la 'thujes nas brgyad tsu pa la gshegs/ 'ba' ra ba'i slob ma ni gtsang pa blo gros bzang po bar gas pa de yin te/ 'on gyi byin phag tu lcags pho byi ba la 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus yab rin spungs na yod pas der snyegs nas rin spungs pa'i khang gnyer mdzad/ de nas chos la mos pa yang dag par skyes te/ bla ma chos dbyings pa'i drung du gtugs/ de dang mi ring bar chos rje 'ba' ra ba la gtugs te gdams pa mang du zhus nas bskyangs/ bla ma ma 'a mas pa la gdams pa gsan/ de'i stobs kyis slob ma la khrid rim 'chags pa yang gdams ngag gi sna mi gcig pa brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis chad par grags/ gangs ti ser yang byon zhing bzhugs/ de nas chos tshol ba'i phyir rgya gar nub phyogs lcam be rgyal khams su yang byon/ rgya gar shar phyogs shing gi rir yang byon/ la stod snyer lo shas bzhugs nas/ si 811

tu chos rin gyis zhabs nas bteg /phyis skyi skad du spang po kha dang ldan rdzong du bzhugs/ de rjes g.yor phyogs su phebs nas yar rgyab pa dpon chen dge bsnyen pas bla mar gzung / de ltar sa yar mar du 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad nas gra phyi 'brug gi dgon par chu mo yos kyi lo rang lo drug cu rtsa bzhi pa la gshegs/de'i slob ma rgod phrug chos rje dang / mkhan chen shākya grags pa sogs yin no/yang gtsang pa rgya ras gyi slob ma g.ya' ras/ de 'i slob ma bde mchog sang rgyas/ de'i slob ma rdza ri ras pa shes rab dpal/ de'i slob ma rkyang chen ras pa gzhon nu bsod nasam/ de'i slob ma dbon po dbang phyug gzhon nu/ de'i slob ma mkhas btsun don grub gzhon nu/de'i slob ma chos rje shes rab dpal te/ 'di ni rkyang chen sprul ska'i dbon po/ rkyang chen nang so'i zhabs tog dang las ka byed bzhin pa 3ca/ chos ma byas na da lta'i spyod pa 'dis mi 'ong dgongs pa byung dus/ sprul sku la gdams pa zhus te/ ri bo'i phu khyag pa dkar mor thugs dam mdzad/khong rang gi phu bo dbon po rin grub kyis rgyags skyel gyi yod pa/ lan cig rgyags zad pas rkyang chen du len du byon pa/ dbon po rin grub na re/ rgyags skyel song yod pa la lam du ma mjal lam zer/ der lo byon pas su yang ma byung 'dug pa/ nga khyod la mi re'o snyam du thugs tha 812

d+dha da/ rgyal khams la byon/ yab tu skyes mchog bsam gtan dpal ba'i drung du mjal/ chos gsung pa'i chos khri'i 'khris su bzhugs pas/ skyes mchog pas khong gi dbu skra nas then then mdzad/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs kyi 'dug pas/ khong gis kyang gzigs pa na/ dam pa sangs rgyas sku gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig gzigs/ de ltar skyes mchog pa dang /sngon po yon rdor ba la'ang gdams pa gsan/ lha lung du byon nas rig pa'i 'brug sgra la chos zhus/ kong por byon nas chos rje mkha' spyod pa la gdams pa mang du gsan/ spo bor byon pa'i tshe phyags phyi yang mdzad/de la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams las gdams pa thob nas/ de rting gzhung gi gyu ra dmar rtser sgrub pa mdzad/ de rting rdza spor yun ring du bzhugs pas chos rje rdza spro bar grags/ de nas chab tshan khar byon nas de'i man khang du bzhugs/ de rjes chu tshan kha'i mkhar de la bzhugs/ zhal dkar mdzad nas mtho dman thams cad la zhal ston/ gsol ras zwa dang sngo tshod kyi tshod ma ma btab dgu btab pa dang / rgyab mdun gyi gsang rdzas gnyis ka la 'gyed mo che mdzad/ sku tshe'ang ring du bzhugs/phyag tu byung ba'i dngos po rnams grwa sa so sor dge 'dun la 'bul/ grub thob chen por grags/de'i slob ma lha ri kha ba chos rje nam mkha' bzang po dang / gra phub skyes mchog smon lam bar grags pa gnyis kyis kyang chos rje shes rab 813

dpal ba las cags pa thob gzhan chos kyis 'brel ba'i bla ma ni shin tu mang / bye brag tu chos rje shes rab dpal bas phu bo shi ba'i shul na gnyer mang po yod pa/ nyin cig dol mdar bsod stoms pa byung ngo cog la bzhi nam re bkye/ lhag ma gser mang po yod pa nam mkha' bzang po la bskur nas sgom chen pa sgrub rgyags med pa dang / mtshan nyid pa slob gnyer gyi ཿrgyags med pa rnams la dum re phul/ bla ma bzang po rnams la 'byor ba che yang gser 'bul ba gyis gsung nas/ gsung bzhin bsgrubs te skyi shod nas sa skya'i bar kyi bla ma rnams la gser phul zhing gdams pa zhus pas/bla ma dang gdams pa shin tu mang / chos rje nam mkha' bzang po bas dang por glang lung btab/ phyis chab tshen khar bla ma'i gdan sa mdzad/skyes mchog pas mu tig btab/ rnam pa gnyis gas chos don du gnyer ba'i slob ma mang du bskyangs/ sto brag tshun g.yor phyogs 'brog dang bcas par 'brug pa'i bstan pa gzung ba yin no/ — yang rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i dngos kyi slob ma rin po che rgyal mtshan 'bum zhes pa'i rtogs ldan de ni/ 'khrungs yul la stod/ chung ngu nas yang dgon pa dang mjal/ dad pa thob ste rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu drug pa la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ phyis grub chen u rgyan pa la sogs bsten/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan yang legs par btsugs so/de'i slob ma la stod pa shes rab mgon po yin te/ gdung g.yung /d+ngha ’814

yab sangs rgyas skyabs dang yum myang mo dpal ldan 'bum las lha gdong dgon par 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi pa la da na gsar ba'i drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs/ na bza' ser mo mdzad/ bris klog chog phrin kyang bslabs/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum sogs la chos gsan/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la lha gdong pa la gtugs/ mtshan shes rab mgon po btags dgung lo bcu dgu pa la zur phug pa dang mkhan chen bsod gzhon pa las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ bla ma sangs rgyas dbon/ zur phug pa/mkhan chen chos sdings pha/ drod chung ba/ bla ma rin chen ma na/ bla ma dar bzang / mkhas grub khru ba sprul sku grub chen pa/ mkhas btsun bsod nams 'od zer/ grub thob 'dam zhig bla ma rin chen rdzogs pa/ bla ma shes rab dar/ bla ma spang dkar pa/ rtogs ldan na khru ba/rtogs ldan shag shang rnams las gsan pa mang du mdzad nas shrī rir 'dag 'byar lo bdun mdzad pa'i tshe rtogs pa lo bcu bdun nas 'khrungs kyang bogs cher ma thon/ de lta bu'i rtogs ldan chen po de dbus phyogs su byon/kur ma pa rang byung rdo rje dang rig 'dzin gzhon nu rgyal po la sogs pa'i bla ma mang du bston/ sha dang gsal rje gangs la sogs pa'i dben pa rnams su bzhugs/ kong po yan chad du 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad/'di la bla chen rin gzhon pas kyang thug 'dis bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar yang mdzad/ gzhan la phan gdags pa'i gsung rab — 81

kyang 'ga' zhing/ bkod/ 'di ni shin tu grags pa che bas rnam thar rgyas pa las yon tan rnams shes par bya'o/ stod 'brug gi skabs so/ grub chen pa blob ba da dang bcas pa'i skabs/yang dpal rgod tshang pa'i thugs kyi sras grub chen u rgyan pa yin te de'i gdung rabs ni mdo smad dbyar mo thang tu rgyus byang chub gzhon nu bya ba byung / de ni slob dpon pad+ma'i dngos kyi slob ma dang / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi mchod gnas su gyur pa zhig go/ de'i sras byang chub mchog/de'i sras byang chub yon tan/ de la sras byang chub rgya mtsho dang chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis byung ba de gnyis kyis g.yog po rdo rje kun thub khrid nas dbus gtsang du byon/ myang smad spa snams su sleb pa'i tshe ar tsho ban de bco brgyad kyis khong dpon g.yog gsum gzung / mkha' 'gro'i mchod rdzas byed zer nas rkang lag phur pa la brgyangs/ der kun thub na re/ da khyed gnyis la grub rtags yod na ston pa'i dus la bab zer/ gcung po na re/ ngas phur pa'i khrub zhon cig bya'am zer/ gcen gyis 'jigs mi dgos kyi gsung nas dpal rta mgrin du byas/ rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags pas/ de thams cad brgyal nas brgyal sangs pa dang de rnams kyis gus pas btud cing yang dag pa'i lam la btsud/ byang chub rgya mtsho'i sras 816

bsod nams grags/ de'i sras rgyus nag bde gshegs/ de'i sras rgyal tsha bsod nams 'phags/ de'i sras dbon jo 'phan dang btsun mo dug ge me la sras bzhi dang lcam gsum byung ba'i grub chen pa ni chung lhag yin/lcags pho stag gi lo la sku 'khrungs/ mtshan seng ge dpal du gsol/byis pa'i dus nas ting nge 'dzin rang 'khrungs su byung bas/ dgongs pa la dang por thos pa byas/ de nas sgom pa bya ste da lta'i sems 'di dang khyad ci 'dug lta dgos dgongs pa byung / yab kyis btsun mo gcig len zer bas khu bo'i drung du byon/ nga chos rang byed 'dod pa yin te/ phas chung ma len zer byas nas mang du bshums pas/ khu bos dbugs phyung /der lo bdun nas bcu drug gi bar du/ ma phur / bde dgyes/ phyag rdor/ yo ga la sogs pa'i rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs phyag len dang bcas pa gsan zhing mkhas par bslabs/ de nas dgung lo bcu drug pa la bo dong or byon/ chos rje rin chen rtse mo la mngon pa gong 'og tshad ma rnam nges/ shes rab 'grel chung gsan zhing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'gran zla med pa'i grags pa thob/ de nas chos rje rgod tshang pa bde chen stengs nagaspyang lung du 'byon pa'i lam go lung phu ru gdan phebs pa la/chos rje rgod tshab pas de ring las can zhig dang phrad 'ong gsung pa'i lung bstan mdzad pa bzhin/ mjal ma thag tshad las 'das pa'i dad pa skyes/sbud trar phebs dus zangs shig dang bur ltang cig la phyag rten byas/817

chang dang rtsa ba bzhi bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen mdzad pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ slob dpon jo gras/ da ni btsun pa dang khyad med sdom pa thub pa dka' 'o/ /'o na yang khong gis thub thub/ khong skye ba snga ma'ang btsun po cig yin mang / rgan po kho de zhes zhig po byang dpal la ga stong / chos rjes ka ra snyim pa rgyur ba gang gnang byung ba rdzogs par gsol bas rten 'brel yang 'grig chos rje'i zhal nas khyed lan cig nga'i rtsar 'ong dgos/ ngas phyag rgya chen po bstan pas grol ba ska tshegs med gsung /de nas go lung ba mdo sde dpal la 'grel chung gsan/ 'dul ba'i skor rnams gzigs pas bag chags 'thug par 'dug cing / khyad par las brgya rtsa gcig pa gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs la rgyung / dgung 'o nyi zhu yon pa'i tshe bo dong rin rtses mkhan po/— nga bsam gling pas slob dpon/ slob dpon bsod nams 'od zer gyis gsang ste mdzad nas cig char bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan rin chen dpal du gsol/ de nas yo bcu gnyis su stan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs gzung zhing sha yang mi gsol/ chos rje rin rtse la dus 'khor labro sugs legs par zhus go lung pa la dus 'khor chag lugs legs par bslabs/ rtsis la spyongs shing mkhas par mkhyem khong gi gsung gis dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje tsa mi lugs la mkhas pas nyon gsung nas zla ba bcu gcig tu dzin dang bcas pa gsan/ der khong chos bcag nas ser chags la byon pa la thugs cung zad skyo na dam pa la 818

gsol ba btab spro sa/ mnal lam du mjal zhing lung yang bstan/ de rnams tshar nas bde chen stengs su chos rje rgod tshang pa'i sar mjal du byon pas/ das/na par phebs pa tsam gyis ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'khrungs/chos rje'i drung du bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zhing ji lta ba bzhin du thugs la 'khrungs/ skabs shed du bdag sham+bha lar dus kyi 'khor lo'i dka' phreng ma bde ba rnams gcod pa la 'gro bsam pa yod zhus pas/sham+bha lar las kyi 'brel ba med/ las 'brel u rgyan dang yod der byon gsung / ma bde ba ci 'dra ba yod gsung ba la/ 'di 'dra yod byas nas 'ga' zhig zhus bas/ lan ji lta ba bzhin du gnang byung / der ha las te/ chos rje rin po ches dus 'khor ni ma gsan/ 'di 'dra ba'i mkhas pa 'ong ba tsug lags zhus pas/ gsung gis/ shrī rir sdad dus bud med dmar mo cig gis po ti cig byin/ de mid pa'i snang ba byung pas/ bod du 'gyur ba'i chos la mi shes pa med gsung / 'o na bdag la dus 'khor gyi dbang cig kyang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon jo btsun rang gsol ba thob la rmi lam gzung cig gsung nas/ gsol ba btab pas mi lam du chos rje rin po che dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje'i cha byad du mdzad nas dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyas pa cig gnang byung / sang de spyan sngar byon pas slob dpon jo btsun thugs tshim mam gsung / shin tu tshim lags/ de 'dra ba'i phyag len mkhas pa su la bslabs zhus pas/819

mkha' 'gro mas bslabs pa yin gsung / de rting u rgyan du 'gro bar zhus nas dang por byang mi med kyi ri la bsgrub pa la byon/ thugs dam shin tu 'phel bas sngar gyi chos brjed pa thams cad sos/ de nas ti ser byon nas thogs shig bzhugs/ de nas mar yul dang ra byang nas lam mthon nas dza la/ rar grogs mched lnga byon/ de nas gzhan thams cad phyir slog dpal ye dang 'grogs byon pas/ spyir yang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang mang po dang / khyad par sog po'i rta bas mgul sgom thag tu bcug nas bsnams/ sku lus la rdogapas kyang bsnun/ cung zhig 'gyel ba la de ma thag bzhengs te/ zhabs bro mang po mdzad/ 'o dod chen po bos pas rta ba zla bo rnams kyis 'di ni grub thob tu 'dug khyod kyi bu smad la ji 'dra ba 'ong ngam zer/ chu bo chen po gcig gi 'gram du gnam sa bla 'og 'gyur ba'i snang ba'ang shar/ de thams cad brtul zhugs kyis zil gyis mnan/u rgyan :ma tha lar rtol/ der rdo rje rnal 'byor ma smad 'tshong ma'i bu ma'i gzugs su byas pa cig gis tshod ma phor gang byin zhing byin gyis brlabs pas las kyi sgrib pa'i lhag ma thams cad slongs shing zad/ rdo rje gsum gyi don ji lta ba bzhin du thugs la 'khrungs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyi skur bstan nas zhal gyi gdams pa yang gnang / de nas phyir byon/kha che la lam mdzad pas/ kha che'i rgyal pos gsod mi sum cu tsam zhig myo ngags pa dang lam du phrang kyang grogs mched gnyis ka ci yang ma nyes par 820

thar bod du phebs pa na chos rje rgod tshang ba gshegs 'dug rten la sog pa mi bzheng pa'i bka' gnang 'dug pa la/ nga de'i bka' khongs na ni med byas nas rton bzhengs kyang 'ga' re mdzad/ de nas lcags mo bya'i lo la dpon slob mang po rdo rje'i gdan du byon/ der byang chub kyi shing gzigs pas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rang 'khrungs/sngar chos rje rgod tshang ba'i gsung gis da ste lo bcu gnyis na khyed la dge sbyor gsha' ma cig skye gsung ba de 'dir 'dug dgongs pa byung / bsil ba tshal du bzhugs pas gzhi bdag des stog pa btang byung ba stog pa gris phyung ste bor/ 'khrul 'khor mdzad pas de ma khad rma sos/ phyis gzhi bdag nge dbang du 'dus nas drag po'i phrin las sgrub dgos pa tshor nges slob/rdo rje'i gdan du lha tshogs kyi bdag pos cho 'phrul chen po bstan yang ma tshugs pas yon bdag tu khas blangs/ de phyin chad ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa chen por gyur te/ spyan zur gyis gzigs pa dang dbyug pa re tsam bsdun pas nad gdon mtha' dag sos/ lha 'dre mi gsum zil gyis mnan/ mdo rgyud kyi chos la 'di mi mkhyen bya ba yang meng /dbu g.yor gnyis gnyal lo ro dang mtsho sna la sogs par yang byon/ gzhan gyi don sa 'ur dang rdo 'ur du mdzad/ phyis rgyal po go be+e las spyan drangs nas hor yul du byon/ rgyal po la rgyu rin po che 'ba' zhig la byas pa'i 821

dus kyi 'khor lo'i da kyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon du gyur pa'i rin po che thams cad chu la dor/ mgyogs par bod du 'byon rtsis mdzad pa la/ rgyal pos yi chad kyi zhu ba phul bas/ nga skra bo dong rin rtse la bcad/ gsol ba rgod tshang ba la 'debs/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin mdun du byung yang thod pa bkas nas klad pa ldag snyam pa min pa seng ces pa'i gsung gis zil gyis mnan pas rgyal po la spyan chab mang po byung / rgya yul nas dngos po'i gzung ba khab tsam yang med par phyir byon/de lta bu'i grub chen rin po che de brgyad cu pa sa mo bya'i lo la gshegs/gsung las/ ngas bsnyen sgrub 'di bstan na lung pa grub thob kyis 'gengs te/ 'brug pa'i brgyud 'dzin pas khrid chen brgyad la gtso bor byed pa yin zhes gsung ba ltar gdams ngag gi gtso bo cha gnyis su gyur pa'i /'brug skor la ni phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa can shin tu mang bar byon/ de'i slob ma dug dang / me dang chu dang dgra dang g.yangs la sogs pa gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pa mang ngo / rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub zhus pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ rin po che mkhar chu ba/ chos rje rang byung ba/ bla ma dbu ma pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams 'od zer/ rtogs ldan zla ba seng ge/chos rje kun dga' don grub rnams te/ de la chos rje rang byung ba lasabasnyen sgrab kyi gdams pa'i gnad cung zhig mi 'dra ba byung ste/ phyis poram pa'i r+sha'i skye ba rnams dang / de'i bu slob brgyud pa dang bcas pa la822

'phel lo/ de bzhin du dbu ma pa nas brgyud pa rnams la'ang rdo rje'i tshig gi bshad pa dang man ngag gi lag len yang yod cing / mkhan chen bsod nams 'od zer bas rdo rje'i tshig la rnam bshad chen mo yang mdzad pa/ chos rje gangs pa nas bzung nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi bar du brgyud do/ chos rje zla ba seng gis ni/ rdo rje'i tshig la rnam bshad kyang mdzad/ khrid rim gyi yig cha dang gegs sel dang ngo sprod 'a/ sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang po mdzad cing / de thams cad kyang rgyud 'grel chen mo dang sbyar te gdul bya rjes su 'dzin par mdzad la/grub chen rin po che'i 'phral gyi gsung la zin bris byas pa phreng skor du grags pa yang khong gis mdzad do/ de'i slob ma ni mchid phu'i mkhan chen byang chub seng ge'o/ de'i slob ma ni 'phags mchog bsod nams dpal te/sa mo glang gi lo ba yin/ sne'u gdong du khang gnyer mdzad pa las gtsang phyogs su chos la bros byon pa/ dang por chos rje gangs pa la gtugs/khrid zhabs phal cher ma tshar ba la gangs pa gshegs/ de nas mkhan chen byang chub seng gi la gdams pa rdzogs par gsan/ de rting gdan sa thel ba'i ri pa mdzad nas chu bar du bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis sgom pa grags legs kyis mang dkar sgang gi zhabs der spyil bo cig brtsigs te der bzhugs pa na/ chos kyi rje rin po che rgod phrug grags pa'i mtshan can gyis de dang nye ba'i phug par bzhugs nas 'phags mchog pa 823

la bsnyen sgrub dang / bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams kyi dmigs pa gnang ba la phebs pa'i tshe'ang ja sun re zhus/ bsgoms pas phug de nyid du phyag rgyachen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ 'phags mchog pa'ang mnyes te/ khong rang gi bla gos phud nas gnang / de nas phyogs gzhan rnams su chos rje theg chen pa la sogs pa'i bla ma mang po bsten zhing / gdams pa rnams blangs/ ri khrod rnams su gnyan slong kyang mang du mdzad/ sgam por bzhugs pa'i tshe gzims khang gi steng du shā 'od chen po 'byung ba'i nyen la thugs rjes ma gnod/ phyur gyi jam pa nas chu nang du lhang ba mkha' 'gro ma mang pos ca co phyung ste bton pa la sogs pa dang / rdza zlo la mtshan gang de la ji tsam btsags kyang chang bzang por 'ong ba la sogs pa mnga' ste/ slob ma rjes su bskyang ba'i phyir chos sdings kyi ri khrod btab/ mi'i bdag po grags pa 'byung gnas pa'i yang gus pa mchog dang ldan pas bkur ba'i bla mar gyur te/ 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad/ spyir chu mo yos la 'khrungs nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa me mo tse sa kyi zla ba gsum pa'i nyer gnyis la chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ de'i rjes su gdan sa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sangs rgyas blo gros gnyis kyang bla ma la rtse gcig pa'i mos gus dang / phyag rgya chen po las g.yo ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin mnga' la/ de'i rjes su chos rje shel brag pa ni/ chos rje rgod phrug ras pa nyid kyis kyang gzhan don 'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin sgo 824

mtha' dag nas gdul bya 'dul lo/ de la gdan sa ba bsod nams rgyal ca/tshan sa pho byi ba la 'khrungs/ lnga bcu rtsa drug pa chu mo lug gi bar dubazhugs/ de nas da lta'i me pho spre'u'i bar du lo bcu gsum song ste/ spyir phag mo gru pa gshegs pa'i lcags stag nas drug cu rtsa gcig pa la grub chen pa 'khrungs/ de'i drug cu rtsa gcig pa la bu ston rin po che 'khrungs/ de'i drug cu rtsa gcig pa la chos rje mkha' spyod pa dang / chos rje sgron ma pa dang mkhan chen rin po che rgyal mtshan bzang po rnams 'khrungs/ de nas drug cu skor gnyis dang lo bdun me pho spre'u yan la song ngo / grub chen pa slobabargyud dang bcas pa'i skabs te/ spyir 'brug pa'i ska bas so/khro phu ba'i skabs/'gro mgon rin po che'i bu chen rin po che rgyal tsha ni/ sha ba smad 'dzal gyi lung par snubs nam mkha' snying po'i gdung brgyud sngags rnying ma'i dngos grub la mnga' mdzad pa sha stag byung ba dang / yum lha gcig gi sras su sa pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs/ lo lnga nas yig rtsis bslabs/ byis pa'i dus nas 'jig rten la ma chags shing chos la dga'/ bla ma bsten pa la/ gnur nyi ma/ slob dpon gan chag pa/ ram sding ma ba/ dge bshes rtsi gnyan/ grol ston lha 'bum/ bla ma sgang ri bo che pa/ zur chung 825

ba'i sras rje sgro phug pa/ bla ma 'or kha pa/ sgang shes rab bla ma/ mnga' ris skyi ston/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ bal po'i pa ta sa masta shri/khu lo tsā ba de tso/ pazlo ta shākya shrī/ spos sgang ba/ lha rje jo 'khor/ lha rje shes rab bzang po/ jo btsun me 'bas rnams la so so'i chos mang du gsan/ dbus su dgung lo bcu dgu la byon/ g.yor po lugs smad du pu hrangs lo tsā ba'i dngos slob dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ mes ston kun snying /rngog mdo sde/ lo tsā ba chos gyi bzang po'i slob ma bla ma gshen chen po dgung lo gya gsum bzhes pa dang mjal/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga la yul du byon/che 'don yang mdzad/ chos 'ga' re yang bshad/ yab kyi zhal nas/da bag ma cig len dgos gsung ba/ mi len par gting nas thag gcad kyang yab la rim gyis zhus pas phyis gnang ba yang thob/ de nas yang bla ma bsten pa ni/ brag dkar po ba/ zhu don mo ri ba/ mnga' ris pa zhang sgom/ dge bshes tho ston/ dge bshes rgya ston/ bya ru dben tsha'i dge bshes gshen/ thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ pa ta be+e ro tsa na/ke ke hor grags/ dge/ bshes sum pa/ dam pa phyar chung / baspro kro t+ta/zla ma 'ol ba chen po rnams la chos zhus/ de nas bla ma dmar gyis phag mo grur brdzangs/ drung du byon/ dad pa thob/ chos gdams ngag mang du gsan/ der phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ de nas zangs ring rgya ras dang mjal/ chos kyang zhus/ de'i tshe sgom tshul 826

ngang yang mjal te chos zhus/ ma gcig lab sgron gyi zas po thod ston grub ba bya ba la gcod yul zhus/ de tsa na bla ma des dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad bzhes/ dam pa rgya gar dang mam gnyisaka'i slob ma zings po zla ba la'ang chos zhus/ spyir bla ma brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ de nas yul du byon/ las sgo len mi btang / spel bsgyur mdzad nas phag mo grur 'bul ba dang dge 'dun so so'i rnam bzhag mang skol rnams bzang nges pa zhig mdzad/ dge bshes zhang sum thog pa la sogs pas bsngags pa chen po mdzad/ de res lam skor la sogs pa bla ma la mnga' tshad kyi chos rnams zhus/ she'u 'dul ba 'dzin pa la'ang chos gsan/ de nas bla mo la gyi phyag byas/ ji ltar bgyi'i bka' stsal yang zhus bas/ yul rang du 'dug la skye shis 'jigs pa rnams la chos byin cig gsung ba byung /lam du'ang sna len byed ba mang / de nas don mo rirabyon nas rang lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa lcags yos la mkhan po zhang mdzes la zhus nas bsnyen par rjogs/ dge slong bzhi sde re dang 'grogs par dgongs/ zhang btsun dbon chung bya ba la khro bu'i sa de nyos/ dbu rtse dang bran khang la sogs pa byas nas dge 'dun nyi shu tsam bsdus/ gtso bor thugs dam la sgril/ skabs shig tu ston pa tshul shel sogs 'ga' zhig la dbang rgyas pa 'ga' re gnang / drug cu rtsa gcig gi skeg la cung zad ma bde ba na/mgon po phag mo gru pa byon te/ bu rang sems dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /827

rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi lo grangs shar/ /da ste lo skor bco brgyad na/ /sems dga' 'am snyam na da phyir 'brongs/ /gsung nas seng ge la chibs te/ gnyan dkar gyi thad mi'i ri'i thang la gshegs so/ /de kho na bzhin bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa shing mo yos la bde bar gshegs/ /gcung po kun ldan yang sa pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ phag mo grur gcen po'i rgyags skyel du byon pas/ rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar gsung ba dang thug /de 'dra ba cig ngas kyang bya snyam nas chos grwa der mgo lcog lan gsum byas/ 'gro mgon la gdams pa zhus te bsgoms pas rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes/grub thob chen por gyur te/ mu ge byung ba'i tshe khro phu'i mchod khang gi sgo la phyag mkhar gtug gtug mdzad nas/ rnal 'byor ma rnams de ring rnal 'byor pa la bsod stoms shig zhu'o gsungs pas/ mchod khang gi sgo bar nas nas phyir mang du byung / yul mi thams cad kyis blangs kyang zhag lnga'i bar du nas ma zad pa'i grub rtags kyang bstan/ dgung lo bdun cu pa me mo glang la gshegs/rgyal tsha dang kun ldan ras pa sku mched kyi dpon po khro phu lo tsā ba yin te/ de ni 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa gshegs ris kyi lo gsum pa chu mo sbrul gyi lo la/ yab jo 'phan zhes bya ba dang / yum bsregs mo gsal byed gnyis kyi sras su bltams/ lo drug pa la klog bslabs/brgyad pa la rgyal tsha dang mjal/ bcu pa'i skabs su rin po che rgyal tsha 828

dang kun ldan gyis mkhan slob mdzad nas dge tshul mdzad/ mtshan tshul khrims shes thab tu btags/ lo bcu gcig pa la dge bshes gtsang gi sar rnam nges gsan du byon/ /bcu gnyis pa la sa skyar rtse mo gshegs pa'i chos 'khor la byon/ chos 'khor de la zhu ston hral mo yang byon/ 'jad pa gzhon byang yang byon/ de nas lo bcu drug lon gyi bar du gtsang dkar la gsan pa mang du mdzad/ chos 'khor byung ba rnams su rtsod pas kyang gzhan pham par byas/ slob dpon gtsang dkar ba la 'bul ba zhabs tog kyang cher bsgrubs/ bcu bdun la sdur pa'i thugs sras rtse ston kun bzangs lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad lon pa cig khro phur spyan drangs nas rdor dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga brgya lhag cig gi lag len kyang bslabs/ phyis 'byon khar bya rgod gshongs kyi rnam sras des rtse ston kun bzang la rmi lam du nga jo sras 'di la phog bya ba byung bas rnam sras kyi rjes gnang yang gsan/ lo bcu dgu pa la 'bring mtshams zhang gi dpon po zhang dge ba zer ba'i lo tsā mkhas pa cig yod pa de la lo tsā ba bslabs pas phul du byung bar mkhyen/ lo de la rin po che rgyal tshas mkhan po dang /slob dpon gtsang dkar gyis las slob/ kun ldan ras pas gsang ste ba mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas gtsang nag la 'dul ba slob pa'i phyir lo ril po gnyis su bsten nas mkhas par bslabs/ lo nyer gcig pa la kun ldan la lo ro ras pa'i thabs lam dang thun 'jog la sogs 829

gsan/ de'i tshe yab kyis mnan gtad byas pa'i rkyen gyis nad gzhi'i rtog pa byung bas lo gsum du mtshams bcad pas nad phal cher sangs/ de'i ring la rgyal tsha la snga dro snga dro gdams ngag lugs mi 'dra ba brgya dang sum cu rtsa drug dang / bka' babs bcu gsum bya ba rnams zhus/ lo nyer bzhi pa la rje rgyal tsha gshegs pa yin te/ gshegs khar bos nas zhal gdams mang du gnang / khyod rag dung bzhin du je sbom la 'gro ba 'dug bya ba'i lung yang bstan/ ye shes 'pho ba'i dbang bskur yang mdzad/ de nas zla ba gnyis na gshegs der rgyal tsha'i sku 'dab dang rten bzhengs la sogs legs par grub nas/ nyer bzhi pa la bal por chas/bal por sleb nas paṇa chen bu shrī la sngags mtshan nyid kyi sbyangs pa mang du mdzad/ der rje btsun mi du dang mjal nas bod du spyan drangs nas zla ba bco brgyad bzhugs/ khro phu'i gnas gzhi'i sa byin gyis brlabs/ rje btsun mi tra gshegs pa'i tshe spyi rong gi la kha bar du bskyal/ de rting paṇa chen but+ta shī spyan drangs/ lha mo che bzhings pa'i bkod pa byed kyi yod pas chag dgra bcom la phrin btang ste/ khong gis pa ta gnyal gyi bar du spyan drangs/ der gdul bya'ang khyad par du 'phags pa byung / paṇa chen de la zang sum brgya'i rdzong ba mdzad nas phyir thegs/ de rting 'khor rnams lha bzhengs pa'i rtsol ba byed du bcug nas dpon slob 'ga' zhig gro mo'i la sgo la mthon nas rgya gar gyi bai zur tshong 'dus su byon/ de nas paṇa —8103 —

chen spyan drangs nas shing pho byi ba'i lo la bod du phebs/ paṇa chen gyis byang rwa theng tshun nas sto brag dang gnyal smad yan du 'gro ba'i don mdzad/bod du lo bcu bzhugs pa'i bar gyi lo tsā rnams lo tsā bas mdzad cing phyag tu 'bul ba stobs chen po byung ba rnams phal cher lha'i cha rkyen du gnang / gzhan rnams ci rigs par sde sdod 'dzin pa la sogs pa la gnang sbyin du mdzad/ gyis kha cher gshegs pa na mnga' ris kyi bar du skyel thung mdzad/ dpon slob 'bral khar paṇa chen gyis 'khor gzhan rnams sku mdun du med par byas/ gser sil ma zang sum brgya gnang /de nas paṇa chen ni bod kyis phul ba'i rdzas cung zad kyang ma bsnams phar kha cher byon nas/ der lo bcu gnyis bzhugs te/ kha che'i bstan pa nyams pa rnams legs par gsos shing der rgyas su mdzad nas shing mo bya'i lo la gshegs zhes grags/ de ltar lo tsā bas paṇa chen gsum spyan drangs pa gtsug lag khang lha chen dang bcas pa bzhengs pa la sogs pa'i rnam par thar pa snams shin tu rgya che ba las phyogs tsam bsdus te bris pa yin/ sku tshe'i smad la dbus su 'byon khar khro phu sems dpa' chen po bskyed pa'i cho ga mdzad nas dbus su phebs te/ gshegs sa'ang dbus yin/ de la rin po che rgyal tsha dang kun ldan rnam pa gnyis ni rje phag mo gru pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa bskyed pa'i dngos kyi slob ma yin/ chos rje lo tsā ba yang rin po che rgyal tsha'i gdams pa la brten nas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs 83

r+sha —'khrungs/ phyis skyi rong du phebs pa'i tshe bla ma klong rtse ba bya ba rje sgam po ba'i dngos slob cigaci gis —rtogase pa'i bogase bton te/ dpame sgam po ba'i bka' ba da kho na'o/rta nag tu —'khrungs pa'i grub thob lce sgrome zhes grags pa de yang rishe po —che rgyal tsha lalas chose tho song shinge / bye brog tu kun ldan la phyag rgya tshen spre ga ni pas rtoge la tha gonarme mkhe'i deng mnyam mer gyur/ de —dnge snyen ci zhe —tu —byung po'o r+sharma ga goro me zhe cagasepa de yange deng por ting nge rna'adzin gyi nyamar+sā rbazangachal shi rdu byung be la/ phyogasnyi brlung dregayo dpe mde —pa mi ga kyang byung / de lce —rnalam gyis —ga san na gdams pa btab bes rtsos nyid kyi thode spu —mngon dzum dwo gzig sau shese grags —so/ /khro phu lo rte ba'i 'ar 4su sgo tshan be da cadabang cadang / dzha khro phu semasostodapa'i tshan po rme so so shā byor zhing —/— mes —dpa' chene zhepor slob me yeng rtse b.lan che na seng ge/1 de'i slob me bu ride po che yog no/ — /khro ca' pe'o sheporme so tshoshā sa —nardzo than h+pha tsā sgobashā me 83 ba rtsesgo pa'i rmo bso —/ — lhukhotsotshulaste so stochagalase me digamichadosaboms lkepo'irnga nge rnga rlorin po che rna/ yul tsha spro grur/kā ya ji se bespu'i rje sems de 'a dang / yum mcha de bya ba'i sra4༄ ngo mtshar me'i sgoltarangadeng bca teḥs yo 8323

la 'khyungs/ dpal pha sto gru 〉〉 bcu ga'i kha min/ chung ngu na 44su ñtsa bag chags mu t+pa byung — lha 6 7da sdu stongalnga drug chun /'arke yab kyisaspradamya7 ba'i thug bsngal gleshad sa / cad ngas shing—brodanasakhasto spra sna por+sha ji pas lha phyag rangar+ṣa sgor+sha lkom stan )cha lhag rnyan snyonarba sha sta bo'i bka'astanad+ku rgyarta skya phyag shang skor bre la da rteng zho bdu stakhucag dang chacen tsho7)spoglogamig legs mas bsgrabs/ —5 gu ho tsho she 'u lhag shi lngo sdugs dang mutshoshurtogs snyen phologasashazas1—— bcu pradzālā sprog dpyon gshen sa mtsha ṣ+ka brjo ṣ+ka tesrogs pa gsan / kwa tsho ba cu 7ltocig rtsa 9 rngog mdo sde la ra marang dang —/ spur dang 2/ tsho marwadzomatsho'i ke lotshogastag cho/ srangasta dpa —gsang ldan la bshad palangazaṭha da/ — — marwa ṣ+ṭa mu 〉mo ba la sta4shā pu sti tshad musgo gas pa zabadu gas /tsho rwa — bco zab dpa skro tshopha sngonasta gri 0za dzibyung pas sgrub khem r+shalo —gsum mdzud nas tshar gcad / — go sgyu de stang khams su byon nas nyi zhu rtsa gsum pa lu zlob dpon ston bya bra pha brten tsho khrims lnga'i sdom pa blak+ṣam/ tsho der yung mngon spyod 3gyi phrin lus lomi7)gra mdzad/ tsho lha shu —rtsa bzhi t+yā n+t+rasa'aphro dade/ man la 4sta shā sna pre stsa rna ga smug mang spro zag za'i ma ra sbru 'dra ba'i— sedhisku sna na ṇ+ḍang popo zhig mthon nas shub phyogs su rgyang zing phyor srong / der khyod —dang —yin rings zhig 'grogs te da ni tshomi 'phyad snyamang sta byung /tshogaster g.yus mdo grogs po 5cig la mtsho rin —ma gyishas nga'is rkyen byas nas 'khor —ba la yid 'byung ciyang dag 833

pa ra skyes nas mthu mdzad 'phro'i rten gtor brdabs/ khrug gi rdza ma pho/slob mas slob dpon smyo 'dug pa de tsug ma byed zer ba yang byung / de nas sdig pa ma byas tsam ma gtogs cher ma byung / /nyi shu rtsa drug pa la dkon brtsegs gzigs pas dad pa chen po 'khrungs te/ mkhan por dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhar sgo ba dang/ slob dpon grab mkhar ba/ gsang ston gzung dzong mdo ba snams las bsnyen par rdzogs mtshan brtson 'grus grags su betags/ lo gcig tu tsog pu dang stan cig mdza da/ na bza' brje ba'i dus ma jugatogs sku raṭa kyang ma bkrol thir byang chub lhung bshags lo pod skor mdzad cing bzhuṭa tsa na/ dpal rga lo sogs tu phebs pa'i spyan sngar byon/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyise dad pa yang dag pa skyes/ sgom lung zhus pas thog mar he ru spu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob bar bya snyams gyis gsung pas/ 4gsang sngags kyi gdams pa yang dag pa cig gnang ba 'dug snyam du dgongs te/ phyis de kho na bzhin du byung / /rdul tshon dang ras bris ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gnang zhing sbyor drug la sogs pa rlung rtsol mang du gnang nas bsgoms pas mgo na ba la sogs byung ba la/ 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i skyon yin pas sha rus la longs spyod pa gyis/ nang phan nas mi za ba yin mod gsung / de nas rang yul gyi dben pa rnams su bsgoms pas rtag tu 'dres ga ra/ thig ma'i gegs shig byung ba rje btsun zhwa lo thag ring bas rje btsun yer ba pa la dang por yi ge btang 834

pas / byang bu la yi ge bris nas 'dis ma sol na zla ba yar tshes la shog bya ba skur byung / rting du zhal mjal phyin nā ro pa'i thabs lam rnams gnang nas bsgoms pas de nub rang la drod skyes/ phyis sngar gyi chos rnams tshe 'di'i rnalartog dang 'dres 'dug snyam nas/ bla ma'i drung du bshags pa byas shing / stogs 'khyags bzod par byas te ri khrod bsten/ slar yang lo gsumakhasong ba dang dpal rga lo dang mjal/ gdams ngag lhag ma zhus/ de nas 'brong bu la sogs su'ang bzhugs/ 'bad pas sgom nyams myong bzang po mang du byung ba la/ dgung lo so gsum pa la slob dpon sgom pa dang mjal/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gnang nas bsgoms pas shes rab kyi rtsal skyes te/ gsung rab kyi tshig mang po la 'di'i don 'di yin par 'dug 'di'i don 'di yin par 'dug snyam pa byung bas/ slob dpon sgom pa'i zhal nas/ de thams cad brtag dpyad kyi shes pa bya ba min/brtag dpyad ma byed par bsgoms shig/nged kyi 'di byin rlabs la re ba yin gsung nas bsgoms pas gzod dngos po'i de kho na nyid lhang gis rtogs te/'khor 'das sa lam/ bya byed thams cad gzhi rtsa dang bral bar thugs su chud/ sngar rang gi chos zab mo gzhan la bshad pa rnams kyang don thog tu dus der phebs nas dga' grags te/ te te yang brdungs/ slob dponasgom pa la zhus pas/ bka' brgyud 'di la byin rlabs yod/ de tsug 'ong ba yin/ da 'ur gyis song ba lags gsung / de lta bu'i rtogs pa mnga' 835

yeng 'aza kho'agrib bag re byung bas thobs lam la 'bad cing bsgoms pas boṭa chen po thon/ skabs shig tu bla sa 'ol kha bstadang mjal/ gdams pa zhus pas byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la rtsobogs lathon zhing grub pa brnyes nas gtsug lag khang dang lha chen bzhengs/ de'i cha rkyen yang la la la blangs/ la las phul/ la la la btsan sgrogs lta bu mdzad/ bka' los 'gal ba rnams la dmag yang dang ming du bskul nas 'thabs/ rgyab pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs pa mdzad de/ gzhan gyi blor shong ba dka' mod kyi /ging nyi da kyis jo bo lha btsun la gdams pa las/ — kha bos zhi 'a btarten blos btang na 'jig rten dang pa'abrelar+sha ga rbad kyis chod nas ṣ+yo ched nam mkha'i ngang du cham gyis spu'anganas dgung lo mang po lon 3 lags so/ skyo bo'i phyi'i byed1spyod 'di rnams kyi rjes su dpags nos/ ba khu ma snying sdu ma rnams ma gtogs pa ga na mang po cig gi blor sa zhong mar bstab/ mi tsho sa kyi yul du gzhi phabartenas/ lugs ma dang gdas ga dang rgyal khrim sa dang lam rgya dang rku skyabs dang 'khyug pa la sogs pa 'jig rten 'di ba'i bye da spyod kho na 'dra ba sha stag tu snang ste/ 'jig rten 'di dang 'brel ba gting nas bdog na 'gum pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa de kho na snye/gzhan gyi don rlabs po che de lta bu mdzad pas bdun cu rtsa gcig pa chu mo glang gi lo la zhi bar gshegs so/ de'i bu slob gnas las ming du btags pa lha ri ba nam mkha' 'od/836

lha phyug pa nyi ma 'od/ kha rag gra pa 'dul ba 'od/ 'bri ra ba shākya 'od ces grags pa'i mas dang / mnyam med shākya ye shes dang / brag dkar shes yes la sogs rtogs pa dang ldan zhing gzhan gyi don nus pa mang du byung ngo/ /de dag las gra 'jad pa nam mkha' 'od sangs rgyas ras chen du grags pas lha ri kha'i dgon pa btab ste/ dbon po lha dges gdan sa mdzadi/de nas dbon/ de nas de ba ku mā ra zhes pa la sogs pa byon zhing / lha ri gyang mtho sogs dgon pa skor gsumachodang / 'grog yangasakhastengs sogs btab la /nyi 'od kyis lha phyug btab ste chos skyong gi bka' babs pe ra gragabangaso/ kha rag pa 'dul ba 'od ni/ 'khrungs yul gra/ kha rag tu spya ba pa mdzad/ klu dam la btags te dge bsnyen byed du bcug/ de'i dbon pos tshodagon lta btab/ dge 'dun khri tsho tsam 'dus/ chos skyob zhal gzigs pa'i sku byin rlabs can cig kha rag bon drug na bzhugs/ 'bri ra ba shākya 'od kyis byang du dgon pa btab/ 'gro don che zhing gzhan don nus pa'i ga chen kyang mang du byon/ gzhan yang brag dkar shes chas kyi slob ma rtogs lhan spra sgo sogs las brgyud pa'ang shin tu mang ba byon no/zhang rin po che slob ma dang bcas pa'i skabs so/83

gshegs/ de lo rang rin po che shākya 'bum pa shing mo glang lo paṃ sa sum cu rtsa bdun bzhes pa zhig gdan sar bskos de rting chu pho stag zla ba bcu gnyis pa la tiri shrī grags pa 'od zer sku gshegs/ chu pho stag 'di slob dpon byang rgyal gyi lo yin/ chu mo yos la 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal gong du thegs/ rin po che shākya 'bum pa gdan sar lo bcu bzhugs te lcags pho khyi la gshegs/ rin po che byang chub dpal bzang po dgung lo sum cu pa zhig lo de la gdan sar bskos te/ lcags sbrul la 'khrungs/lo zhe bdun gdan sa mdzad de me pho spre'u la gshegs/ de rjes spyan snga graṭa pa bshes gnyen pa chu pho khyi la 'khrungs/ so drug pa me mo bya la gdan sar bskos/ gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi mdzad/ drug cu bzhes pa lcags bya la gshegs/ de rjes chu khyi nas me spre yan la lo dgu bcu go lnga song ste/spyir na zhang rin po che 'khrungs nas me spre yan la lo sum brgya dang lnga bcu nga bzhi song ngo / mtshal gung thang ba'i bla rabs kyi skabs so/ /sems khrid kyi ba da pa'i skabs/chos rje sgam po ba'i slob ma skye bo ye rdor gyi skye ba dung tsho ras pa ni/yar klungs gcen ‘ sa'i g.yag mkhar sngon por yab zhang sgom 'byung gan 'od/ yum khu mo khye 'dren 'bum gnyis la sras gsum yod pa'i 839

bar mar 'khrungs/ gzhon mdus nas gdan sa thel du sbyan snga ga sdo thog pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ skra ༷zhar/ chos zhus/ shes rabargyal mtshan gyi ming gnang / de nas 'phyog pa'i sgom la sna ba nga po zhig yul na rba zhugs pa dang lha sgomakhaganyis kyi zhabs la gtugs/ de nas kha raba'ilha ma ri 'khrul zhig khams pa'i drung du dka' thub mang po zhus/ ba tshul gtso mtshore song zhig dir don grub par lung bston/ de lanyan nos ba 5lo g.yu mtshor byon zhing / dir de'u lacig gi kha na salapoga'adug par dka' thub la brten na sgrobs tha byas/ cho 'a la yang che bar thong /spyil po de nyid kyi 'og gastong ring po ma yin dzi zhig nas/ dong ciporal la ba thor gyi byung / de nas bas pos la ca'i 'bol do cig /rgyuX / di bcag nas bltas pa tsho ma po'i chub kyi mtsho ma lonag po sangardzo75ma po bas sbas ba'i gter gyi lta byang / 'don pa po yang nenganganyid 'aX ba ston par legaso par go nas gnas de tsho sa 'gro bar 'dod pa/ 0gtso thutanas kha ba mthug ches pas lam ma dod/ shing dang thag pa 'thud nas dwags po phyogs kyi g.yang chen po la btas snye'i 'i ba'i gru tsho gtsang po brgal te sgam por byon/ rin po che rdor blo ba la bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ mtshan rin chin bzang poro rkabatags/tsho dgongs gcig bslag lung rtsa kyang zhus/shi mo'athas dang me pho 'geg gi slo maphams su gnam stong cig tshwa thon bya ba zhe gi bas/ shing yoso rgyal rnyes nyer dgu'ige'in g.yog chag khrid de 840

phyen pa / tsorngagyi khorar+shang ra za tshomatsho ga ji lta bshizhin asgrornyedazhes rmetsho 'og malitsāgobagyi44 'gyir+sā le'i ṣ+kazugs mong sgo'i 17 'dug dzigacho cas sa 'a sna dzi— snye rgod shi ba'i brabawo stonami drage rdzo na 4r+sās ñtsa ba skyesañtsa ༷/sko pho bye zhi la tso la 'a sa tsho mugathormengo lta brtsa chuthu rgyas sbo ba khyo yang bros /byung tshamatshar lha zhugo92 me the khrig 7cad zho /lta gamatsho kho gang btags rnya/ / r+shachu kho spyobotsugiso/rme sgror+sha spyodwags lha snamardzo nang // the nga /btsa ji sgogs kholta la dod0tsozhu ga slong byas/rngu to074 ༷skul rna gang dzi ga zlo ga rdzalha chag dzigasasko gitso cig 'dug la tshu snyi byas bto pas thon/ṅgā/sgo stospungatha bu sa rasgrumu shu nag spyo 7bye nga rkang ngo nu gte zhi cu gi pal ci dar mar na phyo chemothumichi/ dam bcas lke 9 la zhog dril 'ju ma la lo rgyu stosgro la stobub /dzi gte rkosal ṅge zheñtsa ṇ+ḍashā r+sha spyo gam ba pho khulasta lke/chisan rnams khyen nas sgom lha /song rte/bhemardzog mi rgyu dag na mas la rdzogamar bros tsho jis de'i snya tsā rmi ma the /dzha sgrohā duX mtshorames sgral byed byas pasadzog rna stsa kyi rno ga mdza potha sku ro na b.ring shāgagil ༷shes snyam 0 skyon/ gyis po ba tham skasto cho cigs he yo zhusagal(bzhugs/ga ston /kha bu lasko ma ba dus k+ṣa gan skasakhumi ri bsna brgyad brgya tsam byung ba/ tsho gzhan rnamus yi —1phadu song zhos rke ma tshal pha zugaya ba'i 'gro mgon rin chen mams bya ba snag841

khyed la gter chos zab mos yod 'dug pa de nga zhu ba yin zer/ de 'dra su zer byas pas/ khri ta cig zer ba yin zer/ kho dge sbyor bzang po yod pas gzhan rnams ma byin par ro gcig yan chad kyi thogs 'don byin pas rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ de nas ras pa brgyad basbyo/ la'ang khrid btab/ sbyis sto gnyal la sogs pa'i yul mang por 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ mthar grang mo'i rdza chu dar mor yun ring du bzhugs so/ /de la slobakham ni shin tu mang mod kyi/ gdams ngag gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa ni/ bla ma 'khrul zhibatasna'u ba/ tsa ri ras pa/ bye ma ras pa/domaḥtshang ra pa/ sgrod lu4pa/ stag tshang ras po sogs te/ de rnams las sna'u bya bral ba ni/ 'khrungs yul zur mkhar/ : za lung du rab tu byung /—8 mtshan rdo rje mdzes tsu gsol/ ca'agro mgon dung mtsho ba dang kā la rdung mtshor mejal nas shog dril rnams tshang bar gsungs/ 4 bla ma'i zhabaso tog /ming/legs bar mdzad/ tshosna'u gangs mir thugs da mdzād mas snam rdu byi bral bar grags/ gzhan yang ri khrod mang bor bzhugasu/ phyag gye chin pho'i dngos grub po rnyes/ sku 'das dus ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon/— — des bla ma chen po rin chen gzhon nu rjes su gzung ba min trī/gdung rus mkha' re/ —'a phyos kha sgang gi 'brog tu tshes bzhi rnying ma ba'i zhe gcig pa chu mo bya la 'khrungs/ tshes bzhi rnying ma ba'i zhabs la gtugs nas dgu4lo dgu la rab tu byung / /chos khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/842

dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la ti ser byon/ der lo bzhi/ chu bar du snga stang gnyi sa la lo bco brgyad de lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ mngon par mkhyen pa'ang mnga' de kho ṣ+ka nyid gzigs shing thuṭa rab rno bas mkhas pa chen por rlom pa rnams kyi thobs pa yang 'phrog nus pas/ spu pa dkon gzhon chu bar du byon chos kyi gtam mdzad pas khong pham par mdzad de/ khong gi thang zhu cig 'dug pa dbul gsol nas/ khyed ston pa min nga ston pa yin gsung pa mdzad/ mkhas pa su dang phrad kyang nyam mi nga / shu tshe ril por bya bral ba'i brtul rgyags gzung nas/ gong ma chen po mi dbang bags 4 rgya — mtshan la sngogs pa che dgu'i bla mar gyur kyang / dgon par phebs ma khugi ga ga pur bzhuṭa shing thab kha'ang rang gis mdzad/ rkang du na bza' 'a nga ci byung gsol/ brtson 'grus dang sgom sran che bas tshos pho che gnyis kyang rje btsuna.oṃ la'i dang 'dra bar yod zer/— de la slobye ma mang du yod kyabā gtso 4 gi spyan snga rin po che ba bo nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga/nas min te/ bla chen pha la sems khrid gsan nas de'i khrid yig kyang mdzad/ gdul bya yang grangs med pā la khrid btab bo/ de gnyis ga'i slob ma ni skyes bu dam ya dam mkha' bsod nams pa yin te/ — des bla ma dam pa de gnyis las gdams pa mnos nas nyams su blangs shing / re shig rkyang gi phur gcod la byon nas shing sdong gnyan par byed pa cig gi sar bzhugs 843

pa sno7 khyaspyo po'i rtogasatshopa'irkyengs/ phyin bgo tshi 'di 'i 0 sprerwa'ortog la snyecade byetso shes bsag sto brage tu sto(r+sā7nyidaX steng rdu5 —tonge ngermowe lho me lhag tsuṣ+ṭhazhugos te/ rmermecho can na307 'akyobya pa sa rta'ang ngas no spyo dge pa gapho rgal ge gele zhe ngaming 64da'agrel sno ṣ+ṭhas rtsa ge 4des sna'u 4sotso dungar+sha 47snyo la4 — tsho dasi mi'akhalasag la sermepo'itshomagodamagayo gsanawi te/ — 5 74 yenges spu kod phungartserolarma do/'a ji gdung ru ngad nga theltar tshagaci neng lhur+shardo rje rgyan gnyisakyi zabe rmu skangatswagyi 4la'akhrungs/ chu nan cho4dzi 'gresteng rdo rje drubade yab yum gyi khyejir /dzin slo 94sgyes la mtshanalang rdorje bkra sa btagame/tsho 9lo cas khrirgya la briklog dongad 5 de das sgom dpal me dzab la sogaso la chosadzin 'o'akho yong sgo thasir la dgeng ma bcu gnyis chachogalabros/ ma lardu me khortse gzangardzan skasi jeb la mekhan po/dmed ༅slongadaza'acha' ca 4 rgyan chu'igabosabarosalazhus das rab tu༄94/ tshe mtshan dbung phyutswardordzing ga la/tsho 7777pa'i ta rkuno de 'a rgyal mawo sogam la gal 4ming cidu mo7da/ noyolo shisabazhi bo labarta gnyi skong/4 tshe ga ra bshadaltanyeratshogi po le bas gas/ da palalo rgobasalagatug ḍa k+ki'i :tho thu mkhonas song ge dpalab so gsas bsnyen bar rnyogs༈ 9 ma ni cho dbyings dbong phyugi dro gsolakho ga rna yang gamag sde brte chen sog 84 4

la'ang chos mang du zhus/ mtshal du mkhan pos bka' nan mdzad pa mkhar dgon gyi gdan sar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nub gcig rmang lam du shin tu mdzes pa'i bud med lnga byung / 'dir shog zer te gtsug lag khang chen po cig tu khrid sgo phye ba'i nang shin tu yangs pa na chos rtsig mang po 'dug sgo gsar pa skya khrig ge ba'ang mang po 'dug pas/ re re nas gyes pas de rnams kyang po ti du mas khengs 'dug sde mig gi phon chen po cig khong la gtad nas/ 'di rnams kyi gnyer gyis dang / bstan pa'i zhabs tog che ba yin zer ba rmis/ sang nang bar bla ma sna'u pas 'brong phur yo dgu ri mi 'babs mdzad bzhugs pa nas byon te mjal/ chos kyi gsung zeng mang po mdzad pas mos te/ phar la yang phyag rgya chen po ga 'u ma sogs phul/ tshur yang sems khrid skor rnams gnang nas khong gi rmang lam du yang bud med cig gis bskal nas byon pa yin/ chos bdag po la 'phrod/ nga'i skye ba'ang don can t+t+waṃ song gsung nas dgyes par mdzad/rin po che cas dbyings pa la'ang snang srid thams cad bre kha bcad pa bzhin chos nyid mnyam pa nyid dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas/ 'khor 'das rgyu 'bras thams cad kyi mig phyed 'gag khrol/ phu thag chod/ rmang thon/ mthil khogs pa 'di khong gi bka' drin yin gsung / 'khrul zhig pa'i zhal brda la brten nas yig cha'ang ma lus pa mdzad/ spyir bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad bsten/ rgyal sras dri med pa'i spyan sngar yang chos zhus/845

phyis phrin las kyang che bar byung / gtsang rong gi byang khar bzhugs pa'i tshe chos rje blo gros bzang pos sems khrid zhus te/ de'i rnam par thar pa ni bshad zin to/ /lhag ru mkhan chen pa rin chen dpal bzang pos chos rje nyer gnyis pa dang blo bzangs pa gnyis ka la zhus nas/ zhwa dmar rtogs ldan rin po che la phul/ de nas brgyud nas sprul sku rin po che depal chos kyi grags pa la'ang gdams —pa 'di bzhugs so/ sems khrid kyi gter mi pho 'brug la thon nas/ ding sang gi me pho spre'u yan la 'o brgya dang drug cu rtsa gcig song / sems khrid kyi brgyud pa'i skabs so/ /mjug rtsad du mar pa'i bka' brgyud dang dgas po'i bka' ba da du grags pa'i gtam rags tsam brjod pa'i bebs/de ltar dpal dwags po'i bka' brgyud ces grags pa 'di ni tshig gi brgyud pa ma yin gyi/ don gyi brgyud pa yin la/ don yang phyag rgya chen po dri ma med pa'i rtogs pa'i brgyud pa yin te/ bla ma gang las phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa thob pa de la rtsa ba'i bla ma'o zhes rnam par 'jog go/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa de yang rje mar pa dang rje btsun mi la gnyis kyi caring la/ sngon du gtum mo'i ye shes bskyed nas/ de'i stobs kyis phyag 46

rgya chen po'i rtogs pa bskyed par mdzad pas rdzogs pa'i rim par yang bzhed do/ /dwags po rin po ches ni/ las dang po ba dbang bskur ma thob pa dag la yang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa bskyed par mdzad pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs te/ de yang dwags po rin po ches dpal phag mo gru pa la/ 'o skol gyi phyag rgya chen po sto'adi'i gzhung ni bcom ldan 'das byams pas mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos 'di yin zhes gsungs shing / dpal phag mo gru pas kyang ri 'bri khung pa la de skad du gsungs pas/ rje 'bri khung pa dpon slob kyi gsung rab rnams su theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bshad pa mang du 'byung ba de yin no/ 'di la chos rje sa skya pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la phyag rgya chen po'i tha snyad med cing / phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes gang yin pa de ni dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes kho na yin no zhes bzhed mod kyi/ slob dpon ye shes grags pas mdzad pa'i de kho na nyid la 'jug par/ pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par brtson pa'i dbang po rab ni/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bsgoms pas so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs nyid na phyag rgya chen po dang nges par ldan pa yang dag par rtogs pas phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyid dang / zhes gsungs la/de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'brel ba lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad par yang /ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa/ sngags dang rjes su mthun pa ming phyag rgya chen po zhes bu ba'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i de bzhin nyid rtogs pa'i ye 847

shes gsalabar bsha do/ rtse de mas na rje lha po ba'i rol chu nga'i na pa'igyiphyag chen kro ga pa'i bad/ske rmi ci ba'i ma ga khrin par rje rgod tshange be rkyang bshadarna/ ci /—sngags kyi las dug gyur ༄ cag rgya chen lo yong ji sgom bo ba nang gaslob ma rnams la thos mkho bstan 9sto/ rje mar pa 'ikhrungs na garang song gi me pho spre'u mi la'7bgi brgya dab drug cu rtsa lnga'o zhes shes pag sto/ rje cha'i po'i bka' phargyud dang / khyad par bags po'i bko' brgyu ces gigi pa'i gtam rags sa tsa ma gis la / ste༈/
(ta)deb ther sngon spro las/ ko brag pa dang /ni gu'i skabs so/ /

dum bu dgu pa/ ko brag pa dang / ni gu'i skabs /ko brag pa spob ma dang bcas pa'i skabs/ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa de/ yul ding ri/ gdung ni sdong / yab gtso bo rgyal g.yung / yum stod mo rje ma gnyis kyi sras su chu pho stag gi 'o la zhu bltams/ chos rje sa skya pa ta dang 'khrungs lo gcig bris klog rtsol med du mkhyen/ se mig pa la dge bsnyen mdza da/ paṇa chen ཿshākya shrī la blokhusbyong sogs gsan/ gam du d+nghabla —ma rdo ji depal ba la rigakha'adzin bcu/ rdzogs chen dmar khri da la sogs chos meng twe gosan/ rgya zug jo srame la'ang rdzogs chen la sogs gsan/gyang rimakhadang kong mo'i ri ma mtshams mdzad pas phyag gyi chen pos rtogs pa 'khrings/ zlo paṇa chen rat+narab ta la rade mchog gi dbang gsan/ de nas la phyi sogarajisung bzhugs/ tshotsanarje skos la chomakhan skusgo/ yungadzu 'dulasa'adzin la slob de na/ ——— slob dpo na lo la gsang ston rgyas nas dgur lo nyi shu rtse dgu lad gi slong chog rdzogs mdzad/ mtshanan sod nams rgyal mtshan du gsol/ de nas ti ser byon lo lnga bzhugs/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i mngon surme gyi ye shes brnyes/ khyad par rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs/ ma pham gyi klu chu'i dngos grub phul/ phyis kyang stod ko brag gi dgon pa btab pas sa skam po la chu mig brdol/ choko 851

brag pa zhes kyang grags/ 'di la ni sgrub pa po dang mkhas pa'i mchog thams cawa kyis spyang zhabs la gtugs/— chos la'ang 'di mi mokhyetshore bya ba med/ bal 4ga spre bhu ’ smon wo 44 sbya ngungus/ spyor sa sha ba rigamong rgyug ngagis ga ba ba'i stong mos 0sko lug cig gi shadams ngu'e gsan/pa rtas kya'u/tshur r+sās shul tha 'gro ba'i don rgyu gi snyematsha pā dang ñtsa rjekhrib gnyisdo mdzasko tshonam ba ga gcu pa lcags sgo tha'i lo sro zhi ribasto — sheg sa/ skyes bu chen pho de ni shāka' zasargyud 'di'i khangs su gtogs so rnyes bya spru hro khothasgo sa shes pa logs stsa sbyi sto/ /de'i slob mya che ba 7 ngupasasta nad sha na pa/ rka de'i gcen tshopo rin sngo che /rgyag masan pa/ rin dzipo〉 che lha ba/ / dzo jin po chetsho rgyal po/ snun po che bar 'asdog pa/ rin po dh+ra cho sa sding/ sa pa/ tsho zan ston sher seng / rin po che dgasnye ldan pā/ — ye phro rgye gtsang so ga ri po che stosko grub sgo/ rtogs lhan dkon seng la gogasu pri ༷nga ṭ+wā dang / zlo jo lha/ mu mas nam mkha' gragasa'i mkha na chen lde rurangapa/ khyu lung pa/ lo zhing 'dzi grags byang ba/ 'olta rgod pa/ la phu ritsā lton lo che/ 9 glang ri ba la sogs bstan pa'i bdag sa mang sgo dakhu / —dpyal ṭha zhosna tsā/ tsho'o sga lo —1/ chag lo 1) nagā maspyi 'a dpokhu yo tsā/ ras ya chu tsā/ gnyalha ba chu tsā 'a sogs lo tsā tshob sa po dang / — da bshes gtsab pha/ dge bshes —nyi ma/ —'jam dbyangs ga shā ma/ sna ngargyang ro gzhon rin/ mnga' rig da brtsom3 853

nyi ma spral nag gtsang pa drug po/ mkhas btsun byang chub la sogs mkhas pa mang po dang / gsal pa/ snyo brag lung pa/ rgal gam pa snal gam pa/ sto mnga' pa/ rgyal mtshan grags/ ser ma ba/ phu gu ra ba/ srang skya pa/ myang 'tshal pa/ lha rje skyob pa/ pho rog pa/lcab be ba/ dbrang ston phul dmar pa/ kong ston pa/ so zur pa/bla ma pa ri ba sku mched/ seng ge rdzongs pa/ mim shing dang / rong thong pa/ gnyos ston zhig po/ sham 'bum/ dngos chos shes/ rdza ri ba/ myang ro ba/ g.yu rgyal pa/ chu mig pa/ yar 'brog da ra po/ so zhig khams kyi 'ong pho/ bra 'o pa/ dom thod can/dar seng la sogs dgon sde'i bdag po bla ma dge bshes mang po dang /'phan yul mdo thod lo pa/ za lung pa/ lho brag pa/ stod lungs pa/yang klungs pa la sogs dbus pa'i dge bshes mang po dang / gzhan yang dge thoshes marang / grub thob ma dgon 'dzin/ bla ma/ zhig po la sogs/ mdor na gsar rnying gi bdag po/ mnga' bdag jo bo/ lha btsun hor gyi mi chen/ mi dpon/ gnas gzhi'i bdag po la sogs pa thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs so/ /de dag las bya skyungs pa'am pho rog mdo sde mgon zhes pa de shing mo yo la 'khrungs/ re gsum pa me sbrul la gshegs/ ko brag pa slob ma dang bcas pa'i skabs so/ /853

ni gu'i skabs/de ltar dpal nā ro pas rje mar pa la gnang ba'i thabs lam chos drug gi brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams bshad nas/ nā ro pa'i lcam mo ni gu ma las byung ba'i chos drug gi rim pas smin pa dang grol ba'i rim pa bshad pa ra bya'o/ /lugs de'i len pa po ni grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor te/ de ni gdung rus khyung po/ yab stag skyes/ yum bkra shis skyid gnyis kyi sras su stag gi lo la snye mo ra mangs su 'khrungs/ btsas ma thag tu rgya gar grub thob a mo bha byon te lung legs par bstan/ lo bcu lon pa'i tshe klog dang rgya bod kyi yi ge mkhyen/ dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas/ lo bcu gsu / pa la slob dpon g.yung drung rgyal ba la bon mkhas par bslabs nas gzhan la bshad pas dpe 'grems bdun brgya tsam byung / de nas bla ma 'byung gnas seng ge la rdzogs chen sems sde'i skor mang du gsan nas bshad pas/der yang slob ma bdun brgya tsam byung / de nas stod lungs sho ma rar skor ni rū pa'i chos ma lus pa gsan/ de nas gser mang po bsnams nas bal por byon nas pani ta pa su ma ti la lo tsā bslabs/ kṛ yog gi dbang dang rgyud sgrub thabs lnga bcu tsam zhus/ a tu la baspro gyis grogs mdzad nas rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal/ dge tshul mdzad chos mang du gsan/854

de nas shrī bha dra sasnyan/ be ro tsa na/ kha che dgon pa ba/ rme byi ba'i slob ma zhing gi rdo rje/ mi mnyam rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje ste rnam pa gsum/ de khri ko snyi'i ṭī gi ma ka na shrī/ bram ze rat+na pha 'a rnams la gsang sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ bod du 'ongs pas jag pa lan gnyis su byung ba nus pas pham par byas/ yul du spu mo la med 'tshol dang ste sgyur phyin/ de la bu gsum byung / lha mo dkar mo zhig gis bu gsum po 'dis khyod bla ma shangs par grags pa la nas khal stong phrag re lo re la 'bul zhing / rtsa ba'i yon bdag byed do zhes lung bstan/ der sngar gyi slob mas longs spyod mang du phul ba dang / gu lang gi gser kha brdol ba dang thug pas gser srang stong lhag pa cig byung / yang bal por byon te pham mthing ba la bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang gdan bzhi zhus nas rgya gar du byon/ rdo rje gdan pa la gser srang brgya phul/ nā lan+d+rar nā ro pa'i slob mdā chen po/ su ma ti gīrti/ ra ma 'i la/ na te ka ra/rka ka ta'i rje btsun ma rin chen lha mo/ ku ku ri pa'i slob ma grub thob nyi ma'i snying po rnams la chos mang du zhus/ d+me tri ba dang mjal nas rgyudamang po'ang zhus/ gser srang bdun phul/ bod longs spyod chung bas nor sgrub lhag tshan che ba cig zhus pas/ yid bzhin gyi mgon po phyag drug nangag/ de nas pa gser srang lnga brgya bsnams te/ rdo rje 'chang dngos la thug pa su yod dris pas/ nā ro pa'i lcam mo ni gu ma zhes bya ba yod 855

de/ de dag pa'i sa la gnas thu 'ja' lus su gyur pas su rung rung gis mi mthong / so sa gling gi dur khrod du mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyi gtso la 'byon pas semagodag na der mthong sri da zer/ der so sa gling du byon/ na mo burta ya'i gsol ba btab pas/ tā la bdun srid tsam gyi nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro ma sumadog thug nag cig tu yod pa rus pas brgyan pa/phyagatanag shālag dang tho da pa bsnamasapa/ gcig dang du ma la sogs pa'i gzugs su ston zhing gar bsgyur ba mthong nas ni gul yin par nges te phyag dang skor ba byas/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa zhu 'tshalazhus pas/ nga ni sha za'i ṭā gi yin gsub / yang btud de zhus pas/ gsang sngagasakyi gdamathobapa zhu na gser dka sa ga stong pagazang lnga brgya po phul bas phyag tu bzhe naganags sungagator/ 'o na sha za'i mkha' 'gro 4yin nam snyamadu the rtsamabazos pa na/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs pas mkha' 'gro mang po 'dus nas dkyila'akhor sprul/ der sgyu lus rmi lam gyi dbang bskur gnang / mkha' 'gro mas dpag tshad gsum du khyer nas gser gyi༄sde'i kharobazhag desarmi las shu rdo rje btsun mos chos drug tshar gcig dbor su tshangagasag rdo rje tshigakar+ṣa sgru galam rimaganang/ ga rnamang rgyudadang sgrub thabs zhin tu mang po gsungag ni rtsama'i zhal nas/ chos drug rbetagadams pa di rnams shes pa nga dang wa ba pa ma gtogs med / brgyud pa bdun gyi bar du chig rgyud gyis/ de rnam ngas byin 856

gi sne dpe 'ga' chud zos pa'ang khong gi dpe las gsos/ rin chen bzang po dang dharma blo gros kyis 'gyur yang mdzad/ glang ri thang pa la bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'phan yul jog por 'chad dkar dgon pa btab/ der ri nag po'i khong gseng gi rnal 'byor pa rā hu la gusta dz+ra byon nas/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang dang mgon po'i skor la sogs pa'i chos mang du gnang /dus gyis 'jad kyi tsha lung du shing mo lug la byon/ me pho spre'u'i lo la phag ri'i shag rtsar byon/ lcags mo glang gi lo la gro mo'i stong gra ru byon/jog po nas gdan 'dren byung bas shang su byon/ lo gsum gyi nang du zhong zhong la sogs pa'i dgon gnas brgya rtsa brgyad btab/ chos mang du bshad pas grwa pa rnams bshad pa la cung zad 'byams/ sgrub pa la g.yel bar gyur pas de rnams kyis mthong bar res lha mo'i gzugs mang po bstanares gshin rje'i skyes bu 'jigs su rung ba mang po bstan pas slar sgrub pa la tshud/ grwa pa gzhan gyi phrag dog gis dmag drangs byung ba sprul pa'i dmag gis phyir bzlog pas gus shing slob mar gyur/ thang lha dang zhab kyi 'ba' ra nag po la sogs pa bar chad byed du byung ba'i lha 'dre rnams nyin mo thog dang mtshan mo ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan zhing srog sngags blangs te dam tshig la bzhag /de'i tshe cho 'phrul dang lha skur bstan pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul yang dag par bstan te/ sku tshe mthar phyin nas grwa pa rnams la de ring gi 'di chos kyi tha ma yin no zhes pa'i gsung byon nas zhi bar 858

ba/shegs/ spur ma sbyangs par gser dngul gyi sgam du bzhugs na thong zhong rdo rje gdan dang mnyam par 'gyur gsung yang khams pa'i grwa pa rnams ma mnyan te/ spur sbyangs pas rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs la sogs pa shin tu mang bar byon no/ /snga phyir sdoms pas grwa pa khri tsho brgyad byung ba yang /slob ma'i gtso bo ni/ rme'u ston pa/ lagayor po rgya mo che/ rngul ston rin dbang / la stod dkon mchog mkhar/ rmog cog pa/ zhang sgom chos seng rnams min sgo/ ('di'i sku tshe lo brgya lnga bcu gsung ba/ dam pa sangs rgyas ding rir byon pa'i tshe/ rje khri pas khyed kyis lo du lon zhus pas/dgu khri dgu stong dgu brgya dgu bcu lon zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra bar/grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi dgongs pa can gyi gsung la rdzun du blta bar mi bya la/ phyis 'di las grub thob mang du brgyud mar byung ba'i gtan tshigs kyis grub pa'i skyes bu kho nar lta bar bya ste/ du ba las me rtogs pa bzhin no/ /brgyud pa bzhi pa rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus ni/ de nyid kyi gsung las/ bdag gi yul lha phu spang rtsa/ rus zhi she/ pha she rgan sman chung / ma 'be mo bad+ma sgron gyi sras su 'khrungs/ lo bcu bdun la zhong zhong du chos sgor zhugs/ bla ma shangs pas kye rdor gyi dbang bskur gnang / btsun chung khyod gzhon dus thos pa gyis/ sgom sngas na 'dres 'khyer/ ngas cha rkyen dpe cha byin gyi gsung ba la/ chos rje'i chos gzhi sar 'brom ston bya ba cig thos pa la yi chad pa'i gsung mang 859

rla sgon bcan ṣ+ka khyad nga lasgom smra snyesgo zer zas/ slar ma la gad mas paphulasgomatha'aror chu 7rtag cang tsā 79 tsā rta stags pal mas ngag 'a tshe 5lko dh+ra bhāsgo blo masalhamasasnang kyang thong ma byukhu /yaṣ+ṭha za'idru ta dra — a 0ṣ+ṭhaston la tsho r+ha skang 3 khros kyi maṣ+ṭha༄4 sang snyo wī ñtsa myo chegobul dz+ra 7 rkya 〉byung tshomi mas77sha sag yozagadrug sgradojipho 〉pu lha ga garnams gzi4nas snyo rtse'i rjes la d+ngha gsangs tre 2 2lha nas 777 7lo7 pu ma gsosdu po po che'i snyi la tshophyon7 3sta ṣ+ṭha zhe yi sto rtsa /spyo khyod r+sāṣ+ṭha skyi dbo ro du gsung / — gyin 〉pā'i la byu da 7shesardzo nyi rta rdzosnar 7bgrosgro mas yi chud spyo brang lasang ske sa stusta 'a lha mas skyags ciste/staX lam pa sa steng byu ba dpalachen sa'islobaza thos pā rnyarta sna shu lar+sāsko rdzo sgrub blo la zhugs pā gad longatshog a the zeng blo de gnas ji rte bha tsho r+sha drung rla phyin/ dze sgo dbangu masgomaṣ+ṭha stan 07 — mo lha lta zang dbajo thus rjes 'dzin pam zhu byas tshobs/ khyad sku'i slosgyu ma rkyen ga sta /zhe mo ngas pa'i lugs zhus( nga / 〉 〉 na 7 krortad las tabasam nas bong sna lke rgon nam ga da /tsho mun chu phros9 pas rung ga khu nas/ dge bshes77 spron ba/myang bran pa chos yes/ tsho skyi za tshula'aphag /rmo g.yon gaska/ shā — ma rdzi nga / khams pa lo tsā ji/ ston 'u mu zhigasabog cu zo 'dugarnapas khong rnams don dam —bden cig khu tshe ba lta/ — pa zla steng ji ga pa gas/ 86snyo

dang po khecha gide ma bde stong nan tor bde gsung / dngos ga 'i nu ba mo bla ma sa song gyis rali kyi 'du she skyes/ der rdul tshon dang lhang nge 'a'ad zu di kyil 'khor labartenangapa gnyis/ bskye da rim : yiparang lha 57sasalha / rdzogs ri sbyor co rtsa 'grel gnyis/ sbyoratso ngartsa 'grem gnyis/ snang po masam 'grel lha rnamasazhur/ de bla ma'i: ngadubatsamadzoyosaga'ar+sā bsgoms/ bla ma dbegabakhodar+shalaragyesapa se na bur sgol rna du rmethongs bu ra gyi rgyag)gabyas shangs pa slobarnayi zhus/ der yang rta cadang bobs gta r+sāng / der ra tshung lug kyidathos godams ngag rnaralakro ngadagapar gnang rto bung sgom gyi gisgo༄dzilor sa yas sterabarka rin ra rtson 'gru khyod gyis serab yigasubabs ra bangagazar ga d+ku yongab migatso mi'ab 'ag ri bas shun khulaca'acatsholagayo ra babs/ nga sa sdi ga 4 ba gso rgya nas la'i drubartu co pas/ ba0na pa dang rga l+le go du byasathalarūsrolamasang rgo chod/2 cis kyab blo rdzobader mtshamagomed bya4sgomadzosang ma gyi ba'istonadam ra zad gsu nga namakhanang / rje brkyab tsun ze'i sha ba'akho smisto ma napo'akhu nāl0rmāl nga zhig dbasgo po ra chugrubatho shes mi zi spuragamadzom da/ ce 'byung ba mnyes/—— gi/khyo kyisamagostolha dngalha khros gartsigabal phulagasung nas bzlalas /go2 nyag mo pa'i dge ma gshonartemakhar la spyo hwa'i 86

sgom rim dang rab gnas/ dge bshes rdza rab la bka' gdams ngag mang po/ slob dpon g.yor po can du lo lnga bzhugs nas phar phyin dang spyod bsdus/ myang sgom la kha rag skor gsum zhus/ yul du byon/pha gum 'dug pa la zhing btsongs nas dge ba byas/ de nas rgya grags bsod la sbyor drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang la sogs gdams pa mang po/ dge bshes zhu la'ang gdams pa mang po/ slob dpon zhang la 'dul ba 'od ldan sogs/ 'bal sgom phyag na la zhi byed sogs mang po rgyas/ slar yang g.yor po can du 'gro bsam pa la bla ma'i drung du phyin/ rnal 'byor ma zhal mthong ba dang rmi lam zin zhus pas/ shes chog pa'i phar phyin de mi shes par rdzun shes 'dug nga'i rtsar ma bsdad gsung bka' bkyon pa la/ yang de nub rang sku mdun du shog gsung nas dbang chos gdams ngag thams cad gnang / gzims g.yog tu'ang mdzad/ sngar lo lnga dang de res lo gcig dang zla ba bdun chos zab dgu rnams gnang / nga'i brgyud pa zung / rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa gyis gsung nas bla ma zhi bar gshegs/dgun gyi rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshar nas sdings mar lo gnyis mtshams bcad nas bsgoms pas nyams myong mang po byung ba shangs pa mi bzhugs pas drir med nas/ rje sgam po ba la zhu bar dgongs te byon pa'i lam bar du dpal phag mo gru pa dang 'dzom/ gdams ngag bar zhu tshur zhu mdzad/ de nas sgam por bla ma rin po che'i drung tu rtol/ chos drug sogs kyang zhug/862

phyab / rgya chen pa'i lta ba la thag chod pa'i bogs thon/ yang 'byon dus skyel thung kyang mdzad lam du'ang gdug pa 'dul ba'i bya ba mang po mdzad/de nas rmog cog tu bzhugs/ lo bcu gnyis su nyung lo la brten nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs ris kyi slob ma mang po 'dus/ der grwa pa ma shong bar skugs lungs btab/ dngos su gdams pa btab pa rngams lta zhog sos gus kyis lam du zhugs pa tsam gyis rtogs pa shar pa yang mang du byung / nga'i brgyud pa 'di dbon ston skyer sgang bas 'dzin/ de'i brgyud pa sangs rgyas snyan ston gyis 'dzin/de'i brgyud pa sangs rgyas ston pa bya bas 'dzin/ de'i slob ma rnams kyis chos 'di dar bar byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ bde ba can du spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya byung ba la da lan mi 'gro gsung nas lo gsum bzhugs/ der bu slob rnams la nga mngon dgar 'gro bas der gsol ba thob cig gsung nas zhi bar gshegs so/ /brgyud pa lnga pa rin po che rmog cog pa'i zhal las 'khrungs pa'i gdung 'dzin pa grub thob skyer sgang pa dharma seng ge ni/ 'khrungs yul stod lungs gnam pa/ gdung rus 'bal/dgung lo bcu gnyis nas gshin rje gshed la bsnyen pa bskyel/ bcu bdun la khu bo 'bal thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du rab tu byung nas chos mang du gsan/ lha sar chos 'khor byung ba cig la khu bo'i phyags phyir phyin pas grwa pa cig gis rnam bzhag byas pa'i skal ba dar yug gsum/ zangs phye 863

mar dang bcas pa cig byung ba khyer nas brag lha klu phug gi thang du nye 'don la phyin pas/ ri ngos de la spyil chung skya khad de pa zhig mthong nas pha gi na su bzhugs byas pas/ 'phags pa lce sgom bya ba thugs rje chen po'i grub thob cig bzhugs zer/ mos par byung nas dngos po rnams phul/bla mas 'phags pa zhal gzigs pa yin lags sam zhus pas/ thugs rje chen po yin nam cha med/ grib kyi thad ka 'di na tshur skya shar shar ba cig gtan du mthong gi 'dug gsung / 'o na thugs rje chen po zhu dgos zhus pas/thog mar rig gtad kyi dbang ma mdzad/ mar khal gnyis la mar me byas/gnyis la tsā ru'i ston mo byas te sgrub thabs tshar gsum zhus nas/ bla mas lo du la zhal gzigs zhus pas/ ston kha bsod stoms re byas/ de nas mtshams bcad nas bsgrubs pas lo ngo brgyad lon tsa na gtso 'khor gsum po zhal gzigags/ de nas gtan du zhal mthong ba yin gsung /de nas dbon ston gyis skyer sgang du mtshams bcad de bsgrubs pas lo phyed dang bzhi na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal mthong / zhar la sngar bzlas pa byas pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi zhal yang mthong / de nas khu po'i sar shog gsung nas byon pas/ khyod kyis spyan ras gzigs dang rta mgrin gnyis kyi zhal mthong 'dug nga khams pa la mnyan mi dgos sgrab pa kho na khe che/ 'di khyer la la stod na ras chung pa'i slob ma tsa ri them pa bya ba cig yod 'dug pa der song gsung nas gser zho gang dang / dar 864

yug drug rnams gnang di bsnams nas la stod la byon pas la kha cig tu nyi ma tsha la ser ba drag po cig byung ba la brten nas gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa der 'khrungs/ de nas tsa ri sgom pa'i drung du phyin pa na/ nye gnas kyis mdun bsus/ phyag btsal byung bas/ khyed nga la phyag byed pa ci yin byas pas/ bla ma'i gsung gis de ring grub thob cig 'ong bar yong pas/ de thong gsung ba de khyed yin par 'dug gsung nas khrid de bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin/ phyag 'tshal dar kha gang phul nas/ rgyags rtsam med pas chos myur du tshar ba cig zhu zhus pas/ gser zho gang dang dar yug drug zad pa na chos tshar bar bya gsung / bla ma la rdzun de las zer ma myong lo gnyis la ras chung lugs kyi dbang dang gdams pa rnams tshar bar gnang ngo / /de nas 'u yug tu bla ma spen phug bya ba jo bo rje'i gsang sngags kyi gdams pa rdzogs par mnga' ba de la lo lnga bsten nas gdams pa rnams tshar bar zhus/ der rmog cog pa'i stan pa gsan pas shangs kyi la rtsar nyal ba'i tshe/ mi nag po ras kyi maṅga rag gyon pa cig byung nas nang par la la zla bo 'ong bar yod/ ngas khyod kyi bran bzhin du bya/ mi su thod thod la ma sbyin cig zer nas song / sang la la grogs mang po dang bcas nas phyin/ thugs lungs su bla ma'i spyan sngar mjal/bla ma'i zhal nas/ mdang mi nag po cig bsur btang byung ngam gsung /byung lags zhus pas/ de mgon po yin/ da khyod kyi bran bzhin du 865

byed par 'dug gsung / der gdams pa rnams khad kyi dzad kyis gnang /nyams myong gi rim pa shin tu stobs che/ lha dang grub pa thob po'i la 'byor pa dang mjal ba'ang bgrang gis mi lang / bar skabs zhig tu bla ma'i gsung gis gzhan gyi chos sgo phye gsung nas dbang 'ga' mjod pas nyams myong 'gribs/ mtshams bcad cing 'bad pas bsgoms pas yang sor chud rtse gcig pa'i sgrub pa kho na bya dgongs yong pa na/ 'bal tshad ma gshegs pa'i gdan sar 'gro dgos zer nas rta ba sum bgyi tsam gyi gdon 'dren mi byung / nga rtse gcig pa'i sgrub pa byed mi 'gro byas pa la/ bla ma'i bka' gnang nas skyer sgang du byon/ gdan sa mdzad sku 'bum yang brtsigs/ dgon pa la lcags ri cig bya bsam nas sa rdo spungs pa na gzhan gyis byed du ma ster/ der chos skyong bran bzhin du byed zer ba la lcags ri rtsig dbang ma byung gsungs pas/ de nub rang lcags ri bcog pa'i mi tshang 'ga' shi nas babs byed du byung / thugs 'gyod nas de rnams kyi bdusna tshigs kyang mdzad/ de nas 'bal gyi dus mchod kyi tshe ma gtogs sku mtshams dam par bsdams/ thugs ngam mdzad pas gzhan don gyi mthu rgyas te/ 'ga' dang rgya'i rgyal po'i 'bul ba tshan bas sleb/ bla ma'i gdan sar 'bul ba che ba cig skyel dgongs paṃ la gi pa rnams kyis 'bal thams cad mkhyen pa'i grwa sa nas gzhan du 'bul pa gtong ba mi 'a da zer nas/ 'bul skyil la mi gcig kyang mi 'gro ba 866

khrims byas/ der chos skyong gis 'phan yul pa'i tshong par brdzus te bla ma 'bul ba dang bcas pa zhugs lungs mthong sar bo la/ da nged rnams dur khrod tson pa mi bzad par t+ta na skra ta'i tshogs 'khor la 'gro zer nas mi snang bar song / de ltar mngon par shes pas gzhan dbang ba ra ba la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa na ji ltar 'dug mngon sum du mkhyen pa dang /slob ma'i sems kyi rnam par rtog pa phra rags thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas gzhan gyi don rlabs po che mdzad de/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum la zhi bar gshegs so/ /brgyud pa drug khri songs rgyas gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab ces bya ba skyer sgang pa'i thugs kyi sras su 'khrungs pa de ni/ 'khrungs yul yol gyi mda'/ gdung ru gnyan/ 'khore ba mtha' dag la skyo ba skyes/ longs spyod la zhin pa mangs/ da la gyi dal 'byor 'dis thar pa thob par bya snyam nas/ dgung lo bcu gcig la gung bu mkhar du slob dpon ston mas la chos sgor zhugs/ bcu bdun la mkhan po byang chub mas dpa' la dge tshul/ nyi shu la mkhan po bzod pa la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad nas mkhan po dang mkhan par gnyis la 'dul ba dang sher phyogs la sogs gsan/ slob dpon gom la tshad ma rnam nges la sogs/ dbu ma/ bslab btus/ spyod 'jug sogs gsan/ bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan la rgyud gdams ngag dang bcas pa/ zhi byed/phag mo chos drug sa rag skor gsum/ nā ro chos drug so chung 867

pa'i gdams pa rnams zhus/ de nas gong bu mkhar du thos pa mang po stabs su byas pa'i mched grogs la stod 'khyams po bya ba yod pa de na re/thos pa'ang de tsam yin/ shes bya'i mtha' la chod rgyu med pas smig rgyu 'dra/ da sgrub pa cig nyams su len pa khyad che bas ngas dbus gtsang lams gsum du phyin nas bla ma'ang mang du btsal/ khyad par du chos rje 'bri khung pa dang / skyer sgang pa dang / mdo po ba/ sa skya pa rnams bsten pa yin te/ gang byas kyang bsgoms pa'i yon tan la che ba 'tshur phu na bla ma skyer sgang pa bya ba sangs rgyas dngos shig bzhugs shing 'dug pas der 'dod/ ngas kyang en cig bsdad pas sgru lus kyi dal sbyor 'phel po byung zer nas/ rnam thar thos pa tsam gyis gdung ba'i mchi ma khrag ltar zags/ mos gus tshad med pa skyes nas myur du mjal ba'i smon lam dang gsol ba drag tu btab/ de nas ston gsan pa'i dpyid de las mthon/ mjal ma thag tu bla ma'i zhal nas/ kha ning ston ka ri spo to cig gi steng gi khang pa'i nang nas nam srod la ja skol/ ma mkhal skya phyad de nga la gsol ba drag tu 'debs pa de khyed du 'dug sang 'ong gnangs 'ong la de las mi thon pa ci yin gsung / de brel ba cig gis ma thon pa lags/ nga bla ma'i gdams ngag ma lus pa cig zhu dgos zhus pas/spyir bla ma shangs pa'i chos 'di bka' dog par yod de/ khyod la chig brgyud rnams ma lus par tshar ba cig bya gsung nas/ dbang dang gdams 868
