tsho dgu ste nyi shu rtsa bdun po rnams las kyi phyag rgya/ chos kyi phyag rgya/phyag rgya chen po/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste phyag rgya bzhis bcings shing /lta ba lung rigs dang 'brel ba/ sgom pa nyams myong dang 'brel ba/ spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba/ 'bras bu gzhan don dang 'brel ba/ lam drod rtags dang 'brel ba/ dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba ste 'brel pa drug ldan du gsungs/ gzhung la grub pa sde bdun ni/ mtsho skyes kyi gsang ba grub pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i thabs dang shes rab grub pa/ in+d+ra ghā ti'i ye shes grub pa/ la sri la ra'i gnyis med grub pa/sto lha ru 7/hūṃ lhan cig skyes grub/ dā ri ka ba'i gsang ba chen po'i de kho na nyid grub pa/ rnal 'byor ma tsi tog mdzad pa'i dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i de kho na nyid grub pa rna /sa so/ /snying po ni/ rgyal po dang / btsun mo dang / dmangs do ha ste gsum mo/ gzhan rme ti pas mdzad pa'i dbang nges bstan dang / bdag med ma gsal ba la sogs pa'i chos phran rnams dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'grel ba dang / gnas pa bsdus pa/ phyag nas mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig 'byed dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa/ de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ras mdzad pa'i shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ ra ma r+pā las mdzad pa'i dbang nges bstan gyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi rjes su bstan pa rnams la phra mo skor zhes grags te de rnams 1001

gsungs/ de rjes su 'brog rjo sras kyis bla ma phyag na bod du spyan drangs te/ gtsang gi chu sgor bzhugs nas bod ston rnams la phyag rgya chen po'i chos mang du gsungs pa'i slob ma/ she ston byang 'bar/ zhing snga ring cho// khams pa rgu ston/ spu hrangs nag po sher dad/ 'brog jo sras rdo rje 'bar/ 'or brgyad ston chung / klung shod pa khyung khri/ khye'u brtson 'grus/ ba reg thos pa dga'/ brang ti blo gros dbang / bra'o 'bum la 'bar/ brag pa dkon grags/ se ston sgra gcan zin/ mtshur dbyig gi rgyal mtshan rnams dang / slob ma lo tsū ba yang nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rma ban chos 'bar/ gnyan dharma grags/ mtshur ye shes 'byung gnas te bzhi'o/ /de rnams las mang bar byas na bod ston sum cu'o zhes kyang zer ro/ /'brog jo sras kyis phyag na spyan 'dren pa'i tshe gser srang brgyad cu 'bul bar zhus/ yab kyi 'dang mdzad pa'i tshe gser srang lnga bcu la brgyad cu ltar bcos nas phul bas/ bla ma phyag na'i nye gnas rnams kyis gzhal bas lnga bcur 'dug nas/ de la bla ma ma dgyes te 'brog jo sras kyis nga la brdzun bya bar mi 'os/ 'di 'dra na kho'i pha de yang gsha' ma cig min nam/ pha yi spyod pa bu yis ston/ bya ba yin gsung nas chu gris rang gi gsus pa thal mar gshags/ der 'khor rnams bred nas ngul pas/ khyed rnams ma dga' 'am ci yang mi sto gsung nas phyag gis byil ba tsam gyis smin pa tsam yang med par gyur te lho bal du 1004

thegs/ 'di'i grub rtags brgyad ni/ dug sbral byung ba la gzhin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gyis bzlogs pa dang / zlong chen smyon pa byung ba mkha' 'gro mas bzlog grogs byas pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma des lung bstan nas grong khyer du byon pas bram ze rgan po mkha' 'gro ma chung mar yod pa cig gis/ u rgyan gyi rgyal po gnyis 'thab rtsod shor nas rgyal po a : zhes bya ba skye ba bdun pa cig la rgyal po gzhan de'i blon po mong rtse mong gis mda' mde'u rdo rje pha lam las byas pa zhin mtshams su rgyab nas shi ba'i ro mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis hab thob byas pas/ bram ze rgan po'i chung mas mgo thob nas khrim du khyer 'ongs pas bram zes 'bar bas/ khyod dang las 'brel yod pas zhabs tog byas pa yin/ da mi dgos na phyin chog zer nas mgo de phyag na la phul nas mo rang shi/ thod pa de phyag nas sa 'og tu sbas pas nam mkha' nas sgra byung bas dngos sgrub tu shes nas sa las phyung ste/ nyar bcag mdzad pas dngos grub byung ba dang / de'i nang du chang cung zad re blugs nas sdod du bcug pas sdod chang gis khengs 'ong ba dang / chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram na yar byon pas mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis rdo'i sgom thag srubs med cig btags nas phul ba dang / phag mo bum pa gsum pa'i sbyin sregs mdzad nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal slob ma la dngos su ston nus pa dang / ba dmar mo'i lci ba sa la ma reg rin po che'i stod du bzhag nas de'i steng da shing thog bzhag ste byin brlabs mdzad 1003

pa ga shing thog zad med 'ong ba dang / chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du rgyal po byung yang chom kun gyis 'joms pa la/ gshin rje gshed kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis jag pa rengs par mdzad pa dang / jo sras rdo rje 'bar gyis gser phul bas chu gris gsus pa gzhags pa dang brgyad zer ro/'khon phu ba'i sras zla ba 'od zer gyis bal por byon pa'i tshe grub pa'i rtags ngo mtshar ba mdzad pa mthong ba'i lo rgyus kyang 'dug go/phyag na'i slob ma kha che dharma shrī spyan gcig pa zhes bya bas kyang bla ma'i phyags phyir byon/ phyag rgya chen po'i skor mang du bshad/ bod kyi slob ma rnam sa dang bgros nas 'bum gyi ṭā rka dang sdud pa'i lde mig brtsams so/yang phyag na'i slob ma la stod gtsang shong ba/ de nas sher sgom dar seng / jo btsun me 'bar/ zhing deng po lung ba/ go lung ba/grub thob btsun pa/ mnga' ris char chung ba/ la stod na chum pa/mkhan po snying po rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po rgyal mtshan 'od/ mkhan po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyang rin chen bzang po/ mi nyag shes rab bzang po/ rje btsun ri mi 'babs pa las mi nyag pas mdzad pas khrid yig bdag gis thob bo/ /de ltar phyag na dpon slob las byung ba rnams la phyag rgya chen po stod lugs shes grags so/a su ni/ mes po rgya gar nas 'ongs pa'i pani ta bal po'i bha ro rnams kyi mchod gnas yin pa la/ de'i bus yon tan ma bslabs pas bha 1004

ro'i g.yog por gyur pa de'i bu ste/ chung ngu nas shes pa rno zhing grung bas rgya so kha yan chad kyi tshong zong blangs nas rang gi bdag po bha ro de la phul pas bha ro dga' ste/ da ngas khyod la khyim cig dbub zer ba la/ a sus bdag la khyim mi 'tshal/ chos 'dod pas chos la btang bar zhu byas pas lha ros kyang gnang ste/ dang por bal bo dza hūṃ ngam shartoXbha drar grags pas pazlo ta de la dbang dang rgyud 'grel mang du mnyan/ de nas phyag na la gdams pa zhus pas bden pa gzigs te yang dag pa'i skyes bur gyur nas/rgya'i yul du gshegs par dgongs te 'phan yul gyi sum 'phrang du thogs shig bzhugs nas 'khor mang po la chos gsung pa'i tshe/ jo mo 'brom mo gza' cig dang mthun nas sras grags pa seng ge 'khrung pa'i ngo mthong bas rgyal 'byon pa gzhol te/ rlung shod du yun ring du bzhugs/ rma sgom chos kyi shes rab kyis kyang ma su dang klung shod du mjal gyis yon bdag klu phyug gis spyan drangs nas 'brom stod du bzhugs/ der rang gi chos phag mo'i byin rlabs skor dang do ha dang phyag rgya chen po bshad pas grwa pa khri tsho mang po byung / de'i tshe chos rje ras chung pas kyang mjal nas chos zhus/ma su'i gsung gis da bu smad gso dgos pas khyod kyis bsod stoms gyis la nga la nas phul gsung bas/ nas mang po rnyed de/ nas bong rgyab nyi shu tsam phul/ de la rigs kyi sras grags pa zheng ge/ chos kyi grags pa/in+d+ra dbang nge dang bzhi'o/ /sras mo lha 'dre mi gsum bya ba ste lcam sring 1005

bdun no/rje btsun grags pa seng ge ni/ yab kyi dgongs pa lon pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu thugs la 'khrungs pa/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen pa/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa'o/chos kyi grags pa ni/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la mkhas pa khyad par phyag rgya chen po la shin tu mkhas pa yin no/ in+d+ra dang dbang nge la brgyud pa zin pa ma byung / grags pa seng ge'i sras grub thob mgon po gcung sangs rgyas sgom pa/ de 'og seng ge grags/ chung shos slobadapon bal po 'jig rten no/de la grub thob mgon po ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i chos la thos bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ yi dam rdo rje phag mo la sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal gzigs/ 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro bran du 'khol/ chos skyong mgon po dang lha srin sde brgyad kyis srog snying phul/ dngos sgrub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor par gyur/sangs rgyas sgom pa ni/ yab mes kyi gdan sa mthon po la zhen pa med pas mchil ma ltar bor/ zas skom gyi 'khri ba chod pas chu la dka' thub mdzad de/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ chos dang gang zag tu ya ma bral ba yin no/ —1006

slob dpon bal po 'jig rten ni/ sngon bsod nams bsab/sa pas yab mes bka' drin can gyi dpon sras su 'khrungs/ gcen po gong ma rnams kyi thugs zin/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs lon/ yab mes kyi gdan sa mthon po'i steng nas phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gsungs pas 'gro ba'i mun pa bsal/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/mkha' 'gro bran du 'khol/ chos skyong lcam dral dang dam can pho mo rnams dang gsung gleng mdzad cing bka' bsgo ba'i las mdzad pa chen po'o/bla ma skye med kyi thugs kyi sras su gyur pa yang / sgom kwa ba bzhi/gdung drug g.yor po ba'i bu gsum/ dmag pa sgang la sogs te/kwa ba bzhi ni/ rgyal gyi sgom tsho/ grab kyi sgom tsho/ bye ma lung stong gi sgom tsho/ klags kyi sgom tsho'o/ /gdung drug la/ rwa lo tsā ba/ ba tshab lo tsā ba/ dol bo ye shes/ dge bshes gnyan la sogs pa'o/g.yor po'i bu gsum la/ rog pa dmar rdor seng / zhang ba'o brag rtsa ba/ rlung ston rdo rje bla ma rnams so/ /gzhan yang mnga' ris par bu pa dang / sgang ston 'od 'bar dang / spang ston chos 'bar la sogs pa'o/de dag las rog rdor seng gis sangs rgyas brtsag son la gsungs so/slob dpon rlung ston gyis ni/ bla ma yang mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par mdzad/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ bal po skye 100

med kyi thugs kyi bcud 'thigs/ slob ma gzhan las khyad par du 'phags te do ha rgyas bshad la mnga' brnyes/ khong la grub thob mgon po dang sangs rgyas sgom pa gnyis kyis zhus/ khong sku mched la bal po 'jig rten gyis zhus/ de la dol ba jo sras kyis zhus so/yang bla ma mnga' ris pa bya ba gzhon nu la rab tu byung / thos pa mang du mdzad/ khyad par 'dul ba mdo rtsa tshar bcu bzhi tsam bshad pa mdzad pa cig gis/ bla ma phyag na la rje btsun ma dbu bcad ma'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can cig yod ces gsungs nas zhur byon pas/ bla ma phyag na'i zhal nas/ mchog dang thun mong gnyis gang 'dod gsung ba/mchog gi dngos grub 'dod ces zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'o na khyod sku nas kyang byon gda' bas ngas snga ma mi gzhan dag la ma byin pa'i gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po rdo'u skor zhes bya ba/ thabs shes rab zung du sbrel nas lam du 'khyer ba/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes man chad rde'u brgya bdun cu don gsum gyis lam du bsgrigs/gzhung gsum po 'grel par bkod pa ya gi bram ze chen po nas dus de ring yan chad la tshig la mang nyung med pa/ don la 'dra min med pa/ bar na dam tshig gi sel med pa/ rnam par thar pa gzhan dang ma 'dris pa zhig yod gsung nas gnang ngo / der bla mas kyang rtogs pa khong du chud cing thugs thag chod par ba gyis so/ de nas yul dbus su byon nas dbu ru 1008

'brom par byon pa na/ bla ma bal po snyan grags che bar 'dug nas phyag rgya chen po sgom mi dgos pa zhig yod dam snyam nas mnyan pas/ thabs bzhag nas gzhung dang lta ba bstun nas 'chad kyi 'dug pas/ bdag la ni bla ma phyag nas sngar lta bu'i rdo'u skor cig gnang nas yod pa la/ bla ma chen po 'di ltar 'chad pa ci lags zhus pas bal po'i zhal nas/ bod 'di lta bu bun ne ba cig dang / spros pa la dga' bar 'dug nas bdag gis rde'u skor ma bstan pa yin/ khyod la bstan gyis gsung nas tshogs 'khor bshams te zhus pas gnang ste sngar dang khyad ma byung / phyis rlung rdo rje bla mas gdams pa de btsal bas sngar gyi cha 'dra ba de la brten nas bsgrigs pa rde'u brgya lnga bcu tsam pa zhig gnang / bla ma mnga' ris pas bal po'i mchod gnas kyang lo brgyad tsam mdzad do/ /de'i slob ma gru shul ba yin te/ mnga' ris pas gru shul du byon/gnas brtan gyis gnas ma btang bas gyang ra cig na bzhugs 'dug pa gru shul bas nang du spyan drangs pas 'byon du ma gnang / kha ba bab ste spyan drangs pas byon/ brgyud pa'i thang ka gzigs pas 'di la mos sam gsung mos zhus pas/ 'di'i gdams ngag shes sam gsung bas/ mi shes zhus pas/ 'o na nga la yod gsung nas zhag bco brgyad la gdams pa tshang bar gnang / gser la thub zho lnga phul bas nga la mi dgos gsung nas ma bzhes/sang phong chu bo rir dus 'di tsam na shog gsung ba'i dus btab nas 1009

gshegs/ de nas dus la bab pa na gru shul bas chu bo rer byon pa bla ma byon nas zhag lnga song 'dug der zla ba gcig bzhugs nas 'dir bzhud dang 'dir 'das med par gsang spyod mdzad do/ /de la mkhas pa bar phu pa blo gros seng ges phyag rgya chen po do ha skor gsan nas gsum ka la bsdus don/ ṭ+wāṃ ka 'brel 'jug la sogs pa'i yig sna brgyad mdzad de/ yig cha de rnams kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab bo de'i slob ma sgyer sgom chen po/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ bla ma brag 'bur ba/ shug gseb ri ba/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ mi nyag shes rab bzang po/ chos rje ri mi 'babs pa bsod nams rin chen/ des bdag la do ha bar lugs rnams gnang ste/ a su'i skor rnams la phyag rgya chen po smad lugs shes grags so/ /yang phyi 'gyur ni/ phyag na bgres khar mnga' ris pa nag por sher dad kyis/ rgya gar shar phyogs su khong gi zhabs drung du bzhugs nas do ha che chung gnyis/ sku'i mdzod 'chi med rdo rje/ gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje/ thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i mdzod/ sgom rim drug pa/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ de'i 'grel pa ste phyag rgya chen po'i chos bcu gas/na/'di 'gos lo tsū ba'i slob ma yin/ phyis gzhur gru sna'i rgyab tu dgon pa 1010

mdzad nas lhang tsho'i dpon du gyur/ dge 'dun gyi dug sbyor byung nas grongs/ bla ma sos khong dang / skor chung ba gnyis ka la gdams pa gsan/ khyad par nag po'i drung du lo drug bzhugs/ sos bgres khar myang ston rtsags se la gnang / des bla ma rog bde la gnang ngo / /grub snying phra mo dang bcas pa'i bshad pa'i bka' rnams ni ding sang mi snang la/ lung ni/ sha ba ra/ rme byi ba/ rgya gar phyag na/ brang ti/ gtsang yang dag 'bar/ phug zungs skyabs/ rtsangs 'byung se/lce ston mdo seng / bla cha/ ston shāl/ lce blo ldan seng ge/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bar du yod de/ bdag gis ni de las grub pa sde bdun dang / de kho na nyid bcu pa rtsa 'grel tsam thob bo/ /rgya gar phyag na 'khrungs nas me pho spre'u yan chad 'a/ lo bzhe brgya dang drug cu song ngo / rgyal ba rme ti pa las brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i ska bas/ so / /1011
na)zhi byed brgyud pa snga phyi bar bas so/

dum bu bcu gnyis/ pa/ zhi byed brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum gyi skabs/brgyud pa dang po'i skabs/da ni dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed ji ltar brgyud ba'i tshul brjod par bya ste/ don gang gis sdag bsngal zhi byed ces brjod ce na/bod du byon pa'i gdams pa dang 'khri lugs phal che ba ni slob ma mi dge ba las zlog tu bcug nas de'i sems rgyad kyi nyon mongs pa sbyong bar byed pa gtso che'o/ /chos 'dis ni tshe rabazlo snga ma'i las kyi dbang gis tshe 'khrir lus dman par gyur pa dang / nad bu can dang / dbul phongs dang /mi ma yin pas gtses pa dag gi sdug bsngal rnams 'phral du zhi bar byas nas rnal 'byor la sbyor bzod par byed pa ste/ /de bas na ldag bsngal zhi byed ces bya ste/ 'di yang rgyal ba'i lung las/ sdug bsnyel thams/ cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ zhes pa de la brten nas btag par bzhed do/ /chos 'di'i bdag po ni dam pa sangs rgyas te/ de ni grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po yin pa'i phyir/ yon tan bgrang ba las 'das med kyi/ 'on kyang gsung rab dag las bla mas slob ma 'khrid pa na bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis 'khrid par gsungs pa la don dpyod pa ni slob ma 1015

thabs ji lta bus lam la 'dzud pa'i thabs de la bya la/ don mthun pa ni slob ma lam gang bstan pa'i lam de nyid la bla ma yang gnas pa la bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ dam pas kyang slob ma 'khrid pa na rten sdom pa gsum ldan/lam dka' thub gyi srangs/ 'bras bu gzhan don gyi spyod pa gsum gyis 'khrid par mdzad pa'i phyir dam pa nyid la yon tan de dag ji ltar mnga' ba brjod par bya ba yin no/ /de yang dam pa'i yul ni rgya gar sto phyogs be da la'i yul 'khor du gyur pa tsa ra sing ga de'i bye brag khron pa'i gling skyes bo dad pa can mang du gnas pa'i sar/ yab nor bu rin po che len pa'i rigs can brtson 'grus go cha dang / yum dkon mchog mchod pa la mkhas pa spos sbyor la brtson pa'i rigs pa ra sa ha zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs te/ yum la 'khrungs ma thag nyid las tshems dang ldan pa zhig ste/ bram ze mtshan mkhan la rtog tu bcug pa na yang 'dis pa ta dang rnal 'byor pa gang byas kyang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa phul du byung ba'i yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ skye ba bdun pa yin pas sdig pa'i dri ma med cing dge ba la ngang gis dga' ba sto/ chung ngu nas sgra rig pa la sogs pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la spyongs pas mkhas par gyur te/ de ni rigs khyad par can dang ldan pa'i yon tan no/ /de nas bai kra ma shrī lar mkhan po dge ba'i lha las rab tu byung nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la mkhas shing so so thar ba'i sdom pa mchog tu gyur la/ bla ma gser gling ba las byang chub 1016

lha cho ga tu sems bskyed nas spyod pa rlabs po che la gnas zhing / bla ma mang po las dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba mnos te/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam chag dang sdom pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dag ni/ rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i yon tan no/ /de nas grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la gdams pa zab mo mtha' dag mnos te/ de yang mtshan nyid sgra rig pa'i bla ma bcu gcig ni/ klu sgrub/ shes rab bzang po/ yon tan 'od/ chos grags/ ā la/ ra sid+dhi/ shaṅka ra/ ye shes nyang po/ thogs med/ ār+sha de ba/ zhi ba lha/ bla ma gser gling pa rnams so/ /pha rgyud g.yo ba rlung gi bla ma bcu gcig ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug bu gubha/ go dha ri/ kurma badz+ra/ dza ba ri pa/ ye shes zhabs/ klu byang / ā nan/ 4gle pa/ ba su t+ta ri/ pad+ma badz+ra rnams so/ /ma rgyud bde ba nyams kyi bla ma bcu gcig ni/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra stu ti/ ṭo pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ ti khri pa/ nag po'i zhabs/ sgeg pa rdo rje/'a dza yi pa/ bai rū pa/ kun dga' snying po/ ku ku ri ba rnams so/ ༄/phyag rgya chen po brda'i bla ma bcu gcig ni/ sa ra ha/ tsār+yā ba/ ga ṇa ri/ tog tse pa/ ko ṣa pa/sha bar ba/ ze tri ba/ sā gar sirnyi/ nyi ma sbas pa/ ā gar sirnyi/ rat+na badz+ra rnams so/ /rig pa ngo sprod kyi bla ma bcu ni/ ri khrod ma/ dri med ma/ paspro zhabs/ ku mu da/ bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ gaṅgā bzang mo/ mi to ma/ la / shing lo ma/ su kha 1017

sirnyi rnams so/ de rnams las phyi mtshan nyid dang nang pha dang ma'i rgyud kyi gdams pa mtha' dag blangs nas sgrab pa mdzad de/ seng ge rdzong du bla ma'i bsnyen par bskyal bas rtogs rā phyogs med du shar/ shar phyogs seng ge rdzong la lo drug rdo rje gdan du lo bco lnga/ rang byung gi mchod rten du slo bzhi/ ri ku ru ku'ir lo lnga/ chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du lo lnga/rgya gar shar phyogs kyi nags su lo lnga/ rgya gar sto phyogs kyi dur khrod du lo lnga/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du lo bdun/ yang rdo rje gdan du lo gsum/ mngon par dga' ba'i yul du lo bcu ste/ de rnams su sgrub pa mdzad pas yi dam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ rdo rje 'dzin/ sgrol ma/ kha saze ṇi/ gshin rje gshed/ rang byung rgyal mo/ sgrib sel/ 'od zer can/ kun bzangs/ r+pā rā tī/ mi g.yo ba ste yi dam gyi lha bcu gnyis dang / gzhan yang rnam par snang mdzad dang / rta mgrin dang / bde mchog dang / dgyes rdor la sogs pa'i lha bgrang gis mi lang ba gzigs so/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar mkha' spyod kyi bla ma sum cu rtsa drug la sogs pa rig pa 'dzin pa yang dpag tu med pa zhal gzigs/ dngos grub kyang mig sman/ rkang mgyogs/ril bu/ sa 'og gnod sbyin mo/ ral gri/ mkha' spyod rnams grub cing / mchog gi dngos grub ni mthong lam chen po'i ye shes brnyes so/ 'bras bu gzhan gyi don ni yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i gnas thams cad du spyod pa mdzad cing / grub pa thob pa'i snyan pas mtshan yang 1018

sna tshogs su sgrogs so/ /de la bod du gzhan don ji ltar mdzad pa ni/spyir bod du lan lngar byon pa la dang po ni 'brin thang las smo nas tsa rir byon nas re ma ti la rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub zhus te/ skong yul ngang sum yul gyi bar bcad de smad khams gsum zhabs kyis ther med du bcags/ de dus nyid na chos sbyin pa'i sdod med kyang gyis de rnams su bstan pa dar bar 'gyur bar lung bstan/ gnyis pa ni kha che nas 'thon te mnga' ris su byon nas zhang zhung gling kha ba dang bon po khru tshang 'brug bla la gdams pa 'ga' re gnang / gsum pa ni/ bal bo nas tshong pa dang 'grogs te byon pa na yar klungs kyi rmang ra ser po dang mjal te de dang 'grogs nas gtsang du skyo bsod nams bla ma dang rmang ra ser po la gcod kyi gdams pa mang du gnang ngo / /bzhi pa ni sha 'ug stag sgo la byin nas gnyal du bzhugs te/ yum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas phyis dbus kyi phyogs su phebs nas rma so la sogs pa'i don mdzad pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/de nas rgya nag tu byon nas der lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas slad kyis ding rir phebs pa'o/ /de la spyir dam pas bod du gdul bya sna tshogs pa smin par mdzad pas sgo thar la song ba'i grangs ni/ kun dgas dam pa la bod na gdams pa btab pa'i slob ma ji tsam bdog zhus pas/ deng ri'i thad ga'i skar ma ya gi'i grangs khyod kyis chod dam gsung ste/ deng ri ni gnam rgya che bas de'i skar ma'i grangs gzung bar dka' ste/ de rnams sgo thar las kun la grags pa'i brgyud pa zin pa ma byung ste/ skye bo rnams kyis shes 1019

par yang dka' 'o/ /de ltar slob ma dang ga tu med pas gdams pa yang dpag tu med kyang grags che ba ni brgyud pa snga phyi gsum ste/ de la brgyud pa dang po ni/ dam pas kha che dz+nyān gu h+ya la gsungs pa'i zhi byed sgrol ma'i skor gsum dang / gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i sgrab thabs rnams te/ de rnams yong po lo tsā ba la dam pa dang glen gu h+ya ṅgenyis gas bshad/des lo btsun chung dang bla chung 'od zer la bshad/ /de la lo btsun chung ni/ rgya gar du sgrub pa la bzhud nas phyir ma log bla chung 'od zer gyis 'chus pa dar brtson la bshad/ des 'chus pa brtson seng la bshad/ des rog shes rab 'od la bshad do/ /yang kha che dz+nyā na gu h+ya gyis spu hrangs lo chung la bshad/ des dmar ston chos rgyal/ des dge bshes yol me/ des gshen ston nam mkha'/ des kyi tshang zhig po/ des rog shes rab 'od la bshad do/ /spong po lo tsā ba'i lugs la sgrab thabs rnams med do/ /brgyud pa dang po'i skabs so/ / curma lugs kyi skabs/brgyud pa bar pa ni/ gtso bo rma so skam gsum phran dang bcas pa rnams te/ de la dam pas gnyal gyi snang gror dge 'dun gyi g.yog lo gsum mdzad nas chos sgo la byon te/ yar stod du phebs pa na/ gnyags lo tsā ba dang mjal nas bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa gnang / khu 'o 1020

tsā ba la dam tshig nyams 'dug gsungs nas mjal du ma gnang / de nas rma dang mjal te/ dam pa rma de ni/ yar stod skyer snang rma smon lam zhes bya ba'i sras su shing mo lug la 'khrungs/ shing lug 'di jo bo rje gshegs pa'i phyi lo dang / bu to bas bcu gsum lon pa'i lo de yin/gzhon na la rab tu byung nas mtshan chos kyi shes rab tu btags/ yab la pad+ma dbang chen gsan/ de nas spyod phyogs dang dbu ma dang do ha stod lugs dang grub snying rnams gsan/ bcu dgu pa chu mo glang la dam pa dang mjal te/ bla ma rma sku khams ma bde bar rang gi khang thog na bzhugs pa'i tshe ma tsa ra nag po ras rkyang phrag la bkal ba zhig byung ba la khong la khyi shin tu thu ba yod pa rnams kyang de la mi zugs par mjug ma sgril zhing skor ba byed cing 'dug pas ngo mtshar skyes te g.yog bltar btang bas a tsa ra cig 'dug zer/ ngo ma ra can du shes nas nang du 'byon par zhus pas spyil po'i sgo yang ma bstan par mkhyen te nang du byon/ byin brlabs zhus pas byin brlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis bsnyun yang dwangs/gdams pa cig gnang 'tshal zhus pas/ skye ba mang po nas las 'brel yod pas gdams pa bya'o gsung / khyod kyis chos ci shes gsung bas/pha rgyud dang phyag rgya chen po shes zhus pas/ khyod kyi de tshig gi phyag rgya chen po bya ba yin pas/ de don gyi phyag rgya chen po bstan gyi gsung nas/ 3/ga ni mi 'dzu /sa sems ni 'gags pa dang / rlung 'gags pa ni dpal 1021

ldan bla mas rtogs/ shes bya ba la sogs pa'i gzhung la brten nas rtsa ba'i ngo sprod mdzad pas rma la nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes/ de nas zhag bco brgyad song ba dang dam pa de gshegs gsung bas bzhugs par zhus pas ma gnang / phyags phyir 'brengs pas kyang 'brang du ma gnang / cig kyang thugs rjes 'dzin par zhus pas da res log la sang res dgun 'phan yul du shog gsung / de nas mas bsgoms pas nges shes skyes te dgun 'phan yul du so chung ba g.yog tu khrid nas byon/ byen yul du dam pa la gdams pa'i 'phro bcad pas/ bkod pa drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i rdo'u khrid gnang nas/ dam pa'i sar zla ba gsum bzhugs/ de'i skabs su a su rlung shod na yong ba dang mjal/ de nas yul du byon nas 'khor 'dab dang nor rdzas spangs te/ sgrub pa por mdzad nas rma'i phug par lo gcig bzhugs/ de nas kong po brag gsum gyi mtsho rdzong la byon nas lo dgu bzhugs/ der yul de na 'khrugs pa chen po langs ba la gzhi bdag gis khyed kyis gnya' mdzod zer/ ngas ma thub byas pas ngas grogs bya yis zer nas bden nam snyam nas 'khrug pa'i sar byon nas 'khrug pa do ba la rmas/ bar na phar la chos gos brdul zhing nga'i gnya' yod do/ /su mi nyan pa la mi rung ba sna dgu 'ong ngo zer gyi phyin pas/ gar 'byon gyi rjes rlung nag tshub ma chen po zhig byung bas/ der dmag rnams kyis gtad med du 'khrug pa chad/ da ni sems can gyi don 'ong nga / 1022

nga ngas nas dgas po rdzong khar 'khor mang du bsten/ de nas yar klungs sa byon nas kyi tshang du lo gsum bzhugs/ de nas bu slob mang du 'tshogs nas chos zhu gar byung du bzhugs so/ /de la bu chen lnga byon te/ gang bar gshen shud bu lo ts+tsha ba/ bla ma she'u/ sog po mdo sde/ zhang dga' ldan pa'o/ /de la sog po mdo sde ni/ sho skyam pa yin/mched gsum yod pa'i che ba lha rje sogs sman/ 'bring bla ma sog po mdo sde ste/ sman dang chos gnyis ka mkhyen/ dam pa ma'i yab kyi slob ma yin pas phyag skyel du phyin pas/ rma sgom skyer sna'i phug par bzhugs pa dang mjal/ mi'i zhal nas/ kho bo rgya gar gyi grub thob cig dang mjal bas legs par song / de min na ston chen gyi mal nas tha mal gyi ro 'ong bar 'dug gsung pas/ de dang ji ltar mjal gyi lo rgyus zhus pas nges shes skyes nas gdams pa zhus pas slob ma rnying pa yin pas ster tshabs che gsung nas khrid la bcug nas gdams pa tshang bar gnang / sog po yang nges shes skyes nas bya ba btang ste sgrub pa por byas so/ /gyis rma dwags po nas byon/ yar mdar phyag skyel du byon/ bla ma chos rje skad bya ba gsung dris pas/ sems bskyed lam khyer stong thun kha 'thor mthar rgyas bya ba yod 4zer bas/ nga ma ma gnang ba'i chos yod par 'dug snyam nas zhus pas/ dam pa rgya gar gyi chos la tshig gcig la'ang dbri bsnan med pa khyed rang la yod/ da lta nga 'chad pa 'di gang zag gi yul dang bsnun 1023

nas cho lu cho lur bshad pa la ming tha dad du thogs pa yin gsung / sog po mdo sde btsan thang na bzhug pa'i sar rten lo bcu dgu pa cig gis mjal nas gdams pa rnams tshang bar gsan/ de la rog shes rab 'od kyis gsan no/yang rma'i slob ma zhang dga' ldan pa ni/ yar stod gtsang zhal du 'khrungs pa'i mchim zhang yin/ dam pa skor ni ru ba la phyag rgya chen po zhus/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus nas rgya sa sman stag rtse sar rma'i phyir byon/ byar gyi sngon chung gnas kyi shug pa gseb tu khrid mdzad pas thugs thag der chod/ de la slob ma gnyal ston dga' chung 'bar/ skyog sgom bsam gtan khu sgom jo dga'/ rgya dar seng / 'chus pa dar brtson rnams so/ /rgya dar seng ni/ gra snyi phur rgya long chos 'bar gyi bur skyes/ lo sum cu la zhabs la mda' phog pas chu tshan khar byon pas ras pa kha kyog rdo rje seng ge dang mjal nas phyag rgya chen po zhus/ zhang sman mo na bzhugs pa la gdams pa zhus pas rtogs ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor par gyur to/ /de'i bu chen stod du jo sras thun gnyis bya ba dol pa dbang rgyal dang / shes rab me chung ba/ smad du gnyags tsha spun gnyis bya ba zhang ston jo spu dang bla ma slob chung ba gnyis/ bar rgya'i skyon chung gis brgyud pa gzung ste/chu bo rir khru sna rgya smad du 'khrungs/ mtshan rgya cha 'bar/ lo nyi shu 1024

rtsa bzhi 'a/ gri bu gdong pa chu bo rir sgrub pa la byon pa dang mjal nas zhabs la gtugs/ rgya smyon gyis bka' brgyud gsungs/ ma mo mkha' 'gro gsum smyon gyis ngo sprad pas rtogs pa dang nyams tha mi dad pa rgyud la skyes/ mtshan smyon pa don ldan da thogs/ des ri khrod pa la gsungs sna(( rige yang khu sgom jo dgas klu mda' tshe lung du bzhugs nas gdul bya mang du bskyangs/ des stod lungs thong pa steng gi rgyal ba dkon mchog skyabs la gsungs/ des rog shes rab 'od la gsungs/ shes rab 'od kyis phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa der shar/yang zhang btsun rgyal ba bkra shis kyis 'chus pa dar brtson la bshad/des 'chus pa brtson seng la bshad/ des rog shes rab 'od la gsungs so/ /de la me'i chos skor ni chig brgyud dang don brgyud gnyis las/ don khrid ni lag khrid bcu drug chig brgyud ni sems bskyed dang stong thun dang kha 'thor dang khar phog snar phog dang mthar rgyas rnams so/ /rma ༷/ba/sa kyi skabs the / /bas byugibanatha 1) sna thabab /so lugs ni/ yul ra mo ba/ der lo nyes byung nas gza' mi rnams sprang du 'ongs/ bu spun gnyis yod pa la pho bo gzugs chung bas 1025

lke chu nga ba zer/ nu bo gzugs ring bas so rings zer/ sa chung ba de chu pho stag la 'khrungs nas li bcu tsam lon pa'i dus su yar stod skyer snar sprangs pas rma sgom gyis byis pa rgan pa de nga'i rjes la thog ngas sto dang gos ster gsungs pas bzhag ste/ gza' mi rnams yar klungs la song /der rma sgom gyis so la btsun pa bcos/ ming yang dge 'dun 'bar du btags/ der lo bcu gnyis 'on tsa na me'i thad du dam pa byon pa la zhal yug cig mthong / dam pa bzhud nas lo shas song ba na rma sgom khams cung zad ma bde bas/ dam pa'i rjes la snyeg snying 'dod par byung nas so chung ba khrid de byon pas/ khong gnyis po rag ma mda' na yod pa'i tshe/ /dam pa 'phan yul bye khud na bzhugs pa'i tshe so chung bas 'khyam du phyin pa / der dam pa yang byon byung ste/ zhing shas gsum tsam gyis nas dam pa a li dga' nga'i tso lu byung gsung nas bang btang byung ste/ so chung ba'i lag pa la 'jus nas khyod skye ba gsum du nga'i slob ma yin/ da nga'i rjes la 'deng gsung nas bye khud du khrid/ der ngo sprod cung zad btab pa tsam gyis nam nangs pa bzhin du song nas/ so chu ba la dri ma med pa'i shes pa'i stobs chen po shar/ der slar log 'ongs te rma dang dpon slob gnyis pos yos shig btags pa'i tshe so chung ba rang yul 'ju ba bzhag nas had de yun ring du bsdad 'dug der rma so khyod la tsa cig cig byung 'dug dam pas gdams pa gnang ba yin nam zer/ der mas yin 1026

nges snyam nas dpon slob gnyis dam pa'i sar byon/ rma la yang gdams pa 'ga' gnang / rma na re/ da 'o skol dpon slob yul du 'gro zer ba la/ so chung bas nga dam pa la gdams pa cig zhu ba yin byas pas/gdams pa ngas byin pas chog 'deng gsung / slob dpon rang sngon la bzhud/ nga zla ba gcig tsam na rjes la 'ong byas nas ma phyin/ der dam pas don brgyud kyi gdams rdzogs par gnang / dam pa gar thegs kyi phyags phyi byas pas grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i gdams pa yang gnang /de la yi ge byed par zhus pas kyang bkas gnang nas star kha rdo rje grags kyi 'bum gyi shog ras la gdams pa rnams bris/ de nas dam pa gar bzhud kyi phyags phyi byas kha rag mdun du sleb tsa na/ dam pa'i zhal nas khyod rang phyir log gsung / gar 'byon du phyags phyi byed zhus pas/ nga'i rjes khyod kyis mi stogs gsung / de nas dam pa yud kyis gshegs te/ rgya nag la bzhud pa'i res de yin/ — so chung bas phyir log nas lha sar rig pa'i tshad lta ba'i phyir dril gdang la dmigs pa gtad pas dril gdang rang 'khrol ba yang byung / de la sogs pa'i tshad lta mang du byas/ de nas yar klungs su byon/ rma la gdams pa rnams 'bul lam snyam nas rma dbu ri na bzhugs ba'i sar byon nas/ da nga'i shes pa 'di gang la yang 'thogs pa mi gda' byas pas/ khyod rang gi pha ma sprang gi 'dug pa gsos pas chog med gsung / de la so chung bas nad pa la 'dre gang gnod pa dang 1027

nad ci yin pa thams cad sal le mkhyen pa byung nas 'dre 'dul mang du byas/ yon yang che bar blangs/ yo byad mang du rnyed pas yo byad rnams kyis yar mdar gzhis shig nyos nas pha ma dang spun zla der bzhag de nas yang byar gyi sngon chung du so rings gza' mir bcug gzhan rnams yar mdar bzhag nas grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i dpe rnams a ma shung mo shāka sgron la bcol bas dpe la them shog byas pas brgyud pa brgyad ma tshang gzhan rnams la so chung pa rang gis byas pa de yin nam lhug pa rgyas pa cig bzhugs/ phyis 'chus pa dar brtson gyis dam pa skyes mchog che 'bring chung gsum du btags nas tshigs su bcad par sdebs/ so chung bas dam pa ding ri na bzhugs par thos te nad pa gsos pa'i yon gyi gser srang gsum dang rta pho bzang ba cig khyer nas ding rir sleb pa na dam pa khrom gyi dkyil na bzhugs 'dug pas gser srang gsum po de dam pa'i bang du skyur/ dga' grags nas dam pa'i pang du mchongs te dbu nas ral pa cig kyang phyi/ der yos rgyob rgyob zer ba la/ dam pa'i gsung nas/kho la ma brdog cig kho la bdag po bzang po yod do gsung / gser de bud med cig gis tsen gyis blangs song ba su kha mi sa mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs 'khor gyi rgyu la 'khyer ba yin zer/ der langs te mgur cig kyang blangs pas kun gyis grub thob tu shes/ de res dam pas mtha' sel lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi gdams pa gnang / de nas yang phyir dbus su byon no/ /1028

skabs shig tu ding rir dam pa'i gdan sa sus 'dzin lags zhus pas/dam pa'i zhal nas/ de dang so chung bas gzung na dkar gong mang du 'akro gyo mo shar 'gro mkhan pa 'di kun yang nas su smin pa cig 'ong ste/ kho yang khyi'i spre thum bu la chags nas 'dir mi sdod gsung / sgom chen smon lam 'bar dang so chung ba mjal lugs ni/ sha mi de rus pa sha mi yin/ phu thang mgon po nang gi phu der shing mo glang gi lo la 'khrungs/skor ni rū pa rgya sman du byon pa la gdams pa zhus pas sems kyi gnas pa a to cig skyes/ der so chung ba yang byon pa dang mjal bas/ so chung ba na re/ khyod kyi sgom 'di kha ba'i 'og gi 'bar 'bur dang 'dra/ bong ba dang rdo gang yin mi shes/ nga la dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gdams pa thag chod pa cig yod pas khyod rang nga'i phyir 'deng ngam zer/ der phyin pas chog byas te/ so chung ba gnyal la sogs pa kun tu 'khyam pa'i g.yog byas/ khong la byung ba'i dngos po rnams khur tshar khur/ g.yog yun ring po song ba la gdams pa ma byung / lan cig dpon slob gnyis 'phan yul na yod pa'i tshe bur ltang stod pa cig rdos bkang nas sha mi la bskur/bu ram 'di nas stod lungs su sleb dus 'o skol dpon slob za ba yin no gsung / der khur nas phyin pas thang chad pa la/ so chung ba'i gsung nas/ khyod thang mi chad dam zer/ thang chad byas pas/ 'o na ngas ngal gso gsung nas so chung ba rang stengs ka cig tu dkyil dkrung bcas 1029

nadug des kyang cung zad phan par byung / la khar sleb tsa na so chung ba na re/ 'di la ci yang mi btub gsung nas rdo rnams 'thur la bsgril song / der dpon slob gnyis pos stod lungs su mi gcig gi khang par bsdad tsa na/ srod la 'di la gdams ngag med nges par 'dug bla ma gzhan zhig gi thad du 'gro bsam pa byung / nam gung la 'dis res 'ga' nga'i sems shes 'ong gi 'dug pas gdams pa yod dam snyam pa byung / tho rangs da dung 'di kha la gtud nas gdams pa e ster lta dgos snyam pa byung / nam nangs pa dang so chung ba'i gsung nas smon lam 'bar/ khyod kyi srod kyi bsam pa de la ci yang mi btub/ nam gung gi de dga' tshad yin/ tho rangs kyi de la btub gsung bas bsdad/ na ma cig so chung ba rang gis skog tu zos nas/ sha mi la da nang 'o skal dpon slob la tsha ba ster mi cig yod pas der 'gro gsung nas phyin/ sgo ra'i rtsar sleb tsa na 'di yang min pa 'dug 'di yang min pa 'dug zer nas nyi ma de la ci yang ma myong bar nas ldog dgos pa byung bas kyang tshig pa za/ yang na mi cig so chung ba'i g.yog cig la gzhan du phyin nas log 'ongs pa'i tshe/ so chung ba'i rtsa na mi gzhan zhig kyang 'dug pa la/ skad chung re byas nas smon lam 'bar sleb byung / khos skur thong bas ka ca rnams spos shig zer bas/ sha mi'i rtog pa la ngas yun de tsam zhig tu khong gi g.yog sha tsha ba sha stag byas pa la nga 'di 'dra zer ba snyam nas zhe sdang drag po dpe 1030

med pa cig skyes/ gri tsar gyis bton nas so chung ba'i steng du mchongs pas/ so chung ba mdzod cig gi nang du bros nas sgo bsdams song bas sgo tsa der phyin tsa na/ so chung bas nang nas/ smon lam 'bar khyod rang gi sems zhe sdang du rdzogs yod do/ de la stos shig zer bas/ bltas pas sems kyi ngo bo rnal mar rjen gyis mthong ba'i rtogs pa yang dag pa cig shar/ der dga' grags nas lag pas mdun gyi thu ba gnyis bteg cing gzung nas bro 'khrubs te/ thugs rje can khyod la ya'i/ thabs mkhas po khyod la ya'i/ mkhyen pa can khyod la ya'i/ byas pas so chung ba sgo phye ste byon nas/ so chung ba na re/ ngas khyod la ji tsam zhig sngar zhe sdong skye ba'i thabs byas pa la cher skyes ma byung gsung / de nas gdams pa thams cad rdzogs par gnang / so chung ba drug cu rtsa bdun pa sa spre la gshegs gshegs kyi bar du rjes su 'brangs te/ lar ni g.yog bar med tu lo sum cu rtsa bzhi byas/ de nas bzang grong tshugs khar khang chung cig brtsigs nas steng du mal bcas/ 'og tu da 'jug ba lang gi lci ba 'thu zhing byis pa rnams dang rdo 'thab kho na byed pa la nang du yon tan rgyas pas snyan grags chen por song ste/ brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa lcags yos la gshegs/ 'di la slob ma 'chus pa dar brtson/ mal ka ba can pa/ mthing gang pa sher tshul te gsum byung ba'i rnam thar mthong la/gzhan lug ro zhig po la sogs kyi rnam thar ni ma mthong ngo / de yang sha 1031

mi stod lungs mda' na bzhugs pa'i tshe 'chus pa dar brtson tsas gdams pa zhur phyin nas/ gdams pa zhu ba yin byas te phrin du bskur bas mjal kha yang ma gnang / der 'chus pas zhag 'ga' yang khong gi khang rtsar sun bskyed nas bsdad/ der yon bdag cig gis dge bshes 'ga' yar la chos ston byed pa'i sar sha mi spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba byung bas/ sha mi na re/ nga mi 'gro der slob dpon ting 'dzin 'od tshig pa za zer bas/jo mo na re/ gdan 'dren pa la cis kyang 'byon pa 'thad/ nged rang gi phyi na yod pa'i btsun pa 'di phyags phyir khrid na 'dis kha ya yong ba srid zhus pas/ 'o na dris shig gsung bas/ 'chus pa la de ring bla ma'i phyags phyir phyin na slob dpon ting 'dzin zer ba cig yod/ de'i kha ya yod dam byas pas yod cig byas/ de nas dpon slob gnyis kyis byon pas yon bdag gi nang du sleb/ re shig na slob dpon ting 'dzin dpon slob lnga tsam byas byung / ting 'dzin na re/ smon lam 'bar gyis kyang sleb 'dug khyod kha 'dra'i gral dbu rang zer/ der 'chus pas bla ma rnam rtog dum bur gtub pas chos gtam mi mdzad/ nged rang chos gtam nyams dga' mo bya'am byas pas/ byas pas chog nga phar la su la'ang mi 'ji ba yin/ khyod rang nga la dris shig zer bas/ 'chus pa de dang por rigs tshogs 'bamakhas par sbyangs pa zhig yin pas/ 'o na dbu ma nas chos can mthun snang ba med par bshad pa de'i don ci yin dris pas/1032

ting 'dzin jugs nas bshad rgyu ci'ang ma byung bas sgom smon kog gis bzhengs nas 'o de khyer de 'gom byas nas bro 'khrubs pas/ yon bdag thog tu byung nas 'chus pa'i gong rtsa nas bzung nas/ sdug btsun 'dis nga'i bla ma gnyis 'khrug tu bcug phyir bud zer ba la/ sgom smon gyis kho'i slob ma lnga byung ba 'jog nga'i gcig po 'di mi 'jog na nga rang yang 'gro byas pas/ da 'o na bzhugs par zhu zer nas zhu ba byas/ der chos ston thon nas log 'ongs ba na/ sgom smon na re/ 'chus pa la khyod kyi de gser phye bre gang phul ba bas kyang dga'/ gdams ngag bya'o gsung nas nang du khrid/ zhag mang por sngas sbrel nas chos kyi gleng mo mang po byas/ gdams ngag kyang rdzogs par gnang ngo / des rang gi sras 'chus pa brtson 'grus seng ge la gsungs/ des mkhas pa chen po rog shes rab 'od la gsungs/ /yang so chung bas gcung po so sku rings la gsungs/ des byar gyi bla ma spang la/ des 'chus pa yab sras/ /yang sos sha mi/ des dge bshes lde'u/ des rgyal ba dkon skyabs/des rog la'o/yang sha mis mthing gang ba la gsungs/ des spang bzangs pa ba ri sgom chen la gsungs/ des 'phrang kha jo btsun la gsungs te/ 'di gsum gyi lo grangs kyi nges pa ma rnyed kyang sha mi gya bdun pa lcags yos la 1033

gshegs nas/ de rting chu 'brug nas chu pho rta'i bar lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum tsam zhig bla ma gsum po de'i ring la song ba 'dra/ de la nyan po chos rje 'byung gnas ye shes sa pho rta la 'khrungs nas shing pho byi ba'i bar re bdun bzhugs/ sangs rgyas sgom pa byang chub rdo rje me pho byi ba la 'khrungs nas lcags mo sbrul gyi bar re drug bzhugs/ rgya brag chos rje ye shes gzhon nu me mo sbrul la 'khrungs nas bdun cu rtsa gcig pa me mo yos la gshegs/skyes mchog bsam gtan dpal ba lcags yos la yar 'brog brang mdar 'khrungs/ me pho rta'i bar du bdun cu rtsa drug bzhugs te/ dang por rab tu byung nas jo stan tshogs chen mo ba'i khrod na yod pa la/ lan cig mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa'i phyags phyir phyin pas mkhan chen pa rta brdab kyis gshegs pas/ der skyo ba drag po skyes te/ spre zhing mkhan po gzhon rin dang gnyis bsngongs/ nas rgya brag chos rje ye shes gzhon nu ba 'phan yul lan pa'i phu na bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin/ lung pa de'i mdar sleb pa tsam nas tshul khrim / kyi dri phun sum tshogs pa tshor/ grogs po gzhon rin la tshor ram byas pas/ ma tshor se ba'i dri yin la che zer/zhal mthong ba tsam gyis mos gus cher skyes/ de nas don brgyud kyi khrid la btsud/ bsam gtan dpal la ring por ma lon par rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa skyes/ bla ma la yang sangs rgyas su mthong / de nas dka' ba mang po spyad ma dgos par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur te/ gang dang 1034

gang du byon pa de dang de thams cad du gdul bya'i 'ur langs/ zas nor gyi dpung 'du/ tsa rir byon pas kyang dag pa'i snang ba mtha' yas pa gzigs/ dben gnas/ gang dang gang du bzhugs pa thams cad du zab mo'i khrid bskyangs/ phyis yab chos sdings dang sgo mo chos sdings gnyis nyin gcig la btab/ rtogs ldan pho mo bgrang gis mi langs pa 'dus/mgur gsungs pa'i zhal ta tshig re tsam gyis nyams kyi 'ur langs pas khengs/ ri'i rtsa ba thams cad du rang shong gi spyil bos bkang / nor longs spyod la phyag tu mi 'ong bya ba med kyang khab dang skud pa tsam yang bdag tu mi 'dzin/ zho stong phrag phul ba dang khab dang skud pa phul ba thams cad la ja dang bcas pa'i blo bzang pa re gnang ba ma gtogs khyad par mi 'byed/ dpon slob thams cad bsod stoms kyis 'tsho ba ma gtogs dgon pa'i gzhi rkyen du zhing phyar ba tsam yang mi 'dzin/ dang por thos bsam cher ma mdzad kyang nang nas shes rab brdol bas mkhas pa mang po'i yang chos kyi srog gzung / ston pas thams cad du khyab pas gong nas gdan 'dren byung ba la yang cir yang ma brtsis par rang sar bzhugs/ chos rje kun mkhyen jo nang pas lha sar phebs dus 'dir 'byon par tsu dang /'o skol chos kyi gsung glengs byed pa yin gsungs pas/ sangs rgya ba'i rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas kyi drung du sgro 'dogs bcad zin pas su la yang dri dgos pa med gsung nas ma byon/ de'i rjes su gu 1035

ru dkon gzhon la sogs pa gangan sar bzhugs pa thams cad kyis kyang bla ma'i rnam thar gzung nas dgon pa gnyis po la dgon gzhis la sogs pa'i yongs su 'dzin pa med par bsod stoms kyi 'tsho ba la brten nas lo mtshams pa brgya las mi nyung ba la rgyags 'gyed par mdzad/ rang tshe blos btang nas sgrub pa la 'jug chos lugs gang la'ang tshig gcig kyang mi smod/ phrad pa'i skye bo rab tu byung ba lta zhog khyim pa la yang dag snang sgom pa ni 'di rnams kyi chos lugs yin no/ skyes mchog pa'i slob ma chos rje 'phel g.yag pa bsam gtan lhun grub ni shing mo phag la 'khrungs/ shing mo bya'i bar du bdun cu rtsa gcig bzhugs so/ so lugs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ tshig brgyud dang don brgyud gnyis las/ tshig brgyud la yang brgyud pa chen po dang rgyud phran gnyis las/ chen mo la dam pa skyos mchog che ba nga bzhi/ 'bring so gnyis/ chung ba bcu bdun te/ de la grub pa thob pa re re'i lo rgyus dang gdams pa'i ngo bo slob ma 'khrid lugs cha tshang re re yod pas brgyud pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'am / brgyud pa brgya dang gsum du 'gyur bas brgyud pa chen mo zhes bya'o/ rgyud phran ni/ don skor lnga ma/ rim pa bzhi ma/ bsam gtan gyi thun che chung / grags pa brgyad/ yab sras gsum ma/ skyon can skyon med la sogs chos sde sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ don rgyud la phyogs su lhung ba dang ma lhung ba las/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pho mo lnga bcu 1036

gyu sa ni/ yul g.yo'i bye can pa/ grong mal rte'u ra ba/ yab mal dar ma mgon/ yum hab brdal gza' mdo ba/ de gnyis la sras gsum yod pa'i 'bring po/ me pho rta'i lo la 'khrungs/ shin tu thu ba sprang zhi tshe byed pa cig yod/ yugs sa mo nor shin tu phyug pa cig dang lhan du bzhugs pas/ mo na re/ khyed chos byed na ngas rgyags ster/mi byed na 'bral zer bas chos sgor zhugs/ 'ol khar slob dpon dar ma grags la rma lugs zhus/ ma'akhaspos kwa ba smon lam btsal la nā ro pa'i chos dang bya rog ma'i sgrub thabs zhus nas ldom bu byed cing yod pa la/tshir sgang na dam pa so'i 'das mchod kyi mang bskol 'thung bdo ba la slebs/grwal mgo de na rnal 'byor pa dom ra can cig 'dug pa de ce re gzigs nas ja 'thung ngam gsung nas gsol 'phro phor gang gnang / phye 'dod dam gsung nas rkyal ba cig gi zhabs nas gzung nas khyod khyer gsung nas gshegs bzhud/ dam pa sgom smon de sgra che bas zhal lta snyam nas gang yin dris pas/ cig na re khyod 'chal ba cig 'dug da ci nas khyod rang la ja dang phye ster mi de yin mod zer/ 'tshol du phyin pas pha zad zhing 'gram cig na rnal 'byor pa cig dang dge slong cig la chos 'chad kyi 'dug pas phyag btsal/ dad pa skyes/ mig mchi mas gang / mig had por song / sems mi rtog par song ba la sgom smon gyi zhal nas/mi gzung na blud ma 'ong ba yin/ sems gzung bas blud ma ni mi 'ong ci 1038

byed thong gsung / der thugs dam 'khrungs/ de nub der bzhugs rtsa/sa yang sang rtsad bcad pas la ba 'phrang la bzhud zer nas phyin pas/ ma zad na btsun pa cig la chos gsung pa dang mjal/ bar do'i gdam pa zhus pas gnang / phyags phyir 'gro na zhus pas/ nga la chung ma 'dre mo 'dra ba cig yod gsung nas ma gnang / de nas g.yor por 'ongs nas bsong stoms byas pa'i nas gyis tshil bu nyos nas khyer te phyin pas/ rnal 'byor pa bya ba khyi btsongs pa bzhin du log nas 'ong ba min gsung nas bkyon/lo ro zhig pos spru ba seng ge'i don rgyud bya ba yod zhus zer bas/ zhus pas/ su zer la nga de 'dra ba'i gdams pa med gsung / lo ro zhig po zer zhus pas/ kho dam nyams yin/ kho dang phrad tshad dmyal bar 'gro gsung nas bkyon/ yang yang zhus pas don brgyud kyi gdams ngag thams cad tshang bar gnang / phyis lo ro zhig po 'dra ba zhig gyis shig gsung / lo bcu gnyis su nyams su len pa'i bka' rgya btab/ de nas bka' rgya grol ba yin gsung / sngar gyi ja dang phye gnang ba de dbang bskur gyi dod du 'dug gsung / rang lo sum cu rtsa lnga la sha mi dang mjal/lo bcu gnyis gyi bar du bsten/ sgrub pa lo bzhi bcu tham pa mdzad/yon bdag ge rgod bya ba'i sar zla ba gnyis byon/ de ma gtogs sgrub pa la zhugs nas grong gseb 'grim ma myong / rang lo brgyad cu rtsa drug pa lug gi lo la sku gshegs/ ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no/ /1039

'di 'gro b.ri mgon po phag mo grub pa'i lo bcu bdun pa sha mi'i bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa la 'khrungs pa yin/ me pho rta de'i phyi lo me mo lug la rten ni 'khrungs/ ka ba can pa drug cu rtsa gcig pa me pho rta la snye mdo ba smri ba'i seng ge 'khrungs pa yin no/ /ka ba can pa 'di la slob dpon kun bzangs shes bya bas gtugs te/ don rgyud zhus shing / ka ba can pa'i jo mo dang / jo sras la'ang don rgyud zhus zer ba 'dug ste/ slob dpon kun bzangs 'di'i lo rgyus ni rdo rje zam pa'i lo rgyus su shes par bya'o/ /ka ba can pas byin gyis brlabs pa dgyer sgom chen po yin te/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ yul yar klungs gshong ba na dgyer be gu ba dang ni gu ba gnyis las nang tshan be gu ba/ yang dgos khang gsar ba/ khru 'brug pa'i dpon brgyud yin/ yab dmag dpon dkon mchog skyabs/ yum rgyal tsha ma mdo sdi rgyan gnyis kyi sras su shing pho byi ba la 'khrungs/ mtshan chos kyi seng ger btags/ gcung po dmag dpon chos rdor te sku mched gnyis kyi che ba chos seng dgung lo bcu gcig la rab tu byung ste/ mtshan tshul khrims seng gi sa 'brug gi dpon gnyer kyang mdzad/ dge bshes hor la gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhus pa'i gsang mtshan rdo rje rgyal po zhes bya/der gsang 'dus kyi rtsa 'grel la sogs pa gsan/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i snyan pa shin tu che bar yod pas dgung lo bcu dgu la mtha' rtsar byon/dgon pa mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes/ dpal phag 1040

rngod byung ba dga' khyod la phan thogs par 'dug cig gsung / dbu sngag sbrel nas zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs te/ don rgyud thugs kyi man ngag la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsungs/ chos kyi gsung gleng mang du byas pas gzhan la skyar gyi bshad dgos/ khyod la lan re res chog par 'dug khyod dbang po ya rab cig tshar bar 'dug gsung / de nas kwa ba can gyi phug pa cig tu sgom gyi bsdad pas srod cig mkha' 'gro ma grib phog pa cig byung nas rin po ches ngo sprad pas grib sol/ des bdud rtsi ka pā la gang drangs pas zag med kyi bde ba rgyas/ de nas kwa ba can pa yab yum la grwa pa mi che che lnga bcu tsam/ nyi khri tshar gcig rta gsum gyis sna drangs pa'i nor sna brgya rtsa gsum tsam phul/ bka' rgya bkrol nas tshogs pa la don rgyud gsung bar zhus pas zla ba lnga pa cig gsungs/ chos kyi bdag po khyod rang yin pas su bshad bshad la shod gsung nas dgyer gyis bco lnga phan chad la gsungs/ de nas 'ol khar rnal 'byor chos g.yung dang mjal/ mal can du skye med mngon sum du rtogs pa zhus pas/ des kyang en mi 'ong ba cig yod pa yin gsung nas phyag rgya chen po gnang / rje btsun ma zhal gnyis ma'i byin brlabs/ chos drug la sogs pa'i khrid rnams rdzogs par gnang / chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba las grol/ rgyal khams pa byed par zhus nas gnas nges med rnams su byon/ mal grol gzi can dang snye'i mkhar nag la sogs gdug pa can rnams btul bar phur byon nas 1042

rda ha skor gsum 'grel 'jug gi bka' khrid bshad pa dang bcas pa tshang bar zhus/ de dus dgung lo sum cu lon no/ /de nas stod lungs kyi phreng kha brag tu yon bdag nye 'bum gyis yon bdag mdzad nas lo lnga bzhugs/ rten 'brel rgya mtsho yangs pa la sogs pa rten 'brel gyi gdams pa skor mang du mdzad/ mkha' 'gros gdan drangs nas sku lus kyi bkod pa mdzad de u rgyan du byon/ in+d+ra bo d+dhi la sogs pa grub thob lnga la gdams pa zhus/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs shing dbang bskur thob/ de nas dgung glu so brgyad pa lcags mo glang la snye phu shugs gseb btab ste/ lo nyi shu rtsa bzhir bzhugs nas gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs pas slob ma stod nas rgya dang / — dmar mdzod ma ba dang / 'dzod gsum/ smad nas rtogs ldan mi ga9kyim la sogs pa gdul bya dpag/tu med pa smin grol du mdzad de/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig pa shing pho byi ba'i dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma shar ba'i dus ngo mtshapa ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te gshegs so/ shing pho byi ba 'di kha che paṇa chen bod du byon pa yin no/ /de'i rjes su gdan sar dpal rgya mkhar bas mdzad do/ /dgyer gyis byin gyis brlabs pa sangs rgyas dbon yin te/de'i lo rgyus ni/ yab dgyer zhig gi gcung po dmag dpon chos rdor dang /yum rlan chung ma la sras lnga 'khrungs pa'i che ba rin chen snying po sku na gzhon nu cig yum gyis dpal rgya mkhar ba 'a/ bskur nas shug gseb tu chos la 1043

btang / de dgyer gyis mkhyen nas de ring rin chen snying po 'ong bar 'dugakhyed grwa pa rnams kyis bsu ba gyis/ nga bas kho bzang ba cig 'ong ba yin gsung / stag lung la kha na tshur byon pa la bsu ba byas/ grwa pa thams cad khong gi mdzad spyod la mnyes/ dgon par bzhugs nas dgyer dang mjal/ rab tu byung nas mtshan rin chen dbang phyug tu btags/ dgyer gyi spyan sngar rten 'brel la sogs pa snye phu ba'i chos gsum/ do ha gsum khrid dang bcas pa zhus shing / dgyer sku gshegs rjes dmar bu brag pas dpon po'i zhabs tog ngas byed gsung nas mdzod mar gdan drangs/'phral gyi zhabs tog dang snye phu ba'i chos skor rnams kyi tshags bsdams shing /bde mchog snyan brgyud dang lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor la sogase gnang / rgya mkhar gshegs nas snye phu'i gdan sa mdzad de/ grwa bu slob rnams gdams pas bskyangs te/ shug gseb dbus gling gi gzims khang du ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang bcas te sku gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma brag 'bur ba'i lo rgyus ni/ dmag dpon chos rdor gyi sras lnga'i gnyis pa dar re la sras sangs rgyas rdo rje/ tsa ri ba chos kyi bla ma/ brag 'bur ba dang gsum las/ brag 'bur ba sku gzhon nu nas sangs rgyas dpon gyi zhabs la gtugs/ rab tu byung nas mtshan rin chen dbang phyug tu btags/('dir a mdo'i shing par las mtshan rin chen 'bum du btags/ mizhes 'byung / sgrig pa po'i mchan/ )rdo 'on gyi dben gnas rnams su 1044

thabs lam gyi gdams pa la 'bad rtsol drag po mdzad pas bde drod kyi nyams rtogs bzang po 'khrungs/ shug gseb kyi gdan sa mdzad/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa gong du 'byon dus dbus kyi chos dbon rnams kyis kyang mjal du byon pas rin po che'i drod rtags la mnyes nas gdams pa gsan/rin po che 'bras dkar ba la do ha skor gsum ṭā ka dang bcas pa zhus te/gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs ba'i slob ma dmag dpon chos rdor gyi bu bzhi mgon po'i bu gnyis kyi che ba dgyer dbon ri ba/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sras che ba ngams shod rin po che/ bla ma zhang ston kun dga' rgyal po/ bla ma ri ba la sogs pa mkhas btsun bstan pa la phan pa mang du byon no/ de'i slob ma shug gseb ri ba yin te/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ yul ngams shod mkhar chu smad/ gdung rus klubs/ yab skyid pa dpal dang yum bkra shis ldan gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan gzhon nu rdo rjer btags/shug gseb spya brag 'bur ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ rab tu byung nas gzhon nu rin chen du btags/ mkhan po zul phu ba/ las slob dbus khang ba/gsang ste ba gab phu rnams la bsnyen par rdzogs/ brag 'bur ba la spa ba seng ge'i don rgyud/ zab don bzhi la sogs pa zhi byed skor/ rten 'brel yid bzhin nor bu la sogs rten 'brel skor/ bde mchog snyan brgyud/do ha skor gsum bar lugs tsā ka dang bcas pa/ bla ma 'brel 'jugaye shes 'khor lo rtsa 'grel bsdus don dang bcas pa zhus/ gzhan yang 1045

'gro mabon 'phags pa/ 'gar chung ba gzhon nu byang chub/ chu bzangs spro /slob dpon lang ga li ba la sogs pa mang po la dbang mdo rgyud gdams ngag sgrub skor mang du gsan no/ tsa ri dang blang ra'i dben gnas la sogs pa dben gnas rnams su sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ de nas shug gseb kyi gdan sa mdzad de/ de'i tshogs pa mtha' rgya'i bu slob mang po dang bcas pa la rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad do/ de'i slob ma 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal yin te/ lha sar byon nas de natha snye phur byon pas lam du kha bas 'o rgyal bar byung / bla ma ri ba dang mjal bas tshogs gral cig tu gtsang ba'i slob dpon gral mgo ma 'di gang zag khyad par can zhig yin par 'dug go zhes gsung ring po zhig byon/ chos sgo 'byed pa'i ska bas su thams cad kyi gral mgor bton/ zhi byed don brgyud dang / do ha skor gsum/ rten 'brel la sogs shug gseb pa'i chos skor rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ 'byon khar bzhugs gdan mthon po brtsegs/ bsnyen bkur chen po mdzad nas/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan dpal khyod kyis rang re shug gseb pa'i chos skor thams cad thob pa yin pas/ khrid zhu ba la khrid/ bshad pa zhu ba la bshad pa gyis gsung nas/lan gsum du nan chen po mdzad do/ gzhan yang bla ma ri ba 'di la/chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas kyang do ha bar lugs rnams gsan 'dug go 'ba' ra ba la gtsang pa blo bzangs pas mal ka 1046

ba can pa'i don brgyud skor rnams zhus/ de la mkhan chen shākya grags pas gsan pa yin no/ mal ka ba can pa me pho rta la 'khrungs nas ding sang gi me pho spre'u 'dis lo sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'das par shes par tsho bya'o/ so lugs kyi skabs so/ /skam lugs kyi skabs/skam lugs ni/ skam ni dge bshes grwa pa'i slob ma yin/ rten dge slong du bzhugs/ chos phar phyin shes pa cig gis grogs grwa pa'i slob ma khams sgom tshul khrims rgyan zhes bya ba cig dang 'grogs nas dge bshes grwa pa'i phyags phyir klags pa lam du byon/ der grwa pas yon bdag sa gdon gnod pa zhig la phyag na rdo rje'i bha ba ma'i dbang mdzad pa'i shul du slob ma gnyis pos sbyin sreg brgya tshar btang bas/ gdon 'khros te skam dgon skran gyis zin/ khams sgom nang du dmu chu zhugs nas gyis mdzes khyer ro/de'i tshe dam pas rgyal du dge 'dun gyi g.yog yun ring du mdzad/ thab cig kyang bcas pa da dung yang me rang 'bar du 'gro ba'i ngo mtshar can yang yod/ lan cig sog khur chen po zhig khur nas/ sgo mo'i tham pa khar bzhag pas/ sus kyang bskul bar ma nus/ 'ji rgyal ba'i dge 'dun rnams chos byed du dad pa'i sgo 'gags 'dug go zhes pa'i gsung ring po byon nas rgya nag la thegs/ de ltar rgyal du yun ra nga du bzhugs 1847

pa'i skabs shig tu nam zhig dam pas rgyal gyi na khar skyo bsangs la byon pas/ khams sgom kyang de na 'dug pas kho la nad kyi zug langs pas/dam pas sgom pa rtog pa na'am byas pas/ nga min khyed rang na'am zer/sang phrad pas kyang dam pas sngar skad gsungs pas/ na ba yin khyed la thabs cang yod dam zer/ khyed rang yon tan la sbos pa cig 'dug pa/thabs khyed rang la yod pa min nam gsungs pas nges shes skyes nas/ cis kyang gdams pa zhus zer/ deng dam pas sher phyin gyi gdams pa btab pas nad cig char sos nas ngo mtshar skyes te/ mched po bla ma ske ma la phrin btang nas/ 'di na rgya gar gyi bla ma grub thob ngo mtshar can cig 'duganga'i nad kyang drag pas khyed rang yang zhus zer bas/ skam gyis gcen po btang nas zhu ba phul bas/ bla ma de yon bdag rtsi rdor bstan gyi 'bum gyi rab gnas mdzad cing snang ste/ zhal gyis ma bzhes/ nan gyis zhus pas ming ci yin gsung / skam ye shes rgyal mtshan yin byas pas/ 'o na phan thogs par 'dug pas nga gnangs nang bar 'ong gi gsung / de nas skam can du phyin nas bla ma de ngo mtshar can cig 'dug gnangs 'byon pas grabs bya'o zer tsa na/ de nub kha ba bab/ nang bar nam nangs ma thag tu a tsa ra cig nang du byon pas/ bla ma yin nam byas pas yin zer/ nang par 'byon snyam pa la byas pas bar chad byung dogs nas da nang rang 'ongs gsung / kha ba la 'o brgyal byas pas rkang pa kha ba la ma 1048

rag gsung / sgo ma phye byas pas nged la rtsig pa la thogs thugs med gsung nas bzhugs so/ de nas nye 'brel ba sogs nas phyag dang bsnyen bkur byas/ tshogs pa'i gseb tu brda'i ngo sprod cig mdzad pas skam nges shes skyes nas/ mi mangs kyi gseb tu re 'phangs snyam pa dang / dam pa'i zhal nas/ brda mig can gyis mthong ba yin/ mig med kyis mi mthong gsung ste/ gzhan la go ba mi gda'/ der zhag bcu bzhi bzhugs pa la zhag lngar gleng slangs mdzad/ zhag dgu chos thun du bcug nas gsungasate/ skabs dang po la nad thog tu skor ba dang sgom thog tu skor ba gnyis gnyis su ngo sprad/ bar du bden bzhi dang skyabs 'gro dang thor bu pa rnams gsungs/ zhag bcu bzhi lon nas nga 'gro gsung bzhugs par zhus pas ma gnang / phyis mjal bar zhus pas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang lhan cig tu gnas pas der gsol ba thob gsung /shul du ma bde ba byung na su la 'dri zhus pas/ rab rig pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i bla ma cig nang nas 'byon par 'dug gi 'bring 'phags pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum stos/ tha ma gang zag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin te/ nga dang mi 'phrad pas mched po nyams can dang gleng slangs gyis/ lo brgyad bsgoms/ de nas mngon par shes pa 'char/ de nas mdo rgyas 'bring gi bshad pa rtsoms gsung ba la/ skam gyis nga la de tsam sgom long 1049

med/ khog pa na skra na mang dgu yod/ grwa pa mngon shes kyis zla ba gsum na 'chi bar lung bstan byas pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom pa la mgo na ba tsam snya/nga 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro bya ba la sogs pa gsungs nas bzhud do/ de nas skam gyis bsgoms pas skran rnams mod la phan/lo brgyad na mngon par shes pa shar/ mngon rtogs brgyad ka bshad/ sdud pa'i steng du mdo rgyas 'bring drangs nas kyang bshad/ de la yang slob ma yas brgyud dang mas brgyud gnyis su grags/ yas brgyud ni 'khun 'dzi yang dben pa dbang phyug rdo rje dang rgyams shes rab bla ma gnyis nas brgyud de gnyis ka nad pa yin pas nad thog tu ngo skrad/ gzhung skabs dang po/ gdams ngag bden pa bzhi/ lag len thor bu ba dang bcas pa gsungs/ 'khun rgyams gnyis gas dbon po jo dkon la/ des 'gos/ des sras 'gos dar ma/ des rog ston btsan po/ des rog shes rab 'od la'o/ yang ska ma la lha rje sprad kyis/ des 'gos dar ma/de la gtsang pa rngog gis/ des rgyal ba dkon skyabs/ des rog la'o/yang skam gyis bla ma chag brag dmar ba/ des bla ma gnyos/ des bla ma sgog lung pa/ des bla ma zhang ston shes rab/ des bla ma gshen/ des skye med zhang ngo / skye med zhang gis snyan brgyud/ bzhi tsho dgu'i gdams pa la yig cha mdzad do/ yang skam gyis dge bshes 'khun/ des chag brag dmar ba/ des la stod gtsang so'i sprul sku thang chung ba/ des rgya /050

lhan gzhon nu seng gi des sag ston/ yang skam gyis rgyams la/ nges ke ke hor grags la/ des bla ma gnyos la/ des rgya ston gzhon na seng ge la gnang ste/ 'dis ā tsayi de ba'i bden bzhi mthong bas mos nas bla ma gsum bsten pas thugs ma tshim par la stod gtsang sor byon nas sprul sku thang chung ba la gtugs nas gdams pa zhus pas sgro 'dogs chod rtogs pa 'khrungs/ thang chung ba dang gnyos yan du yig cha med pa la rgya ston gasmon nu seng ges skam lugs kyi gdams pa'i yig cha chen po mdzad de/ de'i mtshan ji sher phyin thugs rgyud lag len snyan rgyud rin chen phreng ba rigs pa'i gtan tshigs 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya'o/yang skam gyis rgya gar jo sras/ des ras pa lha ri pa/ des sum sgom mched gnyis la gnang ngo / yang shangs pa ke ke hor grags kyis skam lo dgur bsten nas gdams pa rnams zhus/ phyis 'khun yang dben pa la yang zla ba gsum du bsten/ ke ges rin po che gyel tsha la bshad do/mas brgyud ni/ sgro nas brgyud pa ste nad pa min pas gang zag rim dang cig char gyi dbye bas snying po'i don dang mngon par rtogs pa gnyis su ngo sprad nas mdo ma lus pa rten 'brel gyi 'gros bzhis 'chad de/ mas brgyud sgom thog tu skor ba'i gdams pa'o/ bla ma de yang 'phan yul stod pa/yab sgro ston 'phan rgyal/ yum rī mo bkra shis/ de la lcam sring gsam mong pa'i phu bo sgro chos brtson/ gzhon nu la rab tu byung nas dge bshes 1051

ma tshar skyes/ dus de tsa na dam pa ring ri na bzhugs zer bas sgros ltar 'gro'am byas pas/ 'o na song dang nga'i bla ma de phyag dang zhabs gzhan pas che ba cig yod/ sher phyin bsgoms pas drod kyi ye shes skyes te khong ba'i srin don pas sku stod la smin pa thag thug yod/ zhabs g.yon pa la smre ba yod/ dbu gtsug na bug pa mthe bong shong ba cig yod gsung bas/ bla ma sgros rgyags grabs byas nas glang 'khor du byon pas/ do nub sleb pa'i nyin phyed tsa na dam pa'i gsung cig kyang thos/ rgongs dam pa'i spyan sngar byon pas khrom gseb na bzhugs 'dug phyag dang phyag rten byas pas ma bzhed pa la/ bla ma sgro la dar mchin kha yug cig yod pas de'i kha gang bcad nas dbu skra la btags pas dam pa dgyes/ de nas dar gtubs te dbu skra dang bal thul yo la btags pas dam pa dgyes so/de nas rten 'brel gyi gal te nas sman sna tshogs bsres pa'i thum bu cigarkang mas rgyug ra rgyus pas dkris pa cig bre srang rnams mkhar sder du bcug nas sgro la gtang/ ci yin ngo ma shes nas kun dga' la dris pas/chos thams cad du ma ro gcig tu rtogs pa dang / brgyud pa'i rkang zin pa dang / chos 'jal kha tshugs pa yin no gsung / sman pa gong chis byas pas khyed rang rang gi yin gsung nas sgro la gnang ngo / de nas phung mkhar skyol gsung nas btsun pa lngas phung mkhar du bskyal/ grogs bzhi yod pa rnams gdams pa ni mi 'ong ba 'dug zer nas snye nam du tshong la 1053

sang sgro la shog gsung nas phyin pas dri rgyu ci yod gsung pas/ sngar nas bsams pa'i grub mtha' mang du dris pas/ la na mi gsung bar bdag pos drung du skyol gsung / kun dga' na re/ rang gi nyams sam bla ma'i gdams ngag dris dang zer bas/ skam ye shes rgyal mtshan na re 'di skad gsung byas nas sher phyin la dris pas dgyes nas/ khyod skam gyi slob ma yin nam/ skam ye shes rgyal mtshan bde'am gsung / sngar gyi bla ma yin par ngo shes nas gdams pa zhu zhing sdod par zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ tshogs su 'phags pa brgyad stong pa cig dgos pa la su la yod gsung / so hor 'bar sku mched mchod gnas par yod pas nga cag gis bris la dbul lo zer bas/ yi ge mgo can na mgo can/ mgo med na mgo med/ zla ba gcig gi nang du zin par gyis la khyog gsung / da brgyad stong pa ga re gsung bas/ da dung ma tshar zhus pas shin tu ma dgyes te/ ched ka med par a tsa ra 'khrubatapa pham/ da skyas 'gyogs dgos par 'dug gsung nas dka' thungakhang par gshegs/ brgyad stong pas ci bgyi zhus pas zangs dung gi kha la bkyon nas shar phyogs su 'bud pa yin te gsung / de nas zhag bdun dka' thub mdzad nas grongs so/ sgrol dka' thub kyi phyogs lo nyi shu rtsa bdun gtad/ der spur sbyangs te gdu nga bsduganas sgros yul du byon nas skam dang mjal bas/ nga'i bla ma der 'dug gam mi 'dug gsung / yin par 'dug zhus pas/ e sha nga rang 1054

yang rta cig la zhon nas 'gro ba yin pas gsung / der skam gyi spyan sngar lo gnyis bzhugs/ de nas skam yang gshegs/ de rjes lan pa seg ba tu lo nyi shu rtsa dgu sgrub pa mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal gzigs/ dgongs pa mthar skyol/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis nas bshad pa mdzad/ bdun cu rtsa lnga la gshegs so/ khong gi spyan sngar 'chus pa dar brtson gyis byon te/ de'i yab 'chus pa gang bo/ yum khu mo sgron rna lcam/ de la ming sring gsum yod pa'i ming pos rab tu byung nas gzhung dang gdams pa mang du bsan/ khyad par du zhi byed kyi rtsad ma lus par bcad nas mkhas par grags/ rma so gnyis kyi gdams pa tshar ba'i tshe sgro'i spyan sngar phyin nas sher phyin gyi gdams pa rnams gsan/ dka' thub lo bcu gnyis phog nas nga'i brgyud pa khyod kyis 'dzin dgos pa yin no gsung / de nas yul du byon nas dka' thub lo bdun byas tsa na/ mkha' 'gro mas spyi de dgon pa lung bstan/ de'i mkhar las la 'khrug pa byung nas dka' thub 'phro bcad/ 'on kyang thugs dgongs mthar rdzogs/sgrol ma gtso 'khor gyi zhal gzigs/ dam pas ming lam lan lnga bstan/mkha' 'gro mas gdugs bcu gsum phub/ dbus gtsang ru bzhir bstan pa'i rtsa ba btsugs/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa drug lon pa'i tshe nyin zhig btsas ma'i tshe da nang du 'gro gsung nas bzhud/ de rting jo mos btsas ma'i gro len du byon pas/ nga da lta 'chi bar 'dug gsung / jo mos de 1055

'dra mi bden 'ong / gal te gshegs na spur ci tsugs byed zhus pas khang pa'i gra sags 'dir rdo ba skyor la zhog gsung / de 'dra bya pas sems can 'chor byas pas/ sems can la nga'i ro la 'jug pa'i bsod nams mi 'dug pas ma'u tsi/ nam zhigan nga'i phung po ltag ba sgrod de 'gro/ de'i tshe dus mi bde ba 'ong gsung nas gshegs/ de nas yo mang po song ba na/ spur de stag pa sgyed song 'dug ba'i skab su yar klung su dpon chen rgyal bzang gi dmag byung nas spur de g.yengs/ de nas mang pos sus thob byas te khyer ro/ de'i zas 'chus pa brtson 'grus seng ge de la rog shes rab 'od kyis chang khyim du skam lugs rnams gsan no/ de la dam pa gshegs ba'i tshe sgros lo bzhi bcu/ skam gshegs dus bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ sgrub ba thon pa'i tshe bdun cu rtsa gcig bshad pa 'o bzhi ste/ 'khrungs lo sa pho rta ste sgam po ba lam lo gcig gis bgres/'chus pa dar brtson ni/ dam pa bshegs pa'i me mo bya de la 'khrungs na / don drug pa chu pho byi ba la gshegs/ 'chus pa 'di dbal phag mo grub las lo bdun gyis gzhon 'chus pa 'khrungs nas 7 spre'u 'di yan la lo sum brgya dang drug cu tham ba'o zhes shes par bya'o/ rnam phud kyi skabs so/ 056

ba da phran gyi skabs/bar du byung ba'i rgyud phran la grwa pa dang / lce dang / ljang lugs gsum mo/ de la dge bzhes gra pa la zhi byed sgron ma dgu skor gyi gdams pa gnang ste/ de la man ngag sku'i sgron ma/ theg pa gsung gi sgron ma/gsang ba thugs kyi sgron ma/ yang dag lta ba'i sgron ma/ rin po che sgom pa'i sgron ma/ byang chub spyod pa'i sgron ma/ mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgron ma/rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma/ dngos grub 'bras bu'i sgron ma rnams so/ de ming dam pas gra thang du byon pa la ma tsa ra phal pa'o snyam nas bkur sti ma byas pa la/ sang ngo a tsa ra'i stan gyi sog ma rnams sbubs ma zhar bar 'dug pa mthong nas/ dge bzhes gra pa la zhus pas/ dge bshes pa'i thugs la dam pa sangs rgyas yin nges dgongs nas brgyugs pas gra phyi mdar zin/ gser phul bas ma bzhed kyang gyis 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes byung nas/ slar gra thang du byon te sgron ma skor dgu po gsungs dge bshes gra pas srin chu'i brag la sum btsun chung la/ des do rir myang ston do pa la/ des zhab kyi bla chung 'od zer la/ des shangs su 'chus pa dar brtson la gnang ste/ des grub bsam kyang zhes mdzad do/ (ma mdo'i shing dpar las des dgu po thams cad la tāka mdzad do zhes 'byung / sgrig pa po'i mchan/) des 'chus pa brtson seng la gsung /1057

des rog shes rab 'od la gsungs so/ lce lugs ni/ bzang yul kyi dge bshes lce ba zhes bya ba yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i yab ni/ 'tshur ston dbang nge'i ngang por yon tan gyi rkang 'dzug pa'i bla ma yin/ bar du kha che zla ba mgon po bod du dus 'khor spel du byon/ gnyos 'o tsā ba la babs pa lce yab sras kyis 'gyur gyi sbyin bdag mdzad nas longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas gzhi gzung / gser srang sum cu dang brul srang sum cu'i 'gyur yon phul/ lo gcig la 'gyur rdzogs par mdzad cing mkhyen par yang bslabs/ mthar dam pa sangs rgyas lce dal sgang du byon pa'i tshe lce pa mtshams la bzhugs pas mjal ba ma byung / de la sras po zla ba grags pa ni/ dge bshes gra pa'i lo sum cu rtsa lnga pa me pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs/rab tu byung zhing sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan/ sngags kyi yon tan yang phun sum tshogs par yod pa la/ dam pas yid gdungs te gdan bzhugs rtsad bcad pas yer pa na bzhugs par thos/ nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro mas kyang lung bstan te/ rigs kyi bu rje btsun ka ma la shrī ni sdom pa gsum ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa mkhyen pa/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras nas brgyud pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi gdams pa bar ma chad pa yin pas rje btsun de la chos zhus shig ces bya ba'i lung bstan byung / de'i tshe yer pa na sgom chen nyi khri bya bas dam pa'i zhabs bteg nas yod pa la/ bla ma lce'i khu bo sgom chen 1058

tshul grags dang khul bu'i kong sgom bya ba'i slob ma cig dang gnyis dam pa spyan 'dren du btang bas/ sgom chen nyi khri na re/ bdag gis shing 'khogs pas rje btsun gyi phyags phyir 'brang mi nus pas/ rje btsun bzhud na da kha stabs kyis 'gro pas/ khyed kyi bla ma lce mi chen po la de skad zer ba lugs min te/ bdag pos bag cig sku na gzhon par 'dug pas bdag gis zhabs tog pher par bya'i/ 'dir rje btsun gyi spyan sngar 'byon pa zhu zer nas rje btsun gshegs su ma ster ba la/ de nas lce dal sgang pa yab sras kun gyi phyag na yod pa'i gser thams cad sbrugs yum gyi ske rags la yod pa'i ga ra gyi ba dzir tshun chad skog yab bla ma chen po'i na bza' snyi zab chen la byas/ nang re'u la byas pa'i phyam rtse dang snam bu mang po bsnams nas mar par byon te/ rje btsun gyi spyan sngar gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang phyam snam rnams phul bas/ de rnams la spyan mi gzigs par gnyis ka ma bu phrad pa bzhin du khong 'dzum dang gdung sems byung / de nas rje btsun ka ma la shrīs/ tsan+d+ra gīrti la byang chub kyi sems smon 'jug gnyis dang phar phyin gyi don gyi dri ba mdzad/ de nas gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi'i brda' dang dri smred mdzad/ de nas gsang sngags kyi don mthar thug gi dri thed mang du mdzad/ de nas lces byang chub kyi sems smon 'jug gnyis ji ltar bskyed pa dang / phar phyin gyi don dang gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi'i brda' dang don kyi lan dang mthar thug gi lan btab pas rnam pa gnyis gsung je che je 1059

che la song bas/ tho gyi kun na par la yod pa kun nyan du byung nas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ da ran 'phro chod gsung nas zla ba phug tu bzhud/sgom chen nyi khri na re/ khong dge bshes lce de zugs kyi mkhyen pa ji tsam 'dug zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyi bzang po bzang po 'dugadabyug pa nan de nan de dgos par 'dug gsung / de nas yas la gdams ngag lkog tu bya yi/ lha ri snying po'i khar shog gsung nas byon te/ dang por sems la gros 'debs kyi lo rgyus dris nas de'i gdams ngag zhus/de la brten nas pha rol tu phyin nga lam thun mong pa'i gdams pa gsungs/de nas phar phyin thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag gsungs/ de nas gsang sngags thun mong ba'i gdams ngag gsungs/ de nas gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag gsungs/ lar zla ba dgu'i bar du gdams pa mi 'dra ba brgya rtsa brgyad gsungs/ de nas rtses dam pa gar gshegs kyi phyags gyi 'brang bar zhus pas/ chus bum pa gang ba cig nas cig tu byo ba'i brda' mdzad nas yas dang nga gnyis mnyam por song ba yin gyi/phyir 'brang mi dgos/ nga'i phyir byon na pha ma mi dga' bar 'dug pas yul du song la sgom sgrub gyis gsung / de nas rtses yul du byon nas dam pa'i gsung bzhin du gtso bor sgom sgrub 'ba' zhig mdzad/ mer pa mad 4ma ṇi pad+me yang dam pas gzigs/ sne'i yab mched nyi ma byang chub pa ri ba la chos gsan zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ding rir dam pa dang ma la ba 1060

brda' chos ma gtogs tshig tu ma bsungs/ mos pa thob kyang tshig tu mi gsung bas yul du byon nas lce tsan+d+ra gīrti la rta cig phul nas zhus bas/gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag sku gsung thugs dang /sems nyid gcig pu dang / phyag rgya gcig bzhi dang / rim lnga dang /sems la gros 'debs la sogs 'ga' re gsungs/ rang gi yab dang / sha theng dang / sgom chen brag po la sogs pa dam pa'i gdams pa rgya ba rnams la sna 'ga' tsam las ma gsungs/ byu tsan+d+ra gīrti nyid kyi nye gnas slob dpon rā hu la badz+ra lo bcu bdun la rab tu byung nas bla ma tsan+d+ra bīrti sku ma gshegs phan la zhag gcig kyang 'bral ma myong bas rje btsun gyi gdams pa ma lus pa gnang nas/ rgyad kyis nga ba na du bsgoms shig gzhan la ma bshad par sha gzug rang zo/ khong du mar khu 'thung la kha bong bas gyis gsung nas bka' rgyas btab bo/ de la dge slong byang chub ye shes kyis gsan te/ dang por dge bshes yang gang ba dang dge gong ba la sogs pa bka' gdams kyi gdams ngag dang spyod phyogs la sogs pa mang du gsan nas shes/ de nas mngon pa dang dbu ma'i chos mang du shes/ de nas gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos mang du shes/ de nas dam ba'i gdams pa rnams snyi ma byang chub spang dag mor sku gshegs pa de la khong rang la yod tshad zhus/ de nas dam pas lce la gsungs pa'i gdams ngag gi rnam grangs rnams thos nas rā hu la badz+ra la gsan/ ngam pa'i gdams rtsa la chos kyi 106

gnad che bar dgongs nas tsan+d+ra girti'i sgrub khang du bzhugs/ mos gus drag po byas pas rmi lam du tsan+d+ra gīrti sngon kho na ltar byon te nam mkhar bzhugs nas gdams pa gsung bar rmis pas/ yid la rang mos pa'i sems rmis sam/ dpe dkar gyi cho 'phrul yin snyam du sems pa dang / nang par snga bar slob dpon gyis bang chen btang nas shog gsung nas phyin pas/zhal 'dzum mdzad cing pham phabs kyang gnang nas/ mdang nga la bla ma tsan+d+ra gīrti'i lung bstan byung / nga'i chos thams cad khos shes pa yin kho la phul gsung nas/ ngas chos thams cad phyir bton nas yas kyi ཿna du bsgrigs nas phul ba'i rmi lam byung gsung nas/ chab tsha thon pa dang /gdams ngag gi dpe rnying rnams tshar phyungs su gnang / dam tshig med pa dang sdod ngan pa la ma sbyin gsung nas bka' rgyas btab/ des 'chus pa yab sras la gsungs/ des rog shes rab 'od la gsungs/ de yang chos 'di la mdo rgyud zhal sbyor gyi gdams pa zhes bya ste/ mdo sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa dang rgyud mtshan yang dag par brjod pa sbyar nas phar phyin gyi gdams pa dang / sngags la grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi gdams pa rnams bzhugs pa yin no/ ljang lugs ni/ 'chims yul gyi ljang bka' gdams pa la sher phyin yi ge med pa'i gdams pa gnang ste/ ljang gis ljang chung ba la gsungs/ des 'chus pa yab sras la gsungs/ des rog shes rab 'od la gsungs te/ ngo sprod kyi mtshang gcig las med zer/1062

brgyud phran gyi skabs so/ /brgyud pa thor bu ba ni 'gro sgom la mtshan brjod gser gyi thur ma gnang / 'gu sgom la las rgya'i gdams pa/ chu sgom la snying gtam lhug pa'i gdams pa/ sgom pa dmar sgom la chig chod gsum gyi gdams pa/gnyags lo tsā ba la bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i gdams pa/ lce mo dpal sgron la grub thob nyams kyi chos sde bcu drug pa/ gnyal stod ngor rje sgo rang lhan cig skyes sbyor/ chu bar gyi gnas brtan 'byung grags la shes rab snying po'i gdams pa/ sngags bshad shes rab rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor gyi gdams pa/ shangs pa dbu sdebs la yi gi bzhi pa'i gdams pa/snyi mo'i rgya ston skyi rtsegs la dgyes pa rdo rje'i gdams pa/ zhang sag chung ba laphag mo'i gsang sgrub/ bla ma dkon dkar ba la phyag na rdo rje'i gdams pa/ skyi shod kyi 'ban gung rgyal la bde mchog snyan brgyud/ ma gcig labs sgron la gcod kyi gdams pa gnang ste/ de rnams ni brgyud pa bar ma'i skor ro/ /ma jo nyi tha bzhi'i lo rgyus kyi skabs/dam pas rgya nag ta byon/ rtse lnga'i ri la 'dzegs pa'i lam khar drang srong rgan po chu shing gi khar ba thogs pa cig dang mjal/ de 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin/ de na re/ yul 'di na nad yams mang bas 1063

rdorje gdan na rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs yod/ de khyod kyis de ring yon na rtsal 'di'i nad yams 'chad pas long gsung / rdo rje gdan thag ring ba de ring rang ga na lon byas pas/ brag khung cigagi nang na bug nga ga yod pa bstan nas 'di la gyin na lon zer/ dam pas brag khung de la byon pa / rdo rje'i gdan yud tsa gyis 'khor/ gzung kyang lon nas nad yams zhi bar dzad/ der rje btsun 'jam ba'i dbyangs dang mang mjal/de rnams kyi bkod pa rgya rnams kyis ri mo la bris zhing par du btab pa yang bod du sleb pa 'di yin no der dam pas lo bcu nyis bzhugs na zhi byed kyi chos rnams gsung pas dar zhing / de'i gdams dzodang sgom rgyud ding sang ming ma chad par chad bar grags so/ kha cig na re/ rgya nag tu dam pas gshegs pa'i tshul yang bstan zer/ ji ltar yang rung ste pod du byon na dpal ding ring me mo glang gi lo la phebs/ glang 'khor gyi thang dkyil der thogs cig bzhugs pa na/ yul de'i rgan pa kha cig gibakhanged rang gi yul 'dir mtha' mi sdod du bcug pas mi 'ong zer nas 'don du phyin pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams dang nga yul 'dir 'ong ba su snga lta yi/ 'dir ngas di nga por 'ongs tsa na 'di 'dra ba zhig yod/de'i rjes la 'di 'dra/ de'i rjes la 'di 'dra gsungs bas/ khong rnams kyis ci yang ma spobs te log song / de ltar ding rir zabs pa 'di lan lnga ba zhes bya ste// 'di man chad du gsungasangapa'i chos rnams la brgyud bltas kā

shar na dam pa phyar chen/ sto na badz+ra kro dha/ nub na par chung /byang na byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' ste/ de dag la sgo ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi zhes zer/ khyad par 'phags pa'i bu chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'khrul zhig nyi shu rtsa drug gdan non gyi slob ma bcu gnyis bya ba byung ste/ de rnams dam pas gang zag gi rigs dang bsnun te gdams pa so sor gsungs pa ma gtogs/ gdams ngag gi rgyun gcig tu bgrang du med/ /bla ma phyar chen la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgom yod dang sgom med gnyis su ngo sprad nas bka' cho lu dang / mdo sbyor dang / don sdebs gsum gyis spros pa bcad/ /phyar chung sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis med kyi gdams pa la ngo sprad de/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i srangs su bcug badz+ra kro dha byin brlabs kyi lam pa yin gsung nas rtag tu gsol ba 'debs su 'jug /byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' ni gang zag rim gyis ba min gsung nas/ blo sbyong gnang nas dka' thub kyi srangs rkyang khug lam lnga'i bsdus pa la bcug /bla ma rdzong pa ni/ gang zag cig char ba yin gsung nas phyag rgya chen mo dbang gcig mo la ngo sprad nas lam du bcug /bla ma rgya sgom la dri med grangs su bcug pa rig pa ngos 'dzin gyi gdams ngag bya ba gnang / /1066

bla ma bcug la bdes grol ba dbang bzhi lam khyer gyi gdams pa gnang nas dbang bzhi gnyen po'i lam du bcug /dbus pa sgro ston la snying po'i don dang mngon rtogs gnyis la brten nas 'a ma rim gyis pa dang cig char gnyis su khrid/ de'i 'phra gcod du don rgyud skor gsum gsungs /bla ma ye gzi 'bar re la blo bral sems kyi me long la brten nas phyag rgya chen po'i don la ngo sprad/ / zha ma lcam sring la do ha'i gzhung la brten nas rim cig char gnyis su ngo sprad/ de la sogs pa gdams pa'i sna mi 'dra ba rnams phal cher rang gis nyams su myong zhing grol ba ma gtogs yongs la ma grags/ dam pa ding rir me mo glang gi lo nas me mo bya'i bar du lo nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhugs nas mi rigs mi gcig pa mang po'i don mdzad de gshegs/ sgo ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi'i byang chub sems dpa' kun dgas dam pa'i gsung rnams la bka' cho lu'i skor du ming btags nas sdeb gsum tsam yi ger btab/ /bla ma phyar chung gis dum rum khrigs kyi skor zhes bya ba sde ba phyed dang gnyis/ /phyar chen gyis bka' mdo sbyor gyi skor zhes bya ba yi ger btab/badz+ra kro dhas rin po che don sdebs kyi skor zhes bya ba risdo ba phyed pa cig yi ger btab ste bka'i bsdu ba mdzad do/ de rnams las kyang chig rgyung 1067

gtad pa ni sha chu kun dga'i phyogs su bsgyur gsung nas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' yin no/ de la byang chub sems dpa' kun dgas blo gta/ni kyi ma jo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lo rgyus gsungs pa ni/ /sangs rgyas ni/ yul shrī ri'i chu bzangs/ pha ma la mdo sde yod pa'i gces phyug ma yin kyang dad pas dam pa'i spyan sngar bu mo brgyad dgu dang 'groṭa nas 'ongs te yul du gyin par lo dgu bsgoms pas rtogs pa shar/ dam pas mo 'grongs pa mkhyen nas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/kun dga' de ring khyod kyi tho skor du sangs rgyas ngang phrad pa'i mi cig 'chi g+ne/ de khyod kyis ngo shes se gsung / dam pa rang nyid ma lags so zhus pas/ nga min nga dang 'dra ba cig 'dug gsung / man tsam na jo mo sangs rgyas grongs nas spur sbyangs pas 'ja' 'od kyis khengs so/ /gser btsun ma ni/ yul zha ma pha drug bdag dam pa'i spyan sngar 'gro byas nas pha la gros dris pas ma 'gro rnal 'byor pa dang btsun ma chos lugs mi mthun zer yang phyin nas gdams pa zhus pas ming la ngo sprad nas gdams pa shar/ zhin tu sgrub pa la brtson/ ngag tu'ang rkun ma 'od zhi tshe zer/ lo brgya tham pa thub ste grongs pa'i rjes su nam mkhar 'jas khengs/ rdo rje mas dpa'i sku dang ring bgrel mang du byon no/ /jo mo than chung ni yul la stod stag sde ba/ dam pa yab sras gnyis ka la gdams pa zhu nyams su blangs pa grub pa thob/ dam pa ga kas 1068
