nas kyang glang 'khor du bzhugs/ lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig la 'das/ ring bsrel mang du byon no/ /jo mo 'bar ma ni/ yul myang stod pa dam pa cug gi jo mo bya nas dam ba la gdams ba zhus/ sno gsum nas ri dwags ltar ri la nyams su blang pas rtogs pa shar/ myang stod tshes spong sar 'das pa ring bgrel mang du byon/ /jo mo ri ma ni/ rtsang rong snar pa mo/ khyim ba byas pas khyo ma rungs pa cigabyung nas so sor gyes te tshong pa'i gyi 'brangs nas dam pa dang mang lo bdun du gdams pa zhus shing nyam su blangs pas rtogs pa shar/ de grongs ba'i rgyar khang dzodam pas skor ba mang du mdzad ba thams cad ngo mtshar skyes/ ring bzang nga du byon no/ jo zo ye shes lcam ni yulamang yul gung thang / jo mo rje sno zhe bya ba grub thob lo brgya dang gcig la'ad ba de'i nye gan gle na/ ma mchod ba ska khas skang khyad bar du dam sprangal sa pas rtogs pa shar te phyi gung nga du grongs/ 'od dang 'ja' tshon mang bo byung / jo mo chos sgron ni yul la stod sdog panamo/ byang chub rtse sa dpa' kun dga'i jo mo byas te/kun dga' dam pa'i rgyun rdzor can ring pa la 'tshigashakyin lcog sbu nas thur zhi tshe la 'drud/ de la kun dga' bzogaba'i bla mar khur nas mi bkyon bar gya le dzod cig da res thugasakhul zer yang jo mo 'a da tshig1069

gi nyes pas 'chi khar sdug bsngal nyams su myong / nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nang na ngan shos su song / jo mo ma gces ni/ yul la stod mang 'gar ba/kun dgas jo mor gzung nas yab sras gnyis ka la gdams pa zhus/ nyams len rim par byas pas grub pa thob/ phyis myang stod byang 'dir 'das/rdo rje sems dpa'i sku dang ring bsrel mang du byon/ jo mo chos skyabs ni/yul myang stod khu le/ dad pa skyes nas glang 'khor du byon/ nor skal che bar yod pa spangs nas chu 'thung lo bcu gnyis byas/ nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa shar/ 'das dus 'od dang ring bsrel mang du byon/ jo mo chos skyid ni/ yul ya 'brog kho ba le/ khyim thab byas pas bu nor 'dzom par yod kyang / chos la 'gro byas pas ming po dge bshes gnyal ston na re/khyod chos gsha' ma byed na la stod ding ri na dam pa sangs rgyas bzhugs/der song zer bas glang 'khor du phyin yun ring du bzhuṭa/ dam pa gshegs nas lo gnyis na gshegs/ ring bgrel mang du byon/ jo mo skur mo ni/yul la stod shrī ri'i chu bzangs pa/ glang 'khor du lo bcu bzhugs nas 'das te/ ring bsrel mang du byon no/ jo mo lha mo ni yul stod lungs ril ma/ rus 'ber mo/ rang yul spangs nas glang 'khor du lo drug bzhuṭa/ dam pa 'das nas yul du byon nas lo gsum bzhuṭa/ phyis ding rir byon nas yun ring du bzhugs nas 'das te 'ja' 'od byung ngo / jo mo myang mo ni/ yul zhab kyi tsha rong ba/ dad pa skyes nas dam pa dang 1070

mja9 / glang 'khar du lo bcu bzhuṭa nas 'das/ zhal gnyes ma'i sku dang 'ja' 'od mang du byon/ khro mo dbang phyug lcam ni/ yul stod lungs stong khung ba/ bal po bltar phyin pas dam pa dang ra la/ glang 'khor du lo bcu gcig bzhugs nas 'das te rtags bzang po byung / jo mo rdo rje rgyan ni/ yul ding ri gdong ba mo/ shin tu zheg pa cig yin pa la/ dam pa'i gsung la dad nas glang 'khor du lo bco lnga bsdad/ gyis 'khrul zhig tu song / 'das pa'i tshe bsreg pa'i grabs byas pas 'od kyi phung po cig gis sna drangs nas byang ri'i rtse la song ba thams cad kyis mthong / mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan yin par glengs nang par tho rangs byang ri la bskyal bas ro sna 'od kyis drangs/ zhag bdun du 'od phung ma yal ba yul mi thams cad kyis mthong / jo mo nam mkha' gsal ni/ yul dbus kyi 'ol kha ba/ mdog dkar la shes pa gsal ba cig yod de/dam pa'i drung du lo drug bsdad nas chos zhus bsgoms pas grub pa thob/dam pa 'das nas lo bzhi bsdad pas dri chu yang sbrang rtsir gyur/ de nas dbus su byon nas lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la byang du 'das/ gdung thams cad ring bsrel du song ngo / jo mo sgron ne+e ni mo rang che chos la dga'/che gtor la rtsi/ 'khor mang po yod/ mag che bas dam pas mo'i phyag le tsa na bzhengs nas u lags gsung nas legs mor len pas/ mo dam pa la mos gus chud nas byin brlabs phog 'khor thams cad spangs nas 1071

sgrubang zhugs pa phyis bzang mo cig byung / jo mo 'phan mo ni/ sa 'phan yu / mo rang dang nye gan ma gnyis glang 'khor du bzhuṭa na mnyam du grongs bas lung pa sman drir song / rtaṭa bzang po mang bo byung na tham cad ngo mtshar skyes so jo mo rje'u ma ni/ su mang tra/thugs mkhas zhing bkol bde la dam ba lko nyan pa tsog yod pas ding rir lo mang du bzhuṭa/ gung thang du lo du ma zon na 'ad te/ ro ri laskya ba zhu na sgrol ma'i sku cig byon no/ jo mo ro zan ma ni/ rtsal gung thang / rgya sgom ma'i mna' ma na/ gong nas dam pa'akhumo 'ong bar lung bstan/ rtog pa shar/ grub pa thob/ rtog ba choms/ gyi gung nga du 'das na sar bzhu bas du ba tham cad 'od zer du song ngo /jo mo shangs chung ma ni/ yulanangs phu/ rtsal lngar la phyin pas da ba dang mjal mo gu skye nas chos sgor zhugs lo drug chang 'khor du bsdad na dam ga'adas nas shangs su bzhugs/ spyar sbyang pa ring bzol mang du byon/ jo mo zha chun ma'i lo rgyu ni brjod zin to/ ding ri gdong rdzi mo gzhon nu ma ni/ yul dbu ru stod kyi mar ma pha'i tsho la zung la 'ong ba dam ba dang jal/ gsung la nges shes skyes pas byin rlabs zhugs4te rtogs pa shar/ ngag bcad nas zhug mar brdzus te nyamagasu blang / ring po ma lon par grongs bas 'grongs khar dam pa'i zhal nas/ nang par 'o cag gi 'dir rgyab pa thob pa gsa'ada' 1072

bar gda' gsung / dam pa 'grongs ba min ma zhus pas/ nga min/u rgyan du 'gro rings pa'i bu mo cig gda' gsung / nang bar mo nad med par grongs/ /nya ma khyim pa mo ni/ yul bong shod kyi nya ma rdor gsal bya ba/ bu khyo nor du 'dzom pa/ dad brtson mos par 'dzom pa/ snying rje gtong phod dang ldan pa na pas mo shi bas lung pa 'ja' 'od dang ring bsrel du song bas thams cad ngo mtshar skyes so/ ma jo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i lo rgyu kyi bas so chig brgyud spas pa'i bla ma rnam gsum gyi skabs/byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' ni/ skye ba snga ma rabs lngar dam bas rjes su gzung / tshe 'dir ding ri shar phyogs kyi tshe gung du yab stod pa khri bzangs dang / yum jo mo dar ma gnyis kyi sras su chu pho stag la 'khrung / ming stod chung 'bum me bya bar btags pas dus de/ nga kun dga' yin zer bas de nas kun dgar chags/ de nas khyim thab tu jo mo skyur mo gza' blangs/ pas/ zas ga ra 'od 'khrungs/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba shol bas jo mo dang bras gnyis snang / nor rnams kyang zad par gyur/de nas dgung lo sum cu so dgu bzhes pa'i dus dam pas glang 'khor du phebs nas lo gsum song ba lcags 'brug la rjo mo la brdzun byas te/ 1073

nam la khar jag la 'gro ba skad byas nas glang 'khor du dam pa'i drung du rgyan/de'i nang thogs dam pas gsung gi gdangs bstod de dgon pa ba rnams ston ceg de ring dpa' bo rdo rje 'byon par 'dug pas thams cad phyag dar gyis/ mchod pa shoms/ rol mo khyer la bsu ba'i grabs gyis shigaces gsungs pas thams cad kyi de ltar mdzad/ phyogs thams cad du bya ra byas pas su yang med/ nyi ma phyi dro tsa na mi rong ngan pa/ dug po rgyal ba/ 'khor re zhan la rgyags phye nyung ba cig yib cing byung ba la thams cad kyis khrel rgod byed cing bsu ba byas/ dam pas dgyes tshor mdzad de gdong bsu nas dpa' bo rdo rje 'dir 'ongs pa de dga'o/ phyar chung gis dpa' bo rdo rje la khri brtsigs gdan thing gsung ba la/ brdar ma go nas/ dam pa nyid kyis thal ba'i phung po cig mdzad/ de'i steng du mda' bzhi bsgol nas/ kun dga' ba'i bu khyod rang da ni 'di'i steng du bsdad pa rang bzang gsung / der bla ma byang chub sems dpas dam pa'i na bza' la 'jus nas 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid 'di ci lags zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas kun dga' khyi lud kyi gseb kyi 'bu lags med gsung / 'dir skyes pa'i sems can la bde ba'i go skabs bdog gam zhus pas/ phyag mdzub pang du spel nas sdug bsngal lu gu brgyud du gda' ba gsung / 'di las thar ba'i dus shig nam mchis na zhus pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi 'phrang la thar ba'i lam sna ma zug par gda'o gsung / gsung de tsho la nges 1074

shes skyes nas rang yul la mig mi blta bar dka' thub byas/ bla ma la gsol ba 'ba' zhig btab pas byin rlabs zhugs nas/ dge sbyor gyi rtsa ba zin pa la mnyes nas/ tsha gung nas byon pa'i dpa' bo khyod g.yul las rgyal ba cig bya dgos gsung / bdag gis go cha ji ltar bgo lags zhus pas/ rang shong tsam gyi phug par nyol/ lhags skyob tsam gyi gos rgyal gyon/ srog thub tsam gyi 'tsho ba bsnyen/ ma sun tsam du nyams len gyis/ma 'dris tsam du mi dang 'grogs shig gsung / kho bos nyams su rang ji ltar blang zhus pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa rten 'brel gyi brda' lta stangs kha yar sgyur zhing 'dug gyis la bsgoms gsung nas bsgoms pas/ rig pa'i rtsal phyoṭa med du 'byongs te/ rten 'brel gyi brda' la go ba stongs pas dam pa shin tu mnyes nas/ kun dga' 'dir shog dang gsung nas dam pa'i drung du phyin pas/ rgyal riṭa spyi bo nas dbang bskar na gdan non tsam gyi ljid yod dam/ 'phrul gyi skas la 'jog tu bcushe na mi 'dar tsam gyi yang thor yod dam/ stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la 'gran du bcug na gling bzhi la dbang byed nus sam zer bas/ bla ma byang chub sems dpa'i zhal nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba shes kyang mi shes/ 'ong kyang mi 'ong/ byed kyang mi byed/ byas kyang ma byas pa cig lags te/ — dam pa'i lha chos 'di la go ba dang snying rus dam dum bdag gi zhus pas/ dam pa shin tu mnyes nas/ thog mar rgyal po'i bang mdzod rku ba yin pas/ lde 1075

mig mang du thogs shig bar du mun khung la mar me 'degs 'tshal bas me cha snan po khug mar sbos shig tha mar chu bo las sgrol ba'i mnyan pa 'bab bas/ skya gdos bzang po grabs su chug cig gsung nas/ lam lnga dka' thub gsum gyis srangs nas bton te shes rab kyi pha rol tu sbyin pa don gyi brgyud pa gtang nas/ dbang gi chu bo dang bka' bzhi'i phyag dpe snyan brgyud dang bcas pa gnang ste/ nga dang mnyam pa kun dga' tsam/thur la 'bab pa chu bo tsam/ mkha' la 'char ba nyi zla tsam gsung / gyis dam pa mya ngan las 'dang khar yang / nyi ma nam mkha'i dkyil du nub/rgyud ngan po tsho las byed 'phro la lus pa cig rmis/ ma 'i ma tsa ra cig la ngan gsung / 'o na rten 'brel cig mtshang par zhus pas/ ya stags su kun dga' khyod dgos pas 'dir shog gsung nas phyin pas/ rigs lnga spyi chings kyi phyag rgya kun dga'i gnas lngar bzhag nas/ nyi ma nub kyang zla ba bags kyis 'char bar gda'i gsung / der dam pa dang lo bco brgyad 'grogs/ de rting lo bzhi'i bar du pa tshab dgon pa la gdams pa rnams gnang / de rjes su lo gsum bzhugs te shing pho 'brug gi lo la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ de yang mya ngan las 'da' khar gtsug tor ging gi rtse la dbu che thams cad tshogs pa'i sar/ mi shes dri ma rnam byang bshad rgyud kun la mkhas/ blo ldan sgrub brgyud dka' thub rnam gsum mtha' ru gyin/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams tshar gcig ba gas 1076

nas de nub rang la mkha' spyod du gshegs / de'i slob ma ba tshab sgo lapa na/ 'phan yul smad kyi g.yung po rtar mib pa tshab ston 'bum grags dang /yum gami mo dpal 'dren gnyi gyi za su mi mi bal la 'khrungs/ lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe reb gong gnas chung du po ) ba'i slob ma sgro chung ba las rabangatu byung / g.yas 'dul banga'adzin pa la 'dul ba bslabs/ bcu dgu la khong ṣ+ka ra bsnyen par rdzogs de nas bo to ba'i drung du byon 'jugab byang chub mchog tu sem bskyed/ bka' gdams kyi lam rim ga na/ stod lungs rgya da ra dbu tshad 'grelachung gsan/ pa tshab 'o tsā la byams tshas bslab phyogs gsan/ 'brom byang chub sems dpa' la mngon pa gong ma/ yong ge dbang phyug grags la zangs dkar luṭa kyi bde mcho ga na/ de rang thos bsam yang de tsam yin/ da sgrub pa cig bya dgos pas gad sa ngag su che dris ba skam sgom che zer/ sngar po to ba'i gsung la kyang shes rab kyi pha ro tu gyin pa'i man ngag yang dag pa cigabla ma rnam ma gi la yod par snang ga zhung ba de ming dran nas/ pha rol tu gyin ba'i gzhung 'di tsam zhig mngon par rtog pa'i rgyan gyi mig gye ba bzhin du song 'duganye/ 'di rang la mang sngags dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa non po cig 'ong thang ba bsam pa byung chus skam gyi sar byon/ khong gi skabs brgyad stan thog gcig tu ngo sprad pa'i gdam pa de gnang bas mun khung du sgron me btegapa 'dra ba cig byung der nges shes skya nas chos 1077

'di'i bdag po su yin byas pas/ 'di ngas dam pa sangs rgyas zer ba'i grub thob cig la zhus pa yin/ khong rgya nag tu bzhud/ da lta deng ri na phebs 'dug gam zer te nga gis pas mi thon/ khyed rang gzhon par 'dug pas der byon na mjal 'ong ngam gsung bas/ pha zhing gser g.yu dang dar zab tu bsgyur nas byon pa la lam du grogs med pas ring rab 'gor/ ding rir phebs pa'i nub mo tsha khung du bzhugs/ nang par snga bar byon nas gtsug tor sgang gi rtse nas gzigs pas khrom chen po tshogs 'dug pas dam pa bzhugs pa yin te 'ong snyam nas nyal thabs su byon pa na/ khrom gyi sar ma sleb tsam na du ba sngo reng gis byung bas der sprang mo cig 'dug pa la ci yin dris pas dam pa'i gdung bzhu ba'i du ba yin zer bas/ der gas grags pas ring zhig tu brgyal/ de sangs tsa na sprang mos dbu pang du blangs 'dug mang du bshums pas sprang mo de na re/ slob dpon ston pa du mi 'tshal/ dam pa grongs kyang dam pa nyid dang mnyam pa'i dbu che mang spu bzhugs/ khyed rang gi dgos don grub ste mchi zer/ shar phyogs pha gi na dam pa phyar chen po bya ba khyed rang dang rten mthun pa cig bzhugs der byon dang zer bas/ ga le byon pas yang spang mo de brgyugs byung nas/dbus pa ston pa/ khyod phyar chen gyi bur mi 'dug dam pa kun dga'i bur 'dug pas rdo spyil pha gir song zhig zer nas der phyin/ sgo rtsa nas skyabs su mchi'o byas te phyag mang du btsal bas/ kun dga'ang ci nas1078

spyan btsum 'dug pa phye ste/ cher gyis gzigs nas g.yas mo dpal 'dren gyi bu bshul lam la 'o ma brgyal lam gsung / der mngon par shes pa mnga' bar shes nas dad pa rgya chen po skyes te byin rlabs kyang der zhugs/de nas byang chub sems dpa' la gser gyi ma la phul nas/ bdag bsags nga chung bas dam pa dang ni ma mjal/ bla ma khyed kyis thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ rten ma smin pa smin par byed pa la dbang dgos gsung /khyed la cha rkyen 'dra bdog ge gsung bas/ gser srang gcig dang dar yug gcig phyag tu phul bas rten 'brel bzang / do nub sa phug dkar por nyol la sang 'dir byon gsung bas/ sang de byon pa na glegs bam bshams nas thugs dam la bzhugs 'dug der glegs bam gyi dbang bskur/ de rdzogs pa dang bla ma byang chub sems dpa'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags dang pha rol du phyin pa gnyis las gsang sngags pa smin lam dbang bskar nas grol lam rjes la ston pa yin/ 'ji smin grol dus gcig la storno pa sngon chad gzhan la ma grags pa ma tsa ra nag po'i khyad chos dbang gi chu bo bzhi bsgril yin pas/ de rang gis chog par mi gad 'a 'am gsung /chog par gda' lags zhus/ der lo gcig la blo sbyong tshar te/ de nas dbus su 'gro bar zhus pas da dung rgyags grabs gyis la lo gcig tu mtshams chod gsung nas lam lnga'i bsrangs nas bton/ de tshar ba'i dus su kun dga'i zhal nas/ bu khyed sngar yang mkhyen pa can du 'dug1079

da reg kyang lam dka' ba spyad nas 'dir 'ongs/ thams cad kyi gdams ba yang btab/ khyed rang gis nyams su blangs pa la rga ched dang 'dir 'ongs bas bogs thon lugs nyams rtogs shar sugag 'dra spro med dam shod dang gsung bas/ ma gir gi chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar go ste/ rjes su dbag pa'i lam mun khung gi lag par 'dug 'dir chos nyid dbang po'i mngon sum du shar bas rtogs pa'i mtha' chod pa cig byung zhus pas lemakha so gnang / dbu thog na zhobatabu cig btags 'dug pas/ 'di na tsha bzang po yod de/ la stod na myong shes pa med gsung nas de yang pa tshab la gnang / sna mar gyi thel la kha gye gsung nas der byon nas gziṭa pas/ thog mar zug pa'i rtsa ba'i chos sde zhus lan dgu de nas 'grel ba sdong po'i chos don rgyud skor gsum/ de 'og nas gyes ba yal ga'i chos mtshon dpe dang brul tsho/ de'i 'og nas lo 'dab kyi chos sdo bcu drug de'i 'og nas mdzes pa me tog gi chos sde lnga/de'i 'og nas 'bras bu'i chos sde ā ji kā 'i phyi nang gsang gsum rnams byung / de nas bla ma la gtad pas tsha khyod rang 'tsho gsung nas dpe shu gu dang bcas pa gnang / de nas lo gcig gi bar du dag khrid rnams zhus/ dri bas 'phra bcad de yi gi la btab ba rnams la 'phra tig tu btags/ bu chen gzhan rnams la yang gdams pa'i 'phra bcad de zin bris su btab nas 'phra gcod du btags/ de nas ding ri rang du bzhugs 1080

par zhus pas/ dbu cu ba cud pa rang 'thad/ khyed kyi ma yang nga'i bu de shi ba yin la che zer nas ngu zhing 'dug byon pa rang 'thad gsung /der sgrub pa lo bcu gnyis kyi dam bca' phul bas rten 'brel gyi khang par bcug dpe mas cad kyang gnang / dpe 'di rnams bsdoms la chu bo chen po'i g.yas 'gram nas dbe bdag cig 'ong bas de la gtad par mchi gsung / rgyags lhag gi gser zang gsum phul bas/ ā tsa ra'i brgyud pa la gser gyis dgos pa med kyang khyed tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir blang ngo gsung nas nam mkha' la gtor/ 'byon khar bdag la lam dang sgrub pa'i dus su bar chad med pa cu rgyas pas zil gnon gyi rdo thing ril dang rdo nag po 'dre 'ded gnyis gnang / byang chub gyi sems dang ma bral bar bla ma la gsol ba thob gsung nas skyel thung mang mdzad/ de nas mar byon te lo gsum gyi bar du brgyud pa dang po dang bar pa'i chos btsal zhing sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen bsag / de rting de gong du gnas chung du sgrub pa lo bcu gsum mdzad/ sgrub pa tshar nas gzhan don mdzad pa ni gdams ngag gi snyan pa che bas 'khor yang mang du 'dus pa la/ byang pa bon sgom bya ba mtshan nyid dus kyi zhar chos kyi slob dpon yin pa zhig la gdams pa byin pas gnam mtsho la bzhud nas mkha' spyod du gshegs/ pa tshab sgom nag la gdams pa byin pas rgya nag tu bzhud pas rgya bod mtshams su gshegs nas sku 'bum sogs kyang yod/ bu skang sgom pa bya ba ka ba li gdang gshibs 1081

shan pas de la gdams pa byin pas khong yang mi nyag rgyal po'i mchod gnas la brgyad/ de la brten nas nag khrid zhus lan gyi skor gyis byang khams khyab/zhang nga rnal 'byor ba bya ba khong rang gdams pa'i bdag po yin kyang pa tshab sgom nag dang mjal bas chos la dung dung langs nas de la gdams pa byin pas grub thob tu gyur te/ lo brgya dang bco brgyad thub/ ston pa'i 'khor yang chos mkhas pa'i mthar thug chu mig ring mo pa rgya grags pa song / btsun pa'i mthar thug thang sag ston tshul/ mi che ba'i mthar thug zhang g.yu sgro lha khang pa/ mkhyen pa che ba'i mthar thug rngog ge ser te/ de rnams la gdams pa byin pas 'khrul zhig tu gyur/ sku bgres khar byon pa'i slob ma ni/ gshen sgom re thul can zhes bya ba gdams pa btab pas 'khrul ba zhig ste/ khams su byon nas phung po lhag med du song / /'bro sgom bsod nams byang chub la mkha' 'gro ma bdud rtsi bum pa'i sgrub pa byin pas gtad med du grol nas mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mkha' spyod du spyan drangs/ /u rgyan ras pa zhes bya ba sngags kyi gdams pa mkhas pa cig byung ba la lam gsum gyi khrid mdzad pas shes rgyud grol nas rten 'brel shar te mngon shes bshad pa cig byung / chig brgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus pa rdzogs pa ten ne+e rnams so/ /de la pa tshab kyis sum cu rtsa bdun pa chu mo sbrul yan chad du thos 1082

bsam mdzad/ de rting shing pho rta nas sgom pa la zhugs/ lo zhe gcig pa me mo bya la ding rir byon/ lo bzhir byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la sogs pa'i bu chen rnams la gdams pa zhus/ lcags mo glang la dbus su byon nas sgrub pa lo bcu gsum mam/ zhib mo dar tshags ltar na lo bcolnga mdzad/ bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa lcags pho rta la ten nis sleb/ ten sa so gnyis bzhes shing pa tshab rang gis brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa sa pho stag gi lo la gshegs/ de'i slob ma rgyal ba ten de ni/ gtsang gi shab sgo lnga nas yul 'phos te yar mnga' nub kyi chu 'khor du gnas bcas pa'i jo sras skyab be bya ba dang / yum 'tshur mo gza' mang skyid gnyis kyi sras su me mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ lo ngo gsum tsam lon nas sngon gyi skye ba dran te nga mal brtson 'grus bla ma yin zhes gsungs/ so sku rings yar mdar byon pa la byin rlabs zhus pa dang / khong gi zhal nas/ jo mo'i sras po 'di la grub thob chen po cig 'ong bas nga'i brgyud pa 'dzin du gzhug dgos gsung nas/ thugs rje chen po'i rdzogs rim dang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung gnang / lo lnga pa la ra mo sman chu khar ras chung pa dang mjal bas kyang 'di la grub thob cig 'ong bas nga'i brgyud pa 'dzin du gzhug dgos gsung nas/ ti phu lugs kyi do ha gnang / lo bdun lon pa'i tshe yar mdar sgam po ba dang mjal bas sras 'di la grub thob cig 'ong bas tshar tsa na nga'i rjes la thong cig gsung nas phyag rgya chen po gnang / lo 1083

dgu la rnag tsho'i dbon po slob dpon sgom pa la sgrol ma'i 'don lung zhus pas las 'brel yod par 'dug gsung nas/ las kha tshar ba dang bcas pa rgyas pa dang jo po'i lugs kyi man ngag kyang gnang / lo bco lnga tshun du yab kyi chos ma gshen phur gsum dang / dpe srog gtsang gsum bslabs/lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bya sa'i rjo bo lha chen po dang lha btsun sngon mo gnyis kyi blon po lo gsum mdzad/ skye bo gso thigs sogs lugs kyi bstan bcos 'ga' gzung / nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la skye ba snga ma'i rang yul blta 'dod par byung nas yar 'brog la byon pas/ bya bral ba gzhan gnyis dang mnyam du byung gar 'gro zer bas skye ba snga ma'i yul sto brag rong yin pas ltar 'gro byas pas/ khong gnyis na re/ ya gi yar 'brog glang bu'i dgon pa na/ sprul sku jo sras la mchod gnas zhig po bzhi sde bya ba yod/ de'i nang nas smyon ma rgyal le lcam bya ba/ gtam mngon shernga su smra ba cig yod zer bas/ de bltar 'ded zer bas dgon pa ri di'u cig gi kha na 'dugakhong gsu gyis ri rtsar sleb pa na rgan mo thul gog gyon pa cig cu ra la brgyuṭa byung nas te de'i phyag la 'ju / ma ba jo jo ru 'dug ba/ te ni ru 'dug pa/ nga'i nu ma 'di las kyang nus dang / sto brag rong du ma 'gro/ snang khang 'khrug pas bzhig nas ga 'a ma med/ dbu ru byang phyogs na g.yas mo dpal 'dren gyi bu dang thud yod bas der song zer/khong gi ming 'jig rten grags yin pa la/ de nas te ge ru thoṭa/ der gzhan 10 4

gnyis kyis dris pas gtam lan kyang mi 'jal der yuladu byon nas 'byon dzil byas pas yab kyis ma btang / des snying ma dga' ste rmu mkhan gal te dgos kyi phyaṭa phyi la rlu yang blangs/ de nas 'bring cha ru ba la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs/ bstan rim slob dpon gra thang ba'i luṭa dang /bden gnyis dam pa chos sgro ba'i luṭa zhus/ de nas yab la gsangs nas kom la cig dar sham cig thod phor cig rnams khyer nas gra thang du gzims pas shes pa dga' ba'i tshad cig byung / de nas bye ma'i la bab tu ba zhuṭa pa'i nam phyed na sgom ma rgan mo de'i kha la gtad pa e cad kyang mi shes/ yod de shi yang 'o gnyis 'gyangs/ dbu ru'i chos pa mang mi mang 'di la g.yas me dbal 'dren gyi bu rtsad ga na chod/ yul du bzlog snyam nas sgrol ma tshar bdun bton nas nyal ba'i mnal zi ba cig la nam mkha' nas rkye rigs kyi bu/ blo ma log par song dang 'dod pa'i don grub thong cig zer nas mnal sad de nam mkha' la bltas pas yi ge tī ljang sngon cig skar ma ltar rgyang nge 'dug nas de sgrol ma'i lung bstan du shes/ de gyis pa tshab kyis kyang mkhyen byung / der bsam pa la/ slob dpon gal te dgos kyi yang bla ma spyan shā re bo bya ba gi byed mang du shes pa cig stod lungs na bzhugs pas der sna gtad nas 'byon snyam pa las/ yang thog mar 'phan yul mda' yab kyi slob ma bran ka lha bzo klu btsan grags bya ba la gtsang btsan gyi cho 'phrul gtong ba'i dpe cig yod pa de blangs nas/ de 1085

rjes bla ma btsal snyam nas 'phan yul mdar byon pas/ bran ka de jo mo ma gcig gi sgrol ma'i thang ska bri zhing 'dug pa la/ jo mo ma de na re/ jo sras g.yu ru ba dbu kyi gtso mo 'di ma yin pa'i mtha'i lha ngang pa zhon pa la soṭa pa 'di rnams khyed kyis e shes zer bas/ 'di rnams ches shes byas nas rnam dag gtsug nor bton pas/ mo na re/ jo sras kyi de legs pa cig gnang / nga la de cis kyang slobs dang zer/ de'i lung med stod lungs su/ zhi byed ston pa'i bla ma cig gi sar 'gro dgos yong byari pas/ nga la zhang bo zhi byed mkhan po cig yod pas der bskyal gyis/nga la de cis kyang slobs zer/ su'i lugs yin byas pas byang chub sems dpa' kun dga'i lugs yin zer/ 'o na khong gi ma'i ming shes sam byas pas/ shes ches shes g.yas mo dpal 'dren bya ba lags zer/ der shes pa dga' yal te song nas/ byin rlabs kyang dus de nyid du zhugs de nub 'od kyi gong bu sran ma tsam cig lce thog tu byung ba myangs pas ro mchog khyad par du 'phags shing mid pas lus thams cad 'od du song nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba cig rmis/ nang par jo mo mas dgon pa ston tu phyin/der bla mas mkhyen te ma zad du byon nas mdun bsus/ jo sras yar mda' ba de ring rtol lam 'ongs pa de dga' 'o/ khyed bzhi nang nas 'byon thad pa la gsung / der bdag la dam pa kun dga'i luṭa kyi gdams pa zhu 'tshal byas pas/ khyed rang byon pa de legs chos kyang bya yi gsung / de 1086

ga ci/ byang chub sems dpa'i lugs kyi rgyud ma smin pa la yan tan gyi rtsi mi 'byar bas ā li'i kā li'i byin rlabs bya dgos/ de la khyer la cha rkyen che bdog gsung / da lan ma tshol du 'ongs ba yin/ yul nas cha rkyen blangs la 'ong zhus pas/ bdud kyi las che shos snyi zhol yin pa da lta rang bya dgos/ cha rkyen ye rang med dam gsung bas/ der ko jil cibatagi khar thod pa bzhag dar kha gang khab mig la rgyus te thod bar bcug nas phul bas jo sras g.yu ru ba'i rgyagatarten gyi la nye dang sbyar na chas zab mo sbyin pa'i sgod du ni rung / dad can gyi lam sna yang 'grongs te zang zing gi sku bsod chen po ni mi 'ong gsung nas glogs ngam bsham / byin rlabs mdzad pas mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can cig dus de rang du shar/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ngo bo'i mthong tshul de rang lags kyang / lam rtags dang yon tan kyang dgos pas zhagatabadun gyi bar du zung long la/ rtagaso ma byung gi bar du 'bungasagasum thon gsung bas/ sngar gyi jo mo ma des bar chad byas pas blo sbyong zla ba brgyad du 'gor/ de nas bla ma la tshes 'di 'angadape 'dra ba bdog gam zhus pas/ a tsho ra rig ba dri med du dzo sprad nas brjen ba rang skyong ba yin pas dpe mi 'tshal/ bla ma'i phyag bzhes lta 'tshal bas cha rkyen bgangatsam tshol dang gsung ba sa byang du byon nas rnyed pa shogasngon po ti gnyis dang mdzo mo drug rnyed nas zhog sngon — dang mdzo mo drubartobla ma la phul/ mdzo gnyis la cha rkyen byas te lo gcig tu 1yi87

lam lnga'i khrid bskyangs/ dbang rnams zhus/ de'i bar du bla ma'i gsung thams cad zin bris su byas te zhib mo dar tshags su btags/ de nas chos tshan rnams bka' babs dang dri med dang / snyan brgyud dang do ha'i skor dang bzhir phye nas dpe rnams kyang rim gyis gnang / rten 'brel gyi chos skor nas be'u bum cig phye ste/ 'di sna tshogs ju 'phrul gyi skor bya ba yin/khyed rnal 'byor pas mi srol/ dpe zur byi bas zos 'dug pas lag len yang mi btub par 'dug gsung nas ma gnang / der nag khrid kyi dpe'i zhus dag dang dri ba'i 'phra gcod pa la lo gcig 'gor/ der yul du 'byon par zhus pas ma gnang bar/ da dung gdams pa'i zur gso dgos/tshags kyang bsdom dgos/ slob rim gong ma rnams dang yang 'dris par bya dgos gsung nas lo gcig bzhugs/ der gal te dgos byon nas gdams pa zhus pa la ma gnang bar khong gi sems bsrung ba'i phyir stod lungs su byon nas smon lam 'bar dang spyan sha re bo la yang chos zhus/ 'phan yul gnyaṭa chung ba dang zhang nga sgom chen gnyis la yang chos zhus pas lo bzhi song ba na bla ma'i zhal nas/ jo sras g.yu ru ba'i lam dka' thub kyi bzangs dngapo de bzang por thal/ da ni yar mda' gtsang khar bzhud ran gsung nasadabu che rnams kyang 'tshogs/ lo brgya nyer gcig thub/ bu tshe'u de'u na mar la grub thob mang po 'ong bar lung bstan/ sgrub pa dka' thub kyi dam bca' lo bdun phul/ chos kyang zhu tshar la ster ba'i zhu ba lan bdun phul/ sgru ba 1088

pa'i dam bca' de bas ring kyang mi sto ste/ khyed rang khas ma tshugs na thun mong gi chos rnams legs su shod/ chos bdag mi pher ba la bka' bzhi'i gdams pa ma byin/ 'gro don tshe 'dir mi 'ong ba'i lag tu rten 'brel ma gtong / sgrub pa'i dam bca' mi 'bul na rten 'brel gyi khang par ma gzhugaslob ma ngo che dbral drag byung na/ phyag rgya chen po rin po che'i skor gyis sems gzung / rgas khar legs par 'ong cig de'i bar la sto gos kyis ma gyid pa byung na rten 'brel gyi sna kha 'dra ba bsgyur gsol/ lar 'khor bzhir longs yan chad gyi tshogs dpon ma mdzad par sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du gyis la sgrub pa la rem cig gsung nas/ te sa yar mdar byon to/rtses thang gi ban rgan sgom grags pa blo sbyong gi bzlas lung byin pas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags byung nas khong dga' ste zhabs tog byed par khas blangs/rtses thang gi spe'u cig la sgrub pa lo bdun mdzad pa la lo gnyis song ba na pa tshab grongs par thos te gdan sar yug cig byon/ de nas 'dag 'byar lo gnyis song ba dang yab grongs pa'i 'ded kyi ltad mo la yug cig byon/ de nas lo gsum du sgrub pa mdzad pas lam gyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs kyang /phyi nang grub thob kyi snyan pa che yang dngos su gdu la bya la phan thogs chung chung las ma byung ba de sgrub pa dka' thub de dum bu gsum du chad pas lan pa 'dra gsung / lam rtags kyi yon tan rdzogs kyang phal cher mi gsung /'ga' zhig zhig po la gsungs/ grong du 'jug pa yang rgyas te rngog jo sras 1 glu

kyi chos rang grong 'jug gi ltad mo bstan/ de chas spyod spubaskyang ba'i gyir cu khan pa'i cha phyugs su byas nas lo drug du thu blangs/ de nag sa'i jo bo lha chen po dang lha btsun sngon mo dang jo bo bye'u chung ba gsu gyi gros mdzad nas rab byung gi na bza' gsol te chos spu'i slob dpon du mnga' gsol phal cher sku mtshams mdzad de dam pa'i gsung la bshad 'bum mang du brtsams/ der rngo zas na mkha' la brgyud pa gtad par da ngas pa la gzhon pa la grongs/ gzhon pha ma tshe bya ba rlung gis khyer nas kong por song nas shi gdams pa che ba'i snan pas dbu gsor gyi mi chen mang pos zhu ba phul ming / bla ma'i bka' rgya bsrung bas gdams pa ma gnang / gzhan gdams pa gnang ba'i slob ma ngam shod kyi gtsang po drug btsun tho dang yum bu drug dge bshes drug sngaṭa spra drug khyim pa dad pa can drug bla ma'i bka' rgya mi bsrung ba'i chos 'tshong ba'i tshong dpon drug ste sum cu rtsa drug yod/ gong ma sum cu la tshig rgyud med la/ 'og ma drug la dbang bka' med pas thams cad la chos bdag ma btub/ de nas bla mas lung bstan pa'i chos bdag rog shes rab 'od kyis bar klungs su byon nas zhus pa dang / gyis 'jad du spyan drangs nas zhus pa'i du su zhig po nyi ma seng ge dang sku mched gnyis ka la gnang nas chos kyi bdag por gsol/ yar klungs cu chos grwa'i slob dpon yang g.yeng bar da ngas na bor/ cha lug kyang ci dgar mdzad nas bzhugs/ mar stod du na me

byon nas bos mo'i ri la dpe kha cig gter du sbas/ yang gnas chung dge bshes bya bas gdan drangs nas gnas chung dang gser lhar ba zhugs/ deng yang dpe rnams shan thog gi brag la gter du sbas/ gong po ri dang sham bu la yang dpe gter 'ga' zhig sbas/ de nas zhig pos rgyal khamazasa'akhor te te ne+e gser lha na bzhugs pa la phyag skyel du byon pas/ bla ma'i zha'akhanas zhig po byon pa de dga'/ nga gnas chung dge bshes kyis 'dir bos naba'osto ma byin par sdug bsod btang / da khyod kyis nga grar khridagasung nas spyan chab mang du bsil/ der zhig pos bdag rgyal khams skor can rings pas gzhi na tig po med/ yul du phyin grabs byas nas gzod bla ma sbyan 'dren du 'ong zhus pas/ bu khyod dam tshig can yin pas tshig thog tu 'chag ste 'ong / byung na da lan rang khrid na dga' ba 'dug gsung / de nas zhig pos yul du byon nas zhing bzang po ci ga yod pa btsongs rin mar dang nas su blang nas bla ma spyan 'dren du byon/ grar phebs nas gan ji rigs su bzhugs/ der yang zhabs tog 'dires gsol ba la baspyod/res na bza' la bkyon pas shin tu dga' bar byung ste/ dad snang bzod par byas/ sku tshe'i mthar spyan yang 'gribs/ de nas dgu bcu rtsa gcig bzhes pa me mo glang gi lo brag sgom chen mor gshegs nas gdung rnams ma 'thor bar mchod rten zhig bzheng nagade'i nang du bzhugs su bcug ste da lta yang ma nyams par bzhugs so/ de yang rtag tu ngu cho 'a ga btsaming1091

ban na ma ma/pa' ye shes zhes bya ba mkhyen pa dang nus par ldanapa zhig byung ba'i gsung rab thams cad du sngags 'chad khyad par can sha stag byung ba'i nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la rog shes rab bla ma zhes bya ba go rub yang dag dang dpal lha ri ba'i slob ma rdo rje phur bu'i thugs dam can des bam sgrub cig mdzad pa yang legs nas brgyud pa brgyad du skyes bu khyad par can 'byung bar lung bstan thob pa zhig byung ba de lcags pho rta la 'khrungs nas brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa chu mo sbrul la gshegs/ /de'i sras bkra shis grags pa zhes bya ba yab kyi mkhyen pa rnams lobs pa'i sngags 'chang de di sa pho rta la 'khrungs/ sa rta 'di rgya ma dpon ston 'khrungs pa'i lo de yin/ lo bzhi cu rtsa dgu la gshegs/ de dang yum chos kyi dge gnyis la sras grub thob kyis gzhan don du skye ba blangs pa'i sku mched gsum yod pa las/che ba shes rab 'od ni rgya gar shar phyogs kyi pazlo ta chen po shes rab grub ces bya ba'i skye ba yin te/ 'di mi pho khyi la 'khrungs/ lo lnga la mes po shes rab bla mas yig rtsis bslabs/ lo bdun pa la klog mkhas par gyur nas nyin gcig la nyi khri tshar gcig thon/ yab yid ma ches pas bsnan nas bton pas thon nas/ yab kyis thal mo sbyar/ de nas bcu'i bar du yab mes gnyis la gsang sngags kyi chos rnams bslabs/ der yab kyis bu la mthu yod pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas bcu nas bcu gsum gyi 1093

par du phur ba'i brnyed pa mtsham byas na skyol du bcug grub rtag kyang khu du byung / khyad par rdo rje phur bu'i sga yongs rdzogs zhin tā ga ma ba cig mngon sum du gzigs/ zhal nas/cu ngas gī la ya'i bsnyen spa sgoms te nga'i lus lcags kyi gong bu bzhin du gyur na yod pas/ da lta khu can stong gis bskor yang nga rang lta ci smos te 'khor rnams la'ang 'khu mi su po yin gsung / bcu gsum pa la rog ston btsan bo yab la bskul bas yab kyis khong gi sar slob gter la brdzang nas lo gnyi la cag kyi mdo sgro rtsems gsum/ sgrugathab rnam gsum/ ma ro ga nga skor bra ma la zhi byed yas brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams gas zhib mkha par gyur/ rog ston klu sbyin rkye ya'i sbyangangathabs mang po dang /gyi 'a gas skor 'gyur gsar dang / bde mchog mar do lugs7rnams gsan/ dgung lo bco lnga la lhab dres ma gong ba la mdo sgyu skyo lugs dang byung gyirgyud bu chung drug snga 'gyur gyi rgyud lnga/ bdud rtsi khams lugs/ rta ma na lha bzhi/ sgron sprul la so gas zhus/ bcu drug pa ra bangachag nas lcags kyi tshems tshabababacug ba mkhas pa lcags so can du grags/ slob dpon yam shud dngos grub la mdo sgyu zur lugs bcu drug na nyi shu'i bar du gsan nas dan chags tshe bar mdzad/ der tshog sprangarnams kyis sus kyang rtsod pa ma thub pas sngar mtshan rgya mon zer ba la/mi shud kyis shes rab 'od du btags/ bcu bdun pa la skyang po dar 1094

ma grags la 'jam dpal ga pa'i chos bzhi dang ṣ+ṭṛ rti'i chos drushangagasan/ bco brgyad pa la sgyu 'phrul lam rim gyi ṭ+wāṃ ka dang gzhi bye'i 7gyi stong rgyan brtsams/ bcu dgu pa la rtsang du blon nas thog mar lha na dar so dar nga dang mjal du byon pas/ mjal ba tsam gyis shin tu dad bar gyur nas yang dag gi chos dang bdud rtsi dang / rdzogs chen sgang dril dang mdo sgyu mtshan ma dang / mngon pa'i sdon bslab phyogs dang bcas pa ga na/de'i zur chos pa lang ston jo bad la mngon pa kun las btus/ phur ba skyi lugs/ myang stod du rgya bsod nams 'bar la bdud rtsi rgya lugs/snye brag nub kyi 'phrang du bla ma rgya seng dkar la bdud rtsi/ myang nagamado po la mdo / slob dpon dpon zlos la phyag rgya chen po mdzod/ slob dpon rjo dar la rdzogs chen klong chen/ gtsang nag brtson 'grus nga ge tshad ma bsdus pa dang / 'bum pa'i lugakha kyi sdud pa/ grub thob dngos grub la thugs rī chen po skor gsum/ phyis lha rje so'i sar bzhu'akho pa na yang kyis rgyags skyel du byon pas phyogs ngan dang thug ste/ yab grongs/ de'i mya ngan gyis bsnyung / cha rkyen lhag gang yod yab kyi phyosha su btang / de nas dbus su blon nas grwa thang du phebs/ yab gshegs/yum dang gcung po yang cha phra ba skyo ba skyes nas khams su bzhud par dgong pha la/ yab tshan la thog mkhakun gyis gros btab nas khams su 'byon pa shol nas che 'don byas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig nar 〉na bshad sgyun mi 3

mong du mdzang/ de phyin chad nas bla ma mang po la gsan pa myo dzad de/dge bshes tha' bzhi la phar phyin dang dbu tshad gsan/ nā ro'i thabs lam rgyas pas myong ba khyad par can skyes nas gdams ngag la 'phrig tshud/lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa las bdag gi rtog gzhi byung bas / gru go cha'i tsha 'o gru rnam grags bsam yas bltar byon pa la/ gru'i shog dril zab mo rnams zhus/ rme khar ru sgang du sku mtshams mdzad pas rtog gzhi rnams mgo non/de nas stod lungs su ba ri la don rgyud zhur byon pas khong mtshams bsdams pa dang thug zhong pa stengs ngu rgyal ba dkon skyabs kyi gar byon nas spru ba seng ge'i don rgyud zhus pas/ dang po gdams pa la rtseg gi byung /hin cig chos kyi smad kyi gleng mo dpon slob rtsod pa shor bas jo sras 'brog po na re/ dge bshes 'di gtsang sil ma la man chad na chos mkhas par grags/ slob dpon gyis ga na thub byas pas/ de ltar yin par ma shes bzod par gsol lo gsung nas gdams ngag rnams lhug par gnang /skam gyi gdam pa dang / rma'i thun bcud/ 'brom ye shes 'bar gyi mtshan brjod gser thur gas zhi byed kyi gdams pa mang du zhus/ nad gzhi la yang phan pa byung / de ra zla ba gsum bzhugs/ de'i sang phod dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i rgyal gyis nya ba'i mtshan mo thun bcud kyi tshul du nyams su blangs pa'i tshe rtogs pa'i ye shes snyin ci ma log pa thugs la 'khrungs/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ming tsam du grol bar gyur/nya96

de nas ngam skad rgya ras la phyag rgya chen po'i khrid/ ka ba can pa'i don rgyud/ thabs lam tshigs bcad ma/ mgul sgom gyi thabs lam rnams zhus/ de'i tshe rkyen drag po la rtsa ba'i don dran pa tsam gyis gsal thebs par byung yang lung ma bstan gyi shes pa lam du ma chud/ rig pa bzhi thog nas ma thegs pas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad lon pa'i tshe 'chus pa dar brtson gshegs kyang / gong gi sras 'chus pa brtson 'grus seng ge la gdams ngag dang rtogs pa yab dang mnyam par yod zer nas sdom bu ba'i cha byad kyis chang khyim du byon/ dang po'i lo la rma so skam gsum gyi lung nod zhus nas nan tan cher mdzad/ rgyal ba dkon skyabs dang rtsa ba'i ngo sprod la khyad mi 'dug na'ang / nyams len bsrangs su 'dzud lugs dang bshad pa'i byan 'chus pa mkhas par 'dug grar dge bshes bag chags rjes med kyi 'dad kyi gral dpon la 'chus pa byon pa la/ slob ris yon bdag thams cad la gral skal nas bsnyen bkur byas pas/ khong dgyes nas na ning chos lhag ma rnams kyi zhabs tog byed pas skyel thung la gshegs par zhu zer nas phyags phyir byon/ de res gdams pa'i lhag ma rnams zhus/khyad par so lugs la nan tan mdzad/ sher phyin gyi brgyud pa gtad nas dka' thub kyi phyogs lo gsum bskur/ so lugs la sngar ma gnang ba'i gdams pa zab mo yod par dgongs nas zhus pas de res ma gnang / phyi sa rngal 'byor skyi shod nas byon pa'i lam gyi mgo 'don gyis gsung ba'i 1097

zin byung ba sa slob dpon rnal 'byor la sna len bzang po mdzad de lhan cig tu byon pos gdams pa gnang / gzhan yang zhi byed sgrol ma'i skor dang /sgron ma'i skor dogu dang / lugs ljang lugs la sogs pa thams cad gnang rte/ da nga dang khyed la zhi byed la mkhas mi mkhas khyad par cung zad kyang med do gsung / de nas skam lugs kyi sgrub pa lo gsum po mdzad bar da ngas te/ dngos po thams cad btang ste gsol zhal tsam yang ma lu par mdzad pas/ slob dpon skem zhud cung ma dmis pa la mgur mdzad bas spyan chab sil de byung / de nas rtse ba sgang gi dbus khang du ma ga sumanga'adag labyang dang 'tsho ba bcud len/ na bza' bems po/ cad mdzad na nyam su bla nga bas lam rtags dang rdo rus phrad de za pa'i rgyug da/ zla ba gcig gi bar du nyin mtshan med pa'i snang bar shar/ spyir rna dang por yi da lha'i zhal gzig / bar du mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan thob/ mar ga da na las la 'khol/ de nas sum rtso thol tshang zhig bo dang ma la te/ khong sku nas shin tu byon pa sgom ma gnyi kyi ga sa g.yon rnazakhring na pa/ bdud rtsi skyug btsags mdzadalag gsol ba/ sku shin tu mdzes skang zhal 'dzum pa zhig 'dugapa ma nga bskotsu gyis tha mal gyi snang ba 'argyur/ rgyag dang zhe sa sogs kyang ji ltar bya gtol med bar gyur/ bdud rtsi gsol 'phro de nas gnang byung glegasol bas thu lu mas cad ba do bas gang / mi spobs bzhin du

chos kyi dri mal byas pas/ ngas chos sngar bslabs kyang bslabs/ shes kyang shes/ nyams su yang blangs pa la/ da nga la chos dang chos ma yin pa khyad par med/ khyed la chos nyan pa'i rna ba med par ngas bshad mi shes pas 'di tsam zhig khyer gsung nas phyag g.yon pa'i sen mo la rnal 'byor ma'i sku byon pa zhig kyang gnang / der dge sdig dang / spang gnyen dang / mnyam rjes su 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa thams cad dag sngar 'chus pa'i sar bzhugs tsa na te rna gdams pa can yin par thos nas bya sa'i jo bo rnal 'byor gyis 'bri khung chos rje dang rgya mo rin chen sgang pa spyan drangs pa'i tshe de rnams kyi zhal bltar byon pas de'i tshe te no dang mjal/ thun mong gi brgyud pa dri med gsum gnang / khong gi zhal nas/ chos 'di la dbang la sogs pa shin tu mang bar yod/ da yul du spyan drongs der chos tshar ba bya/ nga dang khyed la las 'brel cig kyang yod par 'dug gsung / bdag rnal 'byor par song nas gzhi med pas gdan mi 'drongs zhus pas/ da gcig po las ni mi yong cis kyang gdan drongs/ bka' srungs kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnam kyang gsung 'byon par 'dug pas chos rnams tshar bar bya gsung / nya drug ba la gdan 'dren pa'i dus byas/ de nas yang skyi tshang du byon nas mtshan brjod dam pa'i lugs la sogs pa dang /gcod brul tsho drug pa la sogs pa zhus/ de yang sngar brul tsho gsum laso galhan la mi gnang ba la/ rog la drug ka tshang bar gnang / bla ma 1 mi

bgres ches rnga/sa zhib tshegs mang po sras mo skal lngan la zhus de nas rtse sgang du phebs pa na sngar dam bca' dka' thub mthar ma skyol ba'i skyon gyis shangs khrug zhag bdun du shor/ sman dang rim gro ci byas kyang ma phan pa la/ spyir bla ma rnams la mos gus byas/ khyad par so dar ma seng ge dran pa cig byung bas/ dar ma seng ge ber sngon gyi na bza' gsol ba cig mdun gyi bar snang la byon nas phyag gis smin mtshams su reg par snang ba cig byung bas khrug 'ol kha bsgyur ba bzhin du chad/ de nas yang rog ston btsan po gshegs pa'i rjes 'dur gyis te rna spyan 'dren pa'i dus de yol/ de nas bang rim na bzhugs tsa na rmi lam du bud med 'gron bu'i rgyan can cig na re/ rgyal ba te ne+e khyed kyi gdan 'dren sgug gi 'dug zer/der mi bzhi gdan 'dren du btang bas rje btsun 'on mdar yon bdag lcags 'bar gyi sar bzhugs pa dang mjal te dgyes par gyur/ de nub dpe dgos pa rnams khong rnams la bskur nas nang par de kha yar byon/rgyabs su yar chen re'u dges gzhi byas nas dbang gnang ba'i tshe zhig po yang byon nas/ ā li kā li'i dbang yon mchod bzhi bcu tsam gyis zhus/de nas bang rims su bteg nas bka' babs dri med la sogs pa thun mong gi chos rnams zla ba gsum gyi bar du gnang / yang phyis phebs te de res tshogs cig kyang zhoms dang / chos 'dra ba bya rgyu yod gsung nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa rgyud stong thun dang bcas/ dbang lam khrid dpa 1100

bcas pa gnang / sngon chad ma grags ji/'i gdams pa zab mo 'di kho bo la bka' babs kyang / bla ma'i bka' rgyas chig brgyud las ni sbyin dbang med/ chig rgyud ban ba sgom la gtad sa yin pa la grongs/ rtags dang yon tan bzang po byung / bu ni las su ma rung / khyed la brgyud pa gtad pa yin pas nga ma shi'i bar du khyed kyis gdams pa 'di 'dra ba 'dug bya ba mchu rtse la ma 'don/ nga shi nas khyed rang thugs tshod dang sbyor gsol gsung nas/ phyag dpe pod chung bcu drug dang bcas pa tsar tshangs su gtad/ phyi res byon pa'i tshe zhig po dang sgom pa sman gcig pa ston ba nam mkha' la sogs pas kyang gdams pa bag re zhus/ gzhan yang gi ma lugs kyi do ha dang / phyar chen gyi bka' cho lu'i skor/ phyar chung gi bka' rgyas pa'i skor/ badz+ra kro dha'i bsdus pa'i skor/ sog po mdo sde'i rma lugs dang bcas pa gnang / sku mda' kha'i dus su'ang gzhan gyi bu slob rnams las thugs la btags shing bla ma'i chos tshar ba gang yin dris pas/ de slob dpon shes rab las 'os ci yod/ khong gis rta stor bzhin du phyi rtsad bcad/ ba stor bzhin du nang rtsad bcad/ gdung sna bcar bkug ste 'og tu zhugs nas bsten pa yin ga sung / de ltar zhus pa des kyang sngar bas nyams thod rgal du skyes pa'ang ma byung ste/ rje dam pa rgya gar gyi thugs dgongs kyi phugs legs par 'khrungs te sems kyi zhus tig tshar ba cig byung / lo sum cu rtsa gnyis pa la gra phyi'i slob dpon ro 1101

snye gdan drangs te/ bde mchog lha bcu gsam ma dang ting bu'i do ha/lo ro ba'i bzhi chos/ 'pho bsre/ thun 'jog snyan brgyud yum skor/rnam 'joms kur lugs/ 'tshur gyi shog dril bzhi la sogs pa zhus/so ga ma pa la sman gcig tu lam bsrang mdzad/ so lnga pa la snye thang gi dar sgom zhig po la rgya gar shārnyi ba'i thig le sbrang 'jib kyi skor gyi dbang gdams rnams zhus/ so drug la mkhar chur byon nas khrug 'thung gi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs/ so dgu pa la dam pas sku'i snang ba bstan nas nyams nga ma gsungs/ bzhi bcu pa la rgyal tsha mdo dbang gis snye mdo phul ba bzhes nas/ gdan sa smra ba'i seng ge la gtad/ bzhi bcu rtsa ga sa pa la rtse sgang du bdud rtsi bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsis dpon slob tsho'i na bza' bangs pa tsam bab/ bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa la mya tig tu lha'i spyan gyi mngon shes ltar/ de nas tshes bo lung du bzhugs dus su grong ga ba cig tu byon pas mnga' ris ye shes grags kyi sras rdo rje grags dang ma la nas khong ston brgyud bab skor mkhan du 'dug pas yab skor dang mu skor brjes/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa na gzhan don bskangs/ te ni batshakhrinas pa dang bka' rgya grol te dge bshes khams pa shes rab brtson 'grus kyis yo bud mang po'i zhu rten dang tshogs bshams nas khyad par ba rnams gsungs/ de nas gnyan cha che bar byung bas gyis drug cu rtsa lnga pa na tshub kyang bags kyis chung bar gyur te snang / re brgyad pa la chos 1102

grwa chen sum cur bla la da kyi bar du chos kyi 'khor yo chen bo skor /dgung lo bdun cu rtsa dgu pa shing pho 'brug la gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pas bde mchog lhan skyes/ rdo rje rnala'abyor ma la sogs sku dang ring bsgrol mang du byon sgo/ de'i gcung po chos rje zhig po ni/ sku skye ba snga ma la mu rgyan gyi rgyal po chos kyi lha sa pa gsang sngags zab mo'i kun tu spyod pas dngos grub brnyes pa zhig yin/ de nas 'dir lcags mo yos gyi lo la 'khrungs/ lo ga thim lon nal 'khor ba'i rgyag bsngal dran/klog legs par mkhyen/ po lnga drug la sum gyi klog yon gsol/ lo bdun pa nas gsang spyod mdzad de shugs rdzu btab/ bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe kha rag grwa pa 'a dul ba 'od kyis chos gsungs pas chos bar sgos skyes pa mang po byung zer ba/ khong mas gzhan zhig tu btang nas chos bar ma sleb pas gtam de thos nos chos ba'i sa der mtshan mo byon/ bdag rda ring mi theb pa byas nas mang du bshums/ lang shu sbyog bcu'i ca mdzad rnams la phyag btsal bas gnas pa ga 'a ma cig der 'khyungs/bcu drug pa la yab gshegs pas gsang spyod grol te grong chog mang du byas zhing yum gyi zhabs tog byas/ bco brgyad yon pa'i tshe bya mo the ltag bya ba'i phug pa gcig tu gcig bur bzhugs pa na/ zin bya'i skad thos pas dang por yid ma bde / de nas yid ma bde ba'i ngo bo brtags pa rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i sems kyi ngo bo mngon sum du rtogs/ de nas gcen ཿzlo

ba'i sgrib pa de/ /da res dag pa'i rtags gsum byung / /rgyud nas bshad khu 'i lam rtags kun/ /bsgoms pa med kyang da res shar/ /rmi lam bag chags yin mod kyang / /bzlas su 'phangs pa'i ltas drug byung / /da chos zad blo zad kyi sgang po la/ /yi ge la dgos pa mi bdog kyang / /pha snyan brgyud kyi bkur ma ston par zhu/ zhes gsan mi gsan tsam du mgur blangs pas/ bla ma mnal sad pa ltar mdzad de/ spyir dam pa'i chos byed pa mang yang sgrub brgyud kyi gdams pa ma nor ba dang phrad pa nyung /gal te phrad kyang thog mar khrid tshar bar mi skyong bar la 'ur yi ge blta rings/ der rten 'brela'achugs nas brgyud pa gtad pa'i yul ma rnyed/rtags dang yon tan khyod la shar ba de rnams kho bos sngon la shes te/ da dung tshar ba'i rgyu yang med/ gal te tshar yang snyan brgyud kyi bkur ma sbyin du btub mi btub cha med/ 'di la bdag po de rtsi na cig kyang yod pas gros byed gsung nas/ yum lha mo bdag med man chad nas/ /pha drin chen pa tshab yan chad du/ /chig brgyud du byon pa'i gdams pa yin/ /rtogs ldan gyi brgyud pa zam ma chad/ /nyams kyi chu bo sbring ma yol/rtags yon tan shar ba 'ba' zhig yin/ /bka' babs bdag la bdog lags te/ /sbyin dbang skyes bu gcig las med/ /sngon chad 'dod pa mang lags kyang / khas blangs byas kyi zhe la bying / dpon slob mthun pa cig rkyang med/ /nga rnal 'byor gyi rang sa 'dzin 'dzin nas/ /dngos 1105

grub 'dre la zhu ma myong / /gsol ba lha lgo 'debs ma myong / /gsang tshig mchu sgor 'don ma myong / /spas pa mi la 'chad ma myong / /gdams ngag rgyal po'i dkor mdzod 'di/ /bu skal ldan cig dang phrad par zhogalar nga la chos la dam par grag /zhes pa'i mgur gsungs/ der kho bos kyang gsung la tshad mar gzung nas 'gran gyi do med du yang bltas/sgrub pa'i dam bca' yang phul/ tshul dang mthun pa'i bsnyen bgur yang byas pas/ bla mas kyang thugs la btags na chos thams cad tshang bar gnang gsung / bla ma mang du yod kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma te ne+e kho na mdzad de/ chos rje 'bri khung pas nga'i brgyud pa gzung gsung sang / bdag bla ma rnal 'byor pa cig gi brgyud pa 'dzin dgos par yod zhu / so gcig la 'gri khung du byon/ gnas po bab lhas kyang bsu ba bya / chos rje tshogs su byon pa dang mjal/ mkhan po dpal chen gur ba dang / slob dpon gtsang pa 'dul 'dzin dang / gsang ste pa lcags ri ba rnam las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan rin chen shes rab ② btags/ rin po che'i na ba 'a lha rdzas kyi dngos po rje nyid kyi sku la gsolate/ g.ya g.yon rgya mdu na bzhi nas gzigs/ sgon tu yang legs so gsung nas myag gi dbu la byugs/ gzhan yang sgo pa chan gcig pa la skabs dang cang dang 'tshal ba'i skor/ 'chus ba brtson seng la brgyud pa bar gzho dar seng la yang dag me gcig 'char bu rgya ras la sgo lugs dbang 1106

rab kyi chos/ ri khrod sbug ston la rje btsun ma bu hrangs lugs/ gcod rgyal tsho drug pa/ rgyal ba dkon skyabs la so lugs/ rog ston btsan po la ga ga ṇi/ rnam 'joms/ bdud rtsi chen mo/ rog ston rmya sbyin la gsang 'dus rgyud rkyang / zhig po bdud rtsi la rdzogs chen snyan brgyud/kha rag skyi ston la gzer lnga sogs 'tshal ba'i skor/ shangs pa rom snye la la ba spyo brtol/ lo sgom dang glan snying po la bde mchog bcu ga sum ma'i dbang/ rog shes rab zla ba la gsang ba phur gcig bdud rtsi sum gcig yab la phyag rgya chen po snyan brgyud la sogs/ lhab dris ma gong ba la 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ma rnams gsan/ 'bri khung nas slar byon nas sgrub pa la zugs gzhol te/ tsa ri/ mkhar chu/ shasbu/mu tig pho ma/ gangs bzang rnams su sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/de nas dpal chen ga gi gyi don la zhugs te/ yul lha rnams kyis bsu ba byas nas dgung lo cha bdun pa la ri khrod du phyags phab/ 'khor yang bzang ngan 'bring gsum bsrungs/ de nas bka' brgyud kyi gsung rab rnams gser du bzhengs pa phal chen tsam zhig byung ba bsnams na ba bcu pa la ding rir byon/ de yang mkha' 'gro ma nyi rlung gshog can gyis 'di ring nas bsus/ bong chu'i 'gram du phebs pa'i tshe dam pa rin po che dang byang chub sems dpa' gnyis ka gdong bsur byon te/ 'ongs pa de tshegs so zhes btosu / glang 'khor du phebs ba'i nub mo ga rna don 'ongasnye1107

ba'i ltas rin po che'i gling du phyin pa'i mnal lam byung / byang chub chen po la sogs pa'i rten rnams la mchod pa rgya cher phul/ rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyang bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes par byas nas/ glang 'khor gyi lo rgyus mang po gsungs pas/ glang 'khor ba rnams dam pa'i sprul pa yin nges snyam nas gdan sar zhu ba phul yang phyir byon/ 'byon khar sku gdung ka ru la snyi phyag mdzad pas sku gdung lan gsum du 'phar/ ring bsrel yang mang du 'phel/ slob ma rnams la chos kyi char phab/ lam rim che chung dang bshad 'bum la sogs pa'i rtsom pa yang mang du mdzad/ mthar dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga pa shing mo sbrul gyi lo dgun zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu gnyis la mya ngan las 'das te/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi tshe gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ bsnyun gyi gnod pa med pa ltar sku bsrang ste/'khor rnams bsdas nas /tho bo dang po nas tshe 'di shas chung ba'i stobs kyis snyigs ma'i semathe can gyi slob dpon byed mi pher tsam cig la byed dgos par thal/ 'on kyang bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i me tog phyir shar nas 'gro ba la phan par byung / rang re dpon slob rnams kyang las dang smo na lam gyi 'brel ba zab mo cig yod pa 'dra bas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang kho bo la thugs la 'dogs shing mos par mdzad ngas kyang khyed rnams la bya mas par byas te pha bad chos dang mthun la skyid par byung / 'grogs yun kya b.ring / gtam snyan gyi 'og tu tshe phyin dka' ba yin te/ chos 1 08

dang 'brel ba'i snyan grags kyis kyang phyogs bcur khyab/ da ni kho bo mya ngan las 'das par gyur nas khyed rnams thugs ngan cig kyang bya mi 'tshal te/ nga dang thugs dgongs gcig tu yong pas 'du 'bral med pa yin/ shul du yang rtogs pa zang sar 'khyol ba'i sgom chen pa la rtags la sogs pa la dgos pa med la/ 'on kyang mkha' 'gro ma phyag dar byed gdan bshom zhing 'dug pas mchod pa'i rten 'di tsam zhig 'byung du rung bar 'dug zhi khyed rnams kyis kyang gsol ba drag po thob cig ces dang /gzhan yang gdung skyong ba'i zhal brda tshun chad mdzad de/ gdan sa 'dir yang thams cad kyis sgrub pa tshul bzhin du mdzod la bzhugs shig lo gsum nas legs par 'ong gi gsung nas zhi bar gshegs/ gsung bzhin du ngo mtshar gyi rten mang du byon pa yang deng sang gi bar ri khrod na bzhugs so / /de rjes dbon po sher dbang pas gdan sa mdzad pas lo gcig na gshegs/ /de rjes gcung 'dag 'byar ba bskos pas kyang lo gcig na gshegs pas/ gdan sa gnyan zhing sus kyang mi non par grags pa la/ /'khrul zhig pas gdan sa yun ring du mdzad pa yin no/ /mkhas pa smra ba'i seng ge ni/ skye ba snga ma yul kha cher grangs can gyi grub ca tha' 'dzin pa'i mu stegs shig tu gyur pa rtsod pa la dga' bas rgya 1109

gar shar phyogs su byon te/ gzhan mang po pham par byas/ gyis pa ta shes rab grub pas rtsod pa bzlog cing zil gyis mnan nas/ de nas shes rab grub pa mar gzung ste gshin rje gshed kyi dbang zhus/ gsang mtshan 'jigs med rtsal du btags/ dpon slob 'grogs u rgyan du chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chos kyi lha'i sar byon/ rgyal pos zhus nas shes rab grub kyis tshogs kyi gtso bo mdzad/ 'jigs med rtsal gyis las kyi slob dpon mdzad nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ skye ba thams cad du 'du ba'i smon lam btab pa bzhin/ 'jigs med rtsal de nyid 'dir me pho rta'i lo la 'khrungs/ lo brgyad la yig rtsis brtsabs pas mtshon pa tsam gyi mkhyen/ lo bcu gsum la yon tan dang shukalus rdzog te gra dol gzhung da ma rtsami pa'i ltad mo la khrom thog chod/ bcu bzhi la 'dag 'byar mdzad pa'i ngang nas gzhi lam gyi stong thun gsungs pas grwa sgom thams cad dgapas mchi ma shor/ bco lnga pa la 'chos tshang khyim du rnal 'byor seng ge la dbu ma rigs tshogs bslabs pas rin po che'i rtsod pa'i ya pher/ bcu bdun la grwa phyi rta lam po'i slob dpon zhang ston dkon mchog la sgra'i bstan bcos mang du bslabs/ lo nyi shu la kha rag tu mkhas pa jo pad kyi sar byon nas/ mdo sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs gsum lo gnyis la mkhyen/ gtsang phyogs rnams su rtsod pa'i grwa skor mdzad/ bzang nye'u la/ ra yang mkhas pa mang po pham par byas pas ru mtshams pa bsod rin bya 111

ba mdzon ba dang gsang sngags la mkhas pa de sngon so ba'i sar mched grog su gyur ba de na re/ ltag chod che la rigs pa myur/ nga'i mched ngo dge bshes shes rab kyi ngag brjod dang 'dra zer/ de nas dge bshes bra bo chen po gshegs pa'i chos lakhor la yar ston rgyal mo bya ba dge bshes shāka bsam sogs sus kyang ma thub pa cig dang / rang bzhin gyis dbang rnon srid mi srid la rtsod pa byas pas lan du ma'i bar du khong pham bar byas pas mkhas pa'i ga ra thon te smra ba'i seng gir mtshanamathogs/ mtshan dngo brtson 'grus song godagung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la snye mdor che 'don mdzad/ phyag dpe chos dung dang bcas pa gtad/ da rubaslob gnyer mkhardzogs pas lo shes gcen na gnyis kyis gnas gzung / de rje gnabasa'adzin bar zhus pas kyang ma gnang / rin po che chen pos snye mdor lta khang bzhed pa dang zhig pos de chos kyis 'gengs pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ gnas gzhi gzung / bla ma rnam gnyis 'jig rten 'di dang da pa'i chos gnyis sha'i bka' drin dang chos gzhan na btsal ma dgos bdang / sems sangs rgyas rtsa bo sprad pa'i bka' drin dran par bya te/cholasakyi bshad nyan dang / 'jig rten gyi gnya' 'dums la sogs pa'i bya tho mang po mdzad pas/ la las 'jig rtegapa kho nar mthong / lo nyi shu rtsa gsum pa la kha rag jo pad gshegs pa'i dgongasangapa rdzogs thabs la 'bul ba mang du bskyal/ so gcig pa la lam lnga'i bsrangs la zhugs pas 1111

rgyu sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags/ lam rlung lnga zin pa'i rtags/ 'bras bu dag snang shar ba'i rtags bla ma gong ma la ji ltar shar ba bzhin byung /nyin mtshan med pa'i snang ba shar/ rtsig pa la thogs jugs med pa sogs byung / don la spros pa chod pa'i steng du bde gsal gyi nyams me dngu nga 'bar ba bzhin du byung bas dran med du bkrabs mchi ma mi thub pa'i dga' spro byung / lo sum cu rtsa gsum la mtshan brjod kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas pad mo'i sdong bu kha phye ba'i nang du 'jam dbyangs lha bdun gzigs/sum cu rtsa lnga la lha sar mchod pa skyel du byon pas spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs/ ka nas ku mu ta lta bu'i 'od byung ba spyi bor thim/ so brgyad pa la rin po che'i sku 'dab dus gsum khegs pa de'i zhor bteg zhig po bsam yas su mchod pa'i phyag phyir byon pas/ rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas 'od byi ru bcag pa lta bu byung ba thugs spur thim/ bzhi bcu pa la snye mdor 'dag 'byar mdzad pas 'od dmar po byi ru 'dra ba byung ba de rta mgrin du gyur nas 'od dmar pos ngams shod khengs/ rta skad thengasagasum bsgrags pa'i dang po dbus gtsang ru bzhir thos/ phyi ma gnyis de yang mi tshad par thos te/ de thams cad mkhyen pa la snyan grags 'ong ba'i brda yin gsung / zhe gcig pa la mkhar chur byon pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro mas lam ston pa/ smyong kha dga' ste mtsho hūṃ sgra sgrogs pa/ yang dag gi sgrub pa mdzad pas sgrub rdzas kyis sgod khengs ming bdud rtsi'i char bab/1112

bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa la thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshe 'don gyi chos 'khor btsugs/ chos nyan sa gzhi khengs pa tshogs pa la dge bshes chen po'i gsung tha ma rnams kyis ma thos/ 'di'i gsung tha mas kyang thos/ lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa la 'bri khung du rje spyan snga'i drung du 'bul ba skyel du byon pas spyan snga nas byang chub chen por gzigs/ spyan snga nas kyi gsung la de snga nas nam mkha' lta bur song 'dug kyang nam mkha' chen por gtong ba yin gsung nas phyag chen cig gnang bas/ dbyer med kyi dgongs pa la dus gsum du bogs 'don du med dam snyam pa cig 'khrungs/ lnga bcu rtsa dgu la sku 'dab tshogs sog mdzad/ ye shes mgon po bzhad pa'i zhal can cig gzigs/ de nas drug cu rtsa gnyis pa me mo lug gi smal bo zla ba'i tshes brgyad la rtags khyad par can mang po dang bcas te gshegs/sku gdung sbyangs pas ring bsrel gyis gang / phyis nang rten rdo rje sems dpa'i sku bzhengs pa'i sku la star chu gsol ba na yang khrus chab ring bzel gyis khengs/ sku ga ra gsol ba na ring bsrel gyi char kha ba bab pa bzhin byung ngo / /de ltar rigs gsum gyi mgon po lta bu'i sku mched gsum po de la bka'i chu bo babs pa'i slob ma dpag tu med kyang / gdung gi rgyud 'dzin pa'i gtso bo ni 'khrul zhig rin po che dang / thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis rmoyin te/ / sgro

de la 'thul zhig rin bo che ni/ yab bde gshegs chen po shes rab 'od dang sum mkhar chu'i rnal 'byor ma byang chub sgron zhe bya ba lamakha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung nas/ mkhar chu nazasabade gshegs chen po'i sbyan sngar byon nas lung bstan byung tshu'akhazhus pas thugs la yang ba /tshogs kyi 'khor lo sngon du 'gro ba'i sbyor nga dzadapa las mngal gzung nga' tshe sum la dag pa'i snang ba nang du shar nas chu mo lug gikhalo la ska bltams mtshan dang ma zheng ger btags/ yo lnga yon pa'i tshe yum gyi ༄nyams legargyun pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i mngon rtog dang rnal 'byor gsum nasa'adon tho cig byung / lo bdun pa la bya ba'i rim ba'i snag mang du mkhyen/ tho de snyid la snye mdor bde gshegs chen po'i drung du bskyal/ 'di la phrin las skor rnams slob par zhu zhus pas/ da lta ci thong gsung ba la/yod pha rnams bton pa log mar klog dang kha bton gnyis ka la dgyes na phur bu'i las byang 'dzin du bcug lan cig 'bol zur du bzhu gas na gso ras gsol bas yum yar de 'os te brdung du byung bas bros pas snye 'og gi khar zin nas g.yang la skyur du byung bas/ slob dpon lhagashamathopo gis zin nas 'og mar bskyal/ ba nga ge'i gsung nas 'di la de ltar bya mi rigs zlob gnyer bya dgos gsung / yu yar des slob gnyer byed du ma ltar bar rta phyug 'tshor bcugacing 'ji ba'i tshe slob dbon — rta'u sgang ba'i lci ba 'thu ba'i sel po bcag zas po ma yar gyi lar rted ma

nas 'ji bla ma grub thob kyi zas slob ma dbabatatu thed pa rnams kyi tha sol ba 'debs pa'i rten yin pa ngan las 'chol bang rigs sam byazhig nas yum yar de la brkyan/ byi ba'i du na chos thams cad rmi lam sbya ma lta bur do gang la spung zhen 'kho med pasarang gi zas gos su dar+sha' ba la ltar/ yid kyi da gas 'dzin med kyang dga' yal yal ba dang bun long ba rtag tu byung / gang lamang zhen 'dzin med pas 'khrul zhig tu mtshan thogs/ bcu gnyi09'dziso ba gdan drangs mdo dbang zhus/ yab kyi zhal nas/ chomakhasnying na byed pa la mi dam cig gi bsnyen pa thems dgos gsung nas phur bu'i stod lag dbang bskur/ sgrub rdzas bsags na sgrub pa la bcug dbang bskur gyi tshe tshe bra brtag pa'i ril bu gsum bum par bcug dbang mdzad tsa na ril bu dgur 'phel byung bas tshe ring bar lubabastan/ gzhan don 'byung ba la rang don tshags su tshud dgos gsung na bsnyen pa la 'bad pa rtags khyad par can byung / dug phur na khayo'i lag len sogs dang zar bu'i lugs rgyas par gsan/ bco lnga la 'cho rmya chang khyim du dge bshes kun da 'a dang grub thob sbyi de ba la mngon rtogs gyi dang mi lug sogs gsan/ bcu bdun la dgongs 'dus la nan chags mchod/ gzhan bde gshegs chen bo nyid la mnga' ba'i chos ma lu ba'i bka' sung gnang / jo 'bum blangs byung bas nga la chung ma r+shad gsung na slog yab kyi zhal nas theg ba chen po gsang sngag 1115

sgrub pa la sngag ma mtshan ldan dgos/ 'di mtshan dang ldan pa yin gsung nas yang bos byung / de nas zhi byed kyi skor ma lus par zhus/ nyams thod rgal ba skyes/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la bde gshegs chen po nyid la mnga' ba'i zhi byed brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum thams cad gnang / bsnyen pa bskyal bas rgyu lam 'bras bu'i rtags thams cad tshang/ ri khrod du song la zhig po'i chos thams cad tshang bar zhus shig gsung bas zhig po'i drung du phyin pa na/ 'di la nga'i chos kyi gtad sa 'ong / chos bdag pher ba zhig 'ong / mi res pus mo la 'bab pas do nub rang bya dgos gsung nas/ brgyud pa phyi ma la gartsa bor mdzad pa'i snga phyi bar gsum tshang bar gnang / bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor du dngang bskar ba'i tshe/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i mos gus skyes/ ji zhir+sha ltar la 'od kyi phung por song / snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang nas bde gsal mi rtog par gyur/ rten 'brel kyi khang nga ra bcug nas brgyud pa gtod pa'i cho ga yang mdzad/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la bde gshegs chen po gshegs khar mya ngan chen po byung bas bde gshegs chen po'i zhal nas rnal 'byor pa 'chi ba la mya ngan bya mi dgos/ snyi rtog ge'i rigs pa la blo ma sbyangs kyang nang nyams rtogs /kyi 'char tshul khyod bzang bar 'dugathugs dam la brtson par mdzod dang 'gro don rgya chen po 'ong bar 'dug gi gsung / gshegs rjes nyin par mya ngan gyis non kyang mtshan mo rmi lam tsāḥ16

khyad par can byung ba dang mthun par spur sbyangs pa'i tshe spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dang thugs ma tshig par phyag tu byon pas yum yar gyis phrogs te khyer kyang mi dgyes pa ma byung / mos rje zhig po yang myur du 'da' ba'i gsungamang du byon nas g.yu stong dung 'thul dang rta bdun gyis thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang po skyel du 'bri khung du byon/ tshur phebs nas dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi rten bzhengs/ de ma tshar ba la snye mdo ba yang gshegs/nyi shu rtsa drug pa la rten rnams legs par grub/ ras pa rdo rje dpal sto bal du gser gdugs dang snya ṭi ra sgrub tu btang bas grub ste byung / rdo rje dpal rang u rgyan du bzhud pas mu rgyan ras par grags/ nyi shu rtsa dgu la rtse ba sgang du bzhugs nas thang dbus pa la sogs pa'i bu slob mang du bskyangs/ dgon skor gsum gyi bla ma grwa pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis gros lan mang du byas pa'i mthar 'khrul zhig pa nyid gdan sar 'os par thag chod nas snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pas khyed kyis ri khrod du bzhugs nas sgrub brgyud spel ba dang / ngas snye mdor bsdad nas bshad rgyud spelagasung ba'i zhu ba phul/ rtse sgang ba'i grwa pa dang yon bdag rnams de la mi dga' bas yon bdag rnams kyis bsnyen bkur khyer 'ongs te/ gtam gtong ba'i dus su mi thegs pa zhu zer bsam pa la/ kha nor nas thegs par zhu zer bas kun bzhan gad du gyur te/ rten 'brel bzang gsung nas sum cu pa la ri khrod du bzhugs nas gdan sa bskyangs/ so gcig pa la 1117

yar klung su bzlo ta dā rna tī la'i drubadu mkhas grungalarnam pa gnyis das byon/ sbyin bsreg gi me bra cung zad rtsub par byung bas/ pa ta'i gsung gis 'di khyed la mi gnodagasung / de res thad du dam pa 'gar la thugs bskyed chen mo dang bsrung sdom zhing ngu zhig zhus/ so garnyas pal 'bri khung du byon nas rje spyan snga na dang lha dkon mchog 'phel bas rab tu byung / 'bul ba yang mang du byas/ chos khrid rnams kyang tshang bar ga nga / sto rten 'brel khang par lama'ica'i dbang khrid tshang bar mdzad/rgo gcig pa la stod lungs dang mkhar chur phyon na zhegazhan gyi don mdzad/snang brkadag pasadam pa nyid du mthong ba yang—byung / zhe gnyimakhapa la phag mo grur 'bu'adzib skye'akhadu byon pa rgyal bsarin bo che rgyag mnyes pas phyag len kyang mdzad/ chos khrid mang du zhu / gnang sgrin kyang mang du gnang /zhe gsum sprangal grub thob me long rdo rje la so gas pakhayang gdams pa tshim par mdzad/ zhe bzhi pa la rang gi sras sgrub pa po phag mo gru nas bo nas ri khrod du gdan sang bskos/ zhi lnga pa la gnyal du rdza dmar ba'i rten gyirab gnas 'dziphyon/ lam dang gnya'akhophyogs thams cad kyi nad dang 'a khyug pa gi bar mdzad/ lo de la spyan rgyu dpal chen thams cad mkhyen pas rtsedang gi gad thar bskos/ zhe brgyad pa la dus gsum mkhyen pa sto bragatotu ba ngas/ zhe dgu pa la spyan snga 'tshal ba ri khrod du bskos/ lnga bcu rtsa gcig nas lo sum cu rtsa gcig(shing par gnyis por sum cu rtsa gcig 1118

zhis 'a/kod 'dug kyang rogs gzhir snang / sgo pha bo'i ma na) gi rnar zur stod du thugs dam 'apa' zhig mdzad/ brgyad cu tso gcig pa chu mo yos la gshegs/ bde spu can du pad+ma la brdzus te skye pa'i byang tshub sems dpa' rdo rje mi zad pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ gdungs sbyang pa rna ring bsrel byung ba rnams ma 'khyar bar nang rten gyi nang du bzhugs/ 'di la sras lnga byung ba'i che ba sgrub pa po sa so rgya rin chen zhing sbrul nas chu stag nga brgyad/ gnyis pa spyan snga dpal chen lug nas shing glang don dgu'i bar du bzhugs/ gsu rdza dus gsum mkhyen pa chu byi nas chu khyi don gcig bzhi pa spyon snga 'tshal thor shāḥ rgya khamatshan sa rta nas lcags rta don gsum/ lnga pa mkhan chen tshul khri sa rgya samatshan sa sbrul nas chu lug don lnga/ /de la dus gsum mkhyen pa ni 'khyu zhig bdang jo mi 'bum rgyan gyi sras su 'khrungs nas/ zul phu'i mkhan po ches byab na 'a 'phred gsol la rab tu byung / 'bri khung gcung la gtug na rtogs pa 'khrungs/ chos mang du zhus/ mkhan po mi nyag dang slo dpon yon tan 'od las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gcung gis nyi kyi na bza' gnang gis brdzangs/yab la gtsang brag nag pas chos gsan pa dang lhan du brgyud pa nyi ma'i skor ma lus pa dang / rnying ma'i skor mang du gas / gcen sgrub pa po las kyang chos mang du gsan/ snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa la bzhugs 1119

sngu drasku pa'i las 'phra ra da pas thugs rab kye rtsal che ba/ dka' las la ma stos par yon tan thams cad zhar la mkhyen pa zhig byon te/ dgung lo brgyad phan la gar 'chams phrin sgrub dkar rtsis la sogs tshegs med par mkhyen/ dgu nas gsang snying gi rgyud dang phur pa'i skor la thugs sbyong mdzad pas rgyud sa gzhung ṭī ka khog dbub/ mchan/ gsung sgros dang bcas pa thugs su chud nas bcu gnyis pa la gdan sar che 'don mdzad/dbyar chos dgun chos ma chag pa gsungs shing / yab kyi drung du zhi byed brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang khrid man ngag lung dang bcas pa rnams legs par gsan zhing / gzhan yang gsang sngags gsar rnying gi bka' lung man ngag mang du gsan/ mtshon dpe chen mo thugs nas gsungs/de nas jo mo cig kun gyis bgros nas bsus pas cung zad thugs skyo nas dpon slob bzhi tsam mdzad nas/ skyes mchog rin po che'i snyan pa la gtad nas bros nas byon pas/ skyes mchog pa rgya brag na bzhugs pa dang mjal zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes/ gang nas byon gsung / grwa ri khrod nas 'ongs zhus par/ zhig po rin po che'i dbon por 'dug gsung nas phyag thugs gar thal mo sbyor bar mdzad/ chas kha gang dgos nang nas long gsung shin tu mnyes par gyur/ don rgyud kyi dmigs skor 'ga' zung dang tshogs chos rnams gsan/ zla ba gnyis gsum na gdan 'dren drag po byung bas phyir phebs/ de nas yab kyi drung 1121

du ga mas pa thams cad zu / pa gang byo'i tshul du zhus/ bya bral chen spra spru 'dzul zhig pa'i lugs kyi phyog bzhes rna /sa dang dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chos skor/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang la sogs rtse sgang na mi bzhugs spu rnams gsan/ bla ma a mo bha pa la gsar ma'i dbang mang po dang gsang pa lung mang po la bka' 'gyur gyis thog drangs lung mang du gsan/de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa la sman gcig tu byon nas phyag rdor bde khros kyi zhub pa mjad/ de rjes gsar rnying gi i dam mang po'i bsnyen pa mdzad/ de rjes brgyud pa bar ma rma lugs la nyams khrid du bskyangs pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ de rting lam lnga'i bsnyin pa lo gnyis su mdzad pas rtags khyod par can mang du 'khrungs/ de rjes lam gsum gyi sgrub pa lo gcig dzad/ de'i tshe tho rangs kyi thun gcig la rten rgyas bskyid kyi bla ma rnam zhal gziṭa/ de la dad pa'i stobs rgyas gdung ba'i shugs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i mod la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma phye/dbang gcig ma'i sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad pas mnal lam du sku lus 'od kyi phung po song nas bla ma'i thugs rkar ma pa zhig rmis/ brgyud pa dang po dang so lugs la yang nyams len thogs re mdzad de sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ nang du rtogs pa'i nyi ma shar/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs/gzung 'dzin gyi sgrog khrol/ byams pa dang snying rje'i mthu rgyas te dad spru can bams cad kyi dad pa'i dbang po brta par mdzad/ yab mes gong 1122

ma thams cad gyi gdung sobs par ma da mu/ skye cu che bo 'a nyin zhag sbugs gcig gi mdzad pha rim pa yang ba ma gyis mi khya 'a/ thong thun la skyabs 'gro mas bskyed kyis ga gzung na na seng/tshun la lam lnga thugs dam/ de nas tshe sgra / rnam 'jo sa/ smre ba gas rna mi chu bsnyen pa/ de rjes mchod bsnams/ mchod bstod ga la 'de rgyun ba ga / dkar gtor la sogs mdzad/ bzhes phu ra ba da mdo sgrub dang / gtor ma'i rim pa shin hu nga ba gang / sa brgyud kyi gsol bdebs du gsum mi rnams ma da na ji dro'i skyon la la cu sa/dro bzhes grol nas na ra ka dotha sprugs dang gza' yum gyi gzungs sogam pa gsungs na gyi ston la bzhugs/ dgong mo sgrol ma tshar nyi zhu rtsa cigasrod la brgya skyag yan lag bdun ma/ snyi bshags/ chos skyong gi gtong ma/ de nas sgron la na mkha' sgo 'byed dang bskyed da ngam sbya thugam nam/ skam lugs dang spyod yul gnyis la yang zhag re zhin cu gas dam ma chag par mdzad/ de rnams ni zhag ji bzhin 'a —ga zin rnam yin no/ de ltar sgrogs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas ngo ma ji ltas kyang / skongs brgya sna mdzad pa'i nub kyi ma la lam tri sku sa pa rnag bka mang du 'thon/ de nas sha rnams kyang sha zhor so sha rus kyang sge nas cas pa skya thong ma cig tu so ba dang / zhe rjo gyi sgrub pa'i dus skyu nyams snang la ri so mchog nga kyi steng du ༄gas na rte 1123

stong gsum gzigs shing sku lus kyang shin tu che bar gyur pa dang / rje btsun ma'i dbang zhus pa'i dus su bla ma rje btsun mar gzigs pa dang / phur ba'i bsnyen pa'i dus su phur pa las 'od dmar po mar me tsam zhig zhag mang du byung ba dang / mnal lam du ri phan tshun phyag gis gzung nas cha lang bzhin du brdob pa dang / tshe bdag gi pasnyen pa'i dus su gtsang po zhal du gsol ba'i mnal lam dang / bsam gtan gling du bcu bzhi'i gtor ma'i dus su legs ldan nag po khang pa'i steng nas babs nas sku mdun du byung nas shod du song ba kun gyis mthong ba dang / zla ba gzas gzung ba'i dus su bde khros kyi sbyin sreg mdzad pa'i tshe 'jig rten pa'i sbyin sreg tshar nas 'jig rten las 'das pa la zug pa'i tshe sku lus gzi mdangs kyang sngar bas che/ me yang sngar bas rgyun ring zhing gsal ba cig byung / cho ga tshar ba dang kho thag chod pa cig byung gsung / de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas mdun bskyed kyi skabs su yi dam me'i nang du dngos su byon/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod pa rnams mis mi la 'dren pa bzhin byas chog par byung / rting la mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyang byon nas skal ba re blangs song ga nga / bde khros dang phur bu ba gnyis po bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yang zugs dam yin/ dbang gi dus su 'di gnyis kyi dbang dus kho na byin brlabs che zhing / dbang zhus pas nad gdon thon pa dang / zhuṭa pa kha phye ba'ang mang / sman sgrub chen mo mdzad pas sman sngar las 'phel 1124

che zhing byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma mang du byung / 'phral gyi rnam thar mdzad spyod thams cad bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin du mdzad/dngos po gang byung rnams kyang bla ma gong ma'i 'das mchod rten bzhengs/stoms chung gi rgyags/ mchod khang yar mar gyi mar me rnams la 'phral dag tu gtong / rin po che gtsug rgyan pa gshegs nas lo lnga song ba'i tshe nyid kyi sras bla ma 'od zer ba sogs nyung bsdus zhig la lam lnga'i dbang khrid rnams mdzad/ de nas dbyar dgun ma chag par zhi byed brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang khrid rnams gsungs pas 'gro don 'phel zhing snyan pas kyang sa'i steng kun tu khyab/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos kyang zhabs la gtugs pa las mchog tu gyur pa ni skyes mchog rin chen bzang po ste/ 'di ni in+d+ra nyu ti yin par khong rang gis zhal gyis bzhes/ bla ma grags don pa/ gtsang pa blo bzangs ba/ rtogs ldan grags lhun pa la sogs pa mang du byon no/ de nas dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa sa mo glang gi ston nas ska nyam chung bas sku rim la sogs pa la 'bad pa cher byas/nyin cig sras snams la so sor dgon pa 'di gzung dang 'di gyis zhal ta mang du mdzad/ grwa ba'i nang gi dpe 'di rnams khyod shes rab bzang pos nya ra gyis la sman gcig gi sgrub gnas 'di ma stongs tsam dang 'gro don gang byung skyongs shig gsung ba la sogs pa'i zhal ta mang du mdzad de dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs so/ de la sras byang chub bzang po/ dar ma rin 1125

che / mdo zer rgyalā mtshan/ sgra pha 'jam dbyangs/ byang chub da 'amasdo spu do 'a ༷shes gnyi༄ / chos rje rin po che she rab bzang po sto/dzardun sgo/ /rtsa rjes she rab bzong po zo sto la 'khrungs ska na gzhon pa na mi kyi drung nyid du gdams pa rnam rdzogs par mdzad/ cu ba pa'i phyag lo — mo kharkyang minga'/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnas rgo mo rin po che ye shes dokhri sod pa'i khrid 'a mas gnang na bla mar gyur/ de nas gzung sto sto brag dong ci gnyi kor bar chad du gzhan don 'ba' zhig me da rgya rgya tshe lha'i rtogaso dzi dang yang ldan/ dge slong gi khrims rna por do pa yong lam / bka' brgyud kyi bdag por gyur pa de la dzad cag rnams kyis zhi byed brgyud pa ji gyi bar gsu zhus pa yin no/ /ri bo tshe rgyang pha ngas pa'i ma bla mi rkun dga' rdo rje ni/ shing pho rta 'kha sapo / ga rna po'i dus nas yab la sgro 'grul gi khro dang phur 'khol sogs pa dzig len rnam legs par bslabs shing / yab dang ri spo che shes ra bzang po gnyis ka la zhi byed kyi chos skor ma lu khri ji gyi ma du ga na/ da lta yang gdul bya mang rdzo la phan par lha ga pa di'o/ ༈ 'i song gi la sro gsu 'thubs pa'i dang po thams cad mkhyen por gregis pa ni/ gye gar rto phyogs kyi rgyud du lo kya tri nā tha zhes bya ba'i 1126

pazlo ta cig tu gyur/ sngags dang mtshan nyid nyis ka la ma pa'istobs kyis gzhan gyi rgol ba yang nga bcad/ slob mi mchog byu rgyur spru mang drug tsam byung / de nas skya pha chen po su dga' snying por 'a nga / sna nas dzā la rar bras ma te shrī sa bya ba'i pa ta rdzu 'phrul yang cung dru thob pa cig tu gyur na / rdzu 'a la skyi stobs sa byu rgyan ji yum nu mang bgrod/ der rang byung mchod rten dang mang / chod rtenade'i phyogam bzhir parnyi ta chen ā+o bzhi ba pa la mogs pa'i dbang rnartsam ri par bskur na kha' gangaba'i de ba na gzhegs pas sbyin gyi rlob dzidang / spyan ma la sogs pi rnams kyis khyu ba dang rka gsu rno ri lasogs pas mchod pa yang byung / de nas pad+ma ba rig sdo blogs pa dung khrod rnams su spyod pa spu sbyin pas ma lhun thung pa snyo — ra chad du gyur te/ zhe dgu pa la 'das nas/ ne na 'jirme zang lko yin shes bya ba rna khong rang snyin gyi 'a nga ngo / ne yang po gyi ya'ardzo 'khrungs/ da yon pa'i ca ri khrod shā rte sna'i sum skyangasaya sar lhu gyis ster bas spur spyong gi bkon pa rnams ji ltab ba na na /lo bdun la klog brda bstan pa tsam gyis shes ga shadze ston rnam 'a tsā 'a la ga pa klog la sogasapa'i sgra'i rton cos rnamasakyang 'a yi ge bshar sna zhag bdun gyisa' snangs r+sā / sbyi sa ni rgya gang chub u spyon la zlogs pa'i mi ge bris ldeng sa zags ya bcathamasacad ri sasmo 37

lo brgyad pa la bka' brgyud kyi lag len gzhung 'drongs/ de'i tshogs lhag yab yum la phul bas dgyes/ lo bcu la yab dang lhan cig tu yi dam gyi bsnyen pa bskyal bas nyin mtshan 'das pa mi tshor ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs/ de ltar yon tan du ma skye bas thob pa bzhin du gyur pa'i rigs ldan des spyir bla ma bcu drug lhag tsam bsten pa las mtha' yas lung gi snang ba rgya thams cad mkhyen pa las rnyed/ rnam dpyod rigs pa'i shes pa lhag ru ba las rnyed/ yid ches don gyi gnas rgya gar paṇa chen las rnyed/snyi nang dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba 'dzi ri ba las rnyed/ dpe rgyud dag pa'i nan chags sdum ra ba las rnyed/ gzhan don phrin las kyi tshul 'bri khung pa las rnyed/ zil gnon byin rlabs kyi drod ri khrod pa las rnyed/ gdams pa gnad kyi mtshang bang rim pa las rnyed/ lta dgongs don gyi tshul rigs bdag nyid las rnyed ces bya ste/ lan re gzigs pa dang gsan pa tsam gyis thugs su chud pas thams cad mkhyen par grags/ mtshan dngos ni bsod nams dpal zhes bya/ 'dis gsar rnying gi rgyud sde dang rig pa'i gnas du ma la bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ khyad par du mkhas pa tre bo mgon po'i gsung rnams sdum ra ba las rnyed pas tre bo'i lugs la shin tu mkhas sgrub pas gsang sngags kyi dngos grub kyang mang du lon nas drug cu rtsa gnyis pa me mo glang la gshegs/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sras gsum gyi che ba kun dga' bzang po ni/ chos kyi rje rgod tshang ba chen 1128

po de sa pho rta'i lo la gshegs nas rta'i lo nyid la/ yab snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pas zhe gsum bzhes pa'i sras su snye mdor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug tshun chad du nga rgod tshang ba yin zhes pa'i gsung mang du byon/ mi la yin pa'i gsung yang mang du byon/ lo gsum gyi bar ngag ma bye ba ltar mdzad/ bzhi pa nas klog yig kyang phul du phyin/ lo bdun pa nas 'khor la chos gsungs/ bcu gcig pa'i bar du yab las rnying ma'i rgyud sgrub thabs mang du gsan zhing mkhyen pas gzhan la gsungs shing phyag len slob pa'i slob dpon mdzad/ bcu gnyis pa la phyogs ris kyi bu slob kyang bsdus/ chos kyi khri brtsigs/ yab kyis phyag dpe thams cad gtad/ mdo sngags lung rigs mang du gsungs/ bcu gsum pa la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gsungs/ 'chad tshul la yab kyang dad/ bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa la sku mtshams bsdams nas rdo rje phur bu'i zhal legs par gzigs/ grub rtags phra mo bstan/ shangs pa tshul she dang lhan du gsang snying gi chos bka' shin tu mang ba dang zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gsan/ shangs tshul nyid la'ang ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po sogs mdo sde 'ga' yang gsan/ mang yul nas slob dpon nam mkha' ye shes sbya 'a phrul dbang mo che sogs gsan du byung ba la las chog pa'i dpon mdzad/sto bcu drug pa la ba ri ba sku skye yin par yid ches pas dpon po chos kyi gzi brjod btang nas 'bul ba mang du mdzad/ de rting snyil dkar ba nyid 1129

byo cho mang po phar ga na tshur gsan mdzad/ yab la dus 'khor gyi dpa ga na/ bcu brgyun pa la 'bri khung du byon pa'i lam du/'a tshal du ga ra khang pa dang ma la zhing chos mang po zhas/ lha sar jo bo dang ma slu/ 'bri khung du byon/ der rab byung mdzad/ bco brgyad pa la maskor yab la khrid mang du gsan/ nyams rtog rgyas pas yab nyid tso ba'i ma 'gro med du mdzad bcu dgu pa'ang de bzhin sgo/me gyi rla rgya bu ma rog che'i dmag lhags/ me glang la yab mkhar chur thegs/ cho rje me ri bas gedan brangs nas la stod du thegs/ lo de la yab mkha chur ga gis/ gtsang nas phyir byon nas gshegs rdzongs stobs che ༷ ba bas/ lcags sbrul la snye mdor grub thob nang ge grags dang ma ma/ gdam pa yang gnang / nye lnga pa chu snye la chu rgyan pa dang mja / chu lug la geyam bzangs dad 'dod mkhar du grub chen pa 5 du 'khor rgyud 'grel tshar re gsan/ so drug pa chu sbrul la bcom rab ma sha ba ra'i gi nga sog rgyal/ sa khyi la lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtsha spyan drang / dgyes rdor/ nā ro 'grel chen/ dbang dor ba na gyi 'grel pa/ man ngag snye ma/ ka rmā pa sogs rgya bod kyi sgra rig tsa ming du ga gi/ gyi mi gi ba'i rgyud dang zu ba btus pa gsan/zhe gsum pa lcag pho skyi ba la tho ri ji gsheg / nga dgu po mi 'a ga rme chos sku zhi dzi chen bo'i dbyings su gshegs so/ bar pa ku dga' 1130
