mgon po shing glang nas lcags spre sgrug chung ba kun mkhyen kun dag don grub sa 'brug nas sa 'byug re gcig yang / chos rje zhig po'i slob ma sangs rgyas ras pa zhes grags pa de ni/ phu thang 'khun pa sa'i zhing tshigs su sku 'khrungs/ gdung rus 'bring / yab mkha' 'gro dang yum srun skyid gnyis la sras gsum yod pa'i tha chungs/ sa mo phag gi lo la 'khrungs te/ lo 'di 'bri khung chos rjes drug cu rtsa gcig bzhes pa/kha che paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i snga lo der snang / chung ngu'i dus nam 'chi ba gsha' mar dran/ gzhon dus rgyal ba te ne+e dang yud tsam mjal/phag mo rgya'i rje spyan snga la lnga ldan zhus/ zhig mo tsa ri nas 'khor ba'i lam du gzigs pas dad pa snyes/ rang lo nyi shu rtsa gsum lon du drung du phyin/ dngos po yang ci yod phul/ dge bsnyen zhus/ mtshan rin chen smon lam du btags/ ma 'ongs pa na slob ma brgya tsam 'byung ba'i lung bstan mdzad/ zul phu ba'i slob ma slob dpon ston pa la ba na rdzogs mdzad/ de nas zhi byed kyi dbang khrid rnams gnang / blo sbyong gi bsnyen pa zla ba drug skyal bas rtags rnams tshang bar byung zhing lam so so'i yon tan rnams thang kur skyes pas byu ma mnyes/ bla ma lo nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bang da bsten/ de nas khong rang gi gcen po slob dpon ston pa/mon 'gar ba'i slob dpon ston pa/ bsam mi / kyi slob dpon yon btsun/'bri khung du dbon rin po cu/ ru mtshams chu ba ngas su khams sgom zhib/ 1131

po/ ko brag pa khro phu pa/ ti se'i grub thob seng yes/ sto brag tu slob dpon gur ston/ mkhar chur slob dpon ri khrod pa/ spyan snga gangs dkar ba/ shākya dge sbyong / slob dpon dbon sgom/ grwa pa ston gzhon/ gru shul lha ri'i slob dpon sde sgod pa/ dmyal gyi slob dpon sgom pa/ slob dpon klu sgom/ bla ma bzang mo ba rnams la so so'i gdams pa rnams zhus te sgrub pa mdzad tshul ni/ bla ma'i spyan sngar sgrub pa lo bcu gnyis dam bcas pa las lhag por lo gsum dang bcas pa grub/ sgrub pa'i gnas gangs dkar ti se/ spu rangs su brag phug gnyan po gcig spa gro stag tshang phug nya 'o gang bzangs/ jo mo kha rag la sa ga gangs phug mkhar chu/ cha lung cha gangs/gzhi'i rdza mda'i gangs/ mtsho sna'i g.yag mtsho/ sha 'ug stag sgo'i lung stong / mon gyi la chen la 'thon nas re ba ti'i lung pa yin zer ba cig tu byon/ mtsho mu le gong bya ba re ba ti dngos su bzhugs bya ba dang /nye 'khor na gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa shin tu che ba gcig tu byon/ de nas chu bo gaṅgā gzigs/ der rgya gar yul gyi rtsa'i spyil po can gyi grong du byon/ skye ba snga ma'i yul yin snyam pa byung / dwags lha sgam po/rang gi grong dang nye ba'i skyo zur dang dgon dkar sogs su bzhugs/ yon tan gyi cha cis kyang dgos pa med pa'i blo dang / zhag re la rlung 'dzin thengs res chog pa/ skyil dkru pa nam mkha' la thegs pa/ rkang mgyogs 1132

kyi cha grub pa/ gzhan gsangs te ma gsungs pa ma gtogs pa snang ba bshang kyis mi rdzogs pa yod/ dus gyis char ma dgon par 'gro don bag re bskyangs/ bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ 'di rnams myang 'ban po dharma sidha zhes bya ba dngos slob des mdzad pa'i rnam thar las btus pa yin/ brgyud pa phyi ma'i chos rnams la phyag rgya chen po dri med/ thigs pa phyag bzhes kyi skor zhes pa'i mtshan btags/ phyag rgya chen po ni dam pa sangs rgyas ze ti ba'i dngos slob yin pas ze tri ba'i phyag rgya chen po de nyid yin/ dri med ni dam pa'i gsung rnams la bya/ phyag bzhes ni bstan pa gzhan rnams dang cung zad mi 'dra ba'i sgrub pa'i srangs yod pa la zer/ de yang ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa gsang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa zhes bya ste/ ze tri ba'i de kho na nyid bcu pa'i 'grel par yang lugs de pha rol tu phyin pa yin pa la/gsang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa bya tshul kye'i rdo rje las bshad pa dang 'dra ba zhig byung / lha'i rnal 'byor la brten pa ma yin zhing phyag rgya bzhi'i rjes su 'gro ba med pas gsang sngags ni ma yin no zhes gsungs pa de dang mthun par snang / de yang thun mong du grags pa rnams kyi dbang du byas nas bshad kyi/ dam pas phyar chen dang / 'ban gung rgyal la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gnang bar grags shing / las rgya'i gdams pa'ang mang po la gnang bas dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed la gsang 1133

sngags gartan med pha ma mid no gsang sngags rjes mthun par bshad pha nyid kyis na shā mi tā mi'i jin d+ma sa ma sogs pa mang gsang sngags dang rje su mthun pa ste/ dngos yin phas ni 'di la log par rtog par rtsi lte shes rab kyi pha ro tu sbyin pa'i mdo nyid nas yi ge ba bcu rtsa gnyis gyi ga ngas gyi sgo bshad pa dang 'dra ma'i skyir ro/ chos skor 'ji la zud mang dang thun long ma yin pa'i chos sde gnyis las thun mong la ma rgyud ga len dang bcasapa bka' babs snyan brgyud dang bcas pa dri 'ad phra rtag dang bcas 7/ dang tshags bshad 'bum dang bcas pa/dang yo ni mno chu klung mjon sa rol pa'i mdo/ dgos mdo shes rab snying yo/ ra rgyud sde ston gsal skyid sgos rgyud chu klung chen po/rgya 'a / dbrang 'khor che 'a nga dang la rim che chung gsum/bka' ba lo dbargyud bloda' bas bzhi/ de'i las slongs snyan brgyud ba / dri zer lha rtag gi ji zad la cho sngag pha rtsa ba'i skor la sod pha rtsu phra nyid gi pa tshab kyis gun dga' la ma de ba'i gegs rnam ji pa'i gdams pa'o dang tshag shad 'bul ni dar tshags gi gdam khaladud rtsi sgor la sog pa brgyad yod de/ pa tshab kyi 'phral gnyam rnye zhe ger bta pa'o/ bshad 'byum ni te rna dang zhig po dang snye do lagasgog pas mdzad spra'i shad la rnal so/ thun mong ma yin pa'i cang la rgyud stong sgron dang bca pa dbang khrid dang bcas sgyu 4
(pa)deb ther sngon po las/ gcod yul dang kha rag pa'i skabasaso/

dum bu bcu gsum pa/ gcod yul dang kha rag pa'i skabs/ mo gcod spyi skabs/da ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdud kyi gcod yul gyi brgyud ba bshad par bya sti/ rje d+ma tri bas po rol tu phyin pa la yang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa yod par bshad pas/ ming du spyod yul zhes bya ste/ ji ltar rjes su mthun na/ brtag pa gnyis pa las/ shing gcig dang dur khrod dang / /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang / /yang na dben pa'i bas mtha' ru /sgom pa bzang bar brjod par bya/ zhes bya ba dang / lus kyi sbyin pa sbyin rgyas nas/ /phyi na spyod pa yang dag spyad/ ces bya ba dang / nges par sngon du lha min gang / /bgyi byin lta bu 'ongs na yang / /de la 'jigs pa mi/bya ste/ /seng ge'i gzu gas kyis rnam par rgyu/ zhes gsung pa rnams dang ma na ba'i gyir ro/ rol tu snyin pha bdud kyi gcod yul zhes kyang bya ste/ de yang 1539

sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ rgyu rnam bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ /bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing bskyod par mi nus te/ /stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi gtong dang / /ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ zhes gsungs pa'i chos rnam pa bzhi po nyams su len pa yin te/ stong nga ra gnas pa'i lta ba/sems can yongs su mi gtong ba'i snying rje/ ji skad smras pa bzhin du byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims/ bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa ste bzhi po de ni nyams len gyi rtsa ba yin no/ bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag len ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang / brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa yin la/ ji skad smras pa bzhin du byed pa ni tho co ma yin gyi/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nas de'i tshe khas blangs pa dang 'gal bar mi byed pa'o/ sems can yongs su mi gtong ba ni mi ma yin pa la sogs pa la yang gnod cing 'tshe bar mi byed par snying rje chen po'i sgo nas de'i spyod pa sems can la 'tshe ba la sogs pa dang phral nas byang chub kyi lam la 'dzud par byed pa'o/ stong par gnas pa'i lta ba ni thog mar rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phung po la bdag tu lta ba spangs nas sems can gzhan gyi yul la yang dngos po dang mtshan ma'i 'du shes su mi byed pa'o/ de ltar byed pa de la ci'i phyir gcod yul zhes bya zhe na/ mdzod las/ phra rgyas spangs pa ma yin dang / /yul ni nye 1140

bar gnas pa dang / /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las/ nyon mongs skye ste/ zhes bshad pa ltar/ gcad par bya ba ni nyon mongs yin la/nyon mongs de dag phra rgyas dang yul dang tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa las skye bas na/ rnal 'byor pas yul de nyer bcug nas bag chags blang ste/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa sngon du 'gro ba'i nyon mongs rnams yul gyi thog de nyid du gcod par byed pas gcod yul zhes bya'o/ de'i gdams ngag kyang dam pa las brgyud pa ste/ skyo bsod nams bla ma dang / yar klungs kyi ming ra ser po las brgyud pa la pho gcod ces bya la/ ma gcig las brgyud pa rnams la ni mo gcod ces bya'o/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung gis yar klungs rog pa sar ma jo mchod gnas ma la snying gtam tshig gsum byas pas mo des grol/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rang nyid des grol ba yin mod kyi/ 'di rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma yin pas 'phral gyi gdams pa'ang mang du byung ba yin no/ 'o na ci'i phyir gzhi gcig la spyod ces bya ba dang / gcod ces bya'i sgra mi mthun pa gnyis 'jug tu rung zhe na/ 'di 'dra ba gzhan du yang mthong ste/ nor gyi bdag po gcig nyid la be+e za ba ṇa zhe byas nas rnam thos kyi bu dang / be+e sha ma ṇa byas nas ngal sos kyi bu zhes zer ba dang / res 'ga' ni gang zag gcig nyid la nā ga bo d+dhi zhes byas nas klu'i byang chub dang / nā ga burnyi zhes byas nas klu'i blor brjod pa bzhin no/ bye brag tu man ngag snye mar khril ba la 'thung spyod 1141

dang 'thung gcod ces bya ba'i sgra gnyis gas bshad pa bzhin du gzung bar bya'o/ la sa sgron ni/ yul g.ye labs/ grong 'dabs grong mtsho mer mo/rus khe gang / yab chos bla/ yum zungs mo 'bum lcam gyi sras su 'thang / lto tsā ba khe'u gang 'khor lo grags dang lcam sring yin zhes zer/gzhon nu nas grwa pa mngon shes la rab tu byung / klog mkhas pas grwa pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol ju phyin pa klog pa'i klog mkhan yun ring du mdzad/ sher phyin klog phas stong pa nyid kyi lta ba ga 'a mar skyes/ de'i skabs shed du dam pa dang mjal/ de nas lan cig gi tshe glog mkhas pas 'dam bur klog la byon pa / gcer grong pa thod pa 'ba' re bya ba mi rabs nyi shu rtsa ga nyam du dge bshes rgyun ma cad pa cig kyang der rim gro la byon/ de dang 'dus pa las ga 'a mir song nas/ gnyis pos kong por byon/ sras mo rig 'khrungs pa la kong lcam zer/ yar la byon pa'i lam du la bar du za sa mo jig 'khrungs pa la la lcam zer/ de nas g.yer phebs nas gangs par thel cig mar za snying po grub pa/ grub chung / yang grub ste gsum 'khrungs/ de rjes yang btsun chas gyon skra bregs nas bzhugs/skyo ba da na sa bla ma khams su blon nas phyir 'khor ba'i lam du sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang ga gi/ dbang gi gral du rtogs pa shar bas dbang gsan 'phro la snying sa na na ba stod pas gzhan rnams kyis mo'i dbang 'phro la lus byas pas don gyi dbang de mos thob nas song / khyed rnams kyis tshig gi sgyu142

dbang thob pa yin gsung / phyis rab tu byung nas gan gar bde rnam su/ gdul byar gyur pa rnams la gdams pa gsung zhing bzhugs/ khyad par du zangs de khang dmar gyi phug par jo mo g.yog mos g.yog byas nas yun ring du bzhugs/ de ltar gcod kyi gdams pas bod khams gang bar mdzad de dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa lnga la gshegs/ yang dam pa bod du byon pa'i dus su bya nag mo bzhi dam pa'i phyi bzhin du 'phur zhing 'ong ba mthong ba las mkha' 'gro ma bzhir gyur pa ni/ ga 'i la sa sgron/gnyal stod kyi ma jo byang chub/ gtsang gi zhing mo rgyal mthing / lha sa'i smyon ma rnams te/ gnyal stod kyi jo mo byang chub ni/ rang gan lugs kyi dgongs pa gsal/ phan sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ zhang mo rgyal mthing ni/ khyo zhi ba'i mya ngan gyis non pa la dam pas blo dngos 'brel med kyi gdams pa btab pas grol/ lha sa'i spyon ma ni/ chos mdzad rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs sel zhing / jo bo rje la rgyal po'i bka' chems ston mkhan de yin zer ro/ labs sgron gyis gdams pa btab pa'i bu chen ni/ yar stod nas snyags pa rgyal mtshan/ yar smad nas man ston rin chen 'bar/ bar na dred jo sras/ shud sbyi lo tsā ba dang bzhi/ rgyal ba grub be/ rtogs ldan rdol bo sangs rgyas gnyan chung / mno sgom chen po dang bzhi/ bya ston klu sgrub/ khu sgom chos seng / :bas mo nam mkha' gsal/ gra pa rtag ston/ sha ston sdor 1143

'dzin/ spo ba sgom chen/ dwags po tshong sde ngag gi dbang phyug 'phan yul gyi rtsi rgyal ba la sogs pa mang du byon no/ sras grub che ni/ dang por sprang nga nyi tshe byed pas rwa sgra grub ber grags pa cig byung bas nam zhig sngags pa stengs ka ba'i rwa brkus pas sngags pa rnams kyis mthu byed pa thos/zla bo mang po shi bas der yum la bzlog pa'i thabs mnga' snyam nas yum gyi sar byon pa la/ yum gyis khyod 'chir 'jug dgos gsung nas bros te/tsha thang ri bo la 'khor cig bskor nas srod la reng gi phug par 'khor ba'i tshe/ grub bes kyang yum btsal te phyi bzhin bsnyegs pas phug par yum sras 'dzom byung bas/ yum gyi zhal nas/ khyod kyang skal med rang du mi 'dug gsung nas gdams pa byin/ da sngags pa'i gtor stegs thog tu nyol/ gtor zan byung na'ang zo gsung / de ltar byas pas sngags pa rnams la mthu log de'i tshe lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa la chos sgor tshud/de nas bsgoms pas chos nyid kyi don rtogs/ dang por lus sems bskyed pa'i ma/ /bar du zang zing 'bogs pa'i cha// /tha mar sems ngo sprod pa'i ma/ /ma drin mo che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pa yang mdzad/phyis g.ye chung glang lung dgon par bcos ma thams cad dang bral ba'i zhig por gyur te bzhugs byin rlabs kyis 'byung po zil gyis non/ slob ma thams cad la ye shes bskyed nus par gyur te brgyad cu rtsa dgu la gshegs/ 'di la sras tshe dbang / khu byug rnal 'byor grags 1144

gsum sdod bu/ kham bu yal le ni phyid bu'o/ tshe dbang la sras gsum las rgyal ba ston gzungs ni/ mes pos lung bstan nas dwags po ri mo mdor bzhugs/ thod smyon bsam grub ni/ sham po gangs la bzhugs pa'i gangs par grags/ skye med 'od gsal ni gnyal stod ma'o mdor bzhugs so/ de la thod smyon bsam grub gzhon dus g.ye dang yar klungs phyogs su 'khrug pa byas pas sus kyang ma thub/ de nas mdze byung bas ba yul gyi gangs la sgrub pa mdzad/ sbrul shun pa brjes pa bzhin du mdze phud/sham po'i gangs la gcer nyal byas pas gangs zhu nas gting ring por song ba la/ gzhan gyis phyugs kyi rnga ma mang du 'phang pa la gos stan mdzad cing zhwa ru yang gyon pas/ gangs pa'i zhwa nag gi srol de nas byung /gsol ba chu 'asang mdzad/ phyis chu rgyud mkhar du ro gsol/ khyad par mdze ro cig gi sna la shu ba 'dug pas 'jigs pas spyan chab chil gyis byung /bsod nams kyi 'ur yang de nas skyes/ ha'o gangs dang jo mo kha rag la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad/ sril ma la kha nas kong dang la yan chad du ri rgya klungs rgya lam rgya mdzad/ 'gron khang brtsigs nas 'gron zan byin te bstan pa bsrungs pas 'gran zla med pa'i grub thob tu gyur to/de la slob ma pho mo nyi shu rtsa gcig sras mo grub thob bco brgyad byon pa las gangs pa dmu yan ni/ 'gran gyi do med du gyur to/ de ni bcu bzhi lon pa la tsa rir 'gro 'dod pa la ma mo bde ldan gyis khyod shas gangs 1145

rin chen seng na grub thob chos sgro ra pa/ 'khrul zhig dge bshe byar po/ sras rgyud 'dzin rdo ji/ de ni lo gsum lon nas ma'on shes shar/ lo lnga lon nas sgom shes/ mas bshad shes/ lo bco sngo lo nas gshigs sun mdzad de yab mes kyi gdon sa gzung / bcu drug pa la lho rgyud du chos skor mdzad pas mkhas par grags/ chos bka'i mang po'i bka' babs/ bcu bdun la sham bu'i gangs la sgrub pa mdzad do/ gi la rgyud 'dzin mang na yang rang gi bras gang khrod ras pa ni/ mtshan skol ldan rdo rje/ lo gsum nas chos kyi spyod lam shes/ bdun la yab gshegs pas sprul sku skyid 'bum gyi phyir gsal rje gangs la byon/ bcu gcig la a ro khrid mo ches dbu byas pa'i sems khrid mang du zhus nas dka' thub 'dag 'byar mdzad/ bcu gsum la pha jo'i gdan sar bston/bco lnga nas rtsa drug gi bar sham spu gangs la bzhugs/ rtsa drug nas la bcu gnyis sto bar la bka' gter gyi chos mang du zhus shing byin chud par mdzad/ gzhan don dpag tu mad pa mdzad nas don gcig pa chu ma glang la gshegs thod smyon gyi sras sras mo la zlos nam mkha' rgyan/gangs pa dmu yan/ ston 'tsher te lta / sring gsum gyi zhabs la skal ldan pas gtugs/ di la 'ban ngo myang chos kyi seng gis gtugs/ yang na sha ston rdor 'dzin/ sangs rgyas myadzi sto / skal ldan pa/ mong dung khrod 'og pa rtogs ldan rdol po/ gtsang ba lang gro dzi/ rna sto 1147

brag sribs mo sher phug gi gle ston sangs rgyas/ des sgom pa gzhung chung ba la gsungs pa'o/ yang ma gcig gi slob ma khu sgom chos seng ni/yul snye mo khu ba/ rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa gsan nas thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad/ gyis ma gcig la mkha' 'gro nyams kyi skor gsan/ma gcig bgres khar zhabs la bsku mnye byas bas yun ring mi bzhugs par mthong nas chos ma lus pa thugs la 'dogs par zhu pas bka' brgyud don gyi gdams pa gnang / gzhan la phan pa'i lung bstan bzang po mdzad/ma gcing gi zhal nas/ 'di don grub la yang sbyin cig gsung pa las/khong la bshad dam snyam pa la/ gsan du ma bzhed pas bka' rgyud don gyi gdams pa don grub la med zer/ mdze byung nas chu mig nag po mthong ba dug zin du gcod la byon pas zhag gsum na snying bton nas khyer ba'i snang ba byung ba la zhag drug na gtad pa'i snang ba byung nas/ zhag bdun pa la mdze sangs kyis dwangs/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa la gshegs/ de'i slob ma dol pa zang thal ni/ 'khrungs yul 'tshur phu ba gdung dol/sku mched bzhi yod pa'i chung shos/ gzhon pa la dge bshes khyung la dbu ma'i rigs tshogs lo brgyad bslabs/ bshad gsar 'ong re ba la ma byung bas skyo shas skyes te dpe cha lha rten bla ma la phul/ gos dkar po gyon nas ri khrod la chig tshugs byed pa'i blo skyes/ khu sgom dang mjal gcod kyi gdams pa rnams zhu / gnyan khrod 'grims pas rtogs pa nam mkha' 1148

dang mnyam par gyur/ mi mangs dbus su su dang chos gtam byas kyang khong rgyal bas mi rnams na re/ na bza' skya la rigs pazang thal du 'gro ba cig 'dug zer bas dol pa zang thal du grags/ sku tshe'i smad la lugs smad du bzhugs/ chos mang du gsungs/ lnga bcu rtsa drug la gshegs/de'i slob ma rgya nag gcer bu ni/ yul khra sna ba/ spyir chos mang du gsan/ yar klungs skya'o dgon pa la gcod chos 'chad cing yod pa'i skabs su dol pa zang thal byon nas gsan pas nyog ge las ma byung / phyis dol pa zang thal mkhas par mthong ste/ da ci nas zho yul du dar ba btsongs/ da khyed kyi nyams nga la gnang ba zhu byas nas ma gcig gi gcod skor rnams tshang bar zhus/ gnyan khrod 'grims yar klungs gyi chu mig sbal 'drar gcod mdzad pas thog gsum bab kyang ma gnod par bsnyun las grol lo/ gcod kyis 'ba' ra nag po yang btul/ sku tshe'i smad la chu bo rir gzhan don mdzad de/ bdun cu bzhes pa'i tshe dbyings rig bsre na 'di ltar bsre ba yin gsung nas spyi gtsug nas yar 'od rgyangs kyis 'thon nas gshegs/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas rab ston ni/ bzad phu brag dmar ba/ gsar rnying thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas shing gyis rgya nag gcer bu la ma gcig gi gdams pa rnams zhus te tshe blos btang nas ri khrod 'ba' zhig 'grims nas brgyad cu la gshegs/ de'i slob ma sangs rgyas dge slong ni/ yul rdog can/ gdung ba shi/ gzhon nu la rab 1149

tu byung nas thos ba ma gyis sgro 'dogs chod/ sangs rgyas rab ston la gcod skor rnam zhus/ ri khrod phyogs med du 'grims pas chos nyid ma na sum du mdzad/ gdul bya mang po smin par mdzad nas lnga bcu rtsa gshegs/ de'i slob ma sum ston ras pa ni/ yul gra phyi/ grong bya rog tshang / yab mchod gnas dkon mchog yum mo na re/ ming sring gnyis kyi dong po/ mtshan byams pa/ lo drug pa la gra thang du bla ma zhang la rting rje 'dzin gyi dbang zhus pas 'dis 'gro don 'ong bar 'dug gsung / lo bco lnga pa la yab yum 'das nas skyo shas drag po skyes nas lcags rir rab tu byung / mtshan bsod nams shes rab tu btags/ dharma badz+ra zhes kyang bya/ slob dpon bka' gdams pa/ mnyan 'chad pa/nang lo tsā ba/ zangs ri rgya ras pa/ paṇa chen shāka shrī/ kham bu yal le/ bra'o lo tsa dang / rog shes rab 'od yab zas sogs bla ma bzhi bcu lhag pa cig bsten nas sngags mtshan nyid kyi chos mang du gsan/rigs pa phran tshegs bslabs pa yan la slob dpon brgya da lnga bcu rtsa gcig bsten nas gser bzo yan chad bslabs/ bla ma dol ba la brten/gye rer spang gnyen gyi 'dzin pa zhig pa'i rtogs pa bzang po 'khrungs shing /gcod yul gyi gdams pa mtha' dag gsan no/ de'i slob ma sangs/ rgyas ston pa/ de'i slob ma mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub/ de'i slob ma gser gling pa bkra shis dpal/ de'i slob ma brag po che ba rdo ri dpal/ de'i 1150

slo ba ma chos sgo ba chos kyi rgya mtsho/ de'i slob ma rgod sbug ras pa ste ni gu'i skabs su brjod zin to/ chos rje rgod phrug ras pas ni bdag la rjes su gnang ngo /gzhan 'phan yul gyi rtsi dar mas gan 'tsho ba mi bskyod rdo rje la bshad/ des chos rje rang byung rdo rje la bshad cing bstan bcos kyang mdzad la/ de las brgyud nas dpal mkha' spyod pas kyang gdams ngag gi yi ge mdzad cing gzhan la rgya cher bstan to/ chos rje rang byung bas ma mas byang chub rdo rje la gnang / des rang gi sras chos rje ri mi 'babs pa bsod nams rin chen la gnang / des bdag la gnang ngo zhes bya ba ni phyogs gcig ga yang dam pa dbus pa zhes bya ba gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis mi'i gzhung gdams pa la mkhas shing / zhi byed rjogs chen sogs kyi gdams pa yang mnga' ba des dang por ma gcig blo gcod kyi gdams pa zhus/ yum gshegs nas sras rgyal ba don rgyab la lo bco brgyad brten/gdams pa'i yi ge yang mdzad cing chos kyi bdag por gyur to/ des bla ma rdo rje bde ba la gnang ste/ de ni sngag pa nad rgyas kyi gtad 'og tu chud pas lus ngan par gyur pa dam pa dbus pa'i snyan pa thos te gcod kyi gdams pa zhug nas nyams su blang pas sdog phug 'dre can zhig tu bzhugs spro sa dang por mi nag po cig dang 'dzings/ stong nyid yid la byas nga sa de gis rgyal/ sna nas sbrul mthon so ri bas rjes la sna khrag mang du 1151

zags pa rmis pa'i de ma thag gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa 'khrungs/ lus kyang rta bas mgyogs par gyur to/ des sgom pa gzhon nu ye shes la gnang ste/ de yang gdams ngag mang du yod kyang nad kyis mnar ba zhig rdo rje bde ba la gcod kyi gdams ngag zhus/ gnyan sa mang po 'grims/ nad las rgyal/ rtogs pa 'khrungs/ gcong can mang du gsos so/ des bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje la gnang / de ni snye mo mkha' ru thog tu 'khrungs/de ni sngags pa yin pa cig bam sgrub nyes nas/ lus gcong gis zin pas bla ma gzhon nu ye shes la gtugs nas gcod kyi gdams pa zhus shing nyams su blangs pas khams dwangs/ gcong can mang du sog so/ des bla ma sangs rgyas ston pa la gnang ste/ de ni 'khrungs yul sgong ma'i ko ru ba/gro sar rab tu byung / phar phyin/ bden gnyis/ rma so skam gsum gyi chos skor la sogs mkhas par mkhyen/ mi bskyod rdo rje la gcod kyi gdams pa rnams zhus/ de rnams kyi don brgyud ma lus par gsan zhing rtogs pa mang du 'khrungs/ des bla ma lung phran pa chen po la gnang /de yang dus 'khor dang phar phyin mkhas par mkhyen/ mi bskyod rdo rje la gdams pa gsan zhing rtsal thon par mdzad do/ btsun gyi lung blangs nas bzlas bsnyen mdzad pa las ring por mi thogs par zhal mngon sum du gziṭa te/ slob dpon dang slob ma dag bzhin du dri zhing lan gdab pa mdzad pas chog pa dang / phal cher mngon du phyogs pas gnang bar mdzad pa zhig 7152

go rje btsun des bya bral la zhugs na da ltar gyi gnas skabs las bstan pa la ches phan pa chen por 'gyur bar lung bstan pas gsung bzhin du bsgrub te/ 'khor 'ga' zhig dang lhan du 'ol khar phebs te/ de nas mon bum thang gi mthar thug pa'i dben pa rnams su thugs dam la bzhugs/ de'i tshe bka' gdams kyi gdams pa sku nyams su bzhes pas thugs rgyud shin tu mtho bar gyur pa'i mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang po dang / gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snang bas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las skad cig kyang mi g.yo bar gyur pa'i mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje gnyis las dpal mar me mdzad ye shes las 'ongs pa'i lam gyi rim pa dag gsan nas sku nyams su bstar/ re shig gnyal gyi mi la'i rtsar zhags mdzad pas/khyod sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa dang 'dra ba cig 'ong bar shes par gyis shig ces pa'i lung bstan pa brnyes/ yi dam gyis kyang 'dul ba'i bslab pa la brten nas gzhan la phan pa chen por 'gyur bar lung bstan pas thog mar dpon slob rnams kyi bla gos dras shing drubs pa dang lhung bzed dang gding ba la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bsnams nas gzhan dag gis mthong ba na/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul ni 'di lta bu zhig kho na'o zhes yid ches par 'gyur bar mdzad nas/ phyis ni lo re'i zla re tsam chos nyan par rtsol pa'i slob ma dag kyang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa la bkod pas mngon sum du gyur pa lta zhog rgyang ring po nas thos pa dag kyang spu lang g.yo bas phyogs 1153

thams cang du snyan spro rnga lja pe sta 'gran zla med par gyur/ so so thar pa tsam gyis chog mi shes par slob ma rnams smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub gyi sem/sa la bkod de/ de'i bslab pa'i gnas ngag la ji ltar slob ba'i tshul gyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas la bskal pa bye bar brtson par byas kyang de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang mi ldan na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal bar mi nus so zhes dgongs nas/ de dag gi tshul leb/sa par ston pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag kyang ji ger mdzad/ de lta bu de la lam gyi cha rags pa tshang yang tshe gcig nyid la sangs rgya ba'i sngags kyi tshul la 'jug dgos par dgongs nas/ dang por bla ma bsten pa'i tshul dang / de nas bla mas gnang ba'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ji ltar bskyang ba dang / dbang bskur ba tsun du 'gro bas rim pa gnyis la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul gyi lam gyi rim pa dang / bye brag tu dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud slob dpon 'phaṭa pa klu sgrub yab sra kyi gzhung gtso bor mdzad pa'i gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ de yang dang por yul phyogs ji ltar rigs pa rnams su zhu zhing gzhan gyi don mdzad pa las/ sa mo glang gi lo sha ba la smon lam chen mo dzad cing / 'dus pa'i skye bo rnams la chos kyi snang ba yang bstsal nas/ lo de nyid la dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab/ de nas shing mo lug gi lo la 'on gyi bkra shis do khar 1154

zabs nas sngags mtshan nyid kyi chos gyi 'khor ma nga du bskor/ sdod 'dzin pa nyung rag shig bsdus nas dka' ba'i gnazangarnamatsho sung gtan r+sās phab/ zla ba gnyis lhag tsam zhiba'ibazhugs nas/ slar dge ldan du zabs te gyi'i mchod khang dang nang du rin pho che mas grub pa'i sngag gyi dkyil 'khor leg par bzhengs/ sa mo phag gi lo la stod phung gyi chab tshan la thegs/ de nas dpal 'bras spung kyi gtsug (sgrigapo po mchan/ dbus kun bde gling gi shing brkos par galas/ 5btsun gyi lung blangs nas bzlas bsnyen mdzad gal ring bor mi thogs par mngon sum du gzigs te zhes pa nas/ de nas dpal 'bras spung kyi gtsug zhes pa'i bar gyi dum bu 'dir a mdo mdo mad chos grwa nga bar las mi 'dra ba'i dum bu zhig byung ba 'di ltar dzides ma ston gcig pa gzhon nu chu la khrims la gnang / 'di lajo ston bang ba zhe sung bya/ dang por thang sag tu byon nas rab tu byung / dbu ma ga la bslabs/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ gsang jigs 'phags skor rnam gri lum par bslabs/ bla ma thar pa ba/ dbyal lo kro ba la ngon pa gong 'og dang / phar tshad bsdus gsum dang / du kyi 'khor 'o tho'agrel gdams pa dang bca pa/ phag mo dpyal gyi chos drug gshed ngamar la sogs pa sngags kyi rgyud sgrub thabs mang du gsan/ de na ngo stan tshogs pa'i ga ba na bzhugs kyi yod pa ma gcong gi theb nas bla snang 755

lung bran pa la gcod kyi gdams pa rnams zhus/ dur khrod gcig tu bsgoms pas sngar grang yang na dro yang na ba la/ der pho ba la rdo grang bslan/ chu 'khyags btungs/ gcer nyal byas/ na rga shi skyed la btang / nyams len byas pas zhag bcu gcig la kha nas dri mi zhim pa zhig byung / zhag bcu gnyis kyi nam phyed nas nad thams cad skyugs/ thogs phyed tsa na sangs thon/ zla ba phyed na khrid tshar ba/ nad sol ba/ thugs dam 'khrungs pa dus gcig la byung / gzhan yang tshad nad dang gnyal stog dang thogs bcas thogs med kyi bdud ci byung yang na rga shi skyid la btang nas thog 'gel drag po byed cing nyams su blangs pas nad gdon thams cad rang zhi la song / sems can la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad de skyam gyi gser lung du bzhugs so/ des bla ma bsam gtan dar la gnang /khong yul g.ye'i zim shi phu/ yab sbor dbon seng dang yum jo mo bsam me gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ sku na gzhon nu nas dad pa dang snying rje dong shes rab bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga'/ bla ma jo stan pa'i sar rab tu byung nas gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ nā ro 'grel chen/ dbu ma tshig 'jug stong gsum/ do ha skor gsum/ spyod 'jug rnam / mkhas bar bslabs/ sbyor drug thar lo lugs/ rim lnga dmar khring skor/thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid/ phyag chen gang gā ma/ blo sbyong /gcod yul le'u lag gnang the mas bka' rgya ma la sogs pa gcod skor 1156

rnams tshang bar zhus/ nyams myong yang thad por bskyangs/ gser lung du chos gsan 'phro la bsnyung nad drag pos blo bur du btab nas/ ri khrod cig tu skyol/ gcod byed gsungs pas/ grogs mched kun gyis gnyan khrod du khur nas bskyal/ der gcod bskyangs pas/ nyams myong skyes/yang g.yam bzangs khri dpon byang nas phebs shing mar gdan drangs pa'i sar mjal 'gro dgongs nas byon pas shugs kyi lam kha cig tu gnam gdon car phog rgyab/ 'byon ma shes pas zhabs tog pas khur nas lam zhogs kyi ri'u ril khrod gcig tu brgyal/ lha rje la rtsa bstan pagasman bcos la 'bungs na 'tsho e srid zer bas/ sman mi byed dge sbyor cig byed gsungs nas/ de nas gri mdo'i zhogs kyi brag phug gcig tu khur nas/ gdan drangs/ der yang lha rje bos pas da gsol ba mi thebs par 'dug zer/ khyed tsho nga'i tho phyir ma 'dug gsung nas bskrad de na dga' shi skyid la btang bas sang de nas cung dwangs/ de nas zhag gsum bzhi na g.yam bzangs ba'i khri chung 'od kyis lha rje khrid/ sha khog gsum bzhi khyer nas byon pas lha rjes rtsa bltas pas nad sol 'dug ngo mtshar che zer/ sku khams sngar bas bzang ba zhig byung / thar pa gling ba la sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe sgrub skor dang khrid chen brgyad sogs mang du zhus/ bla ma blo gros dpal ba la gsang 'dus/ gshed dmar/ rdo rje phreng ba la sogs kyi dbang / sbyong rgyud la sogs pa'i rgyud kun gsan/ ṅge ma rin 1157

chen song ge ba la dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / kye'i rdo rje'i yababaka' yum bka' lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa gsan/ dgung lo so gcig bla mjo stan pa'i gdan sar byon nas ’/) mo nyi shu'i bar la nyan bshad dus bzhi'i chos ma chag par gsungs/da ra ro mtsho nag yar lha shaḥ sogs pa'i gnyan khrod skor zhing gcod mdzad/ de nas dmi' thog r+sha dus ma bde bas thugs cung ma bde bas ldan mkhar dga' ldan btab/ bla mchos dpal dgon po la dus 'khor gyi dbang yong rdzogs/ sbyor drug jo nang lugs/ u rgyan bsnyen sgrub la ga mang du zhu / drung chos rje tho la mkhan chen bu'i sbyor drug sron lugs/ gsang 'dus kyi dbang / bshad bka'/ rim lnga'i dmar khrid nasakhrid dang bca pa mkhasogs pa mang du zhus/ bla ma rtogs ldan nga ri chos skor bsnyen sgrub dang thab lam gyi skor mang du zhus/ bsnyung ba sogagaci byung ming sman bcos rim gro mi mdzad par gtsod 'ba' zhig mdzad/ dgon par ri mi'ababs la zhugs te snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab bo/ de 'angachos rje mi nyan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la lacho sgong tshe 'dor bas gsan no/ mo gcod kyi skabs so/ /pho gcod kyi skabs/ yo gcod du grags pa ni/ yar klungs kyi sma ra ser pos rgya gar 1 58

shar nub tu byin yang 'dod ba ba na gyi chos ma byung bar/ de na tshong pa dang 'grogs te bod du 'ongs ba'i lam du a tsa ra cig dang lhan du byung ste gyi nang gang yin ngo ma shes/ khong gi zla la dge bshes dngos rgya bya nga yod pas de la chu sha nga gi mkhar ba'i loṭa bzhi ma ri ma mang tho yod ba cig yod ba ma tsa ras 'dir thong dang gsung bas btang bas/ 'di mu stegs rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i lag cha min/ ngas kyang rte te dgo ba da gsung nas bcag ma tsa ra zla bo la su yin dris pas da ba min zer der yid ches nas khong gnyis gyis chos zhus bas/ dngos grub la gyi snang nga na du ma len bya ba la sog pa'i gdams ba ga stong pa kho de nges shes rnyed nas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ sma re ra 'o cho zhu ba khyod 'dod pa'i chos shig gzod 'ong gsung bas/ dmakhapa gyi ba na 'brangs nas ldog stag rig su sleb/ dam pas 'gron khang cigatu ba cud pa la/ byin rlabs zhu ba mang du byung / khyad par mig 'ong ba dang rna ba 'on pa sogs mang po 'phral la so bas/ der skyo shākya ye shethasacho 'khor la byon pa'i phyir myang stod pa'i phyug po cig gi bu mdze ma ma byung ba gnyis skyo la gta na nas yod pa/ skyo sku bsod kyis g.yengs na byis ba'i khams la bskyed ma byung / der dam pas nad 'bral du sos pa'i ngo ma ra 'dug pa thos nas/ skyos dam pa lang la byis ba lha 'dre'i 'asgro gnyibasayod pas khyed kyis byin gyis rlob bar cu byas ba / dam pa'i zhal na /1159

sma ra ser po la khyod rang 'dod pa'i chos da 'ong gsung nas skyo dpon slob gsum/ sma ra ser po dang bzhi la gcod kyi gdams pa gnang / gdams pa de la ming brul tsho drug pa zhes bya ba de yi ger btab/ zhal gdams yi ger ma btab/ byis pa gnyis kyis kyang nyams su blangs pas nad sos nas sgrub pa po re re byung / skyos ni gzhan la ma spel bar rang gis nyams su blangs/ brgyud pa chad kyis dogs pas dbon po bsod nams bla ma gcig pu la gnang / des khams la byon nas yar 'khor ba'i lam du labs sgron la brul tsho bzhi gnang / sma ra ser pos kyang gzhan la ma spel bar hang bu'i phag mo dang gcod gnyis la rgyun gyi nyams len byas/ bgres khar rang gi nye gnas smyon pa be re la tshang bar gnang / khyod rang nyams su longs la su la yang ma byin gsung / de'i tshe sne ston dang phug ston gnyis phu thang na sha ston rdor 'dzin gyi grwa sa na yod pa la/ lce ston na ba la/ be re chos de la nyams len byed pa'i rgyus yod pas bsnyad pas/sha ston na re/ pung la gdams pa zhur 'gro zer ba la/ ri khrod phug ston gyi zhal nas/ slob dpon chos 'phro bcad nas 'byon pa ga la 'ong /nga nyams len pa yin pas gnang 'ong bas zhur 'gro yi zer/ rdor 'dzin gyi zhal nas/ 'o na nga'i grogs po lce ston la zhu grogs tshol la/ khyed la dam pa nas brgyud pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa cig yong par 'dug bdag la de gnang bar zhu gyis la zhus /160

shig zer/ bug ston gyis de kho na bzhin du byas nas zhus pas/ bla ma be re smyon pa'i zhal nas nga'i chos 'di su la yang rgyus med pa la khyod la 'dres bshad dam gsung / yang khyed chos nyams su len nges shig yin nam gsung / nyams su len pa lags zhus pas gzhung brul tsho drug ngo sprod zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang / de nas skyi tshang du nyams len mdzad cing bzhugs pa na slob dpon sha ston gyis mi btang byung bas phu thang du byon nas brul tsho gsum gsungs/ khams pa ston pa cig la brul tsho drug gnang / de'i yig mkhan gyis kyang bris/ dusaphyis rog shes rab 'od kyis ri khrod zhig po'i sar byon nas mtshan brjod dang phag mo dam pa'i lugs zhus pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pa yig mkhan de la gnas po bcol pas kho las gdams pa'i khungs chod de phug ston la zhus pas/ gcig gis 'brel na kun gyis 'brel cha rkyen so gas shig gsung nas brul tsho dang po gnang / chos 'ji la 3 lag gzhan mi bdog gam zhus pas gdams pa kha yar yod de phu thang du sha ston rdod 'dzin la gsum las ma byin pas da tshang bar bshad na khong ma dgyes kyi dogs gsung / khong la tshang bar gnang gsha' ba la zhus pas/ gdams pa zab ches pa dang / khong gi de na mi mang po 'dug pa thams cad kyis yi ger 'bri bar 'dug pas kyang ma byin/ bla mar mi 'dzin par yi ge ci thob byed par 'dug pas kyang ma byin gsung / bdag la gdams pa kha tshang ba cig gnang bar zhu byas pas/1161

khyed kyis 'gro ba la na thog par 'dug pas sbyin no gsung nas brul tsho drug pa zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang nas/ da gdams pa la lhag ma lu dzi gcigakyang med do gsung / zhal gdams rnams yi ger ma 'depas cig gsung nas dgyes bzhin du ga nga / des sum ston ras pa lo/ gis dzi ma gnyan ston la/ /ming ri khrod phug ston gyis skal ldan zas mo la/ des gtsang ston skyi tshang pa la/ des gnyan ston la/ des dpon po chos sdong pa dor ma sheso rab la des sgrig ston sangs rgyas la gnang ngo / ya sem ston ra pas sa so gyes ston pa gnang / des mkhas btsun gzhon zu grub ma chad rgyur ba zhin sgo/ spyir gcod kyi skor 'di rnams na tu khyab tshe lo/ de las rnam thar lo rgyus kyi yi ge mthong ba dag gris pa yin no/pho gcod rdzu skab tha / kha rag pa'i skabs/ji gangs can gyi skye bo 'di dag la gtsug gi nor bu gcig dang rna ba'i spyon gnyis yod de/ gtsug gi nor bu ni pad+ma lha ba'o/ rna ba'i rgyan ga lha ni kha ra sgom chung yin la/ gnyis pa ni rje btsun mi la'o/kha byurag sgom chung ni/ gdams ngag gi rgyun chu bo gnyis 'dres gsol zhing sgrub pa rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin no/ de la gdams ngag gi rgyun 1162

gceg ni ma ro ye shes 'byung gnas las bab ste/ ma ro ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ chu mig ring mo'i bye gseb tu bu chung du sprul nas bzhugs pa la/lha btsun ma cig khams bsong du phyin pasamathong / snying rje yang khyer phyin na yang lo byung gis dogs rna / gnas gzhi'i dpon la 'di 'dra ba zhig 'dug smras pas/ 'o na snying rje long la shog zer bas blangs/ ro 'dra bar nyal zhing kha nas a a zer pas ror btags/ gyis 'gro shes nas dge 'dun chos spyod rgyad pa'i rkun dga' ra bar gyin/ dge 'dun rnams na re/ a ro khyod 'dir ci byin zer ba la/ nga ming 'dir chosaspyod byed byas pas/ khyod kyis chos shes sam zer ba la/ bdag gis chos mang po yang dag pa shes byas pos/ 'o na 'di yang shes sa byabra nganas spyod 'jug gi gzhung gcig gtad pas/ legs par bton byung /khyed la ma grags pa'i chos kyang shes zer nas ro lugs kyi gdam ngag gi ming 'ga' zhig bton pas/ der dge 'dun thams cad ha las te a ro dang a ngos te ye shes kyi 'byung gnas su gda' 'o zer bas mtshan ye shes 'byung gnas su chags/ des yun ring bar bzhugs nas gdams pa zab mos gdul bya rnams bskyangs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ de'i slob ma yang khams kyi yang zi bon ston/ kha rag gi bru sha rgyal bu/dbus kyi grum shing shes rab smon lam/ gtsang gi cog ro zangs dkar mdzod khur ro/ de las ya zi bon ston gyis dbus gtsang ju byon nas 1163

gtsang rgyan gong bi gru gu klog 'byung la bshad/ des bres chu bar gyi glam sgosna tshul khrims snying po la bshad/ de ni/ ngas ro'i rna bar chos bshang na ro 'gul/ nam mkha'i bya la sgom btab na yang theb sa zhes zer/des rba sgom bsod nams rgyal mtshan la bshad/ de ni yul 'phan yul spras kyi 'jub/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig dang mjal nas rtogs pa (la sa dgyes te/ da khyod kyi de la byams pa dang snying rje'i sdon ma cig thob la bsgoms/ bsgoms skyon byung na byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs 'chos pa la 'ong gi gsung / jo bos bod kyi rtsom pa 'ga' re gziṭa pas dgyes rgyu tsam ma byung ba la/ a ro'i theg chen rnal 'byor gzigs pas/ 'di tshig snyan ngag che don zhin tu bzang gsung nas dgyes/ rba sgom de pu to ba'i yab kyi mchod gnas yin pa/ pu to bas rwa sgeng du ma byon gong du khong la sgom gyi gdams pa zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ thos pa yen re ma byas pa'i sgom de yang mtshan ku/ nga bas phugs thag thung ba cig thong gi 'dug gsung / phyis pu to ba dge bshes chen por gyur pa'i tshe na rba sgom gyi chos de ci 'dra zhig yin nam snyam du dgongs pa la/ mnal lam rtags can zhig byung bas/ rba sgom gyi chos de yang yang dag pa cig yin pa 'dug gsung / de'i slob ma /— rag sgom/ chung ste/ de ni yul gtsang stod kyi dung zhur bya ba na/ sgom pa da tan mchog rten bya ba la bu bal po dbang sdong/ de 'og shā dbang rā/ de thog sgom pa dbang phyug blo gros te 1164

sasum yod pa las/ dbang phyug blo gros ni/ chung ngu nas dad pa che/cis kyang rab tu 'byung dgos te snyam pa'i zhes bcad kyang yod ba/ be'u klu'i ye shes bya ba thod phu pa cig yod pas de la rdzogs chen gyi gdams pa mang du zhus nas/ 'phyil phu'i sgom khang du sgom pa'i g.yog po bal po dbang rdor gyis byed kyi yod pa'i dus su/ brag dkar rtsi can la sgom bzhugs yod pa'i dus su jo bo bzang po gdams ngag can cig 'dug zer nas/ bal po dbang rdor gyis zhal bltar phyin pas mjal ba dang chos kyi gling bslong byas pas jo bo gdams ngag can cig 'dug snyam nas mos pa cig byung / da nga dor gyis gtsang bu la lo rgyus bshad nas de'i rtsar 'deng byas pas phyag rten med zer/ mar tshud cig yod di phul bas chog byas nas 'grogs phyin/ gtsang bu dang rba sgom mjal ma thag nas thugs yid 'dres/ gdams pa zhus pas rab tu 'a nga dgos zer ba / lab so gnas su mar sgom la rab tu byung / de nas rba sgom la gdams ngag skor gsum po zhus/ gzhan chos zhu ba 'ga' re'ang byung ba la bla mas gzhan rnams bkye/ gtsang bu gcig pu nye logs su bzhag sgom gyis zhag bdun mtshams bcad pas gshin rje gshed kyi zhal gzigs/ de'i bar rba sgom gyis g.ya' ma la yi gi bris te gyir bor ba rnams gtsang bus bklags/der yon bdag gcig gis phye ya gnyi phul bas/ rba sgom gyi zhal nas/bdud byung gsung na blo pa'i phyags phyir byon/ dpon slob gnyis pos 1165

rgyur byon te/ blo sdog bzhi'i rtog ba sum bas gnas brtan rgyal she bya ba na ri/ nga khong gi de la dge ba'i bshes gnyid pa lan cig thob zer ba spu/ de la lan mi thebs/ skyil bu smri ba'i seng gir song 'dug gsung nas bsnyen bkur byung ba tham cad kyi phud nas gtsang bu ma skyel/gtsang bus zhag gcig la byed ba'i chos de 'o skol dpon slob rdzu sbo gcig la mi nus gsung ba'i sngags po chen po mdzad/ lan cig rnal 'byor babe'u klu'i ye shes kyis dam tshig la bsgros nas/ nga na ba cis rkyang byon bya ba byung bas phu to ba la phyag skyel du byon/ 'bral phod pas gnyis ka la sbyan chagabyung / 'phan yul rgyal du zabs dzin chos zhu ba dang 'bul ba chen po yang byung / de na bla ma kha rag tu byon dgabe'u klu'i ye shes la zhabs tomakhabag tsam cig byas na / lta rag zug ba nag pong thugs dam mdzad/ snyan pas phyogs thams cad du khyab ba cags pa stong tsam 'dus/ re shig na de yang rnam g.yeng du da ngas te tshobakhasab bkye nagadabon slob nyung shas shig mdzad de lo mang bor bzhuṭa pa'i mthar ston mo ba nga ba zhig mdzad de/ 'di tha ma'i sa yin no gsung zhing / nga ne+e ba'i dus su phung po 'di ri rtser skyol la nga'i rjes su rten bzhings pa sogs ma byed cig gsung nas sku gshegs/ spur kha rag gi rtse la bskyal bas rnal 'byor po cig gi rgyag ma gcig gril bcad bas kho de rang du shi kha ra ba'i slob ma ba rnyarma skyab dang rngul stod rdo rje rin chen gnyis :67

las/ci ba ni/ yul la mig smon mda' pa/ rong ba chos bzang gi spyan sngar chos mang du gsan/ rab tu byung nas ba dkar 'bring ston 'a/ bslab phyogs dang byams chos la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ yol chos dbang la yang gdams ngag mang du zhus/ kha rag pa'i rtsar byon nas mar tshud phul/ gdams ngag gi zhu ba mdzad pas de ma thag sgo bsdams/gdams ngag can gzhan na mang du yod pa zhus gsung nas lho bas bal po dbang rdor gyi sar lo gsum bzhugs/ de nas gtsang bu'i zhal nas/sto ba de ma song ngam gsung / 'o na 'dir khrid 'a shog gsung nas gdams pa rnams tshang bar gnang / lo lnga 'grogs/ de la yang snyan pa che bas yar sregs rgya dman la sogs pa'i ston chen rnams dang / myang sgom rgod po/ myang sgom dkar po/ myang sgom zhig po chos she ste/ myang sgom mched gsum la sogs pa mang du byung ngo / rngul ston gyis kyang lidams ngag mang du mkhyen pa zhig kha rag pa dang mjal bas ston pa des chos byas na 'ong bar 'dug gsung ba thos nas/ ngas chos mang du shes pa la de 'dra gsung ba ci yin snyam pa la/ phyis skor gsum gyi gdams pa zhus nas nyams su blangs pas gsung de bden par go ste/ kha rag nas yar 'brog la byon no/ de ltar na gdams pa'i chu bo cig ni jo bo rje'i gdams pa rwa sgreng nas bab pa de yin te/ kha rag pas de gnyis bsres nas byang chub sems sbyong zhes bya bar mtshan gsol/ kha rag skor gsam du yang 1168

pags nas zhin tu dar bar gyur to/ a ro nyid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rba sgom gyis gtsang rong gi dam pa 'dzi sgom/ des yar 'brog gi bar sgom che / des yul chos kyi jo mo myang mo/ des skyi mkhar ba'i lha rje lha khang pa/ des dbus pa ston shāka des zhis/ po bdud rtsi la gnang nas brgyud pa mang du 'phel lo/ kha rag pa'i skabs so/ /
(pha)deb ther sngon po las/ thugs rje chen po'i skor dang /rdo sde phreng ba sogs kyi skabs bzhugs so/ /

dum bu bcu bzhi pa/ thugs rje chen po'i skor dang rdo rje phreng ba sogs kyi skabs/ thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs kyi brgyud pa'i skabs/rgya'i yul ni byang chub sems dpa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gzung ba bzhin du/ bod kyi yul 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis rjes su bskyangs pa yin te/de'i byin gyis rlabs kyis bu chung yan chod/ skyes pa dang bud med/rab tu byung ba dang bcas pa thams cad kyi kha nas ma ṇi'i sgra rang grag pa 'di yin no/ de bas na 'dod pa'i lha la gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs byung ba yang spyan ras gzigs nyid la brten na myur la/ spyan ras gziṭa nyid rgyal po'i cha byad du sprul pa'i srong btsan sgam pos bsgrubs pa'i lha dang gtsug lag khang rnams kyang bod kyis mchod par bya ba'i snying po yin zhing / rgyal po bzhugs pa'i pho brang byung ba'i ri la yang po ta la zhes ming du chags so/ rgyal po'i gsung las byung ba'i sngags kyi gdams pa la brten nas 1173

ga rna rje gshed la sogs pa'i grub pa thob pa yang mang du byung bar grags ci rtso/do/ ding sang de'i chos la brten pa'i slob dpon gyi 'grel pa mi snang yang / sgrub pa'i thabs kyi yi ge'i cha shas ni da dung gan so/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub pa'i skor gter du sbas pa grub thob dngos grub kyis bton nas/ spa rnams dgon par rog shes rab 'od kyis zhus/ des rang gi sras dang slob ma rnams la rim par brgyud do/ yang grub thob dngos grub la sprul su myang ston gyis zhus/ des zla ma ras pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ bla ma shākya seng ge bzang po/ lha rje dge ba 'bum/ lcam mo shes mchog byang sems chu sgom/ mtha' bzhi bya bral/ bsod nams seng ge/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma blo gros rgyal mtshan/ deganyis ka la bla ma bsod nams bzang po/ des rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas la 'o/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mcho/ snang ba mtha' yas/thugs rje chen po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bhaṅga la'i phag mo/ ti pu pa/ras chung pa/ zangs ri ras pa/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ spom brag pa/ rkarma ba shi/ grub chen u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ khams chen rgan lhas pa/ stag ston gzhon nu dar/ bag ston gzhon tshul ba/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ rgod sbug pa grags pa 'byung gnas te gzhan yang brgyud pa mang ngo yar klungs lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan las byung ba'i rigs kyi 'jig rten 1174

mgon po zhes bya ba'i mngon par rtogs pa dbang dang bcas pa dang / rgyud sho lo ka lnga bcu pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa lo tsā ba dus 'khor ba bsod she la gnang nas de las brgyud pa mang ngo / kha che'i pazlo ta su ma gi shrīs bu ston la bshad pa'i pad+ma dra ba'i chos skor yang thugs rje chen po'i chos skor ro/ spyan ras gzigs nyid kyi sprul pa grub pa thob pa'i skyes bus gsungs pa'i chos rnams ji ltar brgyud pa'i tshul yang / spyon ras gzinas nyid yin par rtsod pa med pa'i byang chub soms dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho gas bslab pa la bkod pa dang /dbu ma'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i rim pa la sogs pa gzhan yang yod mod kyi/ bsnyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga la brten nas 'phags pa mnyes par byed pa'i rim pa ni/ 'phags pas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i dge slong ma dpal mo dang / des byin gyis brlabs pa'i parnyi ta ye shes bzang po dang / des byin gyis brlabs pa'i bal po be nya ba rnams ni grub thob sha stag yin la/ de la byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis ga na/de ni spyan ras gziṭa nyid yin par gzhan dag yid ches pa'i tshul ni/bal po'i bde mchog gi lha khang du mkha' 'gro mang po byung ba/ de'i dkon gnyer gyis mthong nas khyed rnams gang nas 'ongs/ ci byed byas pas/ li kha ra shing 'phel nas 'ongs/ li kha ra shing 'phel gyi spyan ras gzigs nyid 'di na bzhuṭa pa la mchod pa byed du 'ongs zer/ de 1175

su yin pya sa pas byang sems zla rgyal yin zer ba dang / ong po lo tsā ba sa 'phags pa wa ti'i lha khang du nya'/ ba na zla ba rgyal mtshan 'phags pa nyid yin par wa tis sang bstan pa la sa/gas pas gzod skye bo mang po yid ches par gyur/ zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis sems can rnam kyi sdig pa sbyong ba la ci phan gzigs pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi drung du bsnyung ba gnas khu gan cig byas pas kyang sdig pa chen po zad nas mi'i lus thob/ mthar bde ba can du 'gro ba la sogs pa'i gtam mang du yod pa rnams ma spros so/ bla ma sa chen gyis zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi nye gnas yun ring du mdzad pas nam gyi tshe byon pa des shes la/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal phag mo gru pa dang / grub thob la yag pa'i yang bla ma yin no/de la grub thob nyid phug pas 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs rnams zhus pa yin te/pha ma zhang zhung ba/ la stod du thongs pa'i tshe stag bde seng ge lung du shing pho khyi la 'khrungs/ pha mas rigs 'tshol 'gro zer nas spu hrangs su gzhon nu la khyer/ lo bdun tsam 'on nas las 'bras la nges pa rnyed/bcu bzhi la dbus su byon nas zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i sar bo dong gzugs par byon nas/ khyung la rab tu byung nas mtshan chos kyi grags par btags/jo bo 'bum phrag gsum pa la chos zla ba cig nyan/ zangs dkar gyi drung du lo drug bzhugs nas bde mchog la sogs zhus/ chu mig ring mor gza' mi mdzad/ mnga' ris 'jam dbyangs sto brag tu byon pa la bsnyen 176

par rdzogs/ 'bre shes rab 'bar la sher phyin nyan/ tshar bco lnga bshad /dge bshes dkon mkhar la zur chos nyan/ khyung la dbu tshad/ rgya dmar la zur chos gsan/ ngur smrig pa chen po la mngon pa/ stag tshal gyi mar pa lo tsā la byams chos zhus zer te do ba yin/ dge bshes lcang ra ba la btsan lugs kyi byams chos/ spa tshab lo tsā la rigs tshogs/dge bshes gshin la tsa lo tsā ba'i chos drug mnga' ris skyi ston la spu hrangs lo chung gi bde mchog la soṭa/ rngog gzhung pa la dgyes rdor/dpyal kun dga' rdo rje dang snubs phag mo lung ba la dgyes rdor dang phag skemo/ mtha' bzhi la sngags dang 'dul ba/ de dag gi bar skabs su yang byang sems zla rgyal gyi nye gnas mdzad cing chos mang du gsan/ rgya chu mig pa bla ma sto pa la yang mang du gsan/ 'khon gad pa gīrti la rim lnga'i khrid/ lha rje gtsang shod pa la phyag chen/ bal bo ma su la phyag chen snying po'i skor/ sne'u zur ba'i drung du bka' gdams/ dwags po lha ri'i drung du nā ro chos drug se mkhar chung ba'i nye gnas phar sgom la lam 'bras zhus/ spyir rnying ma mnyan/ gsar ma'i chos ma nyan pa med gsung / de nas rta sgo'i gangs la lo ril po brgyad/ dbyar re dgun re bsdad pa drug ste lo bcu bzhi bsgoms/ mngon par shes pa shar/ rta sgo'i lha btsan gyis chos zhus nas srog snying phul/ der bzhugs ring la jo pad kyis g.yog byas/ de nas ldog tu byon nas slob dpon ldog 117 7

pa'i zha pa snar khyod dze+e mngon shes yod dam gsung / slob dpan la rdzun byar mi rung snyam nas yod zhus/ grong pa ci byed dang khong rang gi lag na ci yod kyang 'drir byung bas/ gsal por zhus pas thug ches nas/ da dung sher gyin gsung sgrogs gsung bas sdud pa la zhal ton mdzad/ nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin de yang pha mtha' med/ ces bya ba'i skabs su sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin skyes nas de gyin chad mnyam rjes med gsung /de nas nyid phug tu bzhugs/ bsnyung gnas dang klog 'don la sogs pa la rgyun du brtson par mdzad/ de'i tshe rang dang gzhan la shar ba'i dag snang la'ang grangs med/ gzhan don rgya chen po mdzad nas dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa me pho rta la gshegs/ de'i slob ma sru pa rdo rje rgyal po ni/'khrungs yul zu sul sgang pa/ lo bdun nas 'bri klog tshar/ nyid phug tu bsnang gnas la phyin pa'i dge bsnyen cig gis bla ma'i gsol ras dang khrus chu byin pas 'gro snying 'dod de nying phug pa'i spyan sngar phyin pas/nying phug pa'i zhal nas/ khye'u 'dis rgyal ba'i sras kyi gdung 'dzin ba cig 'ong gsung nas/ pang du blangs dgyes par mdzad/ dge bsnyen nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi bar du mdzad/ mdo rtsa mkhas par mkhyen/ de nas ma shi'i bar du bsnyung gnas byed par zhus pas bla ma dgyes nas zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam shel gyi spyan ras gzigs cig kyang gnang / der bsnyung gnas bcad nas lo hril po lnga mdzad pas 'phags pa'i zhal gzigs/1178

dzub cig gi rmi lam na 'od dbagazed nga/nga sman bla la sogs ba snangs rgyas rnga nga byang chub sems dpa' mang pos bskor ba'i dbus na khong rang reng bu cig byed kyi 'dug pas/ de rnams na re/ nged rnams su yid du 'ong ba cig gi bu gyis gsung bas/ 'khor de'i dbus na khye'u dkar po lang tsho dar la bab pa cig 'dug pa de na re/ 'dis skye ba bcu bdun du nga la las 'brel bzhag pas nga'i bu'o gsung nas 'od zer thams cad khong rang la thim byung ba dang mnal sad de na gshegs khar zhang ston dgra 'jig kyis gdan sa gzung nas gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pha thugs rje chen po'i sku mang du byon zhing ring bgrelasung nga du byon no/ de'i slob ma zhang ston yin te/ 'khrungs yul zug gan ba ba/ 'khrungs pa'i dus su 'brug sgra chen po nas zlog dang g.yo ba byung bas/ dgra cig yod ba na re/ 'di 'dra 'ong ba 'jigs zer bas dgra 'jigs su btags/ lo bdun pa la yi sge bslabs spu ba la rab tu byung na 'i tu btsun bar gyur de nas sa skyar tshad ma lde bdun bslabs na lo snyi zhu rtsa gsum pa la grwa skor mdzad pas mkha par grags pa byung / de nas byam chos lnga/sa lde lnga mngon ngasagong 'oma'irnams la sbyangs/ dge bshes zhing mo che ba'i sar byon pas mkhan po mdzad la na pa'i bya ba mdzod gsung nas kun spyod gnang / mkhan po mjod pas bstan ba la phan ji bang byung /'dul ba lung thugs las gsungs pas ga pha lnga brgya re 'dus/ zugs 1179

dam gyi mthil sman bla dang sgrol ma la mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa'i dus tha ma'i sems can la 'di phan pas/ 'phags pa'i chos 'di bsgrubs gsung nas bsgrubs pas sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ nam phyed na sman bla zhal gziṭa/ nam langs khar spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong pa gzigs/ dbang bskur lung bstan/ de nas sru ba'i drung du bdag ri la 'gro zhus pas/ da dung gdan sa lo gsum gyis gsung nas shel gyi spyan ras gzigs gnang / de nas lo gsum song ba dang gdan sa dge bshes byang yes la gtad nas/ lung ba'i phu'i rdza rin chen spungs pa la sus kyang mi rnyed par zla ba gsum du bsnyung gnas mdzad/ zla ba bdun rgyun gcod mdzad/ snga dro nub ri dang phyi dro spu'i rdza gseb tu 'phur gyi nyi ma bsro ba la gshegs pa dang / spus chu la phyag mkhar rgyab nas nyin phyed tsam sgyur ba la sogs rdzu 'phrul kyang bstan/ sku 'da' khar thugs ma tshig par thong bas 'ga' rong du skyol/ ljags 'byon pas don mo rir skyol gsung nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig pa la gshegs pa'i gdung sbyangs pas ring srel bre gang byon no/ des mkhan chen rtsi 'dul ba thugs rje byang chub la gnang ste/ de ni gzhon nu la rab tu byung / spyir chos dang khyad par phar phyin la mkhas par gyur/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi snyan grags che bas gtsug lag khang rtsig pa dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ grwa rgyags dang tshul ri'adzugs sogs mdzad pas dge 'dun stong lhag tsam 'dus/ spyir 1180

sngo tha' sa cad la mkhas kyang gtso rba 'dul ba la mdzad pas tshul khrims kyi dri phun sum tshogs pa mnga'/ thugs dam gyi mthil sman bla dang sgrol ma la mdzad pa la/ nub cig mnal lam du/ bud med cig byung nas rigs kyi bu/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo spyan ras gzigs yin pas/ nang par ldog long du zhang ston dgra 'jigs la thugs bskyed gsung bar yod pas lung zhus/ 'gro don 'ong gsung nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas zhang ston dang mjal thuṭa bskyed kyang zhus bcu gcig zhal gyi lung lag len sgrub thabs bsnyen tshad dang bcas pa gnang / shin tu mnyes pa bsnyung gnas stong phrag gcig gi dam bca' mdzad pa las sum brgya song ba'i tshe sa ga'i tshes bcu drug gi nyin thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs/ gsung byon/ de nas yang yang zhal mjal te sems can du ma smin cing grol bar mdzad do/ de nas ldog long ba shākya byang chub la gnang ste/ 'khrungs yul ldog smad/ lo bdun pa la rab tu byung /bco lnga pa la phar phyin dang 'dul ba mkhyen nas sbrags bshad mdzad/ khyad par 'dul ba la mkhas/ sman bla dang sgrol ma la thugs dam mdzad/seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi zhal gzigs nas ldog stod kyi dgon pa 'debs par lung bstan/ rtsi 'dul gyi sar song la 'phaṭa pa'i sgrub thabs zhus shig par yang lung bstan pa bzhin sang nam nangs 'phral du byon nas zhal mjal lung zhus/ grangs bsnyen nyer gcig nga rang gi sar thong gsung nas 1181

bzhugs/ de nas sku ba da skye nas phar 'dul gyi bshad sar gyed pa nyi shu rtsa re lo re bzhin byung / bsnang gnas stong brag lnga'i da bca' mdzad pas/ sum brgya thengs pa'i dngos gzhi'i nub mo 'od zer dkar po cibatamadun na 'dug pa la/ lag bas 'jus pas khos phar khyer nas po ta lar sleb/ 'a ba'i pa'i gsung gis rigs kyi bu 'ong ba legs so gsung nas 'od zer dkar po cig snying gar thim pas lus bde bas gang / ma ṣ+ka bar lko mas can gyi don gyi shi nas ngas 'bod du btang gsung ba dang man da do/ nyin mo sdo snad kyi bshad pa dang gang la gang mos kyi chos mdzad/ mtshan mo ni 'phags pa'i drung du chos gsan/ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa mngon du mdzad do/ de'i slob ma mkhan chen chu bzangs 4byang chub 'bar yin te/ de ni mus kyi ngang dkar du 'khrungs/ lo bcu gcig la sdog long pa la dge bsnyen rgyas/ de na rab tu byung ste spyod 'jug dang dbu ma 'a sbyangs/ nyi shu pa la bsnyen par rdzogs/ nub gcig gi mnal lam du mi dkar po cig byung na / khyod dang nga 'khalas 'gril yod pas nga dang khyad med pa'i ldog 'ong pa la lung sgrub thab zhus gsung nas gshegs sang sdog slong pa'i spyan sngar 'byon nas lo rgyus zhus pas/ 'phaṭa pa min rgyabs su mchi/ nga la mang zi lam cig byung gsung nas lung sgrub thab lag len dang bca pa gnang /bde ba can du bsnyung gnas brgya rtsa gcig byas nas 'gro zhus pas/ da 182

dung 'phags pa'i zhal gzigs gzigs su sdod gsung / yun rings song yang 'gro zhus pas/ khyod dang gzhan mi 'dra bas rem la bsgrubs gsung pas/ sum brgya song ba'i tshe tshes bco lnga'i nub nam phyed yol ba dang nang thams cad 'od kyis gang byung bas/ mig 'khrul pa yin nam snyam nas gzigs pas 'phags pa 'khor bka' gdams brgyud pas bskor ba gzigs/ sang de ldog long pa'i drung du phyag btsal bas/ bu 'dang sems dga' 'am gsung / bdag sems spros pa las rnam par grol zhus pas/ da gar dgyes par bzhud la sems can gyi don mdzod gsung /der mus su byon pas sku bsod skyed nas zla re la bsnyung gnas sgrub pa chen po re mdzad/ yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs nas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa la gsheṭa so/ gdung sbyangs pas lha sku dang ring bsrel mang du byon no/ des snyag phu pa bsod nams dbang phyug la gnang ste/ mus dang ma gling skyar 'khrungs/ lo lnga la dge bsnyen mdzad nas klog yig bslabs/ bcu gcig pa la mkhan chen shākya mgon dang slob dpon 'od zer rtse mo las rab tu byung / bcu gsum pa la sdog long du mkhan chen kun rgyal dang zur chos zhang ston 'gyur med dpal la sogs la mdo rtsa ba bslabs/ mus chen pa'i drung du byams chos lnga la sbyangs/ slob dpon byang seng la rnam nges/ slob dpon shes rab ral gri la rnam 'grel dang sa sde zhus nas grwa skor kyang mdzad/ mnal lam du bud med gcig na re/1183

khyod la tshe zhag bdun las med zer ba byung bas/ mkhan chen chu bzangs pa'i gsung nas/ tshe sgrub tu bsnyung gnas zab gsung nas byas pas sku tshe bsrings/ mkhan chen chu bzang ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bka' gdams kyi chos mang du gsan/ mus gle lung du gro mo che'i gdan sa lo lnga mdzad/ chos rje nyan chen pa la lam 'bras dang dam pa'i chos skor la sogs zhus/ slob dpon grags tshul la phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs mang du zhus/ sa ga'i zla ba la bsnyung gnas lo gsum mdzad/ de rjes yon bdag rnams kyis snyag phu'i dgon pa brtsigs nas phul/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyan chen pa/ chu bzangs pa/ mus chen pa/ rgyal mtshan dpal rnams la mdzad/ gzhan yang bla ma bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi zhabs la gtugs/ 'phags pa'i phrin las dar bar bzhed nas bsnyung gnas khri tsho gcig bya bar bzhed nas stong phrag gnyis thengs pa dang cha rkyen rnams zad pa dang / rmi lam bzang bar byung nas slar yang yo byad rnams 'phel nas/ lo gsum gyi khongs su bsnyung gnas thengs/ gzhan yang bsnyung gnas kyi phrin las dpag tu med pa spel/ gzhan gyi dag snang la spyan ras gzigs su mthong ba'ang grangs med pa byung / dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad pa phag lo la gshegs/ de'i slob ma mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams bzang po yin te/ de'i yab dang yum dang rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i tshigs snga phyi'i rim pa dang / sku na gzhon pa'i dus su 1184

longs spyod ji lta bu dang ldan pa sogs ni gzhan du shes par bya zhing /rab tu byung nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du spyir tshul khrims dang ldan pa rnams kyi gtso bo yin/ khyad par du stan gcig dang rdor dkar gyi dam bca' ba sku bgres pa la sogs pa'i snyad ci yang med par sku tshe dang 'grogs/mkhas pa'i yon tan nya dpon po kun dga' dpal la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang po bsten nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba gzhir gzung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi sde sdod dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor los gtso byas pa'i gsang sngags kyi phyogs la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ rtsod pa na mkhas pa chen po g.yag phyug sangs rgyas dpal la sogs pas kyang mi bzlogs/ yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs/ rmi na lag drug la sogs pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pas chos rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i slob ma'i gtso bor gyur/ dgung lo brgyad cu lhag tsam na 'chi ltas kyi rnam pa byung ba la rlung sbyor zla ba gcig mdzad pas legs par sku tshe bsrings te 'khrungs lo lcags mo sbrul/ dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa chu mo glang gi li la mnyel ba med par gshegs/ bu slob kyang chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang mthong ba don ldan dang bcas pa'i 'dren ba mdzad/ smra ba'i seng ge rong ston la sogs pa'i mkhas pa dpag tu med pa yang me tog la bung ba bzhin du 'du/ 'phral gyi longs spyod ni rnam thos kyi bus ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du sgrub/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i che dgu 1185

thams cad kyis ni zhabs spyi bor len/ grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal nags kyi rin chen yang bod na rnal 'byor pa 'di kho na bzang zhes gsung / de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po des 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub gzhung phyag len rnams 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bsod nams dar la gnang / des kyang dge slong gi bslab pa rnam par dag pa la gnas/ sems byang chub kyi mchog tu bskyed/ 'dod pa chung ba dang chog shes pa rnams kyi gtso bo byas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub pa la rgyun du gnas pas/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rab tu byung ba yang mang du byung bas ding sang dbus 'phags dang gtsang 'phags shes bya ba'i sde gnyis su chags/ bco lnga tsam dang bcu re tsam dang / mtha' nga lnga re tsam 'dus pa'i sde phran gyis ni dwags kong / dbus g.yor/la stod lho byang thams cad du khyab snang bas bstan pa la phan shin tu che'o/thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs kyi brgyud pa'i skabs so/don zhags dmar khrid zla rgyal lugs kyi skabs/yang 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa'i brgyud pa ni/ parnyi ta e ra pa ti zhes bya ba rgya gar sto phyogs pa yin pa zhig rgya gar sto phyogs na dad pa'i stobs kyi gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba zhig yod par phyin nas/rab tu byung nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i pa: ta chen por gyur 1186

pa zhig rang gi yul du 'ongs nas ma la chos bstan nas der khang pa cig gi steng thog tu bcags pas so phag gi dum bu zhig lhung ba ma'i mgo la phog nas shi/ 'di 'dra ba'i rigs la srog gcod pa'i dngos gzhi ni mi 'ong ste/ slob dpon a de bas/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong du/ dge slong gis ni pha rgan la/ myur 'dong zhes ni bskul gyur te/ phul bas shi bar gyur kyang ni/ pham par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ zhes gsungs bas so/'on kyang stabs nyes pas nyes pa de sbyang ba'i phyir don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa zla ba drug tu byas pas rtags gang yang ma byung / de lta bu lan gnyis su byas pas kyang rtags ma byung / gsum du byas pas kyang ma byung ba la/der tsan dan gyi phreng ba cig phyag tu gzung nas gyi tri lo kya'i sngags bzlas pa'i 'phro la gnyid du song bas lag nas phreng ba yang shor/ gnyid sad pa na sa gzhi thams cad mdangs dang 'od kyis khyab/ me tog dang spos chu'i char bab/ de nas phyogs rnams su bltas pas ci yang ma mthong /rang nyid 'dug pa'i shing sdong la bltas pas don yod zhags pa lha lnga shing sdong la gsal bar byon 'dug pas/ 'phags pa thugs rje re chung /nga sgrib pa che zhus pas/ nga dang khyod 'bral ma myong gsung nas chos mang du gsungs shing / de nas gzung ste ji ltar 'dod pas chos gsan chog par gyur/ der yul gzhan du phyin nas 'phags pa'i chos spel dgos snyam pa la/ ma bsad pa'i sdig can yin zer nas mi rnams kyis ma mnyan pas/1187

dpal bī ru ba la sogs pa'i grub thob mang du 'dus nas khong la chos gsan pas yul de'i rgyal pos khyed rnams grub pa thob kyang sdig can 'di 'dra ba la chos zhu ba byas pas/ grub thob rnams kyis 'di grub thob rnams kyi gtso bo yin sngar gyi de thams cad 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul yin gsungs pas/ der rgyal pos kyang bshags pa phul nas thams cad dad par gyur/g.yog dge bsnyen cig yod pas zhus pas de'i don du don zhags kyi sgrub thabs kyang mdzad/ e ra pa tis/ sto phyogs kyi rigs ngan rnal 'byor pa la gnang / de ni grub pa thob pas gru pas gaṅgā la gru ma btang bas kha tsāb chu bo la rgyab pas gaṅgā bad kyis chad pa cig yin/ de la parnyi ta don yod rdo rje rdo rje gdan pas zhus/ yang pa ta dharma ka pā las thugs rje chen po la gsan/ des bde mchog gi grub pa thob pa bsod stoms pa chen po la bshad/ des don yod rdo rje la bshad/ don yod rdo rje ni rdo rje gdan pa che ba'i mtshan te/ des bla ma ba ri la bshad/ yang / kha sarba ṇi'i gtsug lag khang na 'phags pa'i spyan 'dren la bo dge bsnyen des 'phags pa'i bsnyen bkur byed pa la/ de gshegs rjes su 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen gzhan zhig yod pa de la 'phags pas khyod rab tu byung zhig ces lung bstan/ des dge bsnyen gzhan zhig 'phags pa'i g.yog tu bzhag ste bai kra ma shrī lar phyin nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan ni shrī la ā ka ra zhes bya/ des pazlo ta be ro tsa na la bshad/ des ba ri 1188

la bshad/ yang pasnyi ta chos ston zhes bya ba zhig gis kha sapo ṇir 'phags pa la mchod pa byas pas rmi lam du chos gsungs/ phyis mngon sum du yang chos bstan/ des parnyi ta don yod rdo rje la gsungs/ des ba ri la bstan te/ ba ri ni 'khrungs yu la khams pa sngom tshang / lcags pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ lo 'di la rje btsun mi la yang 'khrungs/ khams su kha che'i pasnyi ta cig byon pas mngon pa dang zhal gnyis ma chung ba gsan/rgya gar du 'byon bzhed pas gser srang bdun cu lhag cig rnyed pa khyer nas dbus su byon pas/ lo bco lnga lon pa la jo bo rje dang snye thang du mjal/ byin brlabs zhus pas rdo rje gdan pa'i sar song zhig bar chad mi 'ong gsung nas lung bstan/ la stod dpal thang la byon pas bshas lug brgya tsam ded byung bas/ snying rje skyes byung bas gser zho res blus nas gnas gzhi cig tu tshe thar du phul/ bal por phebs nas rgya gar du 'gro ba la 'jigs pa dang bcas shing lam thag thung ba dang / 'jigs pa med cing lam thag ring ba gnyis yod pa las/ lam thag nye ba la 'jigs pa mi 'ong ba'i yid dam gyi lung bstan byung / sang gaṅgā brgal ba'i do nub rmi lam du spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa cig gzigs/ ko sa la gra mar tsa mi dang mjal/ gser zho re'i phyag rten lan gnyis su phul/ khong gis khri shā rkarmas bzos/ sangs rgyas kyis rab gnas gnang ba'i sku gcig bstan byung bas rmi lam dang mthun par byung / de mthong 1189

bas ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes/ de nas rgya gar du bzhugs ring rnamasasu 'phags pa byon nas gtam mang po gsung ba rgyun par byung / rnal 'byor ma yang zhal ston du 'ongs pa yang phyir log zer ba cig kyang byung / 'phaṭa pa bshum pa cig kyang byon/ ci nyes zhus pas shing stan can gyis btson drug cu gzung nas de rnams btson dong du sbrul dang sbal pa la sogs pas gtses shing nyen nas skad ngan 'don gyi 'dug pas snying rje gsungs bas/sang de kha ltar 'dug nas rgyal po la gser srang gang 'bul btson rnams thong zhus pas/ mi re la gser srang re ma byung na mi gtong zer bas gser srang drug cus btson rnams bston/ sbrul gyis mas pa la sogs pa'i nad pa rnams gso ba'i thabs sman pa bos nas/ de la gser srang gang byin pas byang chub sems dpa'i grags pa chen po byung / yang 'phags pa bshum gyi 'dug pa ci nyes zhus pas/ rgyus lo tsā ba'i gser gnyal pas khyer bas kho sdug bsngal gsungs bas/ rgyus lo'i rtsar sang phyin nas ci byung byas pas/ nga 'dra ba'i bsod nams chung ba zer bas/ gser zho do sbyin pas dga'/ bod du 'byon par brtsams pa na rmi lam du yi dgas mang po byung nas/ ma hā lo tsā ba khyod bod du 'gro ba la/ 'jigs pa mi 'ong bar 'dug si/ nged la gtor ma byin la rgyug zer bas 'bras mi khur bcu gcig la gtor ma byas nas btang / gser lhag mas mnga' ris pa mang po byung ba'i sna len byas pa la/ khong rnams na re/ pazlo 1190

ta ba ra he ta mnga' ris su byon nas byams chos dang rigs tshogs gsung gi yod zer ba la/ bal yul nas gung thang du byon/ de nas gro shod nas spu hrangs su byon nas parnyi ta la rigs tshogs gsan sngon lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'jam dpal sgrol ma rnams bltar phyin pas/ de nub rmi lam du sgrol ma'i zhabs kyi mthe bong sogs nyams pa gsos zer ba rmis pas/ gser gyis gor shi sha nyos nas gsos/ yang rgya gar du byon nas rdo rje gdan pa la 'phags pa'i skor la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan nas slar bod du byon/ yas man mang por 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ 'phags pa'i chos skor sbyin pa'i slob ma mang du yod kyang khyad par du gyur pa snubs phag mo lung pa/ nye gnas sto ba/gung thang gi mkhan pa thang pa rnams la 'phags pa'i chos skor rnams gsungs/ de gsum ga la grub thob zhang zhung pas gsan/ de la skye ma graṭa tshul gyis gsan/ des klu sgrub la/ des bla ma dka' bzhi pa/des don zhags pa shes rab brtson 'grus/ des don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'tshal du si tu dge blo ba'i mkhan lo mdzad pas mkhan chen sang rin pa zhes zer/ spyan yas kyi mkhan po rgyal tsha dang mjal nas spyan yas su 'phags pa'i chos skor gyis gdul bya bskyangs/ stod smad gzhan rnams su byon nas phyis mya ngan las 'da' khar/ nga shin tu btsun pa'i gras spyan yas su skyol gsung / spyan yas su phebs te gshegs/1191

/dung rnams rdza'i mchod rten na ding sang yang bzhugs/ de la don zhags kyi skor slob dpon gzhon nu smon lam bas gsan/ de la mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'bum dpal bas gsan te/ phrin las kyi rgyun da lta'i bar du ma chad par yod do/ yang dwa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba jo bo rje'i dbon po bskal bzangs kyi byang chub sems dpa' yin pa zhig gis 'phaṭa pa la dngos su zhus/ de la parnyi ta shrīdha na zhes bya ba mkhas pa cig yin pa la/ phyis nyin byang chub chen po la mchod pa byed cing mtshan dur khrod du sgom pa zhig yod pa/ mnga' ris pa'i lo tsā ba 'phags tshul gyis bal por spyan drangs pa'i tshe byang sems zla rgyal gyis dbang dang byin brlabs zhus shing 'phags pa'i skor rnams kyang gsan/ gzhan la bskyis nas gser srang bdun phul/ pazlo ta des chog gsung nas lo tsā ba dang gnyis po rgya gar du bzhud/ byang chub sems dpa' la grub thob zhang zhung ba/de la skye ma grags tshul/ de la bla ma 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan/ de la zhig po kun grol/ de la la mo ba sangs rgyas ston pa/ de la sangs rgyas dbon bo/ de la gzhon nu blo gros/ de la grags pa rgyal mtshan/de la grags pa bzang po/ de la bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis zhus te/chos phug don zhags su ming btags nas skya ser shin du/ mang po la phan pa che zhing snyan par grags so/ yang byang sems zla rgyal nas/ nyid phug pa/skye ma grags tshul/ grub thob dkon mchog grags/ sangs rgyas 'jam 1192

rgyal/ thugs rje rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ skyes mchog klu sgrub/ dka' bzhi pa dko/ na mchog gzhon nu/ 'jam dbyangs thugs rje shes rab/ kun mkhyen yon tan mgon po/ bla ma gzhon nu byang chub/ shangs pa kun mkhyen/ yang / grang po lung pa/ bla chen pa/'chims nam mkha' grags/ bsod nams ye shes/ mkhan po grags pa gzhon nu/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/chos rje rgya ma pa yon tan 'od/ kun mkhyen shangs pa/ de bdag la gnang ba lags/ yang / don zhags lha lnga'i dbang rigs gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ shī la ā ka ra/ bai ro tsa na rabata/ba ri lo tsā ba/ skye ma grags tshul/ snar thang pa'i slob dpon don zhags pa/ mkhan chen skyo/ byang chen pa bsod 'phel/ bag ston pa/bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ gan mkhyen shangs pa/ des bdag la gnang ba yin no/ gyuzhal bcu gcig pa'i dbang rigs gtad kyang brgyud rim de nyid las bdag la gnang ba lags so/thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid byang sems zla rgyal lugs ni/ skyi tsha 'od 'byung gis byang sems kyi snyan pa thos nas zhabs drung du phyin pas spyan ras gziṭa su mthong res bla mar mthong / yang mos gus drag po skyes res kyis spyan ras gzigs su mthong ba de la/ byang sems kyi zhal 1193

na khyod kyi chos kyis 'gro don 'ong gsungs nas gnang / de la zhang dbu dkar bas gsan te/ de ni sngon 'gro'i ma ṇi la nus pa rnyed nas lha 'dre la phrin btang bas chog pa dang bden tshig grub pa byung / chos 'dis gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs/ des zhang lo tsā ba mya ngan med pa'i sa dpal la gsungs/ khong gi mnal lam du thugs rje chen po'i zhal yang yang gzigs shing chos gsan chog pa byung / des mkhan po byang chub rin chen la gnang ste/ de yang chos la nus pa thon zhing 'gro don rgya che bar byung /de'i slob mas kyang spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba mang du byung / des lce sgom shes rab rdo rje la gsungs/ des grub thob hūm 'bar la gsungs te/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs shing mi ma yin gyis gtor ma dngos su len pa cig byon/ des mkhan chen byang chub dpal la gsungs/ 'dis phyag rdor dang mgon po'i zhal gzigs shing mngon par shes pa yang thogs pa med par mnga' ba yin/ des dpal rgyal ba grub pa la gnang / khong gi sa gnas thugs rje rdzong du lha lnga'i bsnyen pa mdzad pas bcu gcig zhal zhal gzigs pa la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'o/ des mkhan chen 'dzims chen pa la gnang ste/ yi dam gyi zhal gzigs shing rtogs pa 'khrungs/ des kun spangs ri khrod pa la gsungs shing / yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ des mkhan chen gzhon nu 'bum la gnang / des don yod gzhon nu la gnang / des chos rje chu tshan kha ba shes rab dpal 1194

ba la gsungs/ des skyes mchog nam mkha' bzang po la gnang ba'o/don zhags dang dmar khrid zla rgyal lugs kyi skabs so/ /la stod dmar po'i skabs/la stod dmar po las 'ongs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i chos skor ji ltar byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes/ des zhwa ba pa'am spyod pa ba/ des dur khrod pa'am bai ru ba la/ des rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ des la stod dmar po la gnang ba yin te/ 'khrungs yul 'u yug yab sgom chen lha brtan dang / yum ar mo sing nga gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ gdung ram yin/ byis pa'i dus tsa na byis pa drug gis khyi smyon rdo rub kyis bsad/ de'i ro la sngags pa hom byed pa'i lad mo byas nas bra ma'i gseb tu bsregs pas klu dang thug nas byis pa zla bo rnams lo dus su shi/ khong la yang bsnyun gyis zin/ khu bo dge bshes gcig gi sar mi g.yo ba'i dmigs pa'i sgor zhugs bzlas pa dum re byas kyang yid ma ches/ khu bo'i lad mo byas pas khu bo yang ma dgyes/ slob dpon du gnyen ngan bya ba yin pas khyod rang gzhan du so nga gsung / da 'o na shi yang rgya gar du 'gro snyam nas a de phyug rma ci ga 'i g.yu gang dmar rkang chogs bya ba yod pa pha spun mo cig bag ma la 'gro ba'i chas la g.yar ba skad byas nas g.yu de se ba'i dbyug pa 1195

gcigags/ pa cig gi nang du brdzangs nas khyer te la stod du byon/ ding rir zhag gcig bsdad/ de nas shas shig byon pa na dbyug pa lus nas log ste 'ongs pas/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyis dbyug pa de byin byung /khab gung thang du sleb tsa na mar pa lo tsā bya ba'i gos nag gyon khyi nag khrid pa cig rgya gar du 'gro bar 'dug pa la/ lam gyi mgo 'don grogs zhus pas/ lho bal du g.yu mi brin 'di gser du bsgyur dgos zer bas la stod du log btsongs pas gser srang bzhi bcu rtsa drug khugs/ mar lo de mgon po bsten par 'dug pas mgon po'i sgrub thabs zhus/ rgya gar gyi thang khab du sleb tsa na/ rmi lam du nyi ma rang la thim/ zla ba lag tu thogs/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba cig rmi 'phro la gnyid sad pas bred pa cig kyang byung / mar lo la bshad pas bred mi dgos/ nyi ma rang thim pa chos zab mo khong du chud 'ong ba'i brda' yin/ zla ba lag tu thogs pa de gzhan don 'ong ba'i brda' yin/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba de snang ba zil gyis non pa'i brda' yin zer/ de nas rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du sleb gser phyed phul nas/ tshe 'di'i bar chad sel ba dang phyi ma la byang chub thob pa'i thabs cig zhu byas pas/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas gnang / smyug ma'i sbubs rna ba la btsugs nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ gsungs pas kho gi rtog pa la 'di bod na rgan rgon dang byis pas kyang shes/ chos 'dis rgyal mi thub bam snyam pa dang / bla mas mkhyen nas 1196

gser tshur gtad/ zhal ngo gnag par 'dug pas de mar lo la bshad/mar lo na re/ de bla ma ma mnyes pa yin/ nga bshags pa bya dgos/bshags thabs kyang bla ma la zhus zer/ zhus nas/ dri chen dri chu la zas gyis gsung nas byas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur gnang ba bsgoms/ yi ge drug pa zla ba gcig tu bzlas pas rmi lam na sdig sbrul mang po lus las 'thon pa rmis/ mal chu ser gyis gang / yid dang sing ba snyam byed/ sha ro dad pa la ldogs sogs kyang mi 'dug phar cham tshur cham byas/ sang snga bar bla ma'i drung du phyin/ gser srang gcig la ma la byas/ thugs rje chen po'i rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / rdo rje gdan du bsgoms pas rmi lam du sgrol mas bsil ba tshal du song zhig ces lung bstan/ rdo rje gdan pa la zhus pas ma 'gro gsung / yang rje btsun ma mngon sum du gzigs te song gsung ba'i lung bstan byung / rdo rje gdan pa la zhus pas da khyod rang mkhas song zhig gsung / bsil ba tshal du nu gro t+ta'i shing sdong rtsar bsdad pas sbrul nag po chen po zhig gis shing sdong de la se bcings su bcings/ dbugs mi thon pa 'dra ba byung / mnyam par bzhag pas de ma thag grol te/ sbrul de rnams sras su gyur nas rang gi snying po phul ci 'dod sgrub par khas blangs so/ de nas gaṅga'i 'gram du mu stegs rnams dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran pas kyang mu stegs kyis ma thub par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud/1197

de'i chos ni rdo rje gdan pas gnang ba rnams dang / bsil ba tshal du byon pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro mas lus kyi rkyen dang bar chad sel ba'i phyir du 'chi ba bslu ba'i gdams ngag lam lnga dus gcig tu bgrod pa la lam sbyor ba lnga/ sdig sgrib sbyang zhing nus pa dang ldan pa'i phyir dbang bzhi khug pa/ chos thams cad dus gcig la nyams su blang ba'i phyir stong pa bco brgyad thugs rje chen po'i ngang du dril ba'i gdams ngag gsungs pa rnams so/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung la brten nas gsang spyod lo drug mdzad/de nas stag tshang seng ge phug tu lo bdun sgrub pa mdzad/ thed du grub rtags mang po bstan/ de nas nyin lam bco lnga nyi ma phyed kyis bcad nas lcog ro 'bring mtshams su sleb/ de'i tshe na bza' jag dmar cig dang dbu la she thong cig yod pas dam pa dmar por grags/ rgya ma nye khar gdan phab si rib dang gro po'i bar du byon/ der gar log gi dmag gis 'jigs 'dug pa la pha bong mda' rgyab pas zang thal du song ba de mthong nas log 'bring mtshams su nye 'don dus mtsho dang bre chung du sbra dkar phul nas bzhugs pas mtsho sman gyis mtsho lug phul ba kun gyis mthong / de lta bu la sogs pa nus pa dang gdams pas gzhan gyi don yun ring du mdzad nas mthar myu gu lung du slob ma cig gis dug btang bas mkhyen bzhin du bzhes te grongs/ spur sbyangs pas gdung nyung zad cig dang ring bsrel shin tu mang bar byung ngo / dam pa dmar po de ni nyid 1198

yin par rkar ma pa shis zhal gyis bzhes te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas so/ de la sras gnyis las mkhas pa bsod nams rin chen gyis yab kyis ma gnang bar lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe 'jad pa ston skyabs kyi sar slob gnyer byas/ lo gcig lon nas yab kyis rgyags bong rgyab bcu drug tsam bskyal/ da slob gnyer byas kyi rting la spros pa chod pa cig gyis shig gsung / 'dis ni zhang e pa'i chos grar yang yun ring du bzhugs/lo bcu gnyis pa nas so gnyis pa'i bar du sbyangs pa mdzad nas sngags mtshan nyid kyi chos ma lus pa mkhyen par mdzad/ bar du sbyangs pa'i phrin las mthar phyung ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bton/ tha ma sbyangs pa yal bar ma dor te ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin/ shin tu mkhas par gyur nas las kyi me long la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad nas gzhan la phan pa mdzad/ sku gshegs nas bde mchog yab yum gyi sku dang ring bsrel mang du byon no/ chung ba bha ru ni/ lo bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe yab kyi zhal nas/ nga yang 'gro ba'i dus la bab gdams ngag rnams bya'o/gsung nas lcim chu rdo phug tu mkha' 'gro ma'i chos skor rnams gnang /mang gar mda' ru thugs rje chen po'i gzhung khrid rnams gnang / gdan sa nye khar sgru ba thabs rnams ma lus par gnang ste/ khyed kyis sgrub pa gtso bor gyis shig 'gro don nus pa zhig 'ong galang nas lung bstan/nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa nam mkha' ltar gyur te smyon pa lta bu'i spyod 1199

pas sems can gyi don mdzad do/ smyon pa sdom chung ni/ myang stod kyi gtso bo rgya gar bya ba'i sras yin/ byis pa nas dam pa dmar po'i phyags phyir byon te gdams pa rnams zhus/ rtogs pa thob nas sdum bu bar mdzad de gtsang gi sa phyogs rnams dang lha sa dang bsam yas rnams su yang shas re bzhuṭa/ phyis 'phyog su byon te khang chung re tsam brtsigs nas bzhugs pa la yul pa rnams phrag dog byed pas brtsiṭa shing rang gis gshig pa mang po byas/ de nas ri po'i dgon pa btab ste de nyid du 'gro ba'i don mang po mdzad cing gshegs so/ des dmar po'i gdams pa rnams slob dpon dkon gnyer la gnang ste/ gdams ngag gi lung rgyun da dung yod do/ la stod dmar po'i skabs so/ /khro phu ba las ba da pa'i skabs/rje btsun mi tra dzo gis gsungs pa'i chos rnams kyi lo rgyus la/ rje btsun mi tra ni/ rgya gar gyi shar phyogs radhe'i yul gyi grong khyer chen por 'khrungs te/ til+li pa'i dngos kyi slob ma rol pa'i rdo rjes rjes su gzung nas kha sarba ṇa lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pas spyan ras gziṭa 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du byon nas chos bstan pas grub pa brnyes pa ni dang po ste/ mtshan ni a dzi ta mi tra gubha zhes bya'o/ ral gcig mas thabs lam bstan te gang 'dod thams cad shing stan mdun du byas nas gsol ba 1200
